properties.name: NC State University Centennial Campus
properties.description: Centennial Campus is a 1,314-acre research park and campus located less than a mile from the main campus of N.C. State University. Owned and operated by N.C. State, the campus is home to more than 70 corporate, governmental and non-profit “partners,” along with 75 N.C. State research centers, institutes and departmental units and numerous colleges. In addition to the buildings and research centers, Centennial Campus also contains public walkways, a fishing pier and lake, game fields and an 18-hole golf course. In 2012, the university’s main library was relocated to a state-of-the-art facility located on Centennial, making it a true “live, learn, work and play” environment.

properties.name: 1705 East
properties.description: 1705 East in North Raleigh is an ideal meeting space for corporate events, board meetings, sales trainings, employee celebrations and more. Our Capital Room can accommodate up to 80 people classroom style and up to 160 people reception style. Our Rutherford Room can accommodate up to 48 with classroom style seating and up to 72 with reception style seating. These spaces can be booked separately or together. Affordable meeting space fees include an A/V package, free parking, tables and chairs, and use of common areas for small break out groups. Premium in-house catering is offered by Rocky Top Catering, including breakfast, lunch, dinner, morning and afternoon snacks, and beverages. Make your meetings stand out from the others with our first-class venue with premium catering.

properties.name: 419 Glenwood
properties.description: Located in the middle of Glenwood South, this entire three-level venue can hold roughly 800 guests. This venue is ideal for both large or small company functions with all three levels being a little different than the first!

properties.name: 421 N. Harrington St.
properties.description: 421 N. Harrington St. is a nine-story, 225,000-RSF, Class A office atop a ground-level lobby with bicycle center surrounded by active retail space. Collaborative amenity spaces include outdoor terraces and varied conferencing options with flexibility for large groups. Industrial influenced design embraces today’s progressive workplace while feeling connected to historical context of the neighborhood.

properties.name: A Step to Gold International Ballroom
properties.description:
The Ballroom has a 2,400 square foot floating floor for public dancing and two other smaller teaching studios. A Step to Gold International Ballroom offers a wide variety of instruction and social dances accompanied by music of the Big Band sounds, Ballroom, Shag, Swing and Latin. A Step to Gold instructors make sure students have a friendly, fun and supportive learning experience. Offering classes from the very beginner to the advanced competitor we know how to have a good time. Their students rave about how much they enjoy the positive learning environment and special events.


One meeting space is available during the day until 6pm Monday thru Friday and the entire facility is available evenings on Friday and Saturdays. The capacity is 225 and can seat 180 in the larger 2,400 square foot space surrounded by windows and a balcony. Special lighting creates a very romantic atmosphere. They also have an events coordinator that can make sure your event is organized on their end.

properties.name: AMF South Hills Lanes
properties.description: AMF South Hills lanes offer traditional bowling on 32 lanes with flat-screen scoring monitors, along with a bar/lounge area seating 70 and a meeting room with the capacity of up to 30 people. Watch your favorite sports or catch the latest news on two flat-screen TVs or challenge your friends to some arcades, pool or air hockey. Specials run every night of the week and they offer group events, birthday parties and fundraisers. A Pro Shop is available on-site and the center is wheelchair accessible, non-smoking and features off-street parking.

properties.name: Agri Supply Exposition Center at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
properties.description: Ideal for trade shows, exhibitions, festivals, meetings or conventions.

properties.name: Agri-Waste Technology, Inc.
properties.description: Classroom style seating with full A/V equipment capabilities including: powerpoint presentations, DVD/VCR, surround sound, satellite TV, overhead projector, slide projector, remote equipment access through touch screen podium, and floor outlets.

properties.name: All Saints Chapel
properties.description: Built in 1875, All Saints Chapel has been an integral part of downtown Raleigh's charm for over a century. Its details have been perfectly restored, and the open floor plan of the Chapel and Reception Hall make customizing your meeting or special event easy. We can accommodate up to 200 guests for theater style seating in the chapel, 140 guests for a seated reception upstairs, 120 guests for a seated reception downstairs, and up to 200 guests for a mixed standing/seated reception upstairs. The house sound system and prep-kitchen for catered events provide the necessaries for your event, while the beautiful stained-glass windows and classic woodwork provide a stunning backdrop.

properties.name: Alston-Massenburg Center
properties.description: The Alston-Massenburg Center is adjacent to Taylor Street Park and offers large meeting space with performance stage, theater curtains, automated projector and screen. There is also two smaller meeting rooms and a kitchen available for use when the facility is rented out.

properties.name: Anderson Point Amphitheater
properties.description: Anderson Point's outdoor amphitheater is a wonderful location for wedding ceremonies.  The amphitheater is situated along the park trail and sits next to a large open field.  It is not far from the parking lot and is handicap accessible.  Each level of the terraced lawn is separated by beautiful stone borders accented with evergreen boxwoods.

properties.name: Anderson Point Cottage
properties.description: The cottage at Anderson Point is a charming retreat for all events from small conferences, to weddings, to birthday parties and anniversaries.  The exposed beams and all wood interior  take you back to a slower pace era.  The cottage contains a full kitchen with an industrial sized ice maker, tables and chairs for guests and an open yet intimate floor plan.

properties.name: Angus Barn
properties.description: The Wine Cellar dining rooms offer elegant, silent and formal service for parties of 12 to 34. Private dining is available in four, five and six courses with wine paired by the cellar master. The rooms are adjacent to the wine cellar that houses a 25,000 bottle collection. The Angus Barn Pavilion is a lakeside banquet facility for weddings, reunions, picnics and corporate business functions of 100-500.

properties.name: Avery Street Recreational Facility
properties.description: Avery Street Recreation Center features a gymnasium with a wood floor surrounded by two multipurpose rooms, a meeting room and a game room. The facility is primarily used for programs sponsored by the Parks and Recreation Department, such as athletics, nature, preschool, youth and teen, adult and senior adult activities. The Recreation Center is available for rental when there is not a program scheduled.

properties.name: Ballroom, Talley Student Center at North Carolina State University
Bass Lake Park
properties.description: Bass Lake Park is open year-round from 8am-sunset and offers a visitor’s and environmental education center, conference room, deck, floating dock, free bank fishing, hiking trail and a wildlife observation platform. Facilities are available to be rented out as are canoes and jon boats to those ages 16 years and up. Bass Lake is proud to be an N.C. Environmental Education Center and features an extensive nature library with books and resources for all ages. Events and programs are held on a regular basis for people of all ages.

properties.name: Bloomsbury Bistro
properties.description: This intimate, private banquet facility includes three separate dining rooms. The main dining room seats up to 60 guests comfortably. This room may also be separated into two smaller rooms providing private accommodations for groups of up to 20 or 30. With an experienced, attentive yet unobtrusive staff at your service, Bloomsbury Bistro is able to accommodate any venue, whether you are making a business presentation or are celebrating a wedding, anniversary or birthday.

properties.name: Bond Park Community Center
properties.description:
Located within Fred G. Bond Metro Park, the 29,000-square-foot Bond Park Community Center provides opportunities for athletic programs, fitness and activity classes. The Town of Cary's second community center, which was dedicated in 2000, has three full-time and several part-time staff members. This staff coordinates the popular Summer Day Camp and Teen Adventure Camp, offered during the summer months, and many other fitness and wellness programs for individuals and families. The community center is adjacent to the Cary Senior Center. 

•2 gymnasiums: Sycamore Gymnasium and Magnolia Gymnasium
•2 meeting rooms with kitchenettes: Oak Room and Maple Room 
•1 small meeting room: Dogwood Room
•Locker rooms 
•Vending area

properties.name: Bosendorfer Hall at Ruggero Piano
properties.description:
Ruggero Piano is a third generation family owned business of piano technicians that offers the highest level of piano service, restoration and selection since 1958. Their shared passion and knowledge of the piano has allows them to offer the highest rated collection of new and pre-owned pianos in the area, backed by a reputation for quality service. at Ruggero they encourage research and offer a low-pressure and educational approach to piano service, restoration and selection!

Performances are occasionally held in Bosendorfer Hall at Ruggero Piano.

properties.name: Bowlero Raleigh
properties.description: AMF Pleasant Valley Lanes offers traditional bowling on 40 lanes in their renovated center. Along with a bar/lounge area, the center boasts a new meeting room with a capacity of up to 36 people. Watch your favorite sports on six flat-screen TVs or challenge your friends to some arcades, pool or air hockey. Specials run every night of the week and they offer group events, birthday parties and fundraisers. A Pro Shop is available on-site and the center is wheelchair accessible, non-smoking and features off-street parking.

properties.name: Bridge Club
properties.description: Bridge Club is a social gathering space and event loft located on the second and third floors of a beautiful, historic bank building in downtown Raleigh. This venue is designed to accommodate a wide array of events, from rehearsal dinners to corporate meetings.

properties.name: Brier Creek Country Club
properties.description: Brier Creek Country Club offers an array of accommodations for any gathering. Conveniently located near Research Triangle Park and RDU International Airport, Brier Creek is an ideal location for you to inspire creative and productive functions with your family or business associates. Whether you are planning an intimate dinner, a luncheon or an extravagant gala, Brier Creek Country Club has everything you’ll need to make your celebration memorable. With beautiful views and delectable cuisines, your guests will enjoy a unique and gratifying experience. Our private events team will go above and beyond to make planning your event as easy as possible so you can revel in your special day.

properties.name: Buffaloe Lanes North
properties.description: Number of lanes: 42; scoring system: electronic; air conditioning: yes; parking capacity: 400

properties.name: Burning Coal Theatre
properties.description:
Burning Coal Theatre Company's beautiful flexible theatre space, The Murphey School Auditorium, hosts many Burning Coal performances and is available for rent for shows, weddings, receptions, parties, meetings and presentations.


Photo: City of Raleigh Arts Commission photos, Right Image Photo, Inc.; Prisoner's Dilemma photo, Right Image Photo, Inc.; The Dance photo, Right Image Photo, Inc.

properties.name: CAM Raleigh
properties.description:
CAM Raleigh (Contemporary Art Museum) provides beautiful event spaces that inspire: breathtaking light-filled street views and a spacious meeting room, and more. Architecture, art, and exceptional service: the Museum is the perfect place for celebrations, children and teen birthday parties, special events, or meetings. The Museum is committed to helping plan and execute your event, and catering and decor is available on-site through several of our preferred vendors.

Booking a rental and hosting an event at CAM Raleigh is easy. You can place a reservation, receive further rental and event planning information, meet personally for a tour, officially book a rental space, and assist you from beginning to end with the many aspects of your event.

properties.name: Car Space Raleigh
properties.description:
Car Space Raleigh is a work, networking and cultural hub for the Raleigh professional and automotive enthusiast communities. Inspiring work and meeting spaces come together with relaxed yet refined social spaces, encouraging members to flow seamlessly between work and play.

Car Space Raleigh offers a diverse set of creative spaces including 60-140 ft2 furnished Private Offices for 1 to 4 Members, Broadcast & Podcast Facilities, Conference Rooms, Private Phone Booths, Wellness Rooms and more.

A modern, light-filled gallery of unique cars and attention to detail make Car Space Raleigh the ideal location for events and gatherings. This iconic gallery provides an unparalleled backdrop for unique conversations and immersive experiences in Raleigh.

properties.name: Carolina Exotic Car Club & Business Center
properties.description: Carolina Exotic Car Club and Business Center is a custom built, truly unique facility which combines all aspects of service and amenities for exotic and collector car owners. CECC is a private, membership only club and storage facility which combines an active social club with secure climate controlled storage, on-site maintenance and repair, detail, private event venue rentals, catering, enclosed transport and much more.

properties.name: Cary Town Hall Campus
properties.description: The Cary Town Hall Campus is located in downtown Cary on N. Academy St. near the railroad tracks. It includes the Herbert C. Young Community Center, Page-Walker Arts & History Center, and Town office buildings at 316 N. Academy St. and 120 Wilkinson Ave.

properties.name: Cary VFW
properties.description: The Memorial Banquet Hall at Cary VFW seats up to 292 guests using on-site tables and chairs included with the rental fee. Amenities include a stage, dance floor, enclosed wet bar and a portable serving bar. Pre-prepared foods can be served from the adjoining full kitchen, with ice machine and separate refrigeration for your event. In addition to parties and banquets, scores of meetings, rallies, civil service exams, health screenings and other functions have been hosted in Memorial Hall.

properties.name: Chatham Station
properties.description: Located in historic downtown Cary along the railroad tracks, Chatham Station is the Triangle’s newest, premier industrial chic venue. Chatham Station features 4,500 square feet of open meeting and event space with seven functioning glass garage doors that allow for an entire wall of natural lighting. With exposed bricks, natural wood elements, metallic accents, a skylight, and tons of warm, natural light, we like to think of ourselves as industrial with a touch of glam!

properties.name: City Club Raleigh
properties.description: Established in 1991, and located on the 28th and 29th floors of the Wells Fargo Building, City Club Raleigh has been the site of choice for numerous receptions, dinners and corporate functions. All of the Club's elegantly decorated rooms contain picturesque and breathtaking panoramic views of the Raleigh skyline and surrounding areas. Every event is customized to reflect the planner's individual style and taste, incorporating elements such as exquisite culinary creations, fanciful florals and dramatic decor. The Club has seven function spaces that can accommodate groups from six to 350.

properties.name: Courtyard by Marriott Raleigh Cary Crossroads
properties.description: Enjoy the perfect blend of modern comfort & convenience at the new Courtyard Raleigh Cary/Crossroads. Our property offers easy access to U.S. 1, I-40, I-440 and RDU International Airport. Ideal for business travel, we are centrally located close to Research Triangle Park, downtown Cary, N.C. State University and Raleigh city center. Discover the surrounding area with over 70 shops, restaurants and an IMAX Regal movie theater right outside our doors. Rest & recharge in our spacious guest rooms equipped with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker and 55" LG TVs equipped for Netflix and Hulu. Enjoy waking up to your favorite Starbucks coffee and healthy breakfast options in The Bistro. You will stay productive in our lobby’s flexible workspaces providing fast and free Wi-Fi. Explore our expansive fitness center featuring Peloton workouts and wind down from your day on our outdoor patio featuring a salt-water pool, ping pong and fire pit. We look forward to welcoming you to the “new standard of travel!”

properties.name: Days Inn by Wyndham RDU/RTP
properties.description: Meeting room facilities include 570 square feet and eight foot ceilings.  Different style setups are available.

properties.name: Dock 1053
properties.description:
Dock 1053 is a creative community for makers, entrepreneurs, artisans, retailers and forward thinkers. Located at the doorstep of Raleigh’s Five Points, Person Street, and Mordecai neighborhoods, this is a place where locals and visitors alike can enjoy new experiences in an old way. We seek the curious and creative from all walks to eat, learn, shop, make and collaborate in an effort to add more salt to this flavorful city we call Raleigh.

Originally built in 1955 for the Atlantic & Pacific Tea Company (A&P grocery) as a regional distribution facility, the building was more recently used by Winn-Dixie. In its glory days, a siding track allowed train cars to be backed inside the length of the building. Groceries were unloaded under a covered roof. The building featured a cafeteria and locker rooms for dock workers, cooler space and even a candling room for inspecting eggs by hand.

In its simplest form, Dock 1053 offers warehouse, manufacturing, office and retail space in a location convenient to both Downtown and Midtown Raleigh. Dock 1053 is digging up tradition by encouraging our community to partner with local tradesmen to grow their business, expand their skill set, and hone their passion.

properties.name: Dorton Arena
properties.description:
Dorton Arena hosts a wide array of action-packed sporting events. Since it opened in 1952, Dorton Arena has been home to many sporting activities, both amateur and professional.  Year-round amateur sporting events at Dorton Arena range from Special Olympics Opening Ceremonies, boxing, youth wrestling, cheerleading, colorguard band, and karate/martial arts competitions to collegiate and And1 basketball. Dorton has been a hub of sports activity, including events such as the 1997 World Figure Skating Champions Tour and many professional sports.

Ideal venue for concerts, trade shows, athletic events, circuses, speakers, proms and other special events.

properties.name: E. Carroll Joyner Visitor Center, North Carolina State University
properties.description: The front door to North Carolina State University, the E. Carroll Joyner Visitor Center provides key information to potential NC State students and their families. The building's 2,400-square-foot rotunda features interactive multimedia kiosks, a mini-theater, gallery space and a service desk with a variety of information about life at N.C. State and the surrounding area.

properties.name: Edenton Street United Methodist Church
properties.description: Edenton Street United Methodist Church is a historic United Methodist church in Raleigh. Edenton Street UMC is one of the largest United Methodist Churches in Raleigh and was the first United Methodist Church built in the city. It is located on Edenton Street in downtown Raleigh. Edenton Street United Methodist Church is not just a place of worship; it's a gorgeous, large church building equipped with state-of-the-art facilities. Whether you're planning a large gathering or a small meeting, the church offers versatile spaces that can be rented to suit your needs. Additionally, with its technology and catering services, it's able to host a wide variety of events.

properties.name: Embassy Suites Raleigh-Durham Airport/Brier Creek
properties.description: The Embassy Suites Raleigh-Durham Airport/Brier Creek hotel is an upscale, full service, suite property with modern, transitional decor. Guest suites feature bamboo hardwood floors, granite surfaces, 42" flat panel TV, wet bar with mini-refrigerator and microwave. Flying Spoons Cafe offers lunch, dinner and proudly brews Starbucks coffee. All stays include a complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast and evening reception in the lobby lounge. Complimentary shuttle is available to RDU International Airport and throughout Brier Creek.

properties.name: Eva Perry Regional Library
properties.description: Eva Perry Regional Library offers printing services, children's programs and story time, access to public computers, reading materials, and Wi-Fi.

properties.name: Executive Office Suites at Lafayette Village
properties.description: A professional setting is essential to any successful business meeting, that's why Executive Office Suites at Lafayette Village provides beautifully appointed and fully functional meeting rooms or hourly Guest Offices.  To facilitate meeting your needs and agenda they offer full-service, high-end technology and amenities such as business-class Internet, conference calling, AV/projection services and more. Reservations can be made on an hourly, daily or weekly basis to suit your needs. Also, Lafayette Village eateries offer special discounts for office suite clients (eat-in, take-out or catered functions).

properties.name: Express Library - Fayetteville Street
properties.description: Hours: Mon.-Fri., 10am-6pm

properties.name: First Presbyterian Church
properties.description: First Presbyterian Church is a congregation of the Presbyterian Church (USA), a church with roots in the Protestant Reformation. First Presbyterian Church affirms the sovereignty of God, the Lordship of Jesus Christ and central importance of the Scriptures in shaping our lives and our life together. First Presbyterian Church was organized on Sunday, January 21, 1816, in the old North Carolina State House on Capitol Square.

properties.name: First and Main
properties.description: First and Main is an event venue located in the charming Old Towne District of Knightdale, N.C. The space features beautiful heart pine hardwood floors, 12 ft. high authentic tin ceilings and lots of vintage touches.

properties.name: Five Points Center for Active Adults
properties.description: This 20,000 square-foot facility is a state of the art event space located in the historic Five Points area. The space can be divided into smaller rooms or opens up into one large room. Pre-function space, covered patio and stage are available.

properties.name: Fo Guang Shan North Carolina Temple
Friendship Chapel Baptist Church
properties.description: Friendship Chapel Baptist Church in Wake Forest, N.C., was founded on the principles of love and a desire to worship God freely in spirit and in truth.

properties.name: Goels Plaza, LLC
properties.description: Over 35,000 sq. ft Banquet and Conference Center with a capacity of up to 1,000 people. This is the largest and most central privately-owned Facility located in the heart of the Triangle.  It has four ballrooms and various meeting rooms and expo hall to facilitate a variety of Events.  Some of the Events done in the past include Weddings, Receptions, Reunions, Anniversaries, Birthday, Conferences, Seminars, Trade shows, Expositions, Holiday parties, Comedy shows, Dinner & Dance shows, Award ceremonies, Fund raisers, Licensing Exams, Religious and Cultural programs of all ethnicities.  It is approximately 5 minutes from the RDU International Airport and is 15 minutes from major cities in the Triangle area.

properties.name: Gov. James G. Martin Building
properties.description: The Gov. James G. Martin Building was made its debut on October 6, 2006. The new building includes 60 total toilet fixtures, and a multi-purpose room to serve the needs of the N.C. State Fairgrounds and is available to rent during non-fair time. The facility features tile interiors, day-lighting and easy access. In addition the entire midway area located adjacent to the Martin Building has been improved with large landscape planters, city park style lighting, and underground water, sewer and electrical systems. Year-round the Martin Building hosts small business meetings, training, social events, small trade shows, and many other types of events.

properties.name: Grand Marquise Ballroom
properties.description: Come to the Grand Marquis Ballroom and experience all of the beauty that this ballroom facility has to offer.  The marble Grand Entry Parlor is a perfect first impression. It is large enough to host any social function. With its marvelous decor of marble columns, ornate trim and coffer ceilings adorned with crystal chandeliers, the Grand Marquise Ballroom can accommodate up to 400 of your favorite guests. The breathtaking mezzanine balcony is the home of private bride and groom’s quarters. The grand iron staircase is the perfect backdrop for anyone’s magical moment. Additionally, there is a large full-service kitchen waiting upon the arrival of a caterer of your choice.

properties.name: Greg Poole, Jr. All Faiths Chapel
properties.description:
Overlooking downtown Raleigh, the Greg Poole, Jr. All Faiths Chapel is a unique venue in the heart of Dix Park. The historic building is surrounded by an event lawn, front terrace and lovely gardens. Built in 1955, the chapel’s mid-century modern architecture is well preserved with decorative wood elements, a rose stained-glass window, terrazzo floors, and mid-century stainless fixtures. Renovated in 2020, the chapel now provides all the amenities of a modern community gathering space while retaining its historic charm.

The main hall has an open floor plan with an elevated stage and accommodates approximately 200 guests seated at tables, 400 guests seated auditorium style, or 450 guests standing reception style. Amenities include tables and chairs, catering staging kitchen, two dressing areas, wi-fi, and audio visual capabilities. 

The event lawn can be reserved for outdoor gatherings and events independent of renting the indoor chapel venue. The space is grass covered and beautifully landscaped with shade trees and a brick seating bench surrounding the lawn.

properties.name: Hampton Inn & Suites RDU/Brier Creek
properties.description: The Hampton Inn & Suites RDU/Brier Creek is located between downtown Raleigh and Durham, just 3 miles from RDU International Airport and adjacent to Brier Creek Commons where guests can enjoy a multitude of restaurants, shops and entertainment. The Angus Barn, Umstead State Park and Frankie's Fun Park are a few attractions nearby.  Hotel amenities include an indoor heated pool, 24-hour fitness center, complimentary hot breakfast and 24-hour suite shop. The hotel offers over 4,000 square feet of meeting and event space. Complimentary shuttle is available to RDU Airport and throughout Brier Creek.

properties.name: Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh/Crabtree
properties.description: Opened in 2013, ideally situated just minutes from downtown Raleigh and opposite Crabtree Valley Mall. Enjoy complimentary hot breakfast buffet served daily. Re-energize with an invigorating workout in the modern Precor fitness center or choose to take a relaxing swim in our indoor pool. Catch up with work in the business center or host your next important meeting or event. With over 4,000 sq. ft. of meeting and banquet facilities, the experienced staff can help you plan your next event. After a busy day, retire to a contemporary guest room and unwind on a clean and fresh Hampton bed®. Stay connected with free high-speed internet access, use the handy lap desk to work from the comfort of your bed or simply relax and watch TV.

properties.name: Harrill Center at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
Hartwell Raleigh
properties.description:
Hartwell is a historical, family-owned property in the heart of the beloved Boylan Heights neighborhood!
This one-of-a-kind location will serve as a retail and community space.

properties.name: Herbert C. Young Community Center
properties.description: The Herbert C. Young Community Center is located in downtown Cary and has been offering classes, programs and athletic events for over 20 years. Two large meetings rooms and a catering kitchen are on the main level, and the lower gymnasium, named after former North Carolina State University women's basketball coach Kay Yow, is often converted to an event hall for festivals, performances or large events.

properties.name: Highgrove Estate
properties.description: Highgrove is a magnificent Southern estate on six acres overlooking Lake Laurel. In addition to the spacious interior, Highgrove boasts a 3,000-square-foot, climate-controlled grand tent and outdoor covered patio space to accommodate up to 300 guests, plus a pergola area perfect for outdoor views, ceremonies and receptions.

properties.name: Historic Yates Mill County Park
properties.description: The 174-acre wildlife park features hiking trails, Historic Yates Mill, Wake County’s last remaining gristmill, and the mill’s 24-acre pond, which is fed by Steep Hill Creek. The 18th century water-powered mill is fully restored and operable. Free admission to the park; mill tour fee: $3-5 (all proceeds directly support the mill's ongoing maintenance and operations). Park hours: Daily, 8am-sunset; Finley Center: Daily, 8:30am-5pm; mill tour hours are limited and vary seasonally.

properties.name: Holly Springs Community Library
properties.description: Hours: Mon.-Thur., 10am-8pm; Fri., 10am-6pm; Sat., 10am-5pm; Sun., Closed

properties.name: Holly Springs Cultural Center
properties.description: Located in the Village District of Holly Springs, this $5 million complex has become the center for arts and special events in southwestern Wake County. Its spaces include: a Performing Arts Theatre (an intimate performance space with state-of-the-art sound, video and lighting systems seating up to 184), a Conference Center (four multi-purpose rooms for meetings, classes, etc.), Springs Outdoor Stage (with lawn seating for 300 at outdoor performances and festivals) and a Grand Lobby (a reception and art exhibition space for 120 that includes a soaring atrium ceiling and gourmet coffee bar).

properties.name: Holshouser Building at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
Hyatt Place Raleigh-Durham Airport
properties.description: Meeting space includes 850 feet of dividable space.  Accomodates up to 60 theatre style and 30 classroom style.  Catering and Audio Visual pricing available

properties.name: Industrious Raleigh - Charter Square
properties.description: Located on famed Fayetteville St. in bustling downtown Raleigh, this space puts you in the center of it all. With floor-to-ceiling windows, best-in-class amenities, and a warm sense of community, our office is designed to inspire your best work.

properties.name: Jaycee Park and Community Center
properties.description: Community Center with lighted ballfields, tennis courts, play equipment, picnic shelter and sand volleyball.

properties.name: Jiddi Space & Courtyard
properties.description: Equal parts modern and provincial, the Jiddi Space & Courtyard is a hidden gem in downtown Raleigh. Tucked behind Sitti & Gravy, this fully enclosed private dining and event space is perfect for corporate events, meetings, luncheons, retirement parties, social events, and family celebrations including wedding ceremonies and receptions, rehearsal dinners, and holiday or surprise parties. The Jiddi Space & Courtyard is catered exclusively by either Sitti or Gravy.

properties.name: Jim Graham Building at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
properties.description: The Jim Graham Building is the largest of the fairgrounds buildings. During the year it hosts a variety of livestock shows, home and garden shows, sales showcases, farm shows and other special events. Exhibit space can be extended with the use of outdoor tents and fencing. At State Fair time, the building is used exclusively for livestock shows and exhibits.

properties.name: Junction West
properties.description: Tucked in the heart of Raleigh’s Warehouse District, Junction West is a space for folks to gather to celebrate and connect.  Whether you’re hosting a wedding, a conference or simply meeting friends for a drink, Junction West welcomes you!

properties.name: Kerr Scott Building at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
properties.description: The versatile Kerr Scott Building serves as a popular venue for trade shows, banquets, proms, political rallies and other events.

properties.name: Knights of Columbus Club
properties.description: The Knights of Columbus Club event center is a great place for weddings, birthday parties, family reunions, graduation parties, business meetings and off-site corporate events. Sport facilities also available, which can accommodate volleyball, softball, baseball and flag football. Leagues are welcome!

properties.name: Koka Booth Amphitheatre
properties.description:
Located among 14 acres of hardwoods and pines, and beautifully situated next to Symphony Lake, Booth Amphitheatre blends with its natural setting as one of the most distinctive performing arts venues in the Southeast. With a capacity of 7,000, patrons can enjoy seating on the spacious lawn or the Crescent Deck.
Lumineers photo credit: Bruce Murdoch

properties.name: Lenovo Center
properties.description:
Lenovo Center, which opened in Oct. 1999 and still sparkles like new, is home to the NHL's Carolina Hurricanes and the N.C. State men's basketball team. The 19,700-seat venue, located in west Raleigh, has hosted an impressive array of major sports, concert tours and events year after year. On an annual basis, Lenovo Center welcomes over 1.5 million guests and plays host to more than 150 events. NCAA Basketball Tournaments, NHL Stanley Cup Finals, Disney on Ice, Paul McCartney, Pavarotti, Billy Joel, Garth Brooks, Taylor Swift, Disney On Ice and the Harlem Globetrotters are just a few events hosted by PNC Arena. 
The Center is conveniently accessible from all parts of the state. Adjacent to Carter-Finley Stadium and the North Carolina State Fairgrounds, the venue is just off I-40 and I-440 minutes from RDU International Airport. Amenities include over 8,000 designated parking spaces, 18 permanent concession stands, over 50 portable concession stands, 37 public restrooms, as well as escalators and elevators throughout the building. Equipped with three concourses, 66 luxury suites, 2,000 Club Seats and a spacious 9,100-square-foot restaurant on the Club Level, Lenovo Center is well-equipped to handle events of all types. Full catering service, operated entirely onsite by VAB Catering, is also available for private functions.

properties.name: Little Herb House
properties.description: Proprietress Lisa Treadaway founded her herb business on a horse farm. The pasture was converted into 10,000 sq. ft. of display herb/flower gardens and an old barn was renovated into the drying loft. The Little Herb House hosts group tours and luncheons, as well as weddings and a unique meeting site.

properties.name: Market Hall, A Historic Event Space
properties.description:
Market Hall is a full-service venue hosting corporate events, creative conferences, weddings, live performances, blowout bashes, milestone celebrations, community events and much more. Historic, elegant, and spacious (10,000 square feet), Market Hall is the perfect place to host your next event featuring an American Southern menu with exclusive onsite catering and culinary team! 

This historic multi-use space is located in the center of City Market, in downtown Raleigh. The unique and beautiful building has undergone several renovations and reinventions over the last 100 years with it's rich history as the City's first Farmer's Market and N.C's First Craft Brewery!

properties.name: Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
properties.description:
The Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts is the premier location for cultural arts and entertainment in Raleigh. The center is comprised of four unique venues, Raleigh Memorial Auditorium, Meymandi Concert Hall, A.J. Fletcher Opera Theater, and Kennedy Theatre.


The Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts hosts national tours and performers, and is also home to four resident companies; Carolina Ballet, NC Opera, NC Symphony, and PineCone. Hosting over 600 events each year and welcoming over 400,000 guests, the Martin Marietta Center is a cultural focal point in downtown Raleigh.


Boasting four beautiful performing arts halls, multiple lobby spaces, an in-house box office, and on-site catering, the center is available to rent for your next performance, event, or filming location.

properties.name: Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts - Lichtin Plaza
properties.description: This elegant two-acre plaza in front of the Martin Marietta Center is the ideal, open-air space for festivals, concerts and tented social gatherings and functions.

properties.name: Maywood Hall & Garden
properties.description:
Maywood Hall & Garden is Trophy Brewing's newest venue dedicated to events. Maywood Hall sits right at the edge of Downtown Raleigh on Maywood Avenue, just a few doors down from Trophy’s production facility and taproom. Maywood Hall & Garden is a bright, open, and versatile indoor/outdoor venue that's entirely customizable, and can accommodate groups from 50 to 200 people. Explore our amenities:

Our Garden: A freshly-landscaped, 3,000 square foot private garden with stone pathways. Our green space can accommodate a 50x75 foot tent.
Trophy Beer: Get your favorite Trophy beer right from the source. Choose select classic and specialty beverage packages for your special event.
Private Suite: An additional space for getting ready with a dedicated private bathroom.
Catering Space: A convenient space dedicated to event staff or catering teams.

properties.name: McKimmon Conference & Training Center
properties.description:
Location, location, location. That's the sacred mantra of every real estate agent, but the same adage applies to meeting planners, too. Selecting the right location for your educational meeting can be the single most important factor in determining the ultimate success of your event.


University, state government, non-profit and business organizations choose the Center for large statewide, regional and national meetings or small training sessions. Regardless of your needs, the McKimmon Conference & Training Center is designed to enhance your adult learning experience.

properties.name: Melrose Knitting Mill
properties.description: Melrose Knitting Mill is a chic, urban space located in downtown Raleigh. The tall ceilings, arched windows and open floor-plan allows brides to create an elegant and unique space that guests are sure to enjoy. Melrose Knitting Mill also provides ample free parking for you and your guests.

properties.name: Merrimon-Wynne House
properties.description: The Merrimon-Wynne House was built in 1876 and has been restored to its original grandeur. In addition to the picturesque building, the Merrimon-Wynne wedding and event venue has expansive grounds and is located in the heart of historic downtown Raleigh only a few doors away from the Governor’s Mansion. The Merrimon-Wynne House offers neutral finishings, making it an ideal location for hosting traditional and classic affairs as well as modern and contemporary events.

properties.name: Method Pioneer Building
properties.description: Located next to the Method Road Park and Community Center, the Method Pioneer Building offers rental space for events and meetings.

properties.name: Middle Creek Community Center
properties.description: Middle Creek Community Center represents a collaborative effort between the Town of Cary  and Wake County Public School System.  The Community Center, adjacent to Middle Creek School Park, has a gymnasium and two smaller classrooms.  Programs are offered in fitness, dance, arts, and wellness.  123 Middle Creek Ave., 771-1295

properties.name: Millbrook Exchange Community Center
properties.description: The Millbrook Exchange Community Center offers a variety of classes and programs for all ages including Preschool Sports, Dog Obedience, Group Fitness, Spanish, Composting and weekday programs for Homeschooled Students. The center and gymnasium are available for rental and offer a warming kitchen, tables and chairs for up to 49 people and a whiteboard.

properties.name: Moore Square
properties.description:
Since 1792, Moore Square has been a place of gathering, reflection, entertainment, and recreation for the citizens of Raleigh. This 4-acre downtown urban green space, originally conceived as one of 5 public green spaces for the City of Raleigh, is embarking on its greatest transformation since its conception.

Moore Square includes a dignified border framed with North Carolina granite, an expansive event lawn, a food service kiosk, an interactive water feature, grove rooms and a natural play area. All this, while still ensuring the beautiful bordering grove of 100 year old oak trees remains untouched. Moore Square will distinguish Raleigh as a city with premier public spaces and act as a catalyst for downtown growth and economic development.

Programming for Moore Square will be engaging, interactive, welcoming while featuring annual programs and events that showcase the park and the community partnerships.

properties.name: N.C. State College of Veterinary Medicine
Norris House
properties.description: Originally built in 1879, the fully restored and revitalized house is open for rental and private events. Reopened in May 2018, this historic setting is upgraded with modern technology, full AV, three interior bars and more.

properties.name: North Carolina Community Foundation
properties.description:
The North Carolina Community Foundation's (NCCF) mission is to inspire North Carolinians to make lasting and meaningful contributions to their communities. The NCCF is the single statewide community foundation serving North Carolina and has made more than $145 million in grants since its inception in 1988.

NCCF is excited to make their meeting space available as a resource to their community partners.

properties.name: North Carolina State Fairgrounds
properties.description: Eight facilities plus two facilities/grounds which house the state’s largest indoor/outdoor flea market. The grounds also offer 350 full-service RV access sites, and amenities include free parking in addition to convenient access from I-40, I-440 and I-540. Events are staged at the fairgrounds year-round; call or visit website. Private catering service is available.

properties.name: Northeast Regional Library
properties.description: Northeast Regional Library is apart of Wake County Public Libraries, with a mission to promote the love of reading and to foster the pursuit of knowledge for the residents of Wake County.

properties.name: Oberlin Regional Library
properties.description: Oberlin Regional Library, formerly Village Regional Library, is located within the Village District shopping center near North Carolina State University.

properties.name: Office Evolution
properties.description: Office Evolution Raleigh is conveniently located in the Crabtree Valley area, offering private offices, co-working, meetings rooms, and virtual business solutions such as business address. Contact us today to learn more!

properties.name: Office Suites PLUS at Regency
properties.description: We offer 3 meeting rooms of various sizes with all audio visual aids available to include an LCD projector and video conferencing.   Catering is available upon request

properties.name: One Eleven Place
properties.description: One Eleven Place is a special event rental facility with a fresh environment to handle any type of gathering.

properties.name: Optimist Club of Raleigh
properties.description: The Optimist Club of Raleigh is a service organization comprised of men and women with professional or business backgrounds. Club fundraising and service projects are for the benefit, encouragement and entertainment of the young people in our community. The Club meets for lunch most Mondays at Golden Corral on Glenwood Ave. in Raleigh with a program and speakers beginning about 12:30 p.m. and adjourning at 1:10 p.m.

properties.name: Prestonwood Country Club
properties.description: A clubhouse in a beautiful country club setting, Prestonwood has several private party spaces to accommodate groups large and small.  We offer breakfast, lunch, and dinner/receptions.  There is state of the art AV and wireless internet in all private party rooms. Golf packages are also available.

properties.name: RDU International Airport
properties.description: RDU Airport offers two conference rooms in Terminal 2 on the 3rd floor. They are designed to support business meetings, conferences and gatherings for up to 35 people comfortably in the smaller room and up to 60 in the larger room. There is an available pantry located between rooms, restroom facilities and catering available. RDU offers hourly rates as well as discounted 1/2- and full-day rates, wi-fi upon request, projectors and wall boards.

properties.name: Raleigh Convention Center
properties.description:
Since opening in Sept. 2008, the Raleigh Convention Center has been a remarkable resource for groups from 5 to 100,000. The dedicated staff is here to make sure each visitor’s needs—whether as an attendee, planner or exhibitor—are met.
The Raleigh Convention Center is a bustling hub for the culture, commerce and technologies that make the area one of the most admired and sought-after places in the United States. The modern, 500,000-square-foot facility includes a soaring street-level lobby, an elegant ballroom and a massive exhibit hall as well as reliable, upgraded tech amenities and award-winning culinary delights.
You’ll be welcomed into a grand lobby of dazzling floor-to-ceiling windows. Open and airy, the 4,100-square-foot, street-level mezzanine overlooks the exhibit hall and provides easy access to all other areas of the center and the attached Raleigh Marriott City Center. Granite details, stunning artwork, casual seating and a gracious reception area create the ideal spot to mix and mingle before or after events. All capacities listed are maximum room set without staging and with no or minimal AV equipment.
The convention center is home to the iconic Cree Shimmer Wall, sister venue to the Red Hat Amphitheater (across the street!) and Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts, plus just steps from downtown Raleigh restaurants and hot spots. The center has earned "Most Creative Place to Host a Meeting" and numerous Readers' Choice Awards from ConventionSouth magazine, as well as the Centers of Excellence Award from EXHIBITOR Magazine for three consecutive years (2019, 2020, 2021), and a City of Raleigh Climate Impact Award in Waste and Energy Consumption. The center is also NC Green Travel-certified.
The Raleigh Convention Center is accredited by GBAC STAR™, the cleaning industry’s only outbreak prevention, response and recovery accreditation for facilities.

properties.name: Raleigh Marriott City Center
properties.description: Located in the center of Raleigh's revitalized downtown and connected to the Raleigh Convention Center, the hotel boasts 400 guest rooms, 10 suites and 14,900 sq. ft. of versatile meeting space. Enjoy the indoor recreation pool, jacuzzi and fitness center including Peloton bikes, spacious bar (sports TV), three-meal restaurant, Starbucks coffee shop and business center. Transportation to RDU International Airport available.

properties.name: Ramada by Wyndham Raleigh
properties.description: Ramada Raleigh is the only full service hotel conveniently located near the North Carolina State Fairgrounds, the NC State University Veterinary School and the PNC Arena. Winner of the Best of 2010 Wyndam Award our downtown hotel is ideally located in the heart of Raleigh, within minutes of museums, shopping, and restaurants.

properties.name: Rand-Bryan House
properties.description: The Rand-Bryan House is a historic 19th century home nestled in the outskirts of Raleigh  The home features beautifully restored interiors and porches, which are surrounded by landscaped gardens and grounds.  The Rand-Bryan House offers a unique event venue to fit any occasion.  Located 20 minutes from downtown Raleigh and 30 minutes from RTP, the house and grounds provide a “get away from it all” setting for Corporate Events that is convenient to Wake and Johnston County.  The Rand-Bryan house gives guests the flexibility to design the event of their dreams with customizable packages and a choice of vendors.  From wedding receptions and ceremonies to bridal showers, corporate events and special get-togethers.  The house and porch can accommodate up to 350 guests for a reception and the sunroom and reception room, complete with tables and chairs, can easily seat up to 130 guests with the dining room available for catered spreads. The grounds offer unlimited possibilities for receptions, utilizing the front lawn or the landscaped side yard, which can accommodate up to 325 guests with tables and chairs. Tenting of the site can also be arranged when needed.  This pastoral,  yet elegant home, is the ideal location for your special events

properties.name: Regus
properties.description: Class A Building offering private furnished offices suites.

properties.name: Regus Forum I
properties.description:
Office Suites PLUS provides meeting room space in a professional office setting located in commercial office buildings.  We have three meeting rooms with sizes appropriate for four, eight or up to sixteen attendees.  We have the ability to set up a ten person classroom style room as well at the Forum I location.
Our meeting rooms are consistently used by our clients as well as on an as-needed (or walk-in) basis by individuals and businesses. In either scenario, we can help you project an image of success with our carefully appointed and professional office suites.
Our meeting rooms are designed and furnished for maximum efficiency. Each room comes with wireless internet included in the $25 to $35 per hour or $150 to $250 per day pricing.  We also provide a dry mark board, extra paper and pens for your use, speakerphones and access to audio/visual equipment. We can even provide beverage and catering services.

properties.name: Saint Augustine's University's Martin Luther King Jr. Student Union
Seby Jones Fine Arts Theater at Saint Augustine's University
SpringHill Suites by Marriott Raleigh Cary
properties.description: SpringHill Suites by Marriott Raleigh - Cary is a stylish and smartly designed hotel with suites that are 25% larger than a comparably priced hotel room, giving you room to succeed. Fridge, microwave and sleeper sofa in every room, indoor pool and fitness center, free hot breakfast and internet are just some of the added values and amenities you will receive at this hotel. Elegant, lobby lounge with stylish business center and area to relax indoors and out. Grab a delicious cocktail and an assortment of the chef's specialty appetizers and relax at an outdoor fireplace area. SpringHill Suites is located within walking distance of several restaurants and shops at the Crossroads Plaza shopping center. In addition, it is a short drive from Regency Park, WakeMed Cary Hospital, North Carolina State University, PNC Arena, WakeMed Soccer Park, Triangle Aquatic Center and many more area attractions.

properties.name: TRAINE at Seaboard Station
properties.description: Nestled in the historic Seaboard Railroad Station in downtown Raleigh, Traine is a premier event venue to host weddings and special events. Built in the early 1900’s as the original Railway Express operation in Raleigh; this building features original brick walls, wood timber beams and is surrounded by historic charm in a neighborhood next to William Peace University.

properties.name: The Barn at King Hill Farm
properties.description: The Barn at King Hill Farm is a 4,800 sq. ft. event space with additional private rooms. Located on a working farm, our Barn is an elegant setting for any event. The Barn features a prep kitchen for catering, separate suites for grooms and brides, and ample outdoor space. A perennial garden creates a magical atmosphere for outdoor gatherings and the heated and air-conditioned barn is perfect for indoor parties. Tables and chairs are included with every rental to accommodate up to 240 people.

properties.name: The Cannon Room at HQ Capital Club
properties.description:
Located in the heart of downtown Raleigh, The Cannon Room at HQ Capital Club is a beautifully decorated space with an elegant historical feel. Boasting high ceilings, art-deco plasterwork details and amazing views, this space is perfect for private events, corporate events, weddings and receptions. Host a cocktail hour or a full day event! Furniture and A/V are included for all events.


HQ Capital Club also has small "huddle" rooms for one to three people, as well as meeting rooms for up to 12 people located on floors 8-11 of the Capital Club building. With modern amenities in a historic building, this is a great place to host your next meeting.


Photo Credit: Veritas Digital

properties.name: The Dream Center
properties.description: The Dream Center exists to meet the needs of the mind, body and soul of all its members and the surrounding community. Their state-of-the-art, modern facility is a one stop shop for getting in shape, receiving education of all respects and entertaining the entire family. All it takes is one visit to the facility to see the endless opportunities the Dream Center has to offer. Featuring an unparalleled array of amenities and services, The Dream Center is here to fulfill every need imaginable.

properties.name: The Fairview
properties.description:
The Fairview Raleigh is a sophisticated, urban event venue located downtown in the beautiful Five Points area. The Fairview, featuring an expansive light-filled space, covered outdoor terrace with skyline views and arched wood barrel ceilings, is the perfect setting to host your wedding, corporate event or social gathering. 

​

properties.name: The Forks Cafeteria
properties.description: Full service cafeteria with four private banquet rooms.

properties.name: The Glass Box
properties.description:
Located on the 5th Floor of 230 Fayetteville Street, The Glass Box is a touch of modern luxury located in the heart of Downtown Raleigh. The bright and chic suite is bathed in natural light from floor to ceiling windows, offering amazing views and a private outdoor balcony. The hardwood floors reflect the warmth of the space and the butler’s pantry provides the ability to celebrate in style without having to leave the suite.

Impress your guests with the incredible atmosphere that The Glass Box holds. This venue is perfect for a small event, business meeting, baby shower, or a bridal suite for The Stockroom at 230 weddings.

properties.name: The Greenway Club at Falls River
properties.description: Tucked away off the Capital Area Greenway Trail, The Greenway Club at Falls River offers private event space in North Raleigh, available Sept.-May. The 900-square-foot clubhouse includes a sofa, two cushioned chairs, seven bar-stools, three tables with four chairs and two high top tables with four chairs each. Furniture may be rearranged to accommodate various seating styles. Wi-Fi and AV equipment also available.

properties.name: The Hibiscus
properties.description: The Hibiscus is a modern event space located in the heart of North Raleigh. Space can accommodate up to 500 guests with full event rental catalog and services available. In-house catering, event planning and event decoration services are also available.

properties.name: The Hindu Society of North Carolina
properties.description: The Hindu Society of North Carolina (HSNC) is an umbrella organization for the various Hindu and allied religious communities in Triangle area (Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill) in meeting their religious, cultural and spiritual needs. HSNC's goals are to provide a place to worship and practice the religion with the help of community, and arrange, support and encourage activities that fulfill religious, cultural, linguistic and spiritual needs of current and future generation, and promote India’s rich heritage.

properties.name: The Historic Wakefield Barn
properties.description: The Historic Wakefield Barn is a wedding venue in Wake Forest, North Carolina. This century old, three-story dairy barn stands tall on 11.5 acres with towering silos and a grandeur of its own. We offer a historic splendor with dramatic arched ceilings, whitewashed ship-lap and a cocktail hour space that highlights the restored stable spaces. This venue is ideal for couples looking for a unique venue with a rustic and elegant feel.

properties.name: The Leslie-Alford-Mims House
properties.description:
This charming property offers breathtaking backdrops for those desiring a romantic and timeless wedding. Built in 1840, the sprawling, white mansion has been well-known to longtime Holly Springs residents for decades. Conveniently located 25 minutes outside of Raleigh and situated on more than an acre of land, the Leslie-Alford-Mims House uniquely combines rich history with modern grace and style. 


The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting. The house and grounds are equipped to host both indoor and outdoor wedding ceremonies and receptions, as well as private events and corporate meetings. Imagine getting married under a canopy of Magnolia trees among a southern landscape. Or having your wedding cake displayed beneath a shimmering chandelier.


Envision your guests perusing the various rooms while a pianist plays the Baby Grand. Picture hosting your reception in the Event Lawn either under a tent, beneath market lights or in the open-air. An over-sized porte cochere that once accommodated horse and carriages can now be used as your dance floor. The possibilities are endless and the neutral setting makes the Mims House ideal for any style and any budget.


What makes the Mims House different? It's more than a venue. They vow to devote a high level of attention to you, your day and your details throughout the entire process. Not only will you secure a wonderful place to get married, but you'll also work with a talented team of vendors who are trustworthy, passionate and dedicated.

properties.name: The Life Enrichment Center
properties.description: The Center is primed for a successful event as it offers a variety of amenities. The LEC has several options of classrooms to select from which can be used for trainings and instructional sessions and has seating capacity ranging from 15-45 persons. The gymnasium can host sporting events to dressed events such as annual conferences, gales and banquets. The stage area can be used to host seminars and workshops. The lounge/cafe is suitable for bridal and baby showers, graduation receptions and birthday parties and includes a flat screen HDTV, refrigerator, bar area and relaxing area with comfortable seating. Additionally, you can impress your high profile clients in one of the Executive-style conference rooms.

properties.name: The Loading Dock - 1053
properties.description: The Loading Dock offers training rooms, conference rooms, a board room, and unique event spaces for up to 250 people. Host an off-site meeting or a private event at The Loading Dock! Past events have included board meetings, strategic planning sessions, corporate trainings, think tanks, holiday parties, game nights, wedding showers, baby showers and more.

properties.name: The Lotus Room
properties.description: The Lotus Room is a space created for women - and girls - with the intention to inspire transformation in mind, body, and spirit through social opportunities and fun, educational sessions in the areas of professional development, spirituality, and health.

properties.name: The Matthews House
properties.description: A picturesque setting for the most important events and gatherings or a delightful getaway place for your most special guests - The Matthews House, a stately, Greek Revival mansion nestled among giant oaks and flower gardens on Cary's historic Chatham St. Welcome your guests, clients, family and friends into this historic home for your special event and offer them a highly enjoyable, truly memorable experience. For your convenience, The Matthews House offers complete packages for all events or you can create your own event from the ground up. They also offer access to our expert resources, which include everything from personal services to our florists, equipment rental firms, limousine services and event planners.

properties.name: The Maxwell
properties.description: The Maxwell is an 8,000 square-foot industrial event space that combines modern elegance and classic luxury. This venue easily transforms itself to both large and intimate celebrations alike. It features a 3,500 square-foot Great Room, 1,900 square-foot Lounge as well as a paved outdoor patio and lawn. The Maxwell includes 70 onsite parking spaces as well as free parking on it's private street.

properties.name: The Mayton
properties.description: The Mayton Inn, in downtown Cary, is a boutique, luxury, full-service inn that's centrally located and minutes from Research Triangle Park, North Carolina State University and close to the airport. The Georgian-style hotel encompasses a luxury atmosphere along with green technologies in all aspects of the building. The technical capabilities and scalable spaces make the inn an ideal venue for courses, seminars, workshops, off-site retreats and board meetings. Also visit the full-service restaurant, Peck & Plume.

properties.name: The Meadows at Firefly Farm Preserve
properties.description: The Meadows at Firefly Farm Preserve is a 220-acre heritage estate and nature preserve ten minutes from the heart of Raleigh. The Meadows' space blends rolling meadows and mature forests with elegant simplicity and curated indoor/outdoor spaces. This venue is available for weddings, intimate celebrations, elopements and corporate events Monday-Sunday. The Meadows offers 5 outdoor ceremony spaces, each with their own special aesthetic of nature in mind. Heron Hall, our cocktail and reception space, can seat up to 350 guests with indoor and outdoor seating. Our 2 "getting-ready" suites, Aerie House and The Roost, are also available for your wedding party providing plenty of space to create memories and perfect pre-wedding photos.

properties.name: The Oaks at Salem
properties.description:
Combining centuries-old charm with the best of modern conveniences, the setting is designed to capitalize on the views from every vantage point. Situated on nearly five pastoral acres with mature hardwoods, the site offers a cozy fireplace and over 1,000 square feet of veranda overlooking a one-acre serene pond.

The Oaks is conveniently located only 15 miles from downtown Raleigh, two miles from historic downtown Apex and less than one mile from Hwy. 64. Explore the ambiance of The Oaks at Salem, and create memories you’ll cherish for a lifetime.

properties.name: The Optimist Club Farm
properties.description:
The Optimist Club Farm is available for use by organized and properly supervised youth groups such as Girl Scouts, Boy Scouts, or similar youth groups. It may be rented for private meetings, wedding receptions, birthday parties or similar functions.

The Farm encompasses 70 acres of which about 40 are cleared with suitable areas for softball games, soccer, or other such activities. Wooded areas of the farm may be used for camping or nature walks. A heated/air conditioned clubhouse with chairs and tables provided for meeting or banquet purposes can accommodate up to 87 people. On the property in front of the clubhouse, is a three acre pond that may be used for fishing or canoeing.

properties.name: The Palm Venue & Catering
properties.description:
The Palm Venue & Catering, nestled in the heart of Cary, N.C., serves as an elegant location for corporate functions, fundraisers, weddings, and beyond. The Palm boasts 7,000 square feet and offers comfortable space for up to 250 guests. The interiors feature hand-cut natural stone, brilliant gold chandeliers, and exposed wooden beams. ​

At The Palm, we are dedicated to providing our clients customization, convenience, and price transparency. With over 20 years of experience in the catering and restaurant industry, we have thought of all the amenities you need to make event planning a breeze.

properties.name: The Pavilion at the Angus Barn
properties.description: The Pavilion is an open air facility with seating of 100 to 400 guests, and it is open all year long and will provide roll-down side and heat in case of inclement weather. The patio is adjacent to the Pavilion and is an excellent area for greeting and cocktails. The stone-paved terrace sits lakeside and can hold up to 200 people. It is the perfect place for wedding ceremonies and social events.

properties.name: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
The Royal Banquet & Conference Center
properties.description: The restored charm of the historic Royal Bakery on Hillsborough St. creates a classic setting for your extraordinary event. Elegant jewel tones, neutral paint colors and Old World décor highlight the space providing a charming contrast to the building’s exposed historic brick wall.

properties.name: The Sage Room
properties.description: This is our second level at 419 Glenwood. The Sage Room can hold up to 120 guests for a formal seated event with a dance floor, and 140 guests seated with no dance floor. The Sage Room can comfortably hold anywhere from 250-280 for a social reception, depending on the floor layout and menu selection. With a large bar and huge dance floor with AV/Lighting/Sound included, and a small patio that guests can enjoy overlooking downtown, this level is hard to beat!

properties.name: The Society Room at Olde Raleigh Distillery
properties.description: Separated from the buzz of the tasting room and bar is our private event space: The Society Room. The 20-foot ceilings and large, custom overhead light fixtures make the space feel open and inviting. The real showstopper, however, is the massive, exposed brick well. Our proprietor wanted to add a unique backdrop to the space and did not stop with just paint. Brandon tore the drywall off bit by bit and then acid washed the entire wall, reviving the unique character of masonry work which dates back to the early 1960s. Seating 200 people comfortably, our event space is equipped with glassware and table setting for your next event, with tables and chairs easily available to rent. With the open space layout, the venue can fit long catering tables, poker tables, a massive dance floor and more—think of it as a blueprint for you to create your ideal layout. Join us to celebrate a milestone birthday or anniversary, host a charity auction or an alumni reunion. Whatever your occasion, we can accommodate all and make it a unique experience your guests will not forget. We will also be using this area for our own events, including classes, activations in partnership with other local businesses and more. Historic Downtown Zebulon also has more than 200 free parking spaces within the area.

properties.name: The Stockroom at 230
properties.description: The Stockroom at 230 is an urban venue nestled on the second floor of a century-old, Classic Revival building on Fayetteville Street in Downtown Raleigh. Abundant in historic charm, the architecture of the venue is characterized by exposed brick, warm hardwood floors, and lofty lattice ceilings, crafting a picturesque canvas to highlight your unique style.

properties.name: The Sutherland
properties.description: The Sutherland, a spectacular location for your special event, wedding or reception, offers beautiful gardens, suites for both bridal and groom parties, as well as numerous romantic venues to choose for your wedding or special event. Found on the National Registry of Historic Places, this unique eighteenth century estate boasts over six acres of ancient oaks, stately magnolias, and beautiful gardens which provide an extraordinary setting for any event.

properties.name: The Upchurch
properties.description:
Built in 1905, the Upchurch-Williams property embodies the rich history and natural beauty of North Carolina, restored and designed with care for your meaningful celebration. Their venue harmoniously blends modern and classic, setting the scene to tell your story.

The beauty and ease of your event experience is woven into every detail of The Upchurch, from the thoughtful design of the property to our passionate staff to our magnificent in-house caterer. Let us be a part of your story.

Rocky Top Catering is The Upchurch's in house caterer for all events. Rocky Top Catering is a full-service premier special event caterer serving the Triangle area and beyond. The locally owned and operated company has been devoted to hospitality for over 20 years, being fully committed to local leadership, studying food and service trends, and listening to customer needs. They take a tailored approach to every client they serve, which allows you to customize all your details to your vision.

The Main House features two beautifully appointed dressing suites, a catering kitchen, a custom built bar, and several luxurious seating spaces. The Patio is the perfect location for a cocktail hour that flows between spaces, as well as a grand entrance to and from The Magnolia Lawn. We provide 5 cocktail tables for your use at The Main House and Patio.

The Magnolia Lawn features approximately 2,000 square feet of exquisite lawn space which can comfortably seat up to 225 guests. Although no in-house ceremony chairs are provided, you are welcome to rent in your preference of chair. Power can be provided to the Lawn via two power hookups.

The Conservatory features 4,200 square feet of versatile event space, including an attached prep kitchen, a large custom built bar, and accessible restrooms located through the beautiful tobacco wood lined corridor. We provide (25) 60" round tables, (2) 48" round tables, (4) 8' banquet tables and 5 cocktail tables, as well as 200 indoor chairs to set off the event.

properties.name: The Venue Raleigh
properties.description:
The Venue Raleigh is located in the warehouse district of downtown Raleigh directly across from train tracks, to give your wedding album a visually-rich touch. Set in a historic building, this setting adorns a carefully-restored interior, while featuring its original Belgian Paver stones. The Venue offers 6,000 square feet of open floor space, to give soon-to-be-weds a blank canvas to design their dream theme. Delicate chandeliers hang from the high ceiling, to add an elegant, sophisticated touch to any celebration. Exposed wooden beams and large windows are also featured throughout the space.

The space can hold up to 350 people. Your guests can relax by the custom bar, where your bartender can create both classic and signature cocktails throughout the evening. A dressing suite is available on site, to ensure you and your wedding party can prepare for your altar in comfort. We also have a lounge available for you and your party’s leisure. Its exterior features exposed red-brick architecture and flourishing trees, making it an ideal backdrop for stylish photo sessions.

properties.name: The Westin Raleigh-Durham Airport
properties.description: At The Westin Raleigh-Durham Airport, we provide the optimal setting for every travel experience, from restorative relaxation to dynamic gatherings to revitalizing retreats. We give personalized attention to each and every element of your stay, so you can leave feeling better than when you arrived. Recharge with our Heavenly® Bed and Heavenly® Bath, high-speed Internet access, refreshment center and other essential amenities for a fulfilling stay, available in each of our 236 contemporary guestrooms and suites. Sip on a cocktail in the lounge or sample a meticulously crafted menu featuring local ingredients at our Italian-inspired restaurant, Il Falo. The house has nine large en-suite guest rooms, sleeping up to 20 guests. In total, the house is ~10,000 square feet, with 15-foot ceilings, original hardwoods, large pocket doors, 10 fireplaces and grand common spaces including a library and parlor. properties.name: Heights House Hotel
properties.description: Montfort Hall, now known as Heights House Hotel, is an Italianate-style mansion completed in 1860. It sits on the highest point of the now-historic Boylan Heights neighborhood in downtown Raleigh. It is one of the few remaining pre-Civil War houses in the Raleigh area and is a National and Raleigh Historic Landmark. Over the past 162 years, the house has seen an array of owners, renovations, restorations and changes. This special piece of Raleigh history has been restored to add to the vibrancy of downtown Raleigh as a boutique hotel and event space. The house has nine large en-suite guest rooms, sleeping up to 20 guests. In total, the house is ~10,000 square feet, with 15-foot ceilings, original hardwoods, large pocket doors, 10 fireplaces and grand common spaces including a library and parlor. It has been meticulously and thoughtfully redesigned, highlighting the authenticity of the original architecture while incorporating modern and vintage touches.
