properties.description: Exceptional quality at crazy fast speed is what Blaze Pizza is all about. Head food guy, Executive Chef Bradford Kent (aka "The Pizza Whisperer"). Fresh, made-from-scratch dough. Healthful, artisan ingredients on the assembly line. Inventive to classic. You decide. Blazing hot oven + dedicated pizza-smith + 180 seconds = fast-fire'd, perfectly crisp perfection. Sound good? Enjoy the rest of your day.

properties.name: Blend Raleigh
properties.description: Blend Raleigh features milkshakes, smoothies and energy drinks near NC State University.

properties.name: BlueFox Indian Cuisine
properties.description: Peacock is all about fresh Indian cooking, with emphasis on their hyderabadi dum biriyani from Peacock restaurants in California.

properties.name: Bluegrass Bagels
properties.description: We know it's tough to get out of the office for a long lunch. Bluegrass Bagels is good at getting you quality food, fast. You can grab something cold from the fridge, or order hot food from the counter.

properties.name: Boba Brew - Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: Boba Brew offers authentically sourced Bubble Tea in a wide array of flavors from Green Tea to Taro Root. All teas come with a choice of Boba (Tapioca Pearls), Jellies or Popping Boba and can be made as a smoothie or served warm as well.

properties.name: Bocci Trattoria & Pizzeria - Cary
properties.description: Bocci Trattoria & Pizzeria is a family-owned and operated full service Italian restaurant serving classic Italian food along with sensational pizzas! The "Vintage Room" is a private dining room that can accommodate up to 50 people seated. It also has a exterior entrance onto the courtyard for additional seating.

properties.name: Bodega
properties.description: Bodega—co-owned by chefs Serge Falcoz-Vigne and Horacio Rodriguez, both formally of the award-winning Saint Jacques French Cuisine restaurant in Raleigh—is turning heads and whetting appetites for delicious wine and small plates. Calling downtown Wake Forest home, Bodega offers an eclectic range of cold and hot small plates with influences from around the world. When it comes to wine, Bodega impresses with almost 40 wines offered by the glass and 3-ounce pours (if you rather prefer a craft beer or rum-based cocktail, you're covered there as well).

properties.name: Bombay Curry
properties.description: Bombay Curry brings you the best of Indian cuisine made from the finest fresh ingredients

properties.name: Bonafide Bakeshop & Cafe
properties.description: Bonafide is a blend of crave-able northern classics and good ol’ southern comforts—all made from scratch. We believe in using quality ingredients with a focus on local seasonal offerings delivered at honest prices to our guests.

properties.name: Bonefish Grill at North Hills
properties.description: Bonefish Grill specializes in market fresh fish and seafood cooked to perfection over a wood-burning grill. But leading up to the moment the fish hits the grill there’s the story of the passionate commitment that drives us to search the fisheries of the world to discover the finest fish and seafood, at the peak of its natural flavor and quality and to bring it home to our customers. Enjoy many specialties and big city cocktails in the rich, sophisticated ambiance of Bonefish Grill.

properties.name: Bongiorno & Son
properties.description:
Bongiorno & Son was founded on the inspiration to create a neighborhood eatery and specialty store that reminded us of our Sunday home-cooked Italian meals around the dinner table. Our menu is a combination of family recipes passed down from one generation to the next and meals inspired by our visits to Italy and our travels around the world. Bongiorno & Son carries on the tradition of our great grandfather with his Patisserie shop in New York’s Little Italy, our Grandfather’s Italian Grocery Store in Jersey City, New Jersey, and of course Grandma and Mom’s home cooking! We strive to provide high quality hard to find Italian meats, cheeses, and retail items.  Founded by Michael Bongiorno in 2020 it has been a longtime dream to open an “Italian Store” as they are commonly known in the North-Eastern part of the United States. 

Visit our store to sample some of our delicious selections of Sandwiches, Soups, Imported Cheeses, Cold Cuts, Sausage, Pasta, Bread, and a wide variety of Antipasto offerings. Let us cater your next event for family parties, holidays, corporate functions, training events, school functions & conferences. We can design a custom package to meet all of your culinary needs.

properties.name: Bonjour Banh Mi & Tea
properties.description: Located in the heart of Research Triangle Park, Mekong Vietnamese Cuisine offers authentic pho and other great South Vietnamese dishes.

properties.name: BottleDog Bites & Brews
properties.description:
A new hybrid bottle shop and bar concept with food, draft beer and TVs. This hybrid concept pairs food with 12 rotating taps and more than 200 options of beer to take home. The diverse menu includes: Canadian Poutine, Montreal smoked meat, Nashville hot chicken, gourmet hot dogs\ and flatbreads.


BottleDog also has a Crowler machine that allows a customer to take home a 32-ounce aluminum can filled with draft beer. Dogs are welcome on our patio but cannot go inside due to food service.

properties.name: Boulevard Pizza
properties.description: Boulevard Pizza is a family-owned pizza restaurant that also offers, pasta, subs, burgers, gyro's and salads. Great lunch specials and a private party room for up 35 people.

properties.name: Boulted Bread
properties.description: Boulted Bread is a stone mill and bakery located in downtown Raleigh. They serve craft bread and pastries made with a variety of heirloom and locally sourced grains.

properties.name: Bowlba Cafe
properties.description: Bowlba Cafe offers quality ramen, noodles, rice bowls and boba tea!

properties.name: Bowstring Pizza and Brewyard
properties.description:
Bowstring Pizza and Brewyard offers craft cocktails, local draft beer, and wood-fired pizza served in a 100 year-old garage bar and outside on our two patios & brewyard. Located across from Snoopy's on Wake Forest Road!

Bowstring is also available for events and rentals.

properties.name: Braise Contemporary Southern (Raleigh Marriott Crabtree Valley)
properties.description: Braise serves an unforgettable breakfast buffet with everything from mouthwatering grits to bacon and sausage, and Southern fusion lunch and dinner dishes not to be missed. The master bartenders have been trained in pouring the perfect bourbon as well.

properties.name: Bravos Pizzeria
properties.description: Bravos Pizzeria brings New York-style pizza to the Wendell area! Pick-up and delivery available.

properties.name: Brecotea Baking Studio
properties.description: Brecotea is a new brand of bread, coffee and tea that has recently emerged to cultivate consumers. We pride ourselves on using nothing but the freshest ingredients.

properties.name: Brickhouse Sports Bar and Grill
properties.description: The BrickHouse features eight 120" projection screens! Come on out and celebrate. Located in the heart of Raleigh, off Hillsborough St. (directly across from Meredith College and close to NC State, PNC Arena and the North Carolina State Fairgrounds). BrickHouse also offers a full-service menu featuring American favorites.

properties.name: Brier Creek Beer Garden
properties.description: Located in Brier Creek Commons, 52 craft beer drafts, 100+ bottles, wine, spirits, lunch and dinner menu available. Saturday and Sunday brunch menu served 10am-3pm.

properties.name: Bright Spot Donuts
properties.description: Bright Spot Donuts is a donut shop from the makers of Benchwarmers Bagels and Boulted Bread offering fried donuts and coffee.

properties.name: Brigs Great Beginnings
properties.description: Small Private Parties Large Banquets and Receptions

properties.name: Brigs at Maynard Crossing
properties.description: Family atmosphere.  Moderately-priced breakfast, lunch and dinner restaurant.

properties.name: Brigs of Wake Forest
properties.description: Hot sandwiches, gourmet salads, and dozens of award winning breakfast entrees! Full menu served anytime.

properties.name: Brio Italian Grille
properties.description: Experience the flavors of Italy at Brio Italian Grille with our Fresh Salads, Pasta, Entrees & More. Open for Dine In, To Go and Catering.

properties.name: Brixx Wood Fired Pizza - Bedford Village
properties.description: Brixx is the spot for families and friends to come together to enjoy each other while feasting on wood fired fare, salads, pasta, craft beer and wine. Their fresh ingredients and fine dining techniques meet everyday, casual food so you can sit back and connect in comfort. Vegan or gluten-free? Worry not — Brixx believes everyone should be able to go out for delicious food, regardless of dietary differences.

properties.name: Brodeto
properties.description:
At Brodeto, renowned Chef Scott Crawford pays homage to the Adriatic Sea, spotlighting the culinary traditions of Southern Italy and Croatia. Our menu emphasizes lighter, seafood-centric dishes, reflecting the diverse and vibrant tastes of these coastal regions.

Complimenting these offerings, Beverage Manager Jordan Joseph has curated a menu of coastal-inspired cocktails, amari, and herbal liqueurs, alongside a diverse array of wines from Italy, Croatia, and the broader Adriatic area.

properties.name: Brothers of New York Pizza
properties.description: Life is too short for bad pizza! Brothers of New York Pizza offers hot or cold heroes (like the Philly Cheesesteak or the Chicken Cutlet Club), authentic pastas (like the Eggplant Parmigiana) and, of course, gourmet N.Y. pizzas with all of your favorite toppings. Located in Millpond Village shopping center at the corner of Ten Ten Rd. and Kildaire Farm Rd.

properties.name: Bru's Public House
properties.description:
Bru's Public House is open for lunch, dinner, late-night, and everything between.

Whether you live in the neighborhood and want to become a regular or you’re just stopping in before a concert at PNC Arena, their team is here to serve up fresh dishes from their kitchen, cold beers, and refreshing cocktails. Come on in and grab a table!

properties.name: Bruegger's Bagels - Wakefield Commons
properties.description:
Founded in 1983, Bruegger’s is renowned for its authentic New York-style kettle-boiled and stone hearth-baked bagels, made with only 5 simple ingredients.

In addition, the Bruegger’s Bagels at 10750 Wakefield Commons Dr in Raleigh, NC serves a wide variety of proprietary 100% made- in-Vermont cream cheeses, freshly-prepared breakfast and lunch sandwiches, garden-fresh salads, hearty soups, desserts and custom-roasted coffees — but the essence of Bruegger’s hasn’t changed. We’re still committed to baking authentic New York-style bagels in small batches all day long.

For more information, follow Bruegger's Bagels on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram, and join the Bruegger’s Bagels Inner Circle Rewards program at brueggers.com to receive news and special offers.

properties.name: Bruster's Real Ice Cream
properties.description: Bruster's Real Ice Cream is a counter-serve chain where all of the ice cream selections are made fresh on-site every day.

properties.name: Buckwheat Farm
properties.description: Buckwheat Farm offers delicious, homemade strawberry ice cream that is churned on-site, one batch at a time, using their own berries. All of their jam and jelly is made at the farm using only locally grown produce picked at the peak of ripeness to give it the greatest flavor possible. There jams and jellies make great gifts or are a wonderful way to treat yourself and their honey comes from their own bees, naturally!

properties.name: Budacai
properties.description: Budacai offers asian street food, baos, buns, bowls, boba tea, boba tea with alcohol.

properties.name: Buena Papa Fry Bar
properties.description:
Buena Papa Fry Bar offers french fries “con todo” (with everything), every tasty topping you could imagine. Colombian-inspired, Latin-infused sabor (flavor): hand-cut, made-to-order gourmet french fries with delicious premium toppings. 

Come try the familiar taste of a crispy, creamy french fry coupled with the bright, bursting flavors of Latin America! Sabrosos!

properties.name: Buffalo Brothers
properties.description: Buffalo Brother's has something for everyone in your family.  We pride ourselves in providing exceptional service, tasty and unique dishes, in a clean and safe environment.

properties.name: Buffalo Brothers Garner
properties.description: Buffalo Brothers is a premier spot for food, drinks and fun! With an expansive menu highlighting mouth-watering pizza and burgers, as well as appetizers, soups, salads, wraps, sandwiches and more, there is something for everyone! Not to mention the buffalo wings, just like they make back home! Whether you're looking for a family-friendly restaurant, someplace to watch the big game or a girls' night out, there's no place better than Buffalo Brothers.

properties.name: Buffalo Brothers Wake Forest
properties.description: Buffalo Brothers Pizza and Wing Company tries its best to make sure their menu is full of delicious items made fresh everyday at an affordable price. Many of their menu items are "only found here" in nature.

properties.name: Buffalo Wild Wings - Garner
properties.description: Award-winning Buffalo, New York-style wings in your choice of 24 sauces or seasonings.

properties.name: Buffalo Wild Wings - Holly Springs
properties.description: Award-winning Buffalo, New York-style wings in your choice of 24 sauces or seasonings.

properties.name: Buffalo Wild Wings - Morrisville
properties.description: Award-winning Buffalo, New York-style wings in your choice of 24 sauces or seasonings.

properties.name: Bul Box - Morrisville
properties.description: Using the freshest possible ingredients, we offer a variety of mouth-watering signature boxes inspired by our favorite destinations, as well as a variety of customizable options to please fitness fiends and carboholics alike. So come walk through our door and experience a journey of flavor. There’s something here for everyone.

properties.name: Bul Box - Transfer Co. Food Hall
properties.description: Using the freshest possible ingredients, we offer a variety of mouth-watering signature boxes inspired by our favorite destinations, as well as a variety of customizable options to please fitness fiends and carboholics alike. So come walk through our door and experience a journey of flavor. There’s something here for everyone.

properties.name: Burger Village
properties.description:
Burger Village is a locally women-owned & operated hamburger joint located at 510 Glenwood Avenue in Raleigh, NC 27603. The restaurant is dedicated to offering delicious and healthy food options using only the highest quality, locally sourced ingredients

The menu at Burger Village features a range of options, including organic grass-fed signature burgers, vegan burgers, organic salads, and fresh hand-cut French fries. We make onion rings from scratch, a unique and tasty addition to our menu.

For those with dietary restrictions, Burger Village is a peanut-free establishment that offers gluten-free options. We also have a wide variety of handspun organic milkshakes, signature cocktails, and local beers to complement your meal.

Burger Village is proud to offer various beverages to complement its delicious food. Our signature cocktails are a must-try, as they are specially crafted to pair perfectly with our signature burgers.

properties.name: BurgerFi Cary
properties.description: The Burgerfication of the nation has begun. Natural Angus, Grass Fed, Humanely Raised, 100% Antibiotic and Hormone Free, Sustainable Farmed- Guilt Free. A modern, urban version of the 1950's roadside burger stand. All Natural Angus beef is used to make tender, juicy, and delicious burgers. Hand-cut Idaho potatoes fried crisp in 100% peanut oil for flavor and health. Gigantic onion rings are light and crunchy. All Natural frozen custard is made fresh every 2 hours. A rotating selection of local craft brews and wines served in comfortable recycled furniture and fixtures. Feel Good Again About Eating.

properties.name: BurgerFi Raleigh
properties.description: BurgerFi focuses on all-natural, grass-fed beef - because it tastes better, and it's better for you- with no chemicals, and no additives. Also, where others limit their menu to just the basic, no-frills options, BurgerFi has built a menu with specialty items like Kobe beef hot dogs, gourmet toppings, delectable desserts, craft beer & wine, and an overall focus on a healthier menu selection.

properties.name: Burney's Sweets & More of Raleigh

properties.name: Burrito Shak - Cary

Quick Service. Crafted Recipes. Coastal Vibes. Made from scratch burritos, tacos, quesadillas and more.

properties.name: C & T Wok Chinese and Thai Cuisine
properties.description: C & T offers traditional, authentic Szechuan and Thai food that locals in Morrisville have come to swear by. Open for lunch and dinner, stop by and sit down in the cozy dining area or place a takeout order on the go. Bring a group and order family style!

properties.name: CO
properties.description:
CO's menu is full of bright, bold flavors from Southeast Asia that everyone can enjoy. Explore new dishes or taste familiar ones; from noodles to pho, sushi to banh mi.  

CO is designed to be a place for gathering. Taste fresh, robust flavors, and cheers with signature cocktails made from scratch, designed to pair perfectly with a variety of dishes on the menu. Gluten-free and vegan options guarantee there’s something for everyone, every time you visit.

properties.name: CRU Food & Wine Bar
properties.description: Perfectly poised in the heart of the active Fenton triangle, just around the corner from the theaters, the Sephora, salons, Pilates, gelato, sporting goods & clothing stores, soccer park, aquatic center and so much more. After all that activity, you are going to need a place to unwind. Let our CRÚ staff take care of you! Stop by and experience the unique mix of Napa-style foods, wines, fun and relaxation that only CRU can offer.

properties.name: Cafe Carolina & Bakery
properties.description: Our passion is creating a great experience for our guests. We love sharing “Cafe Life” with them and providing a place where they can stop by for a quick bite or linger a bit longer to relax, work and socialize. It’s an honor that many of our guests consider Cafe Carolina “their place” to visit.

properties.name: Caffe Luna
properties.description: Superb food, outstanding service and warm friendly ambiance have made Caffe Luna the ideal location for dining and catering for more than 15 years. Whether you require a small dinner meeting with complete privacy or an off-site event for 500 people, Caffe Luna will happily cater your event.

properties.name: Cantina 18 - Raleigh
properties.description: Cantina 18 is located in Cameron Village, minutes away from downtown Raleigh. They serve fresh southwest cuisine and a variety of high quality cocktails. Open for lunch and dinner seven days a week, Cantina 18 offers a variety of takes on southwestern in the taco platters, nachos, sandwiches and seasonally inspired entrees. Stop by today and enjoy a drink, a meal or both in the dining room or on the spacious 18 table patio.

properties.name: Canto Brasil
properties.description: Canto Brasil invites you on a culinary journey through the vibrant flavors and rich traditions of Brazil. From savory feijoada to succulent churrasco, their menu celebrates the diverse regional cuisines that make Brazilian food so unique and irresistible.

properties.name: Cape Fear Seafood Company

properties.name: Capital City Chop House
properties.description: The Chop House is not a new concept. It's an old one and a basic one. We put in the quality and the time it takes to be better than the best. In reality, that means we take the time that others don’t to make dining here an exceptional experience. Every meal here is inspected twice – once by our Chef and again by our Executive Manager, so that when it is served to you we know it meets our high quality standards, and yours. As for the steaks, chops and seafood we serve, the standards are also simple. We serve the best available. We trust you will enjoy your experience with us.

properties.name: Cappolla's Pizza & Grill - Cary

Owners Kirk & Juliann make all cookies from scratch - try our eight regular flavors or the special of the week!

properties.name: Captain Stanley's Seafood
properties.description: Captain Stanley's is a family owned and operated "calabash style" seafood restaurant.

properties.name: Carmen's Cuban Cafe and Lounge
properties.description:
Carmen's Cuban Cafe & Lounge is the place to enjoy a fine and authentic Cuban dish at the right price. Carmen's is the first and only authentic Cuban restaurant in the area. With Cuban-born Chef/Owner, Alfonso Sama, watching closely over every dish going out you can assure yourself your receiving the best.


The food is great, the decor is beautiful, and the service is friendly. With a tropical atmosphere and Cuban music playing all night, one can forget they're in Morrisville, NC. The best part of all, the prices here are affordable.


Weekend nights Carmen's Cuban Cafe & Lounge becomes Touch Night Club, from 10pm to 3am, with the best in Latin and International music. If you're looking for the best in Salsa, Merengue, Bachata and more, don't miss the fun and visit Carmen's Lounge!

properties.description: Carolina Ale House is a family-friendly, sports-themed restaurant known for food, sports and fun. Its extensive menu goes beyond the typical sports bar fare to satisfy all cravings its wide selections of ales is recognized as one of the best in the market.

properties.description: Carolina Barbecue of Garner strives to offer the best in Eastern N.C. barbecue, southern fried chicken, cooked-to-order seafood and down-home country cooking. They also offer fresh homemade banana pudding and peach cobbler to hit that sweet spot. So sit back, relax and enjoy some down home cooking and Carolina Barbecue's unique blend of vinegar and spices.

properties.name: Carolina Fish Fry Co.
properties.description: Carolina Fish Fry Co. has been in the seafood restaurant business for 30 years. Our award-winning tradition of quality, freshness, and affordability that started on the South Carolina coast is now available in 3 N.C. locations, with our newest location in the Raleigh area. properties.name: Carolina Popcorn Shoppe
properties.description: Carolina Popcorn Shoppe is locally owned and operated. They've been making only the best ultra gourmet popcorn since 2000 in Raleigh, the heart of N.C. One bite is all it takes to know you have had the best gourmet popcorn in the world! All of their recipes are original. Quality popcorn is air popped and combined with the finest ingredients to create a product they are proud to call our own. Many varieties are hand blended incorporating real creamery butter, plenty of brown sugar, fresh roasted nuts, rich cheese blends and other superior ingredients. Generous coatings help the popcorn to weigh almost double of competitors in some varieties. Carolina Popcorn Shoppe makes popcorn in small batches using no preservatives, and hand pack it the same day utilizing an air tight system so that you can expect more.

properties.name: Carroll's Kitchen
properties.description: Carroll's Kitchen is a social enterprise, nonprofit restaurant with a vision to end homelessness for women in Raleigh and inspire everyone in the city to make a positive change by providing job training for women coming out of homelessness. Carroll's Kitchen offers grab-and-go lunch and simple catering to fuel the city.

properties.name: Casa Carbone Ristorante
properties.description: CASA CARBONE RISTORANTE offers a rich family tradition of authentic southern Italian specialties. Since 1984, co-owners Maria and Michael House have carried on the legacy of great food in a family atmosphere.

properties.name: Cava - Cary
properties.description: CAVA is a culinary brand born out of the desire to share the Mediterranean way of life, bold flavors and innovative experiences in an accessible format. Founded by three first-generation Greek Americans--Ted Xenohristos, Ike Grigoropoulos and Executive Chef Dimitri Moshovitis--CAVA’s 80+ locations provide a welcoming fast-casual experience with a fully customizable menu composed of fresh ingredients, made in-house every day. CAVA’s line of chef-crafted dips and spreads can also be found in Whole Foods and specialty grocery stores nationwide.

properties.name: Centro
properties.description:
Centro was designed with freshness, love, art and authenticity in mind. Lunch is set up as "grab-and-go" -- high quality Mexican food served quickly for your busy day downtown. For dinner Centro becomes a full-service restaurant. The seasonal menus feature both contemporary and traditional Mexican cuisine. Centro prides themselves on using as many fresh organic and local ingredients as possible to provide you with healthy, flavorful food as well as to support our local farmers. 


Centro's unique Saturday Brunch features Mexican and Colombian favorites, and twists on classic brunch cocktails. The bar specializes in making fresh juice margaritas, creative tequila cocktails and some say the best mojito in town. The wine selection features Spanish and Latin American wines and with over 65 tequilas.

properties.name: Cha House Raleigh
properties.description:
Ni Hao, and welcome to Cha House, an Asian-inspired family tea house, influenced by the tastes and traditions of our home, Taiwan. At Cha House, we craft the richest flavors, spices, and aromas to blend the perfect cup of tea.

Quality is at our core and we won't settle for anything less. Working directly with farmers and suppliers in Asia, we ensure our drinks and our dishes consist only of authentic and pure ingredients. Whether it's our premium loose-leaf blends, our brown sugar boba, or a signature Taiwanese street dish, we work hard to bring out the most in our Taiwanese tradition of flavor without sacrificing the well-being of our heritage, our families, our global community and you, our customer.

We invite you to enjoy Cha House. Indulge in a savory cup of tea and a delectable dessert. Let our flavors and aromas nourish your senses. Freshly brewed, all natural, soothing. From our homes to your hearts. We look forward to having you with us at Cha House.

properties.name: Chaat Mandi
properties.description:
Chaat is the food that makes up what we think of when we think of Indian street food or snack food, but to us, it’s the flavors we grew up on. It’s the flavors we enjoyed while we went to the nearby shopping centers with our friends. It’s the flavors we snacked on while doing our homework after school. It’s inviting, homey, and most importantly, delicious! 

We want to provide you with that same experience. Taste the sweet and spicy, crunchy and tangy, and light and refreshing. With craveable and satisfying flavors of Indian classics, as well as our own unique twists and dishes, we are sure that you will find exactly what you are looking for to satisfy that chaat craving. Indulge in our expertly and mindfully cumulated menu to be transported to the curbside stands in India.

The culture of his homeland of Lebanon is infused into the meals through his love of cooking, and many days he can be found sitting with his customers laughing and eating together. Charlie's Kabob Grill, where fresh food, fast service and Mediterranean flair meet for lunch, dinner and just about anytime!

properties.name: Chef's Palette Restaurant and Bar

Chef’s Palette is a friendly neighborhood bar and restaurant at the corner of Kildaire Farm Rd. and Ten Ten Rd. in Cary. Chef’s Palette considers the facilitation of a great dining experience an art form. They embrace the concept of creative flair and originality in every aspect of service. Going out to dine should be a pleasure for all the senses!


Come taste the mouthwatering dishes made from the freshest ingredients. Enjoy the aroma of a home-cooked meal, made to order just for you. Take in the beauty of original artwork decorating the walls, all created by local artists. Listen to the sounds of exceptional live music on Friday and Saturday nights. Relax in a comfortable dining room or unwind in the bar and lounge area. If you have never dined at Chef's Palette before, stop in and discover why it's special!

Colletta’s cuisine draws influence largely from Northern Italy, putting a twist on treasured classics and introducing modern culinary techniques with the changing of the seasons. At Corbett's Burgers they want to serve their guests the best burgers and hot dogs in town! That’s why they painstakingly grind their own burgers fresh daily and hand-patty each burger. This is the same fresh grind that goes into their house-made chili for our delicious Nathan’s and Carolina Bright Leaf hot dogs. They also make in-house creamy buttermilk coleslaw, yummy baked beans, tangy pimento cheese, scrumptious banana pudding, fresh squeezed orangeade, delicious salmon cakes and Corbett’s two secret sauces--Tangy Ranch and BBQ Island.

They have tried to get a good sampling of soda from all over the country. So far they have 245 varieties and counting. Corbbett's also went to great lengths to try and select only sodas that really tasted good. They didn't want just a quantity of beverages, but quality. They did throw a few interesting flavors in the mix (bacon anyone?), but overall they believe you’ll find several you and your family can enjoy.

properties.name: DICED Downtown Raleigh
properties.description:
LET’S GET TRANSPARENT…

- We consistently set new standards in the fast casual industry by only using the highest quality products available.

- We use 100% Extra Virgin Olive Oil for everything, no seed oils or vegetables oils in sight. 

- No need to be scared of a mystery piece of meat - we trim any extra fat before cooking and use grass-fed steak, hormone free chicken, phosphate free shrimp, organic tofu, and real turkey (no deli meat). 

- We don’t cut corners - our Carrot Ginger uses real ginger, real carrots, real green onions. Our Avocado Bacon Ranch uses real avocado and real bacon. The list goes on for every one of our dressings…

- Our veggies and proteins are simply seasoned with extra virgin olive oil, salt, & pepper before being roasted or grilled.

- We cook our food fresh every single day so you can count on consistency and overall freshness.

- We actually DICE your salad/wrap to create a “chopped salad”, so you get everything in each bite.

Whether you are a Raleigh local or visitor, come out to try this satisfying street food today!

properties.name: Feng Cha Morrisville
properties.description:
Feng Cha Teahouse is the place to be for socialites. Our inclusive environment ensures that everyone can bond over the joy of tea. It's not uncommon to see people studying together or catching up with friends.

Our passion for making tea extends far beyond our drinks. All of our stores strive their best to provide a comfy teahouse experience to our customers. In Feng Cha, we always working hard on finding good ingredients to make our quality drinks and fine pastries, even the music that you hear in store is carefully chosen to ensure a relaxing in-store experience. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, catching up with friends, or simply craving some delicious Mexican cuisine, we've got you covered.

properties.name: Figulina
properties.description:
Figulina is a pasta focused restaurant located in the warehouse district of downtown Raleigh, N.C. 

They are an airy, intimate restaurant that uses fresh pasta to celebrate the seasonal ingredients and people of the Carolinas; the ideal spot for everyday or special occasions.

properties.name: Five Points Baking Co.
properties.description: Five Points Baking Company (FPBC) is a Raleigh venture dedicated to producing gluten-free, all-natural snacks without sacrificing flavor or texture. Their mission is to offer gluten-free options without compromise--the kind of treats you look forward to savoring, not mere imitations of your original favorites. FPBC bakes classic Southern cheese straws and melt-in-your-mouth almond shortbread. With all the goodness of almonds, the cheese straws are gluten-free while boasting 3g carbs and 5g protein per 1-oz serving. They mean it when they say the classic Southern cheese straw just got better! All snacks are baked in small batches, by hand, using premium all-natural ingredients. No artificial flavors. properties.name: Five Star Restaurant
properties.description: Five Star is the answer to sophisticated Asian dining and entertainment. The vibrant colors and urban chic décor create a cozy yet refined ambience whether one is enjoying a delectable meal or merely having cocktails with friends. Five Star is located downtown in the heart of Raleigh’s warehouse district and is reminiscent of a speak-easy establishment, as its unmarked entrance blends in with the surrounding brick buildings.

properties.name: Flame Kabob
properties.description: Food is ordered at the counter for now, though evening table service is in the offing. Bakhshandeh says he also plans to offer live Persian music or a DJ on Friday and Saturday nights.

properties.name: Flask & Beaker
properties.description:
Innovative. Creative. Brilliant. A restaurant situated on North Carolina State University’s inspiring Centennial Campus has a lot to live up to. But with smartly designed spaces, a locally curated menu, and breathtaking views of Lake Raleigh, Flask & Beaker doesn’t disappoint. As its name suggests, Flask & Beaker is a deliciously successful experiment in upscale dining and mixology not to be missed during your upcoming visit to Raleigh.

With its prime location on the NC State Centennial Campus, Flask & Beaker is your refined but relaxed meeting place for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Whether you’re heading out to the world-renowned Lonnie Poole Golf Course, relaxing after a long day of research, or gearing up for game day, Flask & Beaker mixes up innovation, creativity, and brilliance to offer you a wholly unique Raleigh dining experience.

properties.name: Flattz Signature Flat Bread Sandwiches
properties.description: Flattz' specialty is flatbread sandwiches with fillings that are as eclectic as is the  owner’s background. Chef Tony roams the culinary globe, from his native South to Asia and the Mediterranean, for inspiration for  flatbread fillers. These he piles generously onto a foundation of roghani naan, an Indian bread that falls somewhere between the more familiar tandoori naan and pita bread, in texture. Dont let the flatbread fool you. It's Not Pizza! It's much better.

properties.name: Flavor Hills Restaurant and Bar
properties.description:
Flavor Hills was conceived with a heartfelt mission – to infuse the world of dining with energy, excitement, and a deep sense of community. Rooted in the vision of its Marine Corps veteran owners, hailing from bustling cities, the restaurant was born from a longing for upscale modern dining in a place where people could truly be themselves and unwind. As technology advances, it's easy to lose sight of genuine connections, and Flavor Hills aims to remedy that by creating a haven where individuals can rediscover the joy of human interaction in a positive and inviting atmosphere.

Their mantra is simple yet profound – Eat, Laugh, Drink – and it resonates through every facet of their establishment. The paramount goal is to elevate the guest experience to a level that transcends a mere meal. The staff is nurtured to embody this philosophy, making Flavor Hills a sanctuary where patrons can immerse themselves in life's pleasures and relish each moment.

properties.name: Fleming's Prime Steak House & Wine Bar
properties.description: Welcome to Fleming’s Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar at Crabtree Valley Mall – the contemporary iteration of the classic American Steakhouse. properties.name: Golden Krust Caribbean Restaurant
properties.description:
In 1989, Lowell Hawthorne, along with his wife Lorna, four of his siblings and their spouses, pooled all of their resources to open the first Golden Krust restaurant on East Gun Hill Road in the Bronx, New York. The pivotal year of 1993 signified Golden Krust’s relocation of its manufacturing operations to the South Bronx, eventually purchasing nearly the entire block from 172nd Street to Claremont Parkway on Park Avenue.

The business became so successful that the Hawthornes were encouraged to create franchises, and they seized the opportunity to do just that. Golden Krust became the first Caribbean-owned business in the U.S to be granted a franchise license. By 1996, they owned 17 restaurants throughout New York City. Today, Golden Krust Caribbean Restaurants operates over 125 restaurants in North America.

properties.description: At Great Harvest Bread Co., we’re dedicated to providing our community with warm, welcoming service and fresh, delicious baked goods each day. This casual restaurant is building a loyal following in and around the Triangle by serving healthy and tasty Japanese food in a flash to people looking for a refuge from burgers and fries, or the other fast food places in town. Hibachi with rice or noodles flies out of the kitchen almost as fast as orders are placed. You know they're fresh because you can watch the cooks put them together in the open kitchen just behind the counter.

properties.description: Hibernian is a traditional Irish pub through and through with authentic hearty Irish fare, old world charm, genuine accents and a staggering selection of beer!

properties.name: Hickory Tavern - Cary
properties.description: Hickory Tavern is the perfect place for a business lunch or lunch with the girls. It's perfect for dinner after the kids' baseball game or date night with that special someone. If you're looking to celebrate the day's victories at Happy Hour then Hickory Tavern is right up your alley. And look no further than Hickory Tavern if you're in the mood for an all-out party night. Did we mention game-day? If you want to watch the game, any game, then you can't beat Hickory Tavern.

properties.name: Hickory Tavern - Holly Springs
properties.description: Hickory Tavern is the classic American story of how a couple of guys, who didn't like their options, built something that became bigger than they ever dreamed possible. A place to hang out that let's you watch the sports you want to watch, have a couple of cold beers, eat great food and get great service. Hickory Tavern is a social gathering spot that is driven by events and is centered around lively bars. It's a place that serves great food and has a passion for sports, entertainment and good times!

properties.name: High Park Bar & Grill
properties.description: Serving wings, soups and salads, subs and sandwiches, burgers, entrees including beef stew, meatloaf and breaded veal cutlet, and homemade desserts. Domestic and imported beer, plus six on tap and wine. Covered outdoor seating.

properties.name: Himalayan Nepali Cuisine
properties.description: Located at Chatham St., near downtown Cary, Himalayan Nepali Cuisine is committed to serving all the flavors of areas surrounding the Himalaya region. Having 25 years of experience, the chef is passionate to help you experience the best meal that is cooked in their kitchen. The chef prepares foods using only the freshest ingredients. Dine-in or take out delicious Nepali and Indian food.

properties.name: Homegrown Pizza
properties.description: Family-owned and operated restaurant serving pizza, sandwiches, burgers, wings and so much more! Pizza dough, sourdough bread, meatballs, chili, wing sauce and blue cheese dressings are all made-from-scratch daily.

properties.name: Honeysuckle Gelato
properties.description:
At Honeysuckle Gelato, we make bad days good and good days better by creating delicious gelato and joyful experiences.

As part of our mission, we proudly partner with Feeding America Network food banks to donate 5% of companywide profits.

As we continue to grow, we stay committed to our vision of providing the perfect dessert for any occasion while setting the bar for quality and innovation. Be sure to stay tuned as new offerings are always in the making

properties.name: Howling Cow Dairy Education Center & Creamery
properties.description:
For decades, NC State’s dairy processing plant, the Feldmeier Dairy Processing Lab, has been primarily known for their delicious ice cream, a State Fair favorite.  The most recent renovations in 2005 added the ability to provide cutting-edge food science innovations and research on popular locavore foods such as farmstead cheeses.

100% — yes, ALL — of the plants current operating costs are generated by revenues from the sale of dairy products, research grants, and fees from educational seminars. The addition of a full-service Creamery Café and Dairy Education Center at our farm will help increase our ability to both educate and enhance teaching and outreach capabilities.

A true destination learning center, visitors to the Lake Wheeler farm Howling Cow Dairy Education Center and Creamery, can enjoy an ice cream sundae while watching video feeds of the plant in operation, or discovering the many facets of North Carolina’s dairy industry on interactive video exhibits.  State-of-the-art Distance Learning technology will bring expanded dairy support to participants nationwide.

properties.name: Hwy 55 Burgers Shakes & Fries (Knightdale)
properties.description: Craving the timeless taste of delicious french fries, fresh custard and a juicy cheeseburger, just the way you like it? Bring the whole family to Hwy 55 Burgers, Shakes & Fries!

properties.name: Hyderabad House
properties.description: The name “Hyderabad” comes with an epitome of cultural diversity, and food is the integral part of any culture. Inspired from this heritage, your “Hyderabad House” -the methodically growing Indian restaurant chain.

properties.name: I Heart Mac & Cheese
properties.description: Craving comfort food with a twist? Indulge in chef-inspired mac & cheese, grilled cheese sandwiches, flatbreads, & more at I Heart Mac and Cheese! With BYO and dietary restriction friendly options, there's something for everyone to enjoy!

properties.name: Il Bacio Italian Grill & Pizza
properties.description: Il Bacio Italian Grill is family owned and operated. Michele Rizzo, Carlo and Giuseppe Finazzo brought their family’s famous Sicilian dishes and created an original menu using the freshet quality and best ingredients. Chef Rizzo has been cooking authentic Italian food for years in the local area. Il Bacio brings the taste of Sicily to you!

properties.name: Il Falò
properties.description:
Il Falò celebrates the art of cooking with fire--with quality ingredients prepared skillfully and cooked to perfection over the open flame.

Our wood-fired oven and grill add a kiss of fire to artisan-quality meats, fresh seafood, vegetables sourced from our local partners, pizzas on house-made sourdough and elements of our craft cocktails.

With an emphasis on the craft of cooking, ingredients are sourced thoughtfully, pastas and breads are made in-house, and a contemporary approach is applied to Italian tradition.

properties.name: Imperial Garden Restaurant
properties.description: Imperial Garden is an award-winning, authentic Chinese Restaurant which opened its doors in 1987 as the original Chinese Restaurant in the Triangle area.

properties.name: Inchin's Bamboo Garden
properties.description: Unique fusion Chinese restaurant offering Indian-style Chinese cuisine. The cuisine is influenced by a wonderful blend of spices from the Szechwan province of China and the flavors of India. Extensive menu with specialty dishes like - Crispy Chili Baby Corn, Pan Fried Chili Paneer, Chili Chicken, Cauliflower Manchurian, Lamb Hot Garlic, Shrimp Tobanjan, Burnt Garlic Fried Rice, Chili Garlic Hakka Noodles and more.

properties.name: Insomnia Cookies
properties.description: Insomnia Cookies was born out of the dislike of heavy meals late at night, love of food delivery and the realization that by the time you get hungry at night, nothing is open. Insomnia Cookies serves fresh, oven baked cookies in an assortment of flavors and offers delivery until 3am! Popular flavors include Chocolate Chunk, Snickerdoodle, Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup and the S'mores Deluxe. Insomnia Cookies also offers brownies, cookie cakes and ice cream with toppings such as Mint Chocolate, Cookie Dough and Snickers. The requisite pint of cold milk is available with any order. Insomnia Cookies... baked right, late night!

properties.name: Irregardless Cafe
properties.description:
Award-winning Irregardless Cafe has been nourishing the community with delicious meals, attentive service and live music from talented entertainers from around the Triangle since 1975. And speaking of trends, Irregardless was "green" before it was the thing to be, serving good things from the Farmers Market and other local purveyors from the first day they opened, and now also for their own Well Fed Community Garden (just three miles from the Cafe). Join them for lunch, dinner, weekend brunch and for their nightlife menu and try their imaginatively prepared meats, seafood and local fruits and vegetables.

As always, there are vegetarian and vegan options, small plates at dinner, desserts made on-site and any "adult beverage" you can think of, including a great selection of reasonably priced wines and local microbrews. Weeknights enjoy bluegrass, traditional roots, folk and jazz musicians. On Saturday nights, Irregardless features dinner music early and then from 9pm to midnight a "Jazz Club Show" from the best musical ensembles in the area.

properties.description: Chow down on delicious New York pizza from your local, family-owned-and-operated Italian restaurant in Apex. Since 1995, J & S New York Pizza has been dishing out delicious, homemade Italian food, New York-style pizzas, hot and cold subs and traditional and boneless chicken wings. The restaurant also features a fine selection of beer and wine to lift your spirits.

properties.description: Chow down on delicious New York pizza from your local, family-owned-and-operated Italian restaurant in Fuquay-Varina. properties.description: J. Alexander’s is a contemporary American restaurant, known for its wood-fired cuisine. Their core philosophy is to provide you with the highest possible quality dining experience. The menu features a wide selection of American classics including prime rib of beef, steaks, fresh seafood, sandwiches and entrée salads. The menu in each restaurant includes a varied and rotating selection of features like Seafood Czarina, Tuscan Steak, Grilled Fish with Mango Papaya Salsa and Chicken Milanese. The restaurant has a full-service bar that includes an outstanding selection of wines both by the glass and bottle.

properties.name: J. Betski's
properties.description:
J. Betksi's has been serving up Eastern European food for over 16 years in Raleigh. Now relocated to High Park Village near Five Points, their new location offers a casual atmosphere with no reservations required. Their large, open space is welcoming as well as their patio that is dog-friendly. 

J. Betski's serves up small plates and delicious craft cocktails as well as J.Betski’s Grab and Go Market, located at the entrance of the restaurant. Run in and get prepared foods to take home to your family for quick amazing dinners. Our offerings vary each week, but sausage and pierogi dinner packs, soups, salads and pretzels are always available along with a large selection of German beers and a wonderful wine selection as well.

properties.name: JD's Tavern
properties.description: The warm inviting ambiance, fresh handmade food, unique beers and state of the art audio visual package combined with the best people in the industry will ensure that a visit to JD’s Tavern is one that will not soon be forgotten!

properties.name: JT's Creamery
properties.description: JT's Creamery invites you to bring your family and friends to enjoy homemade ice cream, shakes, waffles, and Dole Whip, and spend time in beautiful downtown Holly Springs. JT's Creamery is proud to support family owned dairy farms. Locally sourced all natural ingredients are their pride and joy. You will not find any added colors, dyes, or corn syrups here! Nothing but the best for you and your family! Be sure to check their social media updates for fresh seasonal offerings.

properties.name: Jaguar Bolera

For those looking for a little heat, we even have the legendary Red Snapper (Brown Stew) to spice things up for you.  So if you are craving some authentic Jamaican food but can’t quite make it to the islands, come visit us where the food and feeling is always irie.

Jimmy V's is a unique and modern restaurant created with Jim Valvano's passion and commitment to excellence, with 2.5% of the restaurant's revenue being donated to the V Foundation for Cancer Research. Since opening in 2013 Jimmy V’s has donated over $225,000 to help find a cure for cancer.


Jim Valvano's love for food is the influence behind the menu creation featuring local and seasonal dishes with an emphasis on delicious Italian/American cuisine. Executive chef Tom Stagikas and his team pride themselves on offering down to earth and traditional comfort foods using local farm grown ingredients and straightforward preparations.


Jimmy V's Osteria + Bar's concept is a warm and inviting ambiance for family gatherings, a night on the town or toast drinks with friends. The restaurant is also known for having downtown Raleigh's largest outdoor covered patio complete with a 10’ projection screen making it the ideal location to catch a Wolfpack game!

properties.description: For delicious pizza that satisfies your cravings, go to Johnny's Pizza. Johnny's offers a sumptuous variety of different pizzas, so you can have exactly what you want, including wings, subs, sandwiches, salads, desserts and even gluten free options. properties.description: Jolie is a french bistro offering both classic dishes like Steak Frites au Poivre and modern interpretations such as his White Corn Vichyssoise, complemented by sparkling wines and French aperitifs in an intimate and lively setting. Dinner is served in the chic 28-seat bistro dining room designed by Louis Cherry Architecture – punctuated by French blue, camel-colored leather banquettes and gold accents, and upstairs year-round on the 32-seat lush rooftop garden surrounded by lavender, rosemary and the Raleigh skyline.

properties.name: Jose and Sons
properties.description: Jose and Sons serves comfort food that celebrates their forefathers’s Mexican roots and the culinary traditions of the local neighborhood. They believe the American South and Mexican flavors make really good friends.

properties.name: Joyce and Family Restaurant
properties.description:
Joyce and Family Restaurant offers some of the best home-style country cooking you can find in Fuquay-Varina. Mrs. Joyce knows how to do it right! Everything is made fresh in their kitchen each and every day and they don’t skimp on hard work or flavor. It great is the love she puts into every dish. Some of the things they are famous for are their made from scratch creamy mashed potatoes, perfectly sweet yarns and baked mac and cheese.


Joyce and Family Restaurant also knows that planning and cooking for an event may be very overwhelming. They are here to help, worry no longer and trust Joyce and Family for your catering service. Just call ahead and order; they will deliver it when you want it! Joyce and Family always offers a delicious home cooked meal for every event.

properties.name: JuiceVibes
properties.description: JuiceVibes is an all natural juice bar serving nutrient dense fruit and veggie smoothies. They also offer detoxifying JuiceVibe cleanses.

properties.name: Juicekeys
properties.description: Juicekeys is a juice bar and health boutique. The mission is to provide “KEYS” to great health. Juicekeys is passionate about the synergies between nutrition, education and leading an active lifestyle. This is a locally owned and operated brother-sister team based out of Raleigh.

properties.name: Kabab and Curry
properties.description: Kabab and Curry is located at the heart of the historical Hillsborough St. in Raleigh, N.C. Their main goal is to serve the best Indian and Nepalese food in town with a delightful dining experience and an utmost hospitable environment. The chef brings over 15 years of experience and prides in bringing together the exciting flavors using authentic and fresh ingredients. The staff consists of great team work and guarantees that the delicious cuisine, cozy decor, soft music and attentive service will win your heart each time you dine.

properties.name: Kababish Cafe
properties.description: Kababish Cafe is a celebration of deliciousness and creativity. It is where the aromatic blend of spices and flavors bring Pakistan and India straight to your plate, zestfully mingling the art of Mediterranean fare harmoniously. Serving fresh fruit and veggie smoothies with a skillful balance of invigorating ingredients and the latest advances in nutrition will provide access to a healthier lifestyle that will keep you coming back for more!

properties.name: Kabobi
properties.description: Kabobi offers delicious cuisine inspired from Persia, South Asia and Middle East. Our experienced staff members prepare grilled meat and vegetables in traditional kabob style that allows ideal texture, aroma, and taste of food.

properties.name: Kadhai
properties.description: Tucked away in one corner of Pleasant Valley Shopping Center, in the heart of Glenwood Ave. in North Raleigh, is an authentic Indian restaurant, bringing unique flavors of the Indian Wok along with all its favorite curries to satisfy the most discerning palate. Kadhai's goal is to provide you with the best Indian food in town. Kadhai is inspired by the traditional Indian food bringing unique flavors of the Indian Wok with all the different curries, rice and tandoor items to satisfy your appetite at a reasonable price. With excellent service, price and food Kadhai wants to welcome you to their culture and treat you like family.

properties.name: Kale Me Crazy
properties.description: Kale Me Crazy is a superfood cafe that offers juices, smoothies, salads and wraps in a sleek, upscale environment. They support healthy lifestyles through the use of fresh, organic and raw foods.

properties.name: Kandy Apples by K
properties.description: Don’t wait for the fair to get a candy apple! We have over 15 flavors and a variety of colors! We do parties, showers, and special occasions!!

properties.name: Kanki Japanese House of Steaks & Sushi
properties.description:
Planning a family dinner, birthday dinner or date night in North Raleigh? Try a meal at Kanki Japanese House of Steaks & Sushi in North Market Square, voted “Best Japanese Steakhouse & Sushi Bar in the Triangle” for more than 14 years!

Like all Kanki locations, our North Raleigh Japanese restaurant and sushi house serves up a wide selection of hibachi fare, sushi and other tasty menu items that you, your family and your friends are sure to love. Much of our food is expertly prepared by our chefs right at your table, providing a unique dining experience you’ll never forget.

Enjoy your favorite teppanyaki and sushi rolls at your next corporate gathering or business meeting! Kanki North Market Square is proud to offer office catering in select areas of North Raleigh. Please give us a call for more details.

properties.name: Kanki Japanese House of Steaks & Sushi (Crabtree Valley Mall)
properties.description:
Since 1972, Kanki has been the Triangle’s favorite Japanese steakhouse and sushi house.

Our flagship location at Crabtree Valley Mall is also our most widely recognized.  Visit our Japanese restaurant in Raleigh for expertly prepared hibachi fare, sushi, noodle dishes and much more.  Our Crabtree location also serves up hibachi meals and appetizers at our bar for extended hours after lunch.

Come see why Kanki Crabtree Valley Mall has been voted "Best Japanese Steakhouse and Sushi Bar in the Triangle" for more than 14 years!  Our award-winning restaurant provides the perfect setting for a unique family dinner, celebrations or date night.

properties.name: Kathmandu Kitchen
properties.description: Authentic Himalayan restaurant in heart of Cary with a variety of wonderful Himalayan (Indian, Nepali, Tibetian) dishes to help add a little spice to your life. Stop by and enjoy a taste of India, Nepal or Tibet!

properties.name: Kaze Japanese Steakhouse
properties.description: Upscale Hibachi Restaurant that offers high end sushi and delicious chicken, steak, and shrimp entrees carefully prepared with an entertaining show of course!

properties.name: Ken's Produce and Garden Center

properties.name: Khao Sen Thai & Tea
properties.description: Welcome to Khao Sen, derived from the Thai words for rice (Khao) and noodles (Sen), our restaurant is a celebration of two staples of Thai cuisine, brought to life by our passionate owners, Paul, Joy, and Sara.

properties.name: Kickback Jack's
properties.description:
At Kickback Jack’s, “Best in Class” sports bar, you can enjoy watching your favorite teams, all while experiencing an inviting atmosphere, delicious food, thirst-quenching brews and more. This sports bar and restaurant is a place where you can enjoy a drink with your co-workers, bring your family for lunch or catch up with old friends while cheering on your alma mater.


No matter who you're cheering for, you can watch your favorite football, baseball and basketball teams play on one of the more than 50 high-definition, large-screen televisions on site at the sports tavern. You won't have to miss a single minute of action on the court or field when you watch sports in Raleigh at Kickback Jack’s.

They also have 20 heritage breed chickens and two bee hives to add to the ambiance of the farm. LL Urban Farms sells pumpkins, Christmas trees, turkeys and other seasonal items as well.
