La Farm Bakery is a realization of a lifelong dream... a modern bakery that continues the centuries-old baking traditions and techniques, honoring the ordinary yet extraordinary boulangeries that once flourished in every little town in France. Taste La Farm's artisan breads, tarts, pastries, sandwiches and specialty products and experience the taste of hundreds of years of French cuisine.

properties.name: La Farm Bakery - Glenwood South
properties.description: Artisan bread bakery and European-style cafe, owned by Master Baker Lionel Vatinet. La Farm Bakery is a realization of a lifelong dream... a modern bakery that continues the centuries-old baking traditions and techniques, honoring the ordinary yet extraordinary boulangeries that once flourished in every little town in France. Taste La Farm's artisan breads, tarts, pastries, sandwiches and specialty products and experience the taste of hundreds of years of French cuisine.

properties.name: La Farm Bakery - Preston Corners
properties.description: Artisan bread bakery and European-style cafe, owned by Master Baker Lionel Vatinet. La Farm Bakery is a realization of a lifelong dream... a modern bakery that continues the centuries-old baking traditions and techniques, honoring the ordinary yet extraordinary boulangeries that once flourished in every little town in France. Taste La Farm's artisan breads, tarts, pastries, sandwiches and specialty products and experience the taste of hundreds of years of French cuisine.

properties.name: La Farm Bakery - RDU
properties.description:
Welcome to La Farm Bakery, North Carolina’s beloved European bakery, recognized among the “Best Artisanal Bakeries in North America.”

Whether you’re craving a buttery croissant, tender scone or crusty sourdough, we’ve got what you’re looking for! Hand-crafted from locally grown and milled heirloom grain, baked fresh throughout the day by Master Baker Lionel Vatinet and our skilled team of bakers, our breads, pastries, sandwiches and café dishes will transport you before you even fly the friendly skies!

Our French bistro menu features all-day breakfast dishes like our famous Croque Madame, as well as pastries, soups, salads, sandwiches, burgers, Grab & Go items – and a full-service bar celebrating N.C. beer, wine and spirits. Enjoy a taste of North Carolina before you depart, and take a piece of it with you on your journey!

properties.name: La Farm Bakery - West Cary
properties.description: La Farm Bakery's Whole Foods Market location supplies artisan breads, tarts, pastries, sandwiches and specialty products from its local production spaces in Cary.

properties.name: La Grassa Pastificio
properties.description: La Grassa Pastificio is a new and exciting neighborhood restaurant featuring hand-crafted Italian cuisine. We will be offering a variety of antipasti, pasta, poultry, game, meats, and kinds of seafood from inspired Italian kitchens all over Italy. The menu will feature a variety of high-quality local produce and specialty imported food from Italy and beyond. We will have interesting wines and craft beers to complement the dining experience. Our approach is the timeless pursuit of genuine hospitality. Simple, tasty foods served with a little finesse and a lot of pride.

properties.name: La Rancherita Mexican Restaurant
properties.description: Serving the best Mexican cuisine in North Carolina

properties.name: La Rancherita Mexican Restaurant
properties.description: Serving the best Mexican cuisine in North Carolina

properties.name: La Rancherita Mexican Restaurant
properties.description: Serving the best Mexican cuisine in North Carolina

properties.name: La Santa Modern Mexican Food
properties.description: Authentic Mexican food on Glenwood South in downtown Raleigh!

properties.name: La Terraza Mexican Restaurant
properties.description: Since 2009, we have been serving up a fiesta, with exciting and delicious menu items that are sure to enchant and fascinate our costumers.

properties.name: La Terrazza Raleigh
properties.description: La Terrazza presents a delightful fusion of southern Italian and Mediterranean cuisine, complemented by an enchanting city skyline view. With seasonal delicacies, premium ingredients, and market-fresh produce, our menu showcases traditional favorites with innovative flair. Step into our inviting dining space adorned with floor-to-ceiling glass walls, or unwind at one of our two bars – one indoors and the other nestled in a patio enclosure. We aim to whisk you away to a culinary experience like no other.

properties.name: LaGana Burger Room
properties.description: LaGana has the idea of bringing a different kind of experience when you think about burgers, making everything from scratch, working with local farmers and taking the vibe to a whole different level with elevated ambience, awesome food pairings and beautiful bubbles!

properties.name: Ladyfingers Caterers
properties.description: For nearly 30 years, Ladyfingers catered and collaborated with clients on an array of special events; and they've indulged in crafting a bevvy of delectable spreads and creative recipes along the way. Ladyfingers Caterers provides buffet breakfasts, hot and cold boxed or buffet lunches, buffet dinners and catering for dinner parties and receptions.

properties.name: Larry's Coffee
properties.description: Larry's is crazy about coffee — everything about it. They work with farming partners to get beans with deep, rich flavor profiles needed for a slow-roasting process and turn coffee fantasies into realities with a gonzo approach to blending. Everyone at Larry's Coffee is passionate about something, and are into sustaining the groove with solar powering, bio-diesel delivering, composting and any other planet-happy ideas they can get their hands on.

properties.name: Las Ramblas
properties.description:
Las Ramblas is named for the famed “Las Ramblas” boulevard in Barcelona, Spain where the restaurants, cafes and markets contribute to one of Europe’s most vibrant and delicious destinations.

At Las Ramblas, nestled on a lively corner in North Hills, Executive Chef/ Partner Brian Jenzer’s beautifully curated menu offers an experience of old world meets new world Spain, featuring locally and Spanish sourced tapas-style dishes, Spanish Wine and Sherry, as well as craft beer, and creative craft cocktails.

Look for Spanish snacks – like cured hams, cheeses and olives – as well as traditional tapas, like Pan Con Tomate and Croquettes, and more innovative small dishes like roasted stuffed piquillos with lady goat cheese and pesto, and sherry vinegar marinated artichokes imported from Spain with lemon yogurt, crispy artichokes and grapefruit. Several entrée size options will also be available.

properties.name: Las Rositas
properties.description: Las Rositas is located at 207 N. Arendell Ave. in downtown Zebulon. Offering a wide array of fresh food – omelette, chicken quesadilla, asada taco, shrimp burrito, shrimp salad, bistec a la mexicana, flautas de pollo y res and fish or shrimp ceviche. Las Rositas uses the freshest ingredients in preparing their food to provide the best quality and taste.

properties.name: Layered Croissanterie
properties.description: Layered Croissanterie is a croissant bakery meticulously crafting pastries with a modern twist.

properties.name: Lechón Latin BBQ & Bar
properties.description: Lechon Latin BBQ is a locally and family-owned business based in Raleigh N.C., our mission is to bring Latin America to your plate featuring a variety of wood-fired smoked and grilled BBQ flavors.

properties.name: Lee's Kitchen
properties.description: Lee's Kitchen offers tantalizingly delicious Jamaican and Southern Cuisine, all under one roof. A feast of delicious choices, including mouth-watering oxtails, fried chicken, curry chicken, ribs, fish, yams, collard greens and macaroni and cheese…just to name a few.

properties.name: Lemongrass Thai Restaurant
properties.description: Lemongrass Thai Restaurant serves up some of the hottest dishes in the area. Even the salads here are spicy. The green papaya salad is a bevy of julienned papaya, topped with roasted peanuts and chili peppers, in a lime juice and palm sugar dressing that sweetly evens out the peppers' kick. Duck panang comes lightly fried, sliced and slathered in a strong, creamy coconut-curry sauce with carrots and green beans. Chicken red curry is more bamboo shoot than chicken, but fresh basil leaves make a pungent contrast to this dish, one of many marked "hot and spicy" on the menu. Cool off with the "fresh young coconut milk," a refreshing, clear juice with floating pieces of coconut.

properties.name: Libations 317
properties.description: Libations 317 is a friendly neighborhood bar featuring homemade locally sourced foods and craft cocktails. Their menu includes dips, tacos, hot dogs, and sandwiches.  Libations 317 also features a variety of desserts including homemade cakes, brownies and bars, banana pudding, and homemade ice cream.  As well as their craft beers, their carry boutique wines that you will not find in other bars or restaurants in the area.

properties.name: Lilly's Pizza
properties.description:
Lilly's is an Italian eatery offering a large selection of salads, snacks, strombolis, zones, pastas and Gluten-free pies. Pizza sauce and dough is 100% organic.
Photo via the restaurant

properties.name: Lime & Lemon Indian Grill and Bar
properties.description: Lime & Lemon Indian Grill offers an immersive dining experience with exquisite dishes that will take you on a journey through India's many regions, traditions and festivals. We meticulously curate using only the best ingredients to create dishes that are authentic, unsurpassed, and timeless. All this in an ultra-modern setting to ensure your dining affair is nothing short of perfect.

properties.name: Little Blue Bakehouse
properties.description: Little Blue Bakehouse is a Neighborhood Coffee Shop and Bakery that also acts a small incubator kitchen for local bakery/sweets businesses. Inside, you'll find wares from Little Blue Macaron, Bold Batch Creamery, Bites of Sam, Sunny Bakes and Boozie Bakes!

properties.name: Locked & Loaded Grill
properties.description: There's no better place in town to hang with your friends, and make new ones. There's always something happening at Locked & Loaded! Great deals on all your favorite drinks, live bands every Sat. and burgers, wings with a wide selection of sauces, kickin' appetizers, and lots more!

properties.name: Logan's Roadhouse
properties.description: USDA CHOICE Steaks aged and cut in-house by a trained meat cutter and cooked to perfection over mesquite wood. Ribs are hand-rubbed with our special seasonings and slow cooked in a special oven for a minimum of eight hours to ensure “Fall Off The Bone Quality”. The Rolls are made from scratch daily, every eight minutes and served hot and fresh. Salads are made from scratch daily with top quality produce purchased with the Fresh Point Guarantee. Fresh chicken, never frozen is delivered 3-4 times a week. Homemade soups made with fresh ingredients daily. Hook and Line caught Salmon full of the natural nutrients unlike farm raised salmon. Locan's also only uses Idaho 70 count potatoes for their moist and fluffy texture. N.C. grown in shell peanuts and the Roadhouse Tea, which is their Signature Drink and a favorite for more than 20 years.

properties.name: Lola's Beach Bar
properties.description: Lola's Beach Bar is a vintage beach bar in Raleigh's Five Points serving some of the best island style tacos, nachos, margaritas, cocktails and beer!

properties.name: Longleaf Swine BBQ
properties.description: Longleaf Swine is a whole hog barbecue and smoked meats food trailer serving the greater Raleigh area, coming soon to Transfer Co. Food Hall. They bring smoking back to the basics and focus on the traditional technique of whole hog, all wood methods. Longleaf strives to ensure their recipes are deep rooted in their upbringing while incorporating a modern flair that makes them stand out.

properties.name: Lovegrass Kitchen
properties.description:
Lovegrass Kitchen is a gluten free café serving authentic crêpes, Liege waffles, specially coffee, and more.

Lovegrass Kitchen was founded by Meron Afework Kassa, known by her friends and family for her passionate and unwavering advice in making healthy yet delicious eating choices. Born and raised in Ethiopia, where Teff has been the staple food for over 4000 years, Meron is a firsthand witness of the benefits of Teff. At a young age, Meron moved to Belgium where she quickly developed a passion for European-style cuisine.

properties.name: Lucky 32
properties.description: Enjoy American Southern cuisine, served in an upscale environment, with a beautiful dining room, bar, outdoor terrace and private group dining.

properties.name: Lucky Chicken
properties.description: Lucky Chicken's Peruvian cuisine derives from a "secret recipe handed down from the Incas." Every dish is created using the freshest ingredients to satisfy even the most discerning palates. From the signature ceviche and mouth-watering pollo a la brasa to the sweet suspiro a la limena, Lucky Chicken aims to impress and satisfy.

properties.name: Lugano Ristorante
properties.description: Lugano Ristorante offers a comfortable and casual atmosphere for all of your dining needs. From a business function, a night out with friends and family, to events large or small, Lugano's delivers a memorable experience every time.

properties.name: Lumpy's Ice Cream
properties.description: Lumpy's Ice Cream believes in a simple philosophy - to find the finest ingredients locally and craft them into the best ice cream without any preservatives, additives or synthetic hormones. Go try some for yourself today!

properties.name: Lynnwood Brewing Concern - Lynnwood Grill
properties.description: Located beside the Raleigh Grande Theatre, this locally owned bar and grill is the perfect place to grab a bite before or after the movie. It’s also a cozy place to meet friends for drinks, watch a game or listen to live music. When the weather is nice, enjoy drinking and dining on the outdoor patio.

properties.name: M Sushi
properties.description: M Sushi Cary is Michael Lee's second location dedicated to high-quality seafood. Our menu is small, purposeful, and uses only very special seasonal seafood received directly from Japan, Korea, and the US. The quality of our dishes is a direct result of our dedication to fresh ingredients, and our emphasis placed on maintaining traditional Japanese and Korean Cuisine. We specialize in traditional nigiri and sashimi courses in addition to a once in a lifetime Grand Omakase. M Sushi was ranked in 2022 in OpenTable's top 100 restaurants in American. Also, the only restaurant to make the list from N.C.

properties.name: M Test Kitchen
properties.description: M Sushi Test Kitchen is a creative space for M Restaurants, led by chef Michael Lee, with a constantly evolving menu. Items on menu are intended to be enjoyed tapas style for everything to be shared.  We recommend two or three dishes per guest in order to fully experience the creativity of our chefs.

properties.name: MC Restaurant
properties.description: MC Restaurant offers a modern Asian fusion flair within the historic Jones House in downtown Cary. The menu features chef Michael’s signature dishes and high-end sushi and sashimi with sushi chef Richard Fong.

properties.name: MOD Pizza - Raleigh
properties.description: MOD Pizza serves up individual artisan-style pizzas and salads made on-demand. Customers can design their own pizzas and salads or select from a menu of MOD classics. All are the same price regardless of toppings. The handcrafted pizzas are then fired in an 800 degree display oven and ready to eat in less than five minutes. MOD also offers milkshakes, house-made iced teas and lemonades and more. The only question left is are you MOD?

properties.name: MOD Pizza - Wake Forest
properties.description: MOD Pizza serves up individual artisan-style pizzas and salads made on-demand. Customers can design their own pizzas and salads or select from a menu of MOD classics. All are the same price regardless of toppings. The handcrafted pizzas are then fired in an 800 degree display oven and ready to eat in less than five minutes. MOD also offers milkshakes, house-made iced teas and lemonades and more. The only question left is are you MOD?

properties.name: MOFU Shoppe
properties.description:
MOFU Shoppe derives its name from several sources: “Fu” means fortune in Mandarin Chinese. MO (more) FU (fortune); more food; more fun.


MOFU Shoppe brings the flavors of Asia to downtown Raleigh, fittingly, in an old car dealership (hence the unique garage doors). The dishes are inspired by the foods commonly eaten in several Asian countries and represent the owner's identity in a unique way.

properties.name: Mac's Speed Shop
properties.description: Mac's Speed Shop offers award-winning BBQ, hundreds of beer choices and a come-as-you-are atmosphere. Whether you're a connoisseur or just hungry, we'll treat you to an incredible flavor experience. And at Mac's, everyone (white collar, blue collar or no collar) is welcome. Live music almost every night!

properties.name: Mac's Tavern
properties.description:
Mac's Tavern's all-American menu, great staff and a friendly atmosphere is guaranteed to bring a smile on 
your face. They have made it their goal to bring a friendly neighborhood Tavern to Cary and are delighted to be able to offer you this kind of atmosphere, right on your doorstep. Live bands also perform inside and on their outside patio.

properties.name: MacGregor Draft House
properties.description:
Because we're a "Draft" House, it might be obvious that people are coming for our beer selection. With over 24 brews on tap, you're sure to find a favorite.
Because we're a sports bar, it might be obvious that people are coming to catch the games. With enough widescreen TV's and satellite feeds for all of the games, you won't miss any of the action.
What you might not know is that most people are really coming for our food. Repeatedly voted the "Best Burger in the Triangle" by Spectator Magazine, our burgers are generous 1/2 pounders--hand pattied and then grilled to order. Our appetizers are miles above the standard bar fare, and our "Blue Plate Specials" will remind you of Mom's home cooking.

properties.name: Madame B's Bakery
properties.description: Shane Bryant has been baking since childhood. The genuine passion and love for baking at Madame B's Bakery has been the number one ingredient that sets them apart. This black family-owned business is owned by Shanae Bryant, Durham, NC native. Madame B's Bakery will hold true to its vision of "Heavenly Goodness" in every bite!

properties.name: Madre
properties.description: Madre is a celebration of motherly hospitality and the beautiful way of life found along the Mediterranean. Small plates designed for sharing, wine, cocktails and weekend brunch. A night out, a space to celebrate, people watching and late-night friend making. We can’t wait to welcome you!

properties.name: Makus Empanadas - Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: Brothers Hernan and Santiago Moyano, alongside of lifelong friend Ricky Yofre founded the award winning Makus Empanadas in 2013. Looking to share their Argentinian asado experiences from back home, the Moyanos and Yofre have brought their family recipes to the Triangle.  Makus is a great addition to the Morgan Street Foodhall providing downtown Raleigh with this authentic taste of Argentina.

properties.name: Mama Bird's Cookies + Cream
properties.description: Mama Bird’s Cookies N’ Cream is to provide the community the highest quality and affordable cookies, and gourmet handmade ice cream that is tailored to each customer’s personal preferences and indulgences. Customers will be able to choose from a variety of cookie types, ice cream flavors, and their preferred toppings, as it is constructed right before their very eyes. The company aims to consistently to exceed customer expectations, working to become the leading choice for unique and delicious baked goods and handmade ice cream. More importantly, Mama Bird’s Cookies N’ Cream will provide only the highest quality products, by utilizing local ingredients when possible.

properties.name: Mama Bird's Cookies + Cream Food Cart
properties.description: Mama Bird’s Cookies + Cream offers a unique spin on a timeless dessert by bringing two delicious treats together... cookies + cream! Only the finest ingredients are used in the small-batch ice cream and baked goods. All sweet treats are homemade, affordable, kid- and firefighter-approved! The custom-designed, vintage ice cream carts are available for your special event!

properties.name: Mama Crow's Burger and Salad Shop - Transfer Co. Food Hall
properties.description: Drawing on their own culinary background, the partners in Transfer Co., including Jeanne and Jason Queen, join creative forces with Executive Chef David Mitchell to debut Mama Crow’s. Named after a great-grandmother, Mama Crow’s will feature a menu of fresh, locally inspired salads, fresh ground certified angus beef smash burgers, house-made cheeses and hand-cut fries.

properties.name: Mama Nem’s Creole Soul
properties.description: So, you've got an event coming up. You need some really tasty food at a great price. We've got you covered. Or, meet us at one of our trucks and get some of the BEST Creole Soul food in the Triangle!

properties.name: Mama Voula's
properties.description: As a native of Greece, where Mama Voula served as a personal chef to many families, she quickly acquired the skills to bring the finest Mediterranean dinning from her homeland to the Raleigh area. The truck is known for homemade gyros, chicken kabob pitas, homemade baklava and freshly made tzatziki sauce.

properties.name: Mami's Latin Style Rotisserie Chicken
properties.description: Mami Nora’s is recognized for its unforgettable rotisserie chicken, cooked in a special marinade, then roasted in their imported oven from Peru. This oven uses only wood charcoal, no gas or electric heat is needed. This charcoal roasting method is the source of the mouth watering smell as you approach the restaurant! Mami Nora's pairs their chicken with traditional South American sides — from Plantains to Yuca Fries or black beans.

properties.name: Mamma Mia! Italian Bistro
properties.description: Serving Wake County and the surrounding areas from our Apex and Holly Springs locations, with a taste of Italy in every bite!

properties.name: Manchesters Grill
properties.description: Whether you want to have a meal with your friends and family or come have a drink with your friends while you watch the game Manchester's Grill is the place for you!

properties.name: Mandolin
properties.description: Like the City of Oaks itself, Mandolin is Southern at its roots, but draws influences from around the world.  The food is fresh and local, the music is American and the restaurant is home to a family with a passion for serving world class food, wine and spirits in a soulful, comforting atmosphere.

properties.name: Manhattan Cafe
properties.description: Manhattan Cafe's slogan of “Southern hospitality with a big city variety” means just that. They have a wide variety of options and there will always be a friendly smile while serving you. Stop by for breakfast or lunch and enjoy some donuts, sandwiches, wraps, salads, pasta and more!

properties.name: Margaux's Restaurant
properties.description: At Margaux's Restaurant in Raleigh they combine an ever-changing menu, a flare for impeccable service, an energetic ambiance with a progressive decor, and you will understand why Margaux's has remained a favorite for those from near and far for 15 years. It is the perfect fusion of a high-energy metropolis and soulful southern hospitality. Come be a part of the dining experience and understand why Margaux's still stands strong after all these years.

properties.name: Mariscos El Patrón 323
properties.description: The Mariscos El Patrón 323 Food Truck is open 4 days a week and serves seafood cuisine straight from California. Mariscos El Patrón 323 also offers catering. From an office party to an at-home celebration, they can help with your next event.

properties.name: Masa Sushi & Ramen
properties.description: Masa Sushi & Ramen is a Japanese restaurant that serves high-quality sushi and flavorful ramen.

properties.name: Masala House Indian Restaurant
properties.description: Taste the vibrant flavors of our authentic dishes, made with freshly ground spices, fresh ingredients and recipes that will make you come back for more.

properties.name: Maximillian's Grill
properties.description: Maximillian's Grill aligns home-spun hospitality with finely crafted food and drink selections. The cuisine is locally sourced but global in reach, inspired by the eclectic mix of textures, flavor and aromatics pioneered by original owner and chef Michael Schiffer. Come in with anticipation, leave with satisfaction.

properties.name: McAlister's Deli - Raleigh
properties.description: People today crave fresh tastes, quick service and a welcoming friendly atmosphere where they can relax over a leisurely lunch or eat and run. That's what McAlister’s Deli® delivers, with a special touch that's uniquely their own. You'll see it in the menu, in the service and in their faces. You'll also see it in the food, with premium ingredients like Black Angus roast beef, Black Forest ham, caramelized onions, brie cheese, roasted corn and poblano pepper relish and artisan breads like baguette, ciabatta and focaccia.

properties.name: McLean's Ole Time Cafe
properties.description:
McLean's Ole Time Cafe is country cooking at its best! Family owned and operated, McLean's has been serving food since 1956.
Photo via the restaurant

properties.name: Meat & Bite Food Exchange
properties.description: Meat & Bite Food Exchange, located on Hillsborough St. near NC State's campus, offers a variety of food options for dine-in, delivery, and late night.

properties.name: Mecca Restaurant
properties.description: The Mecca Restaurant offers its patrons a selection of Southern staples for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  The beauty of their cuisine is in its simplicity: they serve hearty meals with traditional ingredients that comfort the soul. The Mecca Restaurant has been in its current location on E. Martin Street since 1935.

properties.name: Meeple's Brew
properties.description: Meeple's Brew offers a friendly environment for board gamers of all ages. Stop by in the morning to sip their delicious craft coffee or swing by later with friends to enjoy a variety of food and drink while playing a game from their library of 300+ board games. Meeple's Brew even has game masters on hand to help you pick from their huge collection and teach you the rules if you've never played before.

properties.name: Mellow Mushroom Brier Creek
properties.description: For 50 years, Mellow Mushroom Pizza Bakers has been serving up fresh, stone-baked pizzas to order in an eclectic, art-filled and family-friendly environment. Each Mellow is locally owned and operated and provides a unique feel focused around great customer service and high-quality food. Mellow Mushroom’s menu showcases natural flavors and the freshest of ingredients in a creative menu assortment of pizzas, hoagies, salads, calzones, appetizers and vegetarian/vegan options. Gluten-free crust and a kids' menu are also available.

properties.name: Mellow Mushroom Holly Springs
properties.description: For 50 years, Mellow Mushroom Pizza Bakers has been serving up fresh, stone-baked pizzas to order in an eclectic, art-filled and family-friendly environment. Each Mellow is locally owned and operated and provides a unique feel focused around great customer service and high-quality food. Mellow Mushroom’s menu showcases natural flavors and the freshest of ingredients in a creative menu assortment of pizzas, hoagies, salads, calzones, appetizers and vegetarian/vegan options. Gluten-free crust and a kids' menu are also available.

properties.name: Melting Pot Restaurant
properties.description: The Melting Pot is the original fondue restaurant where guests can enjoy several fondue cooking styles and a variety of unique entrees, salads, and indulgent desserts.

properties.name: Menchie's Frozen Yogurt
properties.description: At Menchie's we focus on quality, variety and innovation to offer you only the best-in-class frozen yogurt with limited time flavors available in store every month. Our innovative research and development team works diligently to come up with fun and exciting frozen yogurt flavors so there is always something new to try at a store near you and with fewer calories than ice cream it's even easier to enjoy! The team also develops unique items like Menchie's custom frozen yogurt cakes. Find a store near you and come smile with us.

properties.name: Metro Diner
properties.description: Metro Diner is the kind of place you're proud to take out-of-towners. It's the kind of place where last night is recalled over pancakes. Where the portions are big, but the egos are small. Where you don't have to impress anyone and you can come as you are. Metro Diner believes that when you care about the people you're cooking for, it shows in the food. And what they serve is comfort food with flair.

properties.name: Mezza Luna Pizzeria
properties.description: Tradition is not made here... It is here! Vittorio (Vic) and Lucia (Lucy) Vitolo welcome you and your family. Expect nothing but the best at Mezza Luna Pizzeria. Vic and Lucy were born in Italy and served the Bronx and upstate New York area for 40 years before coming to N.C.

properties.name: Mi Cancun
properties.description: Mi Cancun brings upscale-Mexican dishes to Morrisville's Grace Park. Stop by for a new twist on some Mexican favorites and sample their wide-variety of tequila.

properties.name: Mia's Kitchen Bahamian Food Truck
properties.description: Mia's Kitchen is one of Raleigh, N.C.'s most talked about food trucks. Try their authentic Bahamian cuisine wherever you can find them throughout the week.

properties.name: Michael's English Muffins
properties.description: Located conveniently in N. Raleigh, Michael’s English Muffin is set in a small storefront behind the hustle and bustle of Capital Boulevard off Spring Forest Rd.  We have a quick-serve cafe with chalkboard menu of different muffin toppings and a handful of sandwiches. A refrigerated case with drinks and some racks of chips round out the rest of the menu for Michael’s English Muffins, very simple and consistent. Our English Muffins are made fresh daily and go though a 12-24 hour process where ever gram that goes into the batch matters. It is a true labor of love and you can taste the difference.

properties.name: Michelangelo's Pizza
properties.description: Mike’s is a casual pizza restaurant that is known for its pizzas. We also have salads, cannolis, garlic knots and more!

properties.name: Michelangelos
properties.description: Pizza Buffet located in Holly Springs, featuring pizza, pasta, and salads.

properties.name: MidTown Pho
properties.description: MidTown Pho offers authentic, home-style Vietnamese cuisine. Order to go or come enjoy a specialty cocktail at their bar.

properties.name: Midtown Olive Oil
properties.description: Inspired by delicious, authentic and healthy ingredients, the owners of Midtown Olive Oil decided to bring a tasting experience of our unique flavors of balsamic vinegars and the very freshest olive oils to the Greater Raleigh area. Midtown Olive Oil is committed to always having the freshest and highest quality Extra Virgin Olive Oils (EVOO) available.

properties.name: Midwood Smokehouse
properties.description: Midwood Smokehouse is your neighborhood smokehouse using nothing but N.C. hickory hard wood and hard work to make the best barbecue around.

properties.name: Mike's Pizza
properties.description: Mike's Pizza is powered by an energetic team of hard-workers that deliver real pizza, fresh salads and tasty sandwiches to all guests.

properties.name: Milk Lab Cafe -- Cary
properties.description: Thai-style, rolled ice cream and premium milk tea.

properties.name: Mitch's Tavern
properties.description: Paneled in dark wood, this comfy retreat is a great spot after a long day of classes across the street at NC State, or for meeting up after work or softball. Come as you are--you'll fit in just fine. And as for that sense of deja vu? Kevin Costner and Tim Robbins drank here in "Bull Durham." The laid-back atmosphere is accompanied by a good selection of beers and a full bar.

properties.name: Mithai Indian Cafe
properties.description:
Welcome to Mithai Indian Café, a contemporary Indian cafe, tea house, bakery and dessert destination in the heart of Cary, NC. Evoking a timeless tradition, Mithai Indian Café is the Carolinas' first local Indian sweet manufacturer. All the sweets are made at our facility in Chatham Square, and not imported from New Jersey, New York, Chicago or Canada. Specialties include authentic Indian sweets, snacks, and vegetarian/vegan dishes. A significant number of sweets are traditional Bengali sweets (from the Eastern part of India, which uses no ghee or oil and only farm fresh whole milk).

Mithai Indian Café also does large orders for all events: weddings, graduations, birthdays, any event you want to give a sweet Indian touch!

properties.name: Mixed Desserts
properties.description: Mixed Desserts specializes in edible cookie dough, large scratch made cookies, and soft serve ice cream. They are delicious on their own, but MIX them together and you get cookie sandwiches, milkshakes, sundaes, and more! Come create your own Mixed Dessert!

properties.name: Mizu
properties.description: Since 2007, Mizu has been serving the highest quality and freshest sushi, seafood and hibachi meals in North Raleigh. Our family owned and operated restaurant prides itself on a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere with impeccable service.

properties.name: Moe's Southwest Grill (Apex)
properties.description: As you probably can tell, Moe's Haddon Hall Commons isn't a place you go to eat traditional Mexican or Tex Mex food, nor is it just a burrito joint. With a variety of fresh and flavorful ingredients to please any diet (paleo, vegan, vegetarian, gluten-friendly, quesoholic, etc.), Moe's has you covered! Swing by Moe's at 700 West Williams Street to see why we rock as much as we roll.

properties.name: Moe's Southwest Grill (Brennan Station)
properties.description: A Moe's neighborhood starts with the fresh Southwestern fare made right in front of you.  Then add a playlist of your favorite items and a welcoming environment and you'll see that we are more than just a burrito place, we're part of your neighborhood.  Welcome to Moe's!

properties.name: Moe's Southwest Grill (Brier Creek)
properties.description: A Moe's neighborhood starts with the fresh Southwestern fare made right in front of you.  Then add a playlist of your favorite items and a welcoming environment and you'll see that we are more than just a burrito place, we're part of your neighborhood.  Welcome to Moe's!

properties.description: As you probably can tell, Moe's Village District isn't a place you go to eat traditional Mexican or Tex Mex food, nor is it just a burrito joint. With a variety of fresh and flavorful ingredients to please any diet (paleo, vegan, vegetarian, gluten-friendly, quesoholic, etc.), Moe's has you covered!

properties.name: Moe's Southwest Grill (Cary)
properties.description: A Moe's neighborhood starts with the fresh Southwestern fare made right in front of you.  Then add a playlist of your favorite items and a welcoming environment and you'll see that we are more than just a burrito place, we're part of your neighborhood.  Welcome to Moe's!

properties.name: Moe's Southwest Grill (Fuquay-Varina)
properties.description: Moe's offers fresh, hand-made, customizable Southwestern food in a welcoming environment that rocks! Welcome to an atmosphere that says ‘you be you, we’re cool with that...'

properties.name: Moe's Southwest Grill (West Cary)
properties.description: Moe's offers fresh, hand-made, customizable Southwestern food in a welcoming environment that rocks!

properties.name: MooMooCha
properties.description: MooMooCha is a bubble tea cafe with fried snacks and other treats. Visit them for specialty themed menus throughout the year.

properties.name: Mookie's New York Deli
properties.description: Enjoy an authentic New York deli experience in the Triangle with house-made pastrami, corned beef, knishes, black and white cookies, and more. The farthest north you need to travel for an over-sized, mouth-watering deli sandwich in Cary, N.C.

properties.name: MoonRunners
properties.description: As seen on Spike TV's Bar Rescue, MoonRunners Saloon food truck serves Wake County, and it offers a variety of MoonRunners specialties with moonshine dips and sauce.

properties.name: MoonRunners Saloon
properties.description: MoonRunners Saloon is a prohibition-era themed restaurant that serves great food, specialty drinks and an atmosphere that pays off the one-of-a-kind concept created by celebrity experts.

properties.name: Morelia Gourmet Paletas
properties.description: Mexican ice cream paletas are popsicles that are way bigger than normal ice pops. Each ice cream paleta is handcrafted and made with 100% natural ingredients. Inside the store, guests are invited to create their own combination and choose between creamy, sorbet or filled ice cream bars and add as many dippings and toppings as they want. On the menu there are options for everyone! from creamy and rich chocolate, Oreo's Cookies and Cream, to dairy free and gluten free options. As well as seasonal flavors and ice cream paletas filled with creamy Nutella or Dulce de Leche.

properties.name: Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: Morgan Street Food Hall, measuring 22,000 square feet inside a re-purposed warehouse, provides a unique dining experience from a wide variety of local chefs, restaurateurs and purveyors. The first of its kind in Raleigh, the space features 20 culinary concepts ensconced in fully-outfitted spaces offering cooked-to-order meals, snacks and specialty foods—a gorgeous patio with tons of outdoor seating (plus a bar serving craft beers and cocktails) is a popular hangout. Some of the many good eats include Raleigh Rolls, a Thai rolled ice cream stand; Sassool, a Lebanese and Mediterranean restaurant with current locations in both Raleigh and Cary; Cousins Maine Lobster, with the freshest lobster rolls around; and Curry in a Hurry, with spicy butter chicken! See the full list of vendors, along with individual hours, here.

properties.name: Morning Times
properties.description: Neighbor to The Raleigh Times Bar, The Morning Times Coffee Shop & Gallery is the first stop of the day for many downtown dwellers and commuters. Head Barista Casey Porn, Tim Roy and their hospitable (but not too cheery for that first "hello" of the morning) crew serve up local Counter Culture brews, along with bagels, biscuit sandwiches, muffins, scones and more to get the morning off on the right foot. Many stop back during the day for the famous tuna salad or apple and brie sandwiches and other tasty lunchtime offerings to eat on the go or at a sidewalk table for a relaxing break. Evening visitors can enjoy a glass of wine and dessert as they check out the creations by the featured artist of the month at The Morning Times Gallery upstairs. Whatever the time of day, it's always time for a visit to The Morning Times.

properties.name: Mr Softee Wake
properties.description: Mr Softee Wake is a soft serve ice cream parlor on wheels! They sell milkshakes, sundaes, floats, dip cones, cones and ice cream sandwiches. Mr. Softee Wake has daily neighborhood routes but are also available for private functions such as birthday parties, corporate events, community and town gatherings and yes, even weddings!

properties.name: Mr. A's Beignets
properties.description: Mr. A's Beignets offers handmade authentic New Orleans style Beignets and Chicory Coffee. Our Beignet mix and coffee are shipped directly from Louisiana and each batch is made on site, and served fresh and hot.

properties.name: Mulino Italian Kitchen & Bar
properties.description: Freshly-prepared Italian plates served alongside accessible estate vineyard wines and inspired cocktails in downtown Raleigh.

properties.name: Mum's Jamaican Restaurant
properties.description: Authentic Jamaican restaurant in North Raleigh. The owner grew up cooking with her grandmother (affectionately called Mum) and learned a lot of traditional recipes from her.

properties.name: Mustang Charlie's Diner
properties.description: You may not think of a Ford Dealership when deciding where to get an awesome meal at a great price, but you need to check out Mustang Charlie's Diner inside the all new Crossroads Ford Service and Parts Center in Apex.

properties.name: Mustang House
properties.description: Mustang House is an authentic Nepalese and Indian restaurant, located in the heart of City Plaza in Downtown Raleigh. Whether you come in for lunch or dinner, you're sure to have a deliciously unique experience that you won't believe until you try!

properties.name: My Way Tavern - Fuquay Varina
properties.description: Killer wings, fresh salads, creatively loaded spuds, gourmet entrées, burgers and dogs, and a long list of My Way sandwiches. Whatever you’re in the mood for, odds are you can find something on their menu. If Nikki happens to be around, ask her how the Game 6 Dog got its name.

properties.name: My Way Tavern - Holly Springs
properties.description: The focal point of My Way Tavern is the horse shoe style bar, expertly crafted with reclaimed wood from 158-year old barn in eastern N.C. From the bar customers can enjoy one of 14 draft beers on tap, 11 proudly brewed in N.C., in addition to more than 50 bottles and a fully stocked bar. The My Way Tavern menu includes a variety of freshly made all-American foods such as appetizers salads, soups, burgers, sandwiches and entrées.

properties.name: My Way Tavern - Raleigh
properties.description: The focal point of My Way Tavern is the horse shoe style bar, expertly crafted with reclaimed wood from 158-year old barn in eastern N.C. From the bar customers can enjoy one of 14 draft beers on tap, 11 proudly brewed in N.C., in addition to more than 50 bottles and a fully stocked bar. The My Way Tavern menu includes a variety of freshly made all-American foods such as appetizers salads, soups, burgers, sandwiches and entrées.

properties.name: N.C. Seafood Restaurant at the Farmer's Market
properties.description: N.C. Seafood is located at the State Farmers Market, Raleigh, and has been specializing in serving the highest-quality, fried, Calabash-style seafood in a casual setting for the past 25 years.

properties.name: NOFO @ the Pig
properties.description:
NOFO @ the Pig is located in Raleigh in the Historic Five Points Business District, near downtown and Glenwood South. Housed in a restored Piggly Wiggly grocery store building, it is a combination cafe, food market and gift shop.


Featured in Metro, Our State, The Independent, N.C. Signature, Midtown, Walter and Southern Living magazines, NOFO has been described as wacky, unique, clever, cheerful, quirky, fun and delicious. Readers have voted NOFO: Best Brunch, Best Bloody Mary, Best Eggs Benedict, Best Gift Shop and Best Salads. Southern Living named NOFO "one of the 50 best gift shops in the South."


The NOFO cafe serves lunch Mon.-Fri., brunch on Sat. and Sun. and dinner Tues.-Sat. Have a drink and dine in the cafe under the pig chandelier, outside on the deck or host a private party on the balcony.

properties.name: Nana's Lil Sweets
properties.description: Nana's Lil Sweets is a bakery located in downtown Garner, N.C. on Main St. offering custom, made-to-order baked goods for your any need!

properties.name: Nantucket Grill
properties.description: American bar and grill with a New England flair offering steak, seafood, gourmet salads and sandwiches and Mile-High Dessert Cakes.

properties.name: Nature's Juice Bar & Cafe
properties.description: Nature's Juice Bar and Cafe offers some of the freshest smoothies, juices, paninis, and subs.

properties.name: Nazara Indian Bistro
properties.description: The English translation of the word Nazara is “beautiful scenery”. Dining at Nazara will invoke the same feelings of happiness and contentment you would experience when gazing upon a beautiful scenery. They believes in doing things the Nazara way, which means no compromises when it comes to freshness, quality and service. The food is inspired by the authentic home cooking of beautiful and taste-rich India. Don't let the contemporary look of the restaurant fool you, as you will be served traditional home made as well as contemporary food from an ever-changing menu.

properties.name: Neomonde Mediterranean - Morrisville
properties.description:
The secret to Neomonde's success lies deeply rooted in tradition and family. For the Saleh family, who founded Neomonde 30 years ago, uncompromising commitment to excellence is a sacred ideal. Every dish on Neomonde's traditional Lebanese/Mediterranean menu is prepared using simple, natural ingredients of the finest variety, prepared in strict accordance with traditional methods. The result: A truly distinctive level of authenticity. It's a commitment you can taste! 

No time to dine in? Neomonde's fresh and flavorful sandwiches, sides and salads are a healthy, convenient alternative when you're on the go. Pick up dinner for the family after work, stop by on your way to a pot-luck party, or surprise your office mates with just-baked bagels or pastries. It's always a good time for Neomonde!
Photo via the restaurant

properties.name: Neomonde Mediterranean - Raleigh
properties.description: The secret to Neomonde's success lies deeply rooted in tradition and family. For the Saleh family, who founded Neomonde 30 years ago, uncompromising commitment to excellence is a sacred ideal. properties.name: Ni Asian Kitchen
properties.description: Ni Asian Kitchen has open-style kitchen for your convenience to see the whole process of food making, to please guests’ eyes and stimulate their appetite.

properties.name: Nightingale Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
properties.description:
Nightingale Rooftop Restaurant & Bar is located in the heart of Holly Springs, filling the rooftop space at The Block on Main.

Led by Executive Chef Christy Griffith and General Manager Matt Griffith of Pimiento Tea Room, and Chris Harol, co-founder of The Block on Main, Nightingale is a chic destination for date nights, special occasions, and after-hours drinks.

properties.name: Nil's Mediterranean Cuisine
properties.description: Located on Main St. in Fuquay Varina, Nil's Cafe is a traditional Mediterranean Cafe serving lunch and dinner. Nil's is a personable family oriented place to dine with a warm friendly atmosphere. During the warmer months there is outdoor seating reminiscent of delightful European sidewalk cafes serving the friendly and charming community of Fuquay Varina.

properties.name: Nina's Ristorante
properties.description: Come experience the traditional Tuscan and Sicilian foods of Nina's childhood. In the warm and inviting restaurant the staff promises a memorable dining experience that involves impeccable service and intensely flavorful food prepared from the soul. Reservations are recommended, but feel free to just drop in and sample a little taste of Italy.

properties.name: NoRa Cafe
properties.description: NoRa Cafe is a local neighborhood coffee shop featuring Carrboro Coffee, locally baked pastries, fresh sandwiches and welcoming, comfortable atmosphere.

properties.name: Noodle Blvd
properties.description: Noodle Blvd provides a fresh and unique take on authentic regional noodle dishes, with a menu that offers made to order dishes ranging from a variety noodle bowls to rice dishes. From Shoyu Ramen to Spicy Kimchi, Curry Ramen to Tom Yum. Originally cultured in Asia, Noodle Blvd thrives on providing the best and most flavorful noodle dishes in Cary, with healthy and simple ingredients second to none.

properties.name: North Ridge Pub
properties.description: Upscale pub with urban decor featuring salads, sandwiches, crab cakes, fish and steamed oysters. When you're in the mood for good times and great cuisine, be sure to come in. The menu at North Ridge Pub features a wide array of great selections, made from only the freshest and highest quality ingredients, with something sure to please every member of your group.

properties.name: Northside Bistro & Cocktails
properties.description: Northside is an upscale neighborhood bistro, with a refined New American style. Whether you're a first-timer or one of our regulars, you'll love the unmatched ambiance and our innovative cocktails that fuels a bustling dining and bar scene.

properties.name: Not Just Icing
properties.description: Not Just Icing, Inc. is a mobile cupcakery committed to providing made from scratch, baked fresh daily on the truck scrumptious treats throughout the Greater Raleigh area. The cupcakes and other treats are made using all-natural ingredients and by usin butter instead of oils and real fruit instead of fruit flavored extracts. You won't find any preservatives in Not Just Icing's cupcakes, so they are best eaten the day you buy them. Visit website to find the Not Just Icing food truck!

properties.name: Nothing Bundt Cakes
properties.description: From the first bite, sweet memories of your Mom's cake, fresh from the oven, gently tug at your heart. These luscious cakes are made with the finest, premium ingredients, including fresh eggs, real butter and cream cheese. Each bite slowly melts in your mouth, calling you back to a day when life was a little sweeter and time passed more slowly. Nothing Bundt Cakes are available in numerous sizes to accommodate gatherings both large and small, from bite-sized Bundtinis, to single serving Bundtlets, to larger 8" and 10" cakes and even double-tiered cakes.

properties.name: O'Malley's Pub & Restaurant
properties.description: This favorite neighborhood pub has been serving up refreshing pints, tasty cocktails and savory meals since 1996. Proudly offering delicious breakfast, lunch and dinner, including some Irish favorites, the food will please your taste buds and your wallets. Whether you’re looking to unwind after work, have a nice dinner, enjoy some live music or let loose late night, O’Malley’s cozy atmosphere and friendly staff is sure to give you a memorable experience and leave you in good “spirits”!

properties.name: O-Ku Sushi
properties.description: O-Ku Sushi Raleigh celebrates authentic Asian cuisine with a southern approach with a menu that focuses on unique ingredients and sophisticated presentations. From petite plates to sushi specialties, O-Ku showcases the freshest fish from the world’s finest markets and produces in areas such as Norway, Scotland, Hawaii and New Zealand, as well as local sustainable sources.

properties.name: ORO Restaurant & Lounge
properties.description: ORO Restaurant & Lounge located in the heart of downtown Raleigh, is a fun, chic and casual restaurant in the PNC Building at the corner of Martin and Wilmington St. With floor to ceiling windows and 20-foot ceilings across most of the space, ORO offers an unparalleled ambiance like no other in Raleigh. Boasting an upstairs mezzanine with a nine-foot fireplace that can accommodate up to 40 guests seated and 60 guests for a standing reception, ORO can meet your audiovisual needs for any business meeting or social gathering. For larger parties who desire the use of the entire ORO space, the facility can accommodate up to 80 guests seated and 150 guests for a standing reception.

properties.name: Oak City Coffee Roasters
properties.description:
Raleigh is full of coffee lovers, and it's time we had our own coffee--one we love and identify with. One we love because it's freshly roasted right here in the neighborhood. And one we identify with because we know not only where our coffee came from but also the farmers who grew it.


Oak City Coffee would like to bring you closer to the source of your coffee by introducing you to your growers and harvesters. Your coffee started with some rightfully proud farmers, and getting it from their farm to your cup is a captivating story; they believe it's worth telling.

properties.name: Oak City Fish and Chips
properties.description: Hand-breaded fish, shrimp, calamari, oysters and scallops, cooked to order and seasoned with our own blend of herbs and spices.

properties.name: Oak City Fish and Chips - Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: Hand-breaded fish, shrimp, calamari, oysters and scallops, cooked to order and seasoned with our own blend of herbs and spices.

properties.name: Oak City Fish and Chips Food Truck
properties.description: A Raleigh staple for fish, chips and shrimp. Visit Facebook page to find where the Oak City Fish and Chips food truck is located.

properties.name: Oak Steakhouse
properties.description: Located at The Dillon, Oak Steakhouse is a modern take on the classic American steakhouse. The chef-driven menu from executive chef Todd Woods features a variety of Certified Angus Beef Selections, while showcasing fresh North Carolina ingredients.

properties.name: Oakwood Pizza Box
properties.description: Pizza joint in historic Oakwood specializing in thin crust pizza by the slice and whole pizzas with five rotating specialty flavors.

properties.name: Off the Hook Seafood Restaurant
properties.description:
This unique Calabash-style seafood is known for its distinctive style, which is lightly-breaded and lightly-fried to golden-brown perfection and off the hook! They are committed to you. Quality begins with hospitality, cozy booths and tight-knit service: not to mention Off the Hook has the fresh, affordable high quality seafood; you can't help but get hooked.
Photo via the restaurant

properties.name: Oiso Sushi & Korean
properties.description: Japanese and Korean restaurant specializing in sushi and Korean food using only fresh ingredients along with incredible flavors.

properties.name: Olive Garden Italian Restaurant
properties.description: Olive Garden is a family of more than 800 local restaurants committed to providing every guest with a genuine Italian dining experience. It’s what they like to call Hospitaliano!: our passion for 100% guest delight. As part of that commitment, Olive Garden is proud to serve fresh, delicious Italian food served in a comfortable, home-like setting where everyone is welcomed as a member of their family.

properties.name: Once in a Blue Moon Bakery & Cafe
properties.description: Serving the Triangle for 20 years! Making stunning desserts that taste as good as they look

properties.name: Opa! Raleigh - Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: Opa! Raleigh offers a small taste of Greece from within Morgan Street Food Hall! Opa serves authentic traditional recipes and flavors. We are delighted to share the Greek cultural food with you. OPA Raleigh!

properties.name: Orchid Japanese Restaurant
properties.description: At Orchid, we provide a different style of buffet, one that does not have food just drying out on a steam table. Food, especially sushi, just isn't good once it has been sitting out in the open for too long. We offer a full service made-to-order buffet, in which you are provided with order sheets at each table to fill out and make your selections.

properties.name: Osha Thai Kitchen and Sushi
properties.description: Osha, meaning “tasty” or “delicious” in Thai, focuses on authentic cuisine prepared with fresh ingredients to create well-balanced and flavorful meals.

properties.name: Osteria G
properties.description:
An "Osteria" in Italy was originally a family place that serves simple food and wine by cooking traditional homemade food.

The menu is likely to be short and of great importance in local specialties, such as pasta, grilled meat and fish.​

In "Osteria G" every day different special dishes are cooked according to the fresh products that the local market offers so that diners enjoy daily varied and healthy dishes accompanied by a good glass of wine, which can never be lacking in an Osteria.

properties.name: Otomi Comida y Cocteles
properties.description: Otomi Comida y Cocteles is a Mexican restaurant in located on Brookside Drive in Raleigh, N.C. Enjoy scratch-made food and hand mixed cocktails from this friendly, neighborhood spot.

properties.name: Over The Falls Deli
properties.description: NY Style Deli & Pizzeria, Delivery is available Mon.-Sat. 5:00pm-9:00pm

properties.name: Overlook Restaurant at Residence Inn Raleigh Downtown
properties.description: At the Overlook Restaurant at the Residence Inn Raleigh Downtown, enjoy a pre-theater meal inside, or al fresco by the fire on our second-floor patio. Either way you’ll be in for an experience with seasonal menus and treescape views.

properties.name: Overtime Sports Pub
properties.description: Raleigh's classiest sports bar offering 14 HD plasma TVs, full service bar and where everything is prepared using only the freshest ingredients. They also have a game room with video games, pool table, dart boards and jukebox. Every Sat. night Overtime has karaoke from 10pm-2am!

properties.name: P.F. Chang's China Bistro at Crabtree Valley Mall
properties.description: P.F. Chang’s is an Asian restaurant concept founded on making food from scratch every day in every restaurant.

properties.name: PTA Pizza
properties.description: PTA Pizza & Hoagie is a cornerstone in the Wake Forest community and has been recognized for its outstanding Italian cuisine, excellent service and friendly staff.

properties.name: Panda Express (Apex)
properties.description: The chefs at Panda Express are famous for working up delicious, one-of-a-kind entrees such as the signature tangy Orange Chicken and zesty Beijing Beef. Guests also enjoy a large menu of other traditional Chinese dishes like spicy Kung Pao Chicken and savory Broccoli Beef.

properties.name: Panda Express (Raleigh)
properties.description: The chefs at Panda Express are famous for working up delicious, one-of-a-kind entrees such as the signature tangy Orange Chicken and zesty Beijing Beef. Guests also enjoy a large menu of other traditional Chinese dishes like spicy Kung Pao Chicken and savory Broccoli Beef.

properties.name: Panda Garden
properties.description: Known for its noodle and rice dishes, Panda Garden Chinese Restaurant serves excellent Chinese cuisine to Holly Springs locals

properties.name: Panda House
properties.description: Since 1993, Panda House has been one of Raleigh’s earliest and most unique Chinese restaurants. The food has been, and still is, served with freshness and nutritious ingredients. The flavoring is different among the other Chinese restaurants in town. You can find delicious tasting General Taos Chicken, Chicken wings, Crab Rangoon, etc. at Panda House.

properties.name: Panda Wok
properties.description: Panda Wok restaurant offers a wide array of authentic Asian dishes, ranging from traditional Asian dishes such as Shrimp Chow Mein, Hunan Beef, General Tso's Chicken to new style entrees such as Shrimp and Scallops in Garlic Sauce, Sizzling Shrimp, Sauteed Double Flavors. Come in for a Lunch Special or during evenings for a delicious Asian dinner. You can also online order your favorite Asian Food for take out or delivery. Panda Wok's goal is to provide an unforgettable dining experience for all our patrons.

properties.name: Paolo's on 54
properties.description:
Paolo's on 54 is an authentic Italian restaurant/pizzeria and a ‘Speakeasy’ themed cocktail bar. All food is prepared on the premises using traditional recipes and fresh produce from local suppliers. The menu dishes are made up of traditional favorites and daily specials designed especially for you to enjoy whatever the mood or occasion.

The relaxed, ‘speak-easy’ bar serves authentic cocktails and discerning wines while the Italian cucina prepares a full lunch and Al La Carte Dinner menu as well as freshly made, hand thrown pizzas made from their own specially prepared unbleached pizza dough. Look for delicious daily specials made with fresh ingredients and inventive fusions thanks to the Chef's extensive knowledge and creativity.

properties.name: Papa Murphy's Apex
properties.description: Handmade. Home Baked. The world’s largest fresh take ‘n’ bake pizza brand, Papa Murphy’s is dedicated to bringing families together through food people love with fun, convenient, and fulfilling dinners.
