properties.name: Paradise India Cuisine
properties.description: Paradise India Cuisine specializes in authentic Hyderabadi & Chettinad Cuisine. Specializing in Hyderabadi Dum Kachi Biryani, we also offer a wide variety of traditional flavors from across India.

properties.name: Park Bar & Grill
properties.description: Park Bar & Grill serves a choice of cooked-to-order breakfast or full American breakfast buffet every morning. They also offer a wide variety of American cuisine, a delicious dinner menu, morning and nightly room service and a full service bar.

properties.name: Parkside
properties.description:
Located at the entrance of the Warehouse District in downtown Raleigh, Parkside is situated on the corner of W. Martin and S. Dawson St., across from historic Nash Square. It was this urban park, one of the four original parks in downtown, that inspired the name Parkside.
 

Housed at street level and under the longest running neon restaurant sign in N.C. you will find the doors, which have been the threshold to hospitality for this neighborhood for over one hundred years. Parkside believes in continuing this tradition in every way. From the warm red brick and reclaimed barn wood clad bar to the N.C. solid poplar tabletops, Parkside wants guests to feel welcome. Whether you are sampling one of the 40+ beers on tap or enjoying chef inspired locally sourced fare, your experience is the priority.

properties.name: Pat Murnane's Irish Pub
properties.description: This Pub’s Founder is the great-grand son of Pat Murnane. This place of relaxation, fun and great food is in honor of the man. Pat Murnane's Irish Pub is sure he would be proud of this country, his descendants and this little pub named in his honor.

properties.name: Paul & Jack Bakery & Cafe
properties.description: Paul & Jack Bakery & Cafe is a bakery and coffee shop located in Wake Forest, N.C. focusing on artisan-made craft desserts and coffees.

properties.name: Peak City Hots
properties.description:
Peak City Hots serves Rochester, NY’s famous “Trash Plate” in the Triangle! 

A "trash plate" is your choice of meet (cheeseburger patties and/or hot dogs) laid on top of a bed of homemade macaroni salad and home fries then topped with mustard, diced onions and our homemade trash meat sauce! Forget the bun!

properties.name: Peck & Plume
properties.description: Peck & Plume — a nod to the restaurant’s view of the future Downtown Cary Park and its avian inhabitants — is a polished yet casual restaurant offering a menu of modern American classics taking inspiration from our southern surroundings. Whether diners want a peck of plates to share with friends or the plume of a special occasion dinner, Peck & Plume is open six days a week for breakfast, lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.

properties.name: Peggy Rose's Sweet Pepper Jelly
properties.description: Peggy Rose's is southern-style pepper jelly... including sweet, golden, hot and ghost pepper jellies made in N.C. for over 30 years with fresh, premium and locally sourced ingredients. Peggy Rose's product line also includes Cranberry Pepper Fruit Spread and Champagne Mustard.  Visit her web page to see the many grocers and retail outlets where Peggy Rose's products can be found around Raleigh, N.C.

properties.name: Pei Wei Asian Diner
properties.description: Our menu samples flavors from Thailand,  Vietnam, Japan, Korea, and China. Dishes  are individually prepared and made to order  using Mandarin-style woks. Resulting in great  tasting Asian food served fresh and hot to  your table.

properties.name: Pelican's SnoBalls - Apex
properties.description: Since Pelican's doors opened in 2001 it has been the area's favorite destination for ice cream and New Orleans style snoballs. Upon Pelican's birth they have always been focused on bringing ONLY the highest quality products to customers, friends and family! Pelican's believes that their product and top-notch service separates them from everyone else. Open Mar.-Oct.

properties.name: Pelican's SnoBalls - Wake Forest
properties.description: Want to enjoy a real New Orleans style SnoBall without visiting the "The Big Easy"? Come visit Pelican's SnoBalls. Named for the state bird of La., Pelican's strives to stay true to the "Original New Orleans" SnoBall. Add it all up, fluffy snow, over 100 fantastic flavors, a great family atmosphere and Pelican's is the hot spot to cool you down. Pelican's SnoBalls of Wake Forest is 1/2 mile north of downtown Wake Forest. Open Mar.-Oct.

properties.name: Peng's ​Asian Cuisine
properties.description: N.C. is home. Peng's uses local ingredients as much as possible. The spices and food are so fresh you can smell spring in Asia. Taste the 30 years experience of Chef Shifu at Peng's ​Asian Cuisine!

properties.name: Penn Station East Coast Subs - Morrisville
properties.description: Penn Station has developed a unique product line that demonstrates, in full customer view, the true quality of their products. The menu features an array of mouth watering Grilled East Coast Style submarine sandwiches, fresh-cut fries and hand-squeezed lemonade. All sandwiches are prepared fresh in full view of the customer using delicious hearth-baked bread, USDA steak and the finest meats, cheeses and vegetables. The potatoes are hand selected, fresh-cut and flash-fried in cholesterol-free peanut oil. The lemonade is made from scratch every day using hand-squeezed lemons.

properties.name: Peri Brothers Pizza
properties.description: Authentic New York Pizza. Come take a trip up North and have a slice that will tantalize your senses. Also featuring amazing pasta dishes with the best sauces made from scratch daily. Choose from strombolis, calzones, heroes and giant salads made to order. Made from the best ingredients available, all natural cheeses and no fillers or anything artificial!

properties.name: Perry's Steakhouse and Grille
properties.description:
Regarded as one of the country’s premier, award-winning steakhouses, Perry’s Steakhouse & Grille remains true to its neighborhood butcher shop roots. Famous for butcher-fresh USDA aged Prime steaks broiled to perfection, table side carvings, succulent seafood and flaming desserts, Perry’s is also known for an unexpected signature—a sweet, smoky, sizzling, seven-finger high pork chop. Perry’s Raleigh, uniquely designed for this community, features a stunning main dining space showcasing a spectacular wine wall and a glimpse into the expansive kitchen as well as four private rooms ideal for meetings and family celebrations and vibrant Bar 79 with glass walls opening up to the patio. Perry’s provides dining that is truly Rare and Well Done®.

Dine-in dinner service is available Sun.-Thurs. from 4–9pm and Fri.–Sat. from 4–10pm. Perry’s is open for lunch on Frid. at 10:30am and every day for curbside To-Go from 11am–Close.

properties.name: Pho Super 9
properties.description: Pho Super 9, located across from Triangle Town Center mall and next to BJ's, offers Vietnamese cuisine including pho, soups, rice platters, vermicelli bowls and more.

properties.name: Pho Vietnam (Cary)
properties.description: Pho Vietnam is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant located near South Hills Mall in Cary.  Noodle soup, banh mi & other Vietnamese staples can be found here served in a small, low-key space with outdoor seats.

properties.name: Piada Italian Street Food - Park West Village
properties.description:
Piada Italian Street Food is a fast casual, authentic eatery serving hand rolled Piadas, Pasta Bowls and Chopped Salads.

Their open kitchen design invites you to share in the experience as our chef crafts your meal, to order — Piadas, Pasta Bowls, and Chopped Salads all to be enjoyed in our dining room or on the run. It's good food, made fast, made fresh. Every time.

properties.name: Piccola Italia Pizza & Restaurant
properties.description: Family owned and operated since 1982, we have been offering traditional Italian-American dishes and New York style pizzas. All of our sauces, soups and pizza dough are made from scratch and are the personal recipes of owner Frank Amato, who is here every day to ensure the highest quality of our food.

properties.name: Pico De Gallo Pizza
properties.description: Pico De Gallo Pizza is "no ordinary pizza" offering both regular Italian fare as well as wings, sandwiches and more!

properties.name: Pie-Zano's
properties.description: Pie-Zano's is a family-owned, authentic Italian Pizzeria offering Jersey-style pizza with a Sicilian flair.

properties.name: Pieology Pizzeria - North Hills
properties.description:
Pieology reinvented the traditional way of creating and serving pizza. Here, they believe you should have the freedom to enjoy a delicious pizza or salad that reflects your unique personality. With a tasty variety of fresh quality toppings, house-made crusts and signature sauces, any flavor combination you can dream up is yours... all for one affordable price.


The Pieologists interact with you to bring your pizza to life, and the open-flame oven bakes your smoking hot creation in under three minutes. In all, your expertly crafted made-to-order pizza or custom salad can be delivered to your table in about five to 10 minutes!

properties.name: Pimiento Tea Room
properties.description: Pimiento Tea Room is a southern-inspired tea room offering small plates for lunch and dinner, cocktails, and Sunday brunch in the Village District of Holly Springs. Located in the historic Brown-Holloway House, c. 1840, guests will enjoy small plates with menu items celebrating the world's most popular drink: tea.

properties.name: Pine State Coffee
properties.description: Pine State Coffee is a local specialty coffee roaster, cafe and bicycle repair/accessories shop.

properties.name: Pineapple Sol
properties.description: Pineapple Sol offers breakfast, lunch and weekend brunch with fresh pastries and coffee seven days a week. Catering, including high tea, picnics, cakes and charcuterie are also available.

properties.name: Pints Ice Cream & Beer
properties.description: We make all our ice cream in shop from scratch, which means we do not buy a bagged base and mix in our flavors. We purchase all our produce and dairy from local farms. Our dairy comes from Homeland Creamery in Julian NC, we also grow our own herbs. We have 10 rotating taps that include beers made right here in North Carolina. You can either enjoy an ice cream, a beer or be adventurous and try them together as a beer float!

properties.name: Pita Bowl
properties.description: Əˈklektik kiCH(ə)n: flavors from around the world

properties.name: Pizza Pit Tavern
properties.description: Pizza Pit Tavern is a sports bar that overlooks the track at Rush Hour Karting. Stop by for homemade fresh pizza, gourmet burgers, hot dogs, salads and weekly specials! Pizza Pit Tavern also features seven high-definition plasma TVs and a giant 110" high-definition projector for all the best games.

properties.name: Pizzeria Faulisi
properties.description:
Pizzeria Faulisi is a small, family-owned and operated restaurant serving wood fired pizzas, small plates, dessert, beer and wine. The menu is subject to change due to seasonality and creativity. Dine in only; no reservations.
Photo via the restaurant

properties.name: Plant Cakes Bake Shop
properties.description:
Plant Cakes Bake Shop, an all-vegan bakery is the first animal product-free bakery in the region. The bakery and ‘dessert bar’ features fresh baked sweets sourced from organic ingredients.

Please place pre-orders online for in-store or curbside pickup, and local delivery, (or stop in and see us to purchase fresh from our bakery cases). Thank you for the support from Plant Cakes Bake Shop, where everyone is always welcome & the menu is always 100% plant-based and organic.

properties.name: Poke Burri
properties.description:
Poke Burri is one of the most unique places to grab a bite and has become popular with patrons thanks to its excellent service, great ambiance and distinctive dining experience. The first Poke Burri location was in East Atlanta Village inside the global grub collective. 

In its new location in Raleigh, NC, Poke Burri remains true to its commitment to provide an innovative style. The restaurant has been described as a blend of traditional poke and your favorite late-night burrito joint. The food is made from fresh ingredients and patrons can expect to enjoy food full of flavor.

properties.name: Poole's Diner
properties.description:
Menus at Poole's are inspired by the season and its many offerings. As the season changes, at some points on a daily basis, so do the chalkboard menus. Everything is made to order, from scratch, and is delicious gourmet southern cooking.


Photo credit: Angie Mosier

properties.name: Pope's Strawberry Farm
properties.description: Pope's Strawberry Farm is a pick-your-own farm located just east of Raleigh in Knightdale, N.C. Their season usually begins in late Apr. or early May.

properties.name: Poppyseed Market
properties.description: Poppyseed Market is a gourmet deli offering an array of salads, sandwiches and entree items.  We have a relaxed atmosphere and can accommodate dining in or take out.

properties.name: Porter Farms Strawberry Farm
properties.description: This Market location is all about strawberries. Bring your family to pick from over five acres of meticulously kept berries from early Apr. through late May. No time to pick – no worries! Porter Farms pickers are trained to fill our buckets with only the reddest sweetest berries for a bucket of goodness all the way through!

properties.name: Postino Village District
properties.description: Postino is a winecafé offering simply scrumptious food and a warm, edgy culture that brings people together. Located in the Village District.

properties.name: Potbelly Sandwich Shop
properties.description: For many years, potbelly stoves warmed millions of homes and acted as gathering places—warm little outposts where local people could share a meal and some conversation. Potbelly stoves might be a thing of the past, but you can still find the same warmth and good vibes at a Potbelly Sandwich Shop in your neighborhood.

properties.name: Premier Cakes Diner
properties.description: Premier Cakes Diner is the second location for the made-from-scratch bakery, located inside the North Carolina Museum of History. Specializing in three layer cakes, pies and international desserts and pastries, Premier Cakes Diner will also serve breakfast and lunch!

properties.name: Prime Barbecue
properties.description:
Prime Barbecue brings together the best of all great BBQ techniques to create something uniquely its own. The process begins with the best meats, seasoned with perfect spice blends and then smoked with 100% hardwood for many, many hours until the perfect harmony of smoke, flavor and tenderness emerges.
Photo: Natalia Weedy

properties.name: PrimoHoagies
properties.description: Originally opened in South Philadelphia in 1992, PrimoHoagies prides itself on serving the highest quality Thumann's meats and cheeses, sliced fresh, piled high, on their award-winning seeded bread. The company’s success is attributed to several factors contributing to the Primo difference including the quality and consistency that result in repeat, loyal customers, and the commitment to only serving the freshest gourmet meats and cheeses through a diverse menu featuring dozens of Specialty Hoagies, unique and original to PrimoHoagies.

properties.name: Pub 4100 (DoubleTree by Hilton Raleigh Crabtree)
properties.description: Pub 4100 features an American menu with Irish inspired items. This family-friendly restaurant is open for breakfast and dinner daily. Room service from The Pub is also available for guests of the Double Tree by Hilton Raleigh Crabtree.

properties.name: Pro's Epicurean Market & Cafe
properties.description: An eclectic market, wine bar and café featuring authentic Italian/French/European cuisine that celebrates the passion and love for food and drink.

properties.name: Pullen Cafe
properties.description: Pullen Place is a locally owned cafe committed to providing fresh, delicious food in the heart of Raleigh's Pullen Park. The menu features snacks and meals made in-house using seasonal and local ingredients. Pullen Place has the comfort foods you would expect along with some tasty treats from around the world, all at affordable prices in a fun setting. Multiple vegetarian options available. Catering is also available at the park for birthday parties, picnics, family reunions and business gatherings.

properties.name: Pure Vegan Cafe
properties.description: Pure Vegan Cafe is a 100% plant-based restaurant. We focus on using high-quality, healthy ingredients to make great-tasting, cold-pressed juices, smoothies, and 100% plant based food. If you are in the mood for plant-based food, healthy beverages, smoothie bowls or raw treats come and check us out!

properties.name: Qdoba Mexican Grill
properties.description: Qdoba is a Mexican kitchen where anyone can come to enjoy a fresh, handcrafted meal prepared right in front of them. They showcase food that celebrates a passion for high-quality ingredients, a menu full of innovative flavors, handcrafted preparation and inviting service. With an extensive menu and wide variety of unique menu items, every guest can find a culinary creation sure to satisfy their taste buds.

properties.name: Qspresso
properties.description: Cuban and Latino-infused food truck that can be found throughout the Raleigh and Cary area. Specialties include cubanos, empanadas, quesadillas, yuca, maduros, tostones, coffee and more!

properties.name: Quiznos - Falls Village
properties.description: Quiznos offers a variety of menu items including grilled flatbreads, salads and wraps, and savory soups! They use all-natural chicken, freshly-sliced deli meats and artisan breads and cheeses! This sandwich shop is committed to bringing guests high-quality and delicious options, whether it's for lunch or a catering order.

properties.name: Raleigh Popsicle Co.
properties.description: Cristhian and Nikki, a husband and wife team from Colombia, South America and Raleigh, N.C. respectively, are the proud owners of Raleigh Popsicle Co. Our popsicles are handmade with fresh ingredients including fruit and fruit puree. There are over 15 flavors so there’s something for everyone! New in 2023 we will offer handmade ice cream, fresh waffle cones, specialty popsicles and some non-frozen treats on sticks!

properties.name: Rainbow King
properties.description: Rainbow King is a cornerstone in the Wake Forest community and has been recognized for its outstanding Chinese cuisine, excellent service and friendly staff.

properties.name: Raleigh Coffee Company
properties.description: Raleigh Coffee Company simply brings you fresh roasted coffee. Whether you realize it or not, if you drink coffee, it is an important element in your life, so lets make it a good cup of coffee.

properties.name: Raleigh Raw
properties.description: Raleigh Raw gets you back to the way nature wanted you to feel through raw and purely organic fruits and vegetables. No pasteurization, no added water, no heat, no preservatives, no GMOs, no artificial ingredients/sweeteners. Just real food. Raleigh Raw sources local produce from N.C. farms and sling that into the best tasting and most potent juices in the South. The small batch, never heated, process preserves the live enzymes which prevent sickness and disease, and promote weight loss, vitality and energy. The flagship store in downtown Raleigh also serves breakfast, poké bowls and numerous grab and go options.

properties.name: Raleigh Rolls - Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: Raleigh Rolls offers Thai rolled ice cream and delicious toppings. Watch ice cream form before your very eyes!

properties.name: Raleigh Tea Company
properties.description: Raleigh Tea Company offers one-ounce loose tea and hand-filled teas/tisanes. We have sampler packs and gift boxes as well as cool tea infusers. We specialize in custom blends and we offer Tea Learning Experiences-where we come to your gathering place and have an educational tea party with delicacies,  your own blend that you make to take home! Since we don't have an actual brick and mortar-we will deliver to your home or office.

properties.name: Raleigh Times Bar
properties.description: The Raleigh Times Bar is a timeless local watering hole and so much more. Raleigh's past, present and future are all on display in this 100-year-old building in downtown Raleigh that has been beautifully restored. Old press clippings and images from our namesake newspaper adorn the walls and capture the unique cultural history of the capital city. Exceptional cuisine, featuring hand-crafted, creative takes on classic bar fare favorites, as well as an inventive drink menu and extensive Belgian beer selection, are newsworthy additions to downtown Raleigh.

properties.name: Randy's Pizza - Lake Boone
properties.description: A New York-style pizza restaurant known for its large slices and pizzas ranging in size from 14" to 30". The diverse menu also offers pasta, salads, sandwiches and wings. Dough is prepared daily and Randy's uses the freshest and finest ingredients and cooks all pizzas on stone brick ovens.

properties.name: Randy's Pizza‎ - Alexander Village
properties.description: A New York-style pizza restaurant known for its large slices and pizzas ranging in size from 14" to 30". The diverse menu also offers pasta, salads, sandwiches and wings. Dough is prepared daily and Randy's uses the freshest and finest ingredients and cooks all pizzas on stone brick ovens.

properties.name: Randy's Pizza‎ - McCrimmon Corners
properties.description: A New York-style pizza restaurant known for its large slices and pizzas ranging in size from 14" to 30". The diverse menu also offers pasta, salads, sandwiches and wings. Dough is prepared daily and Randy's uses the freshest and finest ingredients and cooks all pizzas on stone brick ovens.

properties.name: Real McCoy's
properties.description: Real McCoy's is Wake Forest's hometown place to hang out with friends, have a pint, watch the game and enjoy some delicious fresh-made food. Serving Wake Forest's best N.C. barbecue! Come check out Real McCoy's amazing menu of over 100 beers, including 52 on tap and over 40 local N.C. brews.

properties.name: Red Bowl Asian Bistro - Cary
properties.description: Red Bowl Asian Bistro is traditional with a touch of contemporary.

properties.name: Red Bowl Asian Bistro - Raleigh
properties.description: Red Bowl Asian Bistro is a traditional, with a touch of contemporary setting, Asian restaurant with a full service bar, serving Asian-inspired dishes. Each distinctive dish is handcrafted, only prepared with the finest and freshest ingredients. A combination of Asian cooking techniques (Chinese, Thai and Japanese) allows Red Bowl to create exceptional pan-Asian cuisine! You will always discover more than you expect, from their create-your-own stir-fry bar, award winning sushi bar and family friendly environment to our wide variety of Asian dishes.

properties.name: Red Pepper Asian
properties.description: Red Pepper Asian Bistro offers a selection of dishes from Chinese, Thai and Malaysian cuisines with a focus on takeout and dine-in. Old friends will recognize former Fortune Palace favorites such as fried calamari, beef chow fun and crispy eggplant on the Red Pepper Asian Bistro menu amongst many new dishes. The menu caters to all tastes, including many options that are mild, spicy or vegetarian.

properties.name: Relish Craft Kitchen & Bourbon Bar
properties.description: Relish is a Craft Kitchen and Bourbon Bar that celebrates a love of food, drink, cooking and entertaining in an upscale atmosphere without the upscale attitude or upscale price tag. They get inspiration from both the traditional "tried and true" recipes and also from the latest food trends to encourage full exploration of the culinary world. Relish focuses on comfort foods—anything that is homey, rich and hearty and conjures up images of nostalgic indulgences shared with family and friends. The food is of the “new Southern" style—Southern classics that have been modernized and refreshed with more current ingredients while still retaining the heart and comfort of the original dishes. Bourbon makes the best partner for Southern comforts, so Relish has built an extensive collection of whiskeys to please every palate.

properties.name: Remington Grill
properties.description: We're taking our North Carolina neighbors to the Wild West with burgers, barbecue, and Texas-sized portions.

properties.name: Rey's Restaurant
properties.description: Fine dining with a French Quarter flare, locally owned and operated. Voted Most Romantic Restaurant by Cary Magazine.

properties.name: Ricci's Trattoria
properties.description: Keeping true to tradition, Ricci's offers homemade Sicilian pizza and Italian dishes using fresh and quality ingredients.

properties.name: Rise Southern Biscuits & Righteous Chicken - Brier Creek
properties.description: Rise serves handmade biscuits, hand rolled yeast donuts and cake donuts. Fresh, hot and fast from their counter to your belly. Everything is prepped and cooked fresh, so donuts and biscuits sometimes sell out and are subject to change. Come early!

properties.name: Rise Southern Biscuits & Righteous Chicken - Holly Springs
properties.description: Rise serves handmade biscuits, hand rolled yeast donuts and cake donuts. Fresh, hot and fast from their counter to your belly. Everything is prepped and cooked fresh, so donuts and biscuits sometimes sell out and are subject to change. Come early!

properties.name: Rise Southern Biscuits & Righteous Chicken - Morrisville
properties.description: Rise serves handmade biscuits, hand rolled yeast donuts and cake donuts. Fresh, hot and fast from their counter to your belly. Everything is prepped and cooked fresh, so donuts and biscuits sometimes sell out and are subject to change. Come early!

properties.name: Rise Southern Biscuits & Righteous Chicken - North Raleigh
properties.description: Rise serves handmade biscuits, hand rolled yeast donuts and cake donuts. Fresh, hot and fast from their counter to your belly. Everything is prepped and cooked fresh, so donuts and biscuits sometimes sell out and are subject to change. Come early to the North Raleigh location in the Sutton Square shopping center!

properties.name: Rise Southern Biscuits & Righteous Chicken - Village District
properties.description: Rise serves handmade biscuits, hand rolled yeast donuts and cake donuts. Fresh, hot and fast from their counter to your belly. Everything is prepped and cooked fresh, so donuts and biscuits sometimes sell out and are subject to change. Come early!

properties.name: River Pub
properties.description: River Pub serves a wide variety of Italian, Mediterranean and American food with a full bar and extensive beer and wine selection.

properties.name: Rockin' Rolls Sushi
properties.description: Rockin' Roll Sushi is an all-you-can-eat kaiten-sushi restaurant with sushi & Japanese dishes served on conveyor belts in a contemporary space.

properties.name: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory (Brier Creek)
properties.description: One visit to this store and you'll discover why Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory is the destination of chocolate lovers everywhere. Throughout the store you will discover a fantastic variety of yummy chocolates and confections to satisfy cravings of even the most ardent chocoholic! Watch as they dip crisp apples in thick, bubbling caramel from a traditional copper kettle. Smile as they roll them in a rainbow of tasty toppings to complete your old fashioned treat. Linger awhile longer and learn how fudge is made as they fashion a creamy loaf on a traditional marble slab, the old fashioned way, right before your eyes. And of course, everyone gets a free sample! But don't leave without sharing your experience with a gift of fine chocolate, elegantly crafted and beautifully packaged in boxes, tins and baskets.

properties.name: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory (Waverly Place)
properties.description: One visit to this store and you'll discover why Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory is the destination of chocolate lovers everywhere. Throughout the store you will discover a fantastic variety of yummy chocolates and confections to satisfy cravings of even the most ardent chocoholic! Watch as they dip crisp apples in thick, bubbling caramel from a traditional copper kettle. Smile as they roll them in a rainbow of tasty toppings to complete your old fashioned treat. Linger awhile longer and learn how fudge is made as they fashion a creamy loaf on a traditional marble slab, the old fashioned way, right before your eyes. And of course, everyone gets a free sample! But don't leave without sharing your experience with a gift of fine chocolate, elegantly crafted and beautifully packaged in boxes, tins and baskets.

properties.name: Rolesville Diner
properties.description: Rolesville Diner is a breakfast and lunch cafe with a downhome, small town dining experience. Serving the greater Rolesville and Wake Forest area for more than 15 years, they offer a friendly and casual diner setting full of fresh good'ole homemade cook'n.

properties.name: Roly Poly Rolled Sandwiches
properties.description:
We really do have something for everyone! On a special diet or counting carbs? We’ve added Specialty Salads and Low Carb Tortillas. Our tortilla company created a Low Carb tortilla just for Roly Poly that actually tastes good, and that’s not easy when you’re talking Low Carb! Fat Free Cheeses, dressings and spreads add an even lighter dimension to our menu. Not just delicious, but healthy and hearty too. We’re not just the original rolled sandwich, we’re the original healthy sandwich too!

Our sandwiches and a tasty cup of soup make the perfect All American lunch or light dinner! Roasted Garlic Tomato, Old Fashioned Chicken Noodle, Harvest Mushroom and Broccoli and Cheddar are just a few of our soup varieties to choose from.

properties.name: Rosati's Pizza
properties.description: Rosati's, serving authentic Chicago-style pizza, is far from a traditional pizza chain. This Morrisville location is the first on the East Coast for Rosati's, and almost everything, including the dough, is produced on site at the restaurant. Pizza with buttery, high-rising crust and loads of toppings or traditional Italian pastas are sure to please everyone. Dine in or carryout; delivery and catering available.

properties.name: Rosewater Kitchen & Bar
properties.description:
Rosewater Kitchen and Bar brings to life the charm and intimacy of the village lifestyle. An intention to be the center of the community; it’s where people gather to celebrate in sharing honest food, craft cocktails, and a well curated wine selection.

Rooted in the style of the new American kitchen, its menu is an illustration of local partnerships and perennial ingredients that pay homage to the gardeners, farmers, fishermen, and foragers who bring them to our tables. Inspired by European romance, the nourishing garden, and intimacy of slow cooked food; Rosewater is our interpretation of the never ending, always evolving garden party.

properties.name: Royal India Restaurant
properties.description: Royal India chefs have created a true taste of food served for Maharajas. We serve wide assortment of delicious vegetarian & non vegetarian food. Our speciality is North Indian Food.

properties.name: Ruckus Pizza & Bar
properties.description: Ruckus Pizza & Bar is located near NC State. We're just off of Western Blvd in the Mission Valley Shopping Center on Avent Ferry Rd. Look for Ruckus behind Blockbuster Video and beside Kerr Drugs.

properties.name: Ruckus Pizza, Pasta, & Spirits - Apex
properties.description: Ruckus is a jumpin’ joint with good food, drink specials and the best local music around. They believe that quality ingredients, attentive staff, reasonable prices and a comfortable atmosphere are things you look for in a great place. The Ruckus menu comes from years of travel, tasting and love of great food. The extensive menu caters to everyone looking for a great Italian meal to those looking for the best Pizza in town, and the dishes were designed by a Culinary Institute of America graduate along with recipes passed down from great Grandma and Grandpa - so you know everything is delicious.

properties.name: Ruckus Pizza, Pasta, & Spirits - Cary Tryon Village
properties.description: Ruckus offers great homemade Italian pastas and pizzas as well as a full bar and live music, with a non-smoking interior and larger outdoor patio.

properties.name: Ruckus Pizza, Pasta, & Spirits - Morrisville
properties.description: Pizza, Pasta, Spirits and Sushi. The Most award winning restaurant in the Triangle 6 years in a row. Join Ruckus at any of our locations for a great Meal and a great time. Located in the Park West Village shopping center.

properties.name: Rudino's Heritage
properties.description: Rudino’s Sports Bars specializes in great pizza and awesome Grinders in Wake Forest NC. Rudino’s offers complete entertainment from sports coverage, local brewery tap takeovers, contest nights, local bands and more! They pride themselves on being your local family hang out with great food, lots of sports and a wonderful atmosphere. From the outstanding sports coverage and seemingly endless wall of TVs, to the local entertainment, music, and contests, we keep your entertainment evening filled to the max with choices.

properties.name: Rudino's Pizza & Grinders (Garner)
properties.description: Family-owned, local, pizza & grinders made fresh, from scratch bread and dough.

properties.name: Rudino's Pizza & Grinders Sports Corner
properties.description: Rudino's Sports Corner is one of Raleigh's largest sprots bar with over 20 50" plasma tvs family owned & operated.

properties.name: Rudino's Rooftop Sports Bar
properties.description:
Home to North Raleigh’s largest rooftop patio!

Take a break during the week with seasonal Live Music, Trivia, and the best drink specials in North Raleigh! Whether you’re looking for a cold beer, a family restaurant or the top North Raleigh sports bar, Rudino’s Rooftop is the answer. Rudino’s Rooftop also offers North Raleigh awesome grinders, delicious pizza and a great outdoor atmosphere.

properties.name: Rudy's Pub & Grill
properties.description: Apex's first gastropub specializes in great food, friendly service and making you feel right at home. Seven large flat screen TV's and an outdoor patio make Rudy's a great place to watch the game or relax in the evening enjoying the beautiful N.C. weather. Open until midnight or later seven days a week and also serving brunch on Sundays.

properties.name: Rush Bowls Raleigh
properties.description: A Rush Bowl starts out with the finest all-natural fruit blended extra thick and creamy, to which we add nutrients, protein, juice or milk and an assortment of decadent yet wholesome ingredients. We top things off with crumbles of crunchy granola & a drizzle of the most delicious honey you’ve ever tasted.

properties.name: Ruth's Chris Steak House - Cary
properties.description: Whether it’s a romantic dinner for two, an important business meeting or a private party for six to 300 guests, Ruth’s Chris Steak House can accommodate your needs. This steakhouse provides guests with a warm, comfortable atmosphere that is casual, yet elegant. The restaurant is also handicap accessible.

properties.name: Rye Bar & Southern Kitchen
properties.description:
Located in the heart of downtown Raleigh, Rye offers a refined take on traditional Southern cuisine, inspired by the bounty of quality ingredients from N.C. and surrounding farmers. The seasonal menu showcases the range of Rye's executive chef with collaborations from their kitchen and local farmers.

Rye also offers an approachable setting that invites both friends and families. The main dining area seats 120 guests with an additional 80 seats in the private dining room and ample space in the Rye bar area.

properties.name: SAAP
properties.description:
SAAP is a Laotian restaurant located in the first floor of The Walker, a luxury apartment building in downtown Cary. 

SAAP, which means 'delicious' in Laotian, is the newest restaurant from Chef and Laos native Lou Bounsanga, formerly of Bida Manda and Brewery Bhavana. 

SAAP's menu is divided into small plates, large plates and a wok section for fried rice and noodle dishes. 

The 2,600-square-foot, 70-seat restaurant includes 10 bar seats, a 10-seat private dining room and 16 seats on the patio overlooking Downtown Cary Park.

properties.name: Saints & Scholars Irish Pub
properties.description: Saints and Scholars merges two worlds of amazing, fresh, homemade food and welcomes you to dine-in, take out, host a party or they'll even come to you and cater! The inside of Saints and Scholars is divided into a dining side lined with Irish decor, and a pub side with 15 beers on tap and a full bar. The patio is pet friendly with two fire pits and two canopies.

properties.name: Salem Street Pub
properties.description: Salem Street Pub (SSP) is a full-service neighborhood bar and grill located in the heart of Apex, N.C.'s downtown historic district. SSP is committed to providing superior customer service and delicious, quality standard American food, including burgers, wings, soups, sandwiches and salads, at family friendly, affordable prices.

properties.name: Salt & Lime Cabo Grill
properties.description: Salt & Lime Cabo Grill is a relaxed, full-service bar and grill influenced by the coastal cuisine of Baja, California.

properties.name: Saltgrass Steak House
properties.description: Saltgrass is an award-winning, authentic steakhouse famous for its flavorful steaks. Each steak is char-grilled on an open flame, seasoned with Saltgrass 7-steak spice and topped with fresh garlic butter for mouthwatering flavor. Each morning, the restaurant bakes complimentary fresh yeast rolls, as well as homemade desserts from scratch.

properties.name: Salvio's Pizzeria - Cary
properties.description: Salvio's Pizzeria has been an independently owned family operated restaurant since 2005. They take great pride in using the freshest ingredients to make N.Y.-style pizzas, gourmet pizzas, deep dish sicilian pizza, pasta dinners, calzones, stromboli's and subs. All pizza dough is made fresh daily, and gluten free pizza options are available. Call ahead for pizza delivery, take out or enjoy your dinner in the family friendly dining room.

properties.name: Salvio's Pizzeria - Raleigh
properties.description: Salvio's Pizzeria has been an independently owned family operated restaurant since 2005. They take great pride in using the freshest ingredients to make N.Y.-style pizzas, gourmet pizzas, deep dish sicilian pizza, pasta dinners, calzones, stromboli's and subs. All pizza dough is made fresh daily, and gluten free pizza options are available. Call ahead for pizza delivery, take out or enjoy your dinner in the family friendly dining room.

properties.name: Sam Jones BBQ Raleigh
properties.description: Opening in early 2021, Sam Jones BBQ Raleigh is the second location of third generation pitmaster Sam Jones’ restaurant. Sam Jones BBQ is rooted in the tradition of North Carolina whole-hog barbecue that Sam has known his entire life. After realizing that the family business was his calling, Sam worked with the Jones’ acclaimed barbecue mecca, Skylight Inn, before deciding to open his first location of Sam Jones BBQ in 2015 in Winterville, N.C. The Raleigh location will have many similarities to its sister restaurant, including a detached pit house, which will turn out freshly smoked, wood-fired meats daily, ensuring the integrity of Eastern North Carolina barbecue is preserved. In addition to chopped meats, other menu highlights include tried-and-true Southern staples at their finest, such as slow-cooked chicken, spare ribs, pork skins & pimento cheese, sweet slaw, baked beans, hand-cut fries, collard greens, and more.

properties.name: Sammy's Tap & Grill
properties.description: Sports bar, huge outdoor deck, over 50 TVs, incredible food and overflow parking. Official viewing spot for North Carolina State Wolfpack, Carolina Hurricanes, Pittsburgh Steelers, Georgia Bulldogs, Nebraska Huskers and West Virginia Mountaineers.

properties.name: San Jose Mex and Tequila Bar
properties.description:
San Jose Mex & Tequila Bar has it all! A unique menu with an ambiance all it’s own. The food is superb and the presentation is as good as it gets.

Growing up in Jalisco, Ruben Leon and Josue Flores and his brother in law, loved their grandfather’s traditional cooking, when they immigrated to the United States about 25 years ago, they all worked in Mexican restaurant in Virginia and North Carolina, and longed for the cuisine of their childhood, so they decided to open a restaurant together.

Always looking for more, innovating modern concepts of food, in place where you can find a bar of more than 100 tequila, our margaritas will make you return, we invite you to enjoy a good Food, in modern atmosphere with best friends and family.

properties.name: San Marcos Mexican Restaurant

Seasons 52 is a fresh grill and wine bar conveniently located in Raleigh, North Carolina, and is easily accessible from anywhere in The Triangle area. Whether you’re looking for steak, seafood or classical American cuisine, Seasons 52's seasonal menu is inspired by the fresh appeal of the local farmer’s market and ingredients are sourced at their peak to enhance food’s natural flavors. You can find seasonal items on the menu throughout the year, like Fiddlehead Ferns, Wild Alaska Halibut, Copper River Salmon, Nantucket Bay Scallops, and Black Mission Figs, to name a few. 

Join Seasons 52 for Sunday Brunch featuring special Chef Creations and $5 brunch sips. Or, stop in for Happy Hour Monday through Friday from 3pm to 7pm for $5 wines, small plates and flatbreads - conveniently located at Crabtree Valley Mall.

This is the first Sergio’s location outside of New York.  Don’t let anyone else in town fool you.  We’re the only real New York pizza joint around.  Come in and get a real slice of New York!

properties.name: Shabashabu

properties.name: Shake Shack - Waverly Place
properties.description:
Shake Shack sprouted from a hot dog cart in Madison Square Park in Manhattan to support the Madison Square Park Conservancy’s first art installation. The cart was quite the success, with Shack fans lined up daily for three summers.

An instant neighborhood fixture, Shake Shack welcomes people from all over the city, country and world who gathered together to enjoy fresh, simple, high-quality versions of the classics in a majestic setting. The rest, as they say, is burger history.

With its fresh, simple, high-quality food at a great value, Shake Shack is a fun and lively community gathering place with widespread appeal.

We’re known for delicious burgers, chicken, hot dogs, frozen custard, beer, wine, and more.

Sandwich prices range from $4.50 to $5.95. In addition to a large assortment of gyros, classic options like hamburgers and steak and cheese hoagies are available. Shish kabobs begin at $7.25, while a three-kabob combination platter (including two sides and warm pita) is $11.95. The $7.95 vegetarian platter includes falafel, pita, and choice of two sides – tabouli, hummus, grape leaves, rice, pasta, or fries. A kids menu is also available, along with non-caffeinated, sugar-free beverage options. 
Shish Kabob will be open from 11 am – 8 pm, Monday through Saturday and will offer sidewalk seating, carry-out, and call-ahead ordering

properties.name: Shorty's Famous Hot Dogs
properties.description:
Shorty's Famous Hot Dogs has been s family owned business since 1916. Located in the original location in Wake Forest that they started in nearly a century ago, come by Shorty's for some of the tastiest food around, and a little bit of history too!


Shorty's serves traditional southern "red" Jesse Jones Hot Dogs and offer and serve a Nathans brand all beef dog that is also very popular. All hot dogs are grilled to perfection, topped with fresh ingredients like, hand chopped onions, and our special homemade chilli recipe, all served on hot steamed buns! So stop by today, you'll be glad you did!

properties.name: Showmars - Wake Forest
properties.description: Showmars has served the Carolinas with fresh, made-to-order food in a casual and family friendly environment since the Independence Boulevard location first opened its doors in 1982. We want food that is made with the best ingredients, captures new and different flavors and all of that given at a reasonable price.  We all want to be able to take our families to a place where children are treated special and the choices for their finicky needs will be plenty.  We all want some place to kick back and relax with a cold beer after a hard day of work.  We are in search of a place with live music without the nightclub scene.  For all of these reasons and more, Shuckers Oyster Bar & Grill® was created

Fast forward a few years and add a daughter who had a dream of turning their shared passion of baking into a lifestyle.

Slice is now serving pies to individuals, Triangle restaurants, shipping across the country, delivering, serving large corporate events, weddings, and donating to local charities and organizations.

This father/daughter duo has one goal and one goal only– not to just make a good pie, but to create a mouthwatering, full-flavored experience that your taste buds won’t soon forget. So get your taste buds ready and enjoy some pie; one Slice at a time.

properties.name: Smashburger

Smashburger believes that smashing is better! These handcrafted burgers are smashed, seared and seasoned to order, using our fresh, never frozen 100% Certified Angus Beef®. Whether you choose the Classic Smashburger or decide to create-your-own, the artisan buns, freshly chopped produce, flavorful sauces and variety of cheeses are designed to deliver a great-tasting, juicy burger you can taste in every bite.


Every great burger needs a companion, and the selection of signature sides—like Smashfries hand-tossed with garlic, rosemary and olive oil, hand-breaded haystack onions and fried pickles—are the perfect complement to any meal. The same is true for the hand-spun shakes, served in a frosted glass. And if you're in the mood for something other than a burger, the menu of grilled or crispy chicken sandwiches, crisp entree salads and black bean veggie burgers are sure to satisfy.

An “evolved Tex-Mex menu,” includes the classics: tacos, nachos, tamales and enchiladas plus more intricate dishes such as wood-grilled fajitas and shrimp tacos always served with just-made flour tortillas, all while paying homage to the traditions and recipes that have been a part of the Texas culture for decades.

properties.name: Taco Bamba
properties.description:
Taco Bamba’s menu honors traditional flavors and cooking methods with a selection of classics like chicken tinga, al pastor, carne asada, and barbacoa, but its most famous dishes diverge from taco tradition. While that includes originals that are available at every location, like the signature Taco Bamba (skirt steak, chorizo, grilled guacamole, chicharrones) and the Spicy Shroom (chipotle portobellos, grilled corn, pepitas), the headliners are always tacos unique to the specific location. In Raleigh, that means the Wolfpack Poutine, with sweet potato fries, white BBQ, pimento cheese, jalapeño onion salad, and spiced pecans. Taserface tops Bamba brisket suadero with salsa macha, and sweet and spicy pickled chiles. Cheerwine BBQ bacon carnitas is the star of the Sweet Baby Jesus, which also features chipotle mustard, jalapeño slaw, and tomatillo chow chow in a flour tortilla.

The menu in Raleigh will include Taco Bamba’s new clean-style tacos, a carb-free option allowing guests to skip the tortilla in favor of a crisp cabbage cup. Clean-style tacos are a response to the restaurant’s much-loved dirty-style option, in which any traditional taco filling can be served on a flour tortilla griddled with cheese and topped with a signature sweet chili sauce. Among the non-taco options can be found Bamba ceviche and a potato salad with sweet corn esquites, along with classics like Mexican street corn, and posole rojo.

Taco Bamba’s tortas and quesadillas have almost as many fans as their tacos. The super-sized Torta Bamba is a big-as-your-head sandwich available at all locations that barely contains carne asada, chorizo, al pastor, ham, hot dog, beef and chicken milanesa, black beans, Chihuahua cheese, pineapple, avocado, and pickled jalapeño (yeah, it’s a lot). Selections that are both unique to Raleigh and far more reasonable for a single diner to take on include the Sir Walter Raleigh, with Carolina-style beef Frank, spiced ground beef, chili sauce, queso, and chipotle mustard. Garlic herb cream cheese spread, cucumber, roasted bell peppers, and avocado are the star of the vegetarian Feet Fleet. Vegetarians will also be thrilled by the Big Fat Mexican, a quesadilla packed with a roasted walnut mushroom “chorizo” and grilled corn.

properties.name: Tacos Mexico
properties.description: Autentexican food

properties.name: Tacos Mexico (Fuquay-Varina)
properties.description: Tacos Mexico is committed to providing only the freshest and highest quality Mexican food with distinctive flavorful dishes. They created a unique restaurant concept around original recipes that demand only the freshest ingredients tailored after the traditional Mexican cuisine. Specialties are marinated in fine sauces with distinct seasonings and spices.

properties.name: Taj Mahal Indian Cuisine
properties.description: Taj Mahal Indian Cuisine offers delicious dining and takeout to the Raleigh area. They are known for a modern interpretation of classic dishes and insistence on only using high quality fresh ingredients.

properties.name: Tamasha Modern Indian Kitchen
properties.description:
An ode to modern Indian cuisine. Chef Bhavin Chhatwani, with a Michelin-star experience, serves progressive creations, craft cocktails and an extensive wine list in a stellar ambiance.

Photo credit: Harsha Sipani

properties.name: Tandoori Trail
properties.description:
Taste the original mouth watering delicacies at Tandoori Trail. 

The legacy of Kundan Lal Gujral– Founder of Motimahal (1920) – the inventor of Tandoori Chicken , Butter Chicken and Dal Makhani has now trailed to the United States of America -Tandoori Trail.

properties.name: TapStation
properties.description: Tap Station offers beer, burgers and bourbon in a converted former mechanic's station, Holt & Sons, in downtown Apex.

properties.name: Taylor's Wine Shop
properties.description: Taylor's Wine Shop is North Raleigh's source for the finest wines the world has to offer. Along with fine wine and live bait, Taylor's also sells a variety of locally-made specialty items like Larry's Beans coffee and Escazu artisan chocolates, among many others. Stop by Taylor's today for one of their bi-monthly beer and wine tastings!

properties.name: Tasu Asian Bistro - Brier Creek
properties.description: Tasu's menu includes a wide variety of Asian dishes from Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Thailand and China, as well as specialty fusion dishes. Choose from: Peking Duck, Pho, Pad Thai, General Tso's Chicken, Tiger Cry Steak and Miso Halibut. For the sushi lover Tasu offers classic Nigiri, Sashimi and over 60 different special sushi rolls, all "two for one, All Day, Every Day." Tasu has something for everyone!

properties.description: Tavern on the Green is a family operated Restaurant on Eagle Ridge Golf Course. Serving the community and public the best food around.

properties.name: Taverna Agora
properties.description: Taverna Agora is an authentic Greek kitchen and bar where friends and family enjoy good wine, eat wonderfully prepared, simple food and relax. The restaurant is reminiscent of gathering places found in Greece, with old world flavors and rustic roots. However, Taverna Agora expands beyond the traditional agora with a few modern flares, including hand-crafted cocktails, a gourmet marketplace and Sunday brunch.

properties.name: Taziki's Mediterranean Cafe - Cary
properties.description: From perfectly grilled meats served with signature sauces to mouth-water salads filled with fresh fruits and veggies, at Taziki's has mastered the art of creating imaginative, Mediterranean-inspired dishes that are destined to become your next familiar favorite.

properties.description: Tazza Kitchen's cuisine is simple and fresh, highlighting quality ingredients found close to home, traditional cooking styles and signature wood-burning oven. Though carefully curated menus will shift with the changing seasons, Tazza Kitchen will always offer fresh, delicious food that’s good for body and soul.

properties.name: Tequila Dale's
properties.description: Tequila Dale's is a fresh, unique food products company featuring delicious sauces and salsas! "Shake Up Your Food" with Tequila Dale's!

properties.name: Teriyakin
properties.description: Teriyakin' is a Japanese BBQ restaurant serving deliciously char-grilled beef and chicken. We're conveniently located in RTP near hwy 54 and 540. Open for lunch and dinner.

properties.name: Terrace Dining Room
properties.description: The Terrace Dining Room, located in the Carol Johnson Poole Clubhouse at Lonnie Poole Golf Course at North Carolina State University, features signature burgers, salads and sandwiches at lunch daily (11am-3pm), with bar hours extending into the early evening. The restaurant features a dining room and outdoor patio seating with a sweeping view of the golf course, Centennial Campus and the downtown Raleigh skyline.

properties.name: Texas Roadhouse - Holly Springs
properties.description:
Legendary Food, Legendary Service®!


Texas Roadhouse prides themselves in providing each and every guest with Legendary Food and Legendary Service from their Legendary Team every day! The Signature menu items include Fall-off-the-bone Ribs, Hand Battered Chicken Critters, Tasty Chicken Dishes, Various Seafood Selections, Made-from-scratch Side Items, Fresh Baked Bread, Ice Cold Beer and Hearty, Hand-Cut Steaks! Every day the steaks are hand-cut in-house by Legendary Meat Heroes who are dedicated to giving you the perfect steak every time.

properties.description:
Legendary Food, Legendary Service®!


Texas Roadhouse prides themselves in providing each and every guest with Legendary Food and Legendary Service from their Legendary Team every day! The Signature menu items include Fall-off-the-bone Ribs, Hand Battered Chicken Critters, Tasty Chicken Dishes, Various Seafood Selections, Made-from-scratch Side Items, Fresh Baked Bread, Ice Cold Beer and Hearty, Hand-Cut Steaks! Every day the steaks are hand-cut in-house by Legendary Meat Heroes who are dedicated to giving you the perfect steak every time.

properties.name: Texas Steakhouse & Saloon
properties.description: We have mouth-watering menu items to suit every taste - from our signature steaks to salads, seafood, chicken, ribs, & and other Texas classics.

properties.name: Thai Cafe
properties.description: In the last twenty-five years, owners Oddy and his sister Kanchana have worked in some of the most successful Thai restaurants in the U.S. The authentic Thai recipes prepared by Oddy and Kanchana are based on the common fare available in and around their home village of Bangpoo, southeast of Bangkok on the Gulf of Thailand. These recipes include the balance of the four basic tastes found in all Thai food – salty, sweet, sour and bitter; plus hot. Careful preparation of the ingredients includes cutting items into smaller pieces so the seasonings cover more surface area. Smaller pieces also retain crispness and fresh flavors when stir-fried. And of course, fresh ingredients are used in every recipe.

properties.name: Thai Spices & Sushi Restaurant
properties.description:
* Delivery Availabel
    * Lunch & Dinner

Thai Spices & Sushi Restaurant is a 70-seat casual dining restaurant located at the Preston Corners Shopping Center in Cary. We offer high quality food and services to our customers. We feature a cozy dining room, decorating in a warm tone. It is a perfect place to stop by during lunch or dinner. The menu has two major parts, one is Sushi bar menu and the other is kitchen menu. Sushi bar menu will offer sushi appetizers, sushi, sashimi, and maki-sushi rolls. Kitchen menu will offer both Thai and Japanese appetizers, soups, salads, curries, sautéed, fried rice and noodles. Business Hours: Lunch Tue-Fri 11:00am-2:30pm Sat-Sun 12:00am-4:30pm Dinner Sun-Thu 5:00pm-9:00pm Fri-Sat 5:00pm-9:30pm

properties.name: Thai Thai Cuisine
properties.description: Made-to-order Thai dishes!

properties.name: Thai Twist Noodle House
properties.description: Step into a world of authentic Thai flavors at our restaurant. We proudly serve classic Thai dishes alongside our unique noodle soup creations. Come experience the warmth of Thai hospitality and the delight of our unforgettable taste sensations.

properties.name: Thai's Noodles
properties.description: The menu offers a sampling of noodle dishes from all over Asia, from pad thai to Japanese udon to pho, the beef noodle soup of Nguyen's native Vietnam. There's also a pan-Asian assortment of appetizers and entrees, as well as a modest sushi offering. Soon to be introduced are - surprise! - buy-one-get-one-free sushi rolls, all day, every day.

properties.name: Thaiphoon Bistro
properties.description: With so many ethnic restaurants in America, Thaiphoon Bistro in Raleigh, NC started out as the first Thai restaurant in Downtown Raleigh (Glenwood South) in 2008 that served a handful of dishes. But through the perseverance and hard work of the founder, it has become a well-known place for amazing Thai food. The menu at Thaiphoon Bistro has been crafted one dish at a time, perfecting each recipe along the way to encompass cuisine from every region in Thailand. Recommended dishes include the Papaya Salad, the Green Curry and any of the flavorful noodle dishes. Thaiphoon Bistro also offers one of the largest vegetarian menus, including appetizers, soups, noodle dishes and selections over rice. Thaiphoon Bistro serves simple but tasty Thai food that has gained true notoriety in the City of Oaks.

properties.name: Thaiphoon Bistro - Stonehenge Market
properties.description: With so many ethnic restaurants in America, Thaiphoon Bistro in Raleigh, NC started out as the first Thai restaurant in Downtown Raleigh (Glenwood South) in 2008 that served a handful of dishes. But through the perseverance and hard work of the founder, it has become a well-known place for amazing Thai food.
