Thaiphoon Bistro serves simple but tasty Thai food that has gained true notoriety in the City of Oaks.

properties.name: The Apothecary's Kitchen
properties.description: All-natural peppermint bark: hand-crafted with premium dark and white chocolates, topped with bits of organic candy cane and infused with peppermint. Made in small batches by Ben Smith in Raleigh. The Apothecary’s Kitchen peppermint bark is made with sustainably grown cocoa and features organic peppermint flavor and organic candy cane pieces. The packaging boxes contain 80-100% recycled content. Inside the box, the product is sealed in a compostable cellophane bag. Visit website for complete list of stores carrying The Apothecary's Kitchen peppermint bark or purchase via the website.

properties.name: The Arepa Bar
properties.description: The Arepa Bar offers authentic Colombian arepas. Fried then char-grilled patties with 100% cornmeal and naturally gluten free! Stuffed with your choice of our freshest ingredients.

properties.name: The BBQ Lab
properties.description:
The BBQ Lab is focused on N.C. BBQ with a scientific twist.

The concept was born in Johnston County five years ago, when Owner, Jerry Stephenson, and a college buddy had a crazy idea to start building a brand. The BBQ Lab features innovations and new offerings every month. Our sauces and rubs are made from our own recipes honed from years of competitions and a lot of tastings!

The Lab is focused on North Carolina BBQ with a scientific twist. We’re a North Carolina BBQ restaurant wanting to grow into a large tree in the Johnston County dirt we call home.  

And when it’s gone, it’s gone. Real BBQ takes time, and our meats go on the smokers many hours before they are served.

properties.name: The Big Easy
properties.description: In the heart of Raleigh, you’ll find a little slice of New Orleans: The Big Easy. We embody the best of our two favorite cities with Cajun-inspired Southern fare, live music, and a lounge that looks like it belongs to a Voodoo priestess with a stellar vinyl collection. Indulge in our Cajun and Creole fare -- things like jambalaya, gumbo, and po' boys -- or join us for a classic burger, crisp salad, or some wings. As for our live music, we’ve got everything from make you wanna dance DJs to sing-along cover bands. Enjoy it all with a one of our signature Hurricanes in your hand, and you’ll be feeling the spirit of the Crescent City with all the cool vibes of Fayetteville Street. Here at The Big Easy, life’s always this good.

properties.name: The Big Easy Oven + Tap
properties.description:
The Big Easy Oven + Tap is a modern, southern kitchen with New Orleans roots. We believe in true Southern hospitality. From our warm and friendly staff, to an excellent selection of scratch made food and local drinks, we want you to feel right at home!

We're serving up tasty dishes for everyone, with southern favorites like gumbo, jambalaya, po’ boys, and fried seafood, as well as classics like perfectly grilled burgers and ribs. Whether you pull up a chair inside or unwind on our large outdoor patio, we're sure you'll leave with a belly full of delicious food.

properties.name: The Bistro (Courtyard Raleigh Crabtree Valley)
properties.description: Your food and beverage destination for refreshing breakfast choices in the morning, and a variety of dinner, beer and wine options in the evening. The Bistro also offers specialty beverages made with Starbucks® coffee to help you get a jump on the day.

properties.name: The Blind Pelican Seafood House
properties.description: The Blind Pelican Seafood House offers many of your favorite seafood classics including new dishes to pair with your loaded bloody mary, and we mean loaded!

properties.name: The Border
properties.description: One of last of the disappearing Mom & Pop's restaurants still serving home cooked foods like chickin-n-pastry, liver and onions, meatloaf and more!

properties.name: The Bowls - Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: The Bowls offers varying East Asian cuisines without leaving Raleigh. Pair a rice bowl with fusion egg rolls and fries. Each bowl is named after an East Asian cities and carefully put together with fresh ingredients to represent different types of Asian cuisine.

properties.name: The Brasserie at Neuse River Brewing
properties.description:
The Brasserie at Neuse River Brewing serves European Bistro-inspired fare with a North Carolina twist to compliment our Belgian inspired craft beers.

Join us for dinner Wednesday through Sunday or for brunch Saturday and Sunday (noon-3pm).

properties.name: The Bull & Bear
properties.description: The Bull & Bear are a family owned and operated bar and grill serving the greater Raleigh area for over 30 years.

properties.name: The Burger Shop
properties.description: Serving classic handmade burgers, never frozen- never premade. Hand-squeezed lemonade and hand-cut fries. The Burger Shop strives to serve a simple but delicious burger at a good price.

properties.name: The Capital Grille
properties.description: The Capital Grille is a fine-dining restaurant that offers dry aged steaks, fresh seafood, an award-winning wine list and professional service in an atmosphere of relaxed elegance. Open seven days a week, The Capital Grille is best known for its expertly prepared steaks, which are custom-aged for 18 to 24 days in-house and hand-cut in restaurant by their in-house butcher. The restaurant’s wine list features more than 350 selections, and its floor-to-ceiling wine kiosk regularly houses 3,500-5,000 bottles. The Capital Grille also offers personalized, on-site wine lockers, available by annual lease, and private meeting space for various functions and events. Reservations are recommended but not required.

properties.name: The Cary Pub
properties.description: The Cary Pub, located in Cary, North Carolina, is one of the city’s favorite bars. Conveniently located on the corner of Cary Parkway and Tryon Rd, great food and great times are always just around the corner. Executive Chef John Graham created The Cary Pub’s menu to pair well with a number of our local and craft beers. Like us on facebook to see what fresh food specials the chef is cooking tonight! Come watch your football teams this upcoming season with The Pub’s NFL Ticket on fifteen flat screen televisions! If you’re looking to have some fun at a friendly Cary bar, we host many weekly events, such as trivia and live music.

properties.name: The Chocolate Boutique - North Raleigh
properties.description: The locally owned and operated Chocolate Boutique showcases an extravaganza of dark, milk and white chocolates made from the highest quality ingredients and fair-trade Belgian and Swiss chocolate to enjoy on site or for carry out. Whether you are a chocolate novice or self-proclaimed chocoholic, The Chocolate Boutique has something for everyone. From the moment you enter this elegantly decorated boutique the aroma of salted caramels, creamy marzipan, turtle pralines and all things decadent consume you. Looking for a unique way to celebrate your next event? Visit The Chocolate Boutique and make your own chocolate creations!

properties.name: The Collard Patch
properties.description: The Collard Patch is a pick-your-own roadside farm market. It is designed to help you obtain the freshest locally grown vegetables in this area. A lot of pride has gone in to growing the finest, tastiest garden vegetables, maintaining all the nutritional benefits.

properties.name: The Corner Tavern & Grill
properties.description:
The Corner Tavern & Grill serves a combination of American and Moroccan cuisine.


You've been good - Go sit in the Corner.

properties.name: The Cortez
properties.description: The Cortez features freshly prepared seafood with a globalized pantry. They work with local purveyors and fisherman to source responsibly caught and raised product and offer a rotating selection of oysters obtained both locally and nationally.

properties.name: The Cowfish at North Hills
properties.description:
An excerpt from "The Legend of the Cowfish" breaks down the evolution of this unique restaurant concept, and simplifies it to its roots. The Cowfish is a one-of-a-kind dining experience, thriving on its ability to fuse two niche products seamlessly on the same menu. Certainly unusual, absolutely great! The first and only "Sushi Burger Bar"!


The Cowfish brings to the world the first restaurant focusing on offering both the best sushi AND the best burger in town. Fresh, innovative and delicious, the sushi segment of the menu is powered by the success of sister company, eeZ Fusion & Sushi. All natural, creative and hearty, the burgers entice with fresh, never frozen, ingredients and bold flavors. Spiked hand-spun milkshakes, premium sakes, craft beers, wine and 10oz exotic martinis round out a huge bar menu that is sure to please. The Cowfish aims to offer something for the entire family.

properties.name: The Cranky Yankee
properties.description: A unique Long Island family-owned bakeshop that strives to bring delicious, made from scratch New York style, Italian Inspired desserts, pastries and breads to downtown Apex!

properties.name: The Creamery
properties.description:
The Creamery, located in D.H. Hill Library at North Carolina State University, serves "Howling Cow" premium ice cream made at N.C. State. In addition to hand-scooped ice cream, you can also get specialty sundaes such as the Wolfpack Sundae, as well as milkshakes made with three large scoops of ice cream, fresh heavy cream and a dash of vanilla.


Parking is available at Dan Allen Deck and Coliseum Deck, which are pay lot parking decks, or at one of the various metered parking spots throughout campus or on Hillsborough St.

properties.name: The Cupcake Shoppe
properties.description: Serves 11 different kinds of cupcakes, plus seasonal favorites, muffins, cookies, milk & coffee.  Custom-order cakes & cupcakes for all occasions.

properties.name: The Curry Club
properties.description: Dharani Express Indian Restaurant and Takeout is conveniently located at the intersection of Gorman and Avent Ferry near North Carolina State University's Centennial Campus

properties.name: The Daily Planet Cafe
properties.description: The Daily Planet Cafe in downtown Raleigh prides itself on fresh and local. Fresh produce and products from N.C. farmers and purveyors, coffee from Larry's Beans in Raleigh and beer and wine from across our great state. They are a locally owned N.C. restaurant in a museum—serving breakfast, lunch and small plates made up of the freshest, local ingredients. The Daily Planet Cafe is open seven days a week, so pick your day, visit the North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences and have a delicious meal! In addition to great food and drink, they also offer science cafes and other special events throughout the year in conjunction with the museum.

properties.name: The Davie
properties.description: The Davie is a local neighborhood bar located in the heart of downtown Raleigh near Moore Square. We offer a rotating draft list with an emphasis on quality spirits in a relaxing two story environment.

properties.name: The Depot on First
properties.description: Welcome to the Depot on First. Take a step back in time inside this revitalized early 1900’s Sears Catalog home. Prepare to be impressed with our selection of Chef-prepared meals featuring local farms and seafood options while enjoying a warm and cozy atmosphere. Afterwards, complement your meal with our wide selection of fine wines and bourbons while sitting outside on our expansive patio overlooking Knightdale Station Park. Now y’all come eat!

properties.name: The Dirty V Plant-Based Noshery
properties.description: At The Dirty V you can indulge in some of the sloppiest, tastiest plant-based grub around. Be it a fat juicy burger, a frosty shake, a cold local brew, or a tray of our signature loaded waffle fries… our goal is to normalize the plant-based lifestyle for anyone and everyone. LETS. GET. DIRTY.

properties.name: The Dugout Tavern and Grill
properties.description: The Dugout Tavern and Grill, located in Apex, is a neighborhood sports bar and restaurant with a state-of-the-art entertainment system, extensive craft beer selection, and hand-crafted cocktails. The Dugout is the perfect place to grab a bite to eat, get a cold beer and cheer on your favorite team.

properties.name: The Fiction Kitchen
properties.description: Creative and comforting food which is locally sourced and seasonally inspired, in an eclectic and ever-evolving atmosphere. The Fiction Kitchen is eager to offer the area affordable, fresh and delicious food and beverages which will appeal to vegans, vegetarians and food-curious omnivores alike.

properties.name: The Fish House Eatery
properties.description: The Fish House Eatery is an extension of The Fish House Seafood Market in Apex, serving fresh and delicious seafood made to order.

properties.name: The Full Moon Oyster Bar
properties.description: The Full Moon Oyster Bar is a popular watering hole and seafood grill located in Morrisville, a few hours from the coast but still boasting some of the freshest seafood anywhere. Homemade recipes handed down over the years make their soups and original entrees some of the best in the southeast. Like the traditional steam houses down on thecoast, Full Moon has learned that fresh oysters and other shellfish delights, are best prepared using hot steam only to preserve the salty good freshness we love.

properties.name: The Golden Empanada
properties.description: Chilean handmade empanadas and desserts. The first and only Chilean food truck in the Triangle area. Always bringing you the best flavors from Chile. Come try us out!

properties.name: The Katsu - Morgan Street Food Hall
properties.description: The Katsu serves premium katsu sandwiches made out of handmade chicken katsu, tonkatsu (pork), beef katsu, or shrimp katsu.

properties.name: The Kitchen Table at Relish
properties.description: The Kitchen Table is the “sister” restaurant to long time Raleigh southern comfort staple, Relish Craft Kitchen & Bourbon Bar. We are known for our focus on modern craft cocktails featuring local distilleries, craft beer, and local cold brew on tap. Our food menu can be described as lighter southern fare with a “modern twist”. In addition to being a full service restaurant and bar, we are also a board game café with 400+ GAMES . We have a crew of  “gametenders” that are available to help you choose, learn, and play any game you‘d like.

properties.name: The Kupkake Fairy
properties.description: The KupKake Fairy bakes scratch cupcakes for festivals and events all over N.C. Come to the shop and taste the difference, or look for the pink tent at events.

properties.name: The Lemon Tree
properties.description: Nestled in the heart of historic Downtown Wake Forest, The Lemon Tree offers freshly prepared salads, soups, wraps and sandwiches.

properties.name: The Library Steakhouse
properties.description: Located in the old town library, The Library Steakhouse offers an extensive menu with steaks and other options such as salads and mouth-watering lobster mac-and-cheese. Reserve a table or pop into the bar, Wednesday through Sunday!

properties.name: The Local
properties.description: Local flavors. Local brews. Local sports.

properties.name: The Longleaf Lounge
properties.description: The Longleaf Lounge, located inside The Longleaf Hotel, features classic cocktails with a healthy dose of vermouth and aperitifs along with small plates inspired by 1960s classics.

properties.name: The Mac House
properties.description: A family-owned and -operated "casual gourmet" mac and cheese restaurant that focuses on making things from scratch using ingredients sourced locally.

properties.name: The Mason Jar Tavern - Fuquay-Varina
properties.description: From fresh salads to beer braised chicken sliders to Mason Jar Blood Orange Margaritas, The Mason Jar Tavern delivers quality food and drinks in a fun, exciting atmosphere. The Mason Jar Tavern brings all the comforts of southern hospitality with a modern twist.

properties.name: The Neighborhood Sports Bar and Arcade
properties.description: The Neighborhood Sports Bar and Arcade is a 21 and up bar and arcade with pub food and all your sports action.

properties.name: The Oak
properties.description: The Oak features a chef inspired menu of elevated American fare prepared in our scratch kitchen and served by a staff who share our same passion for food and drinks. A kitchen and bourbon bar using fresh ingredients to create simple, yet elevated fare.  Enjoy our large bourbon selection, craft cocktails, our house-aged bourbons, bourbon dinners, bourbon tastings, and our adopt-a-barrel bourbon program.

properties.name: The Olive Wagon
properties.description: The Olive Wagon specializes in fresh extra virgin olive oil, and 25 Star premium balsamic vinegar from Modena, Italy. The store also provides a wide selection of gourmet foods, pastas, honey, sauces and toffee. There is also a full line of stoneware from Portugal, hand painted dishes from Italy and pottery. The Olive Wagon also makes custom gift baskets and gift sets to meet any budget.

properties.name: The Panini Co.
properties.description: Located in Morgan Street Food Hall, The Panini Co. specializes in gourmet pressed sandwiches, charcuterie trays, and Belgian chocolate-covered strawberries!

properties.name: The Peach Cobbler Factory
properties.description: The Peach Cobbler Factory is a dessertery featuring twelve flavors of cobbler, twelve flavors of banana pudding, and more! Enjoy ice cream, churros, milkshakes, and any other sweet you can think of.

properties.name: The Peak on Salem
properties.description: The Peak on Salem offers Southern contemporary cuisine in a beautiful historic building in downtown Apex.

properties.name: The Peddler Steakhouse
properties.description:
Everything at The Peddler is aged to perfection, from our steaks to our story.

Each steak we serve is aged for a minimum of 28 days for ultimate flavor and tenderness, and cut at your table upon request. Our prime rib is the house specialty, but we strive for perfection in everything we serve, including steak, seafood and chicken entrees all prepared over live charcoal.

properties.name: The Pickled Onion 2 at Glenwood
properties.description: The Pickled Onion is a tavern-style family-friendly restaurant and bar with a full menu every night as well as daily specials.

properties.name: The Pickled Onion at Wakefield
properties.description: The Pickled Onion is a tavern-style family-friendly restaurant and bar with a full menu every night as well as daily specials.

properties.name: The Piper's Restaurant & Tavern
properties.description: The Piper's Tavern is an Irish pub where sports fans gather and karaoke lovers can indulge their vocal chords. The decor is basic, graciously devoid of too much sports memorabilia--and the comfortable neighborhood atmosphere attracts a casual crowd. Weekends are dedicated to live music.

properties.name: The Pit
properties.description:
The Pit proudly serves authentic whole-hog, pit-cooked barbecue in downtown Raleigh's Warehouse District. A celebration of all of the great culinary offerings of the Old North State, The Pit has made a name for itself as the destination for the state's signature cuisine. The pigs used to produce the barbecue are all raised in N.C. using AWA certified farming practices, and the freshest of the state's bountiful produce is featured in the starters, sides and desserts.


Going far beyond traditional barbecue offerings with some contemporary twists on Southern favorites, The Pit also serves Texas-style brisket, baby back ribs, smoked turkey, triple-battered fried chicken and a can't-miss barbecue tofu dish.

properties.name: The Pizza Times
properties.description: The Times Family is growing. The Pizza Times joins Downtown favorites The Raleigh Times Bar and The Morning Times and we're serving up pizzas by the pie and by the slice. We're open for take-out 12pm-8pm to satisfy your pizza cravings from lunch to late night. Find us around the corner from The Raleigh Times at 210 S. Wilmington Street in Downtown Raleigh.

properties.name: The Provincial
properties.description: The Provincial is a bi-level hub with a cozy vibe and sidewalk seats offering farm-to-fork plates and craft beer on tap.

properties.name: The Roast Grill
properties.description: Since 1940, The Roast Grill, located in Historic Downtown Raleigh NC, has been serving just hotdogs and glass bottle cokes as well as the best homemade Greek desserts.

properties.name: The Shiny Diner
properties.description: Gypsy's Shiny Diner is an old-fashioned silver diner with an upbeat, retro vibe serving classic American fare & breakfast since 1997.

properties.name: The Sports Page
properties.description: The Sports Page is Knightdale's Original Sports Bar! They combine a pub fare of Burgers, Sandwiches, Wings, and daily lunch specials with a love of all sports for an eccentric, unique atmosphere! Located in the heart of Eastern Wake county since 1999, they pride themselves on having a fun and friendly environment for people of all ages. Over the years The Sports Page has been voted Knightdale's best place for lunch, best burgers, and best cocktails. They offer food made in house and lots of cold beer.

properties.name: The Station
properties.description: A corner bar and restaurant nestled on the edge of Raleigh's Historic Oakwood neighborhood, blending among the residential streets like a refuge. In the location that originally served as an Amoco gas station- The Station pays tribute to Raleigh's rich past as well as present. A cozy, rustic, watering-hole inviting you to hobnob and toast one another over a bucket of suds, a locally crafted brew or an artisanal cocktail. Creative, insightful takes on classic dishes that have been hand-crafted by Chef Scott Jankovictz set the tone for comfort. A place to linger. This is The Station.

properties.name: The Village Tavern
properties.description:
The original Village Tavern opened its doors in 1984 in Winston Salem NC. The idea was simple, serve the best possible food, at affordable prices, using only the finest freshest ingredients, and to enrich the lives of each other, their guests, and their community. In other words to make a positive difference.

Today, just as in 1984, The Village Tavern remains committed to their founding principles. Be a Great Place to Work, deliver Great Food, Great Service, and Great Value to their guests everyday. 

That's what they do, and they love what they do.

properties.name: The Wandering Moose Tavern
properties.description: The Wandering Moose food truck specializes in sandwiches made with slow-cooked meats, scratch-made sauces and fresh sides.

properties.name: The Wandering Wolf
properties.description: The Wandering Wolf is German American cooking on the go! Find us at local breweries and book us for private and corporate events!

properties.name: The Willard Rooftop Lounge
properties.description: The Willard Rooftop Lounge pairs finely crafted drinks and small plates with spectacular views of the downtown Raleigh skyline.

properties.name: Thymely Meals
properties.description: Thymely Meals is a food truck that offers a health conscious and tasty alternative to typical food truck fare focusing on low sugar, low salt, clean and whole foods as well as many vegan options.

properties.name: Tiger Sugar
properties.description:
With humble beginnings in Taichung, Taiwan, Tiger Sugar has grown into an undisputed cult brand of Boba worldwide.

These Tiger Sugar drinks not only taste good but tell their unique story with “tiger stripes” that are infused onto all of their drinks with unique hand-poured syrups.

Some say imitation is the best form of flattery. Many companies have tried to replicate Tiger Sugar's black sugar bubble tea, but their tried-and-proven methods stand the test of time.

They use a proprietary 8-hour method for cooking their syrups and tapioca pearls. The results are the perfect marriage of tea, milk, and syrup in every sip.

Tiger Sugar's award-winning bubble tea brand is bold, and their unforgettable drink varieties are a testament to this.

properties.name: Tijuana Flats - Holly Springs
properties.description: Tex Mex for All!

properties.name: Tijuana Flats - Parkside
properties.description: Tex Mex for All!

properties.name: Tin Roof Teas
properties.description: Tin Roof Teas grew out of the Hinson family’s passion for tea. They are dedicated to bringing the world’s finest teas and chocolates to N.C. Their tea consultants will help you discover flavors and learn new tea making techniques. With over 250 premium teas, you’ll develop a passion for quality teas. Tin Roof Teas offers monthly tea classes and tastings to provide customers with an opportunity to learn, broaden the senses and tempt the taste buds.

properties.name: Tlaquepaque Mexican
properties.description: Tlaquepaque Mexican Cuisine Restaurant prides themselves on providing customers with a unique and pleasurable dining experience in the heart of N.C. Their mission is simple: to serve the best authentic Mexican food and drink possible at a comfortable price.

properties.name: Tobacco Road Sports Cafe & Brewery
properties.description:
Brothers Brian, Alex and Rommie Amra always shared a passion for sports and great food. Unfortunately, their favorite places to watch the big games were never their favorite places to eat. Tobacco Road Sports Cafe offers delicious, fresh, local food, beer brewed on-site and all the sports you could ask for!


The space also has amazing private event space and, of course, a great atmosphere for dinner or drinks. Come and check out the game room, including some of your favorites: NBA Hoops, Mortal Kombat, pool, skeeball, Golden Tee, pinball and more!

properties.name: Tonbo
properties.description: The aroma of the broth will welcome you. The heartiness of the noodles will give you sustenance. And the flavors of the ingredients will bring you strength — in mind and spirit. This is Tonbo Ramen. A place of comfort and warmth. Where delicious, authentic ramen made from scratch, hand-crafted drinks and Japanese-inspired appetizers, served in our Izakaya bar, can be enjoyed in the company of friends, loved ones and even in blissful solitude. Happy Slurping!

properties.name: Tony's Pizza
properties.description: Tony’s Pizza is a locally owned pizza restaurant! We pride ourselves on having the largest slices of pizza in the Triangle area. Very much inspired by our Northern and Italian roots! Come dine in with us or pick up take out! Tony’s Pizza is located behind the CarMax on Glenwood Ave.

properties.name: Torchy's Tacos
properties.description: Torchy's sources the highest quality ingredients around so they can serve up the best damn taco (or salad) you’ve ever tasted. Cooked to order—just the way you like it.

properties.name: Transfer Co. Food Hall
properties.description:
Housed in the historic Carolina Coach garage and shop, a five-minute walk from Fayetteville St. in downtown Raleigh's Olde East neighborhood, Transfer Co. offers 43,000+ sq. ft. of renovated warehouse and newly built space for food producers, makers, vendors, restaurateurs, their guests and the local community.

Transfer Co.'s mission is to be the gathering place where different communities can connect through food.

properties.name: Tower Indian Restaurant
properties.description: Tower Restaurant serves Pure Indian Vegetarian cuisine with a South Indian twist. Dishes, many of which are gluten-free and Vegan, are prepared by drawing upon the rich tapestry of Indian food culture and tradition. Come to experience the exceptional gastronomic voyage in the ultimate venue. Their authentic cuisine unites people, connecting history and traditions in the warm and friendly atmosphere. Tower Restaurant is famous for their spicy Indian dishes, professional chef, and dedicated staff.

properties.name: Town Hall Burger and Beer
properties.description: Town Hall Burger and Beer offers awesome burgers, wings, and something for everyone with a great rotating craft beer selection.

properties.name: Tra'Li Irish Pub and Restaurant
properties.description: Tra'Li prides themselves upon being the only authentic Irish Pub in Brier Creek or North Raleigh. Tra'Li's Irish atmosphere spreads not only to the woodwork and design of the pub but to the ownership, the Chef, the food offered and the drinks on tap. All of these contribute to an atmosphere that recreates the feel of a true Irish pub. Above all what they aim to offer is a sample of the hospitality that you would expect to receive in Ireland.

properties.name: Tribeca Tavern - Cary
properties.description: With locally crafted beers flowing from the taps, creative entrees prepared in their from-scratch kitchen, and authentic N.C. hospitality, it’s all about flavor and charm at Tribeca Tavern. Handcrafted flavors and homegrown charm always served with a splash of local flair, that is. Settle in for relaxed dining amidst area images of days gone by and every day neighborhood moments and memories. Then, let your taste buds do the choosing from the thoughtfully designed menu with selections ranging from delectably health-conscious to decadently indulgent.

properties.name: Triple Barrel Tavern
properties.description: Triple Barrel Tavern is a restaurant, sports bar & billiards located right off of highway 55 between Holly-Springs and Fuquay-Varina.

properties.name: Tropical Smoothie Cafe
properties.description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe's menu boasts bold, flavorful food and smoothies with a healthy appeal. The food and smoothies are made to order with fresh ingredients. Smoothies are made from superior simple ingredients including real fruit and natural sugar. Toasted wraps, bistro sandwiches, grilled flatbreads and gourmet salads are made fresh with high quality meats and cheeses; and topped with fresh produce and flavorful sauces.

properties.name: Tropical Smoothie Cafe - Cary
properties.description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe's menu boasts bold, flavorful food and smoothies with a healthy appeal. The food and smoothies are made to order with fresh ingredients. Smoothies are made from superior simple ingredients including real fruit and natural sugar. Toasted wraps, bistro sandwiches, grilled flatbreads and gourmet salads are made fresh with high quality meats and cheeses; and topped with fresh produce and flavorful sauces.

properties.name: Tupelo Honey
properties.description: Fresh, scratch-made and Southern—that's Tupelo Honey, where the expected Southern comfort foods are transformed into inventive goodness. From fried chicken to shrimp and grits to ginormous buttermilk biscuits, their take on Southern food is farm-to-fork delicious. And don't forget the signature craft cocktails and selection of unique craft beers!

properties.name: Tuscan Blu
properties.description: Tuscan Blu is owned by former Caffe Luna executive chef Maurizio Privilegi, and is an Italian dining establishment with a menu that includes pastas, seafood and cured meat dishes from the owners native Tuscany. The chef prepares dishes from all countrysides of Tuscany with new feelings of creation, and while using fresh organic products from local farms right here in Raleigh.

properties.name: Two Roosters Ice Cream
properties.description: Two Roosters Ice Cream offers hand crafted ice cream featuring all that the N.C. food landscape has to offer.

properties.name: Two Roosters Ice Cream - Lake Boone Trail
properties.description: Two Roosters Ice Cream offers hand crafted ice cream featuring all that the North Carolina food landscape has to offer.

properties.name: Udupi Cafe
properties.description: With state of art ambiance and authentic food preparation, Udupi Café promise to serve heavenly South Indian dishes to soothe your taste buds. Offer yourself a dive into the hearty South Indian cuisine and savor a cherishing experience at Udupi Café.

properties.name: Umami Japanese Steakhouse Sushi
properties.description: Umami Japanese Steakhouse and Sushi is a restaurant born from heritage in a tradition forged by fire.  Enjoy the distinguished cuisine from centuries-old Japan in a calm atmosphere while our exciting Teppan-Yaki Chefs, skilled in the Art of Formal Japanese Flare, bring you a show quite like no other.

properties.name: Umami Japanese Steakhouse and Sushi
properties.description: Umami Japanese Steakhouse and Sushi offers the most entertaining dining experience in Brier Creek. Offering, teppenyaki, hibachi, sushi.

properties.name: Uncle Julio's
properties.description: Uncle Julio’s serves made-from-scratch Mexican cuisine, using fresh ingredients and authentic recipes to bring its signature taste to life in everything from mesquite-grilled meats to hand-crafted margaritas. Guests find memorable dining experiences through a welcoming atmosphere and interactive menu, such as watching guacamole made tableside, looking into the open kitchen to see dishes being prepared, or cracking open a Chocolate Piñata.

properties.name: Union Special
properties.description: Union Special Bread focuses on hand made bread leavened with natural cultures alongside a line of croissants and other pastries using fresh and local ingredients.

properties.name: Upper Deck
properties.description: Upper Deck is the place for sports and events! Watch your favorite games and enjoy wings and 20 rotating beers on draft.

properties.name: Urban Angeethi
properties.description: Urban Angeethi is an elegant dining experience in the heart of Cary with incredible ambience, offering finely crafted dishes with authentic flavours from the land of spices.

properties.name: V Pizza
properties.description: V Pizza is the combination of true Neapolitan pizza, made with the absolute best ingredients, being paired with unparalleled customer service. Our core ingredients and ovens are imported from Naples, Italy, ensuring every meal we serve to be unlike anything else.

properties.name: Vaishno Bhog
properties.description: Vaishno Bhog offers Cary's finest Indian street food & mithai.

properties.name: Vegan Community Kitchen
properties.description: Vegan Community Kitchen shares authentic, delicious, wholesome, Mediterranean dishes that fuel and energize without compromising flavor, taste or satisfaction.

properties.name: Vic's Italian Restaurant
properties.description: Vic's is a cozy Italian cafe in the middle of City Market in downtown Raleigh. Serving N.Y.-style pizza south of Brooklyn and a wide variety of delicious pastas and entrees in healthy portions. Owned by real Italians, so you know you will get an authentic Italian meal!

properties.name: Vic's Italian Restaurant - The Marketplace
properties.description: Vic's is a cozy Italian cafe in The Marketplace off Lake Boone Trl. Serving N.Y.-style pizza south of Brooklyn and a wide variety of delicious pastas and entrees in healthy portions. Owned by real Italians, so you know you will get an authentic Italian meal!

properties.name: Vic's Pizzeria - Glenwood
properties.description: Vic's prides themselves on having the most authentic Italian food in downtown Raleigh, offering a wide array of choices and using fresh and local ingredients. Order online and enjoy the best New York Style Pizza south of Brooklyn!

properties.name: Vicious Fishes Taproom & Kitchen
properties.description:
In the heart of downtown Fuquay-Varina, Vicious Fishes Tap & Kitchen is a gastropub providing adventurous, eclectic pub fare born from their wood fired grill. Vicious Fishes Tap & Kitchen features a variety of snacks, small plates and larger platters that are meant for sharing, so bring a friend. The menu will change frequently, based on what fresh, local ingredients are currently in season. 

Vicious Fishes beers are integral ingredients in much of our food preparation, such as pilsner for steaming mussels, house pickles made from IPA, brown ale used to braise our roast beef sandwich and pale ale mayo which accompanies smoked beef tartare.

​

properties.name: Vida Dulce
properties.description: Vida Dulce is a local family owned business that strives to serve you the best popsicles, ice cream, fruit waters and snacks.

properties.name: Vida Dulce - Knightdale

properties.name: Vidrio
properties.description:
Vidrio is a colorful window into the flavors and soul of the Mediterranean kitchen. A creative expression of the passion, people and lifestyle that have embodied a timeless culture.


An evening with Vidrio is an evening to savor, slowly. The dinner table is where you reconnect after a long day apart. A place to gather together and truly unwind over artfully crafted cocktails, bold wines and plates made to share.


The menu is an ode to traditional Mediterranean dining, with both imported specialties and local, honest ingredients that embody a passion for earth, flavor and wine.


Photo credit: F8 Photo Studios

properties.description: Vieni Ristobar is a family-owned and -operated Italian restaurant in Holly Springs.

properties.name: Village Deli (Lake Boone Trail)
properties.description: Village Deli was established based on a vision they had about offering hearty, homemade foods in a rustic and cozy atmosphere. They wanted to create a wholesome and warm establishment where people would feel welcome and well-fed! You may have only 15 or 20 minutes for lunch, time to order and eat, but they strive to serve quality products, and serve it fast in a relaxing atmosphere. Smooth and efficient service-but, please, not fast food! The goal at Village Deli is to treat you like family- the way you would want to be treated. So come indulge yourself in a delightful eating experience!

properties.name: Village Deli (Village District)
properties.description: Village Deli at Cameron Village has the honor of being the original Village Deli location. Village Deli serves all homemade products in a rustic, warm atmosphere with outside seating. Serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. Try Village Deli's famous chicken salad, Reuben, burgers and specialty deli sandwiches.

properties.name: Village Draft House at Village District
properties.description: The Village Draft House has more beer taps than you can shake a stick at and offers the finest bar food in all of downtown. We serve lunch, dinner and late night, so come by and say "Hello." We'll be glad to see you, and you'll be glad you came!

Locally crafted beers and food products highlight a menu that is focused on the very best that American Cuisine has to offer.

properties.name: Vinos Finos y Picadas
properties.description:
Vinos Finos y Picadas provides savory food, great wine, and warm, friendly people mixing together to make the perfect concoction. Vinos is a South American wine and tapas bar that boasts an excellent wine accompaniment menu featuring meat and cheese platters, tapas, empanadas and desserts, served in an intimate environment with soft leather chairs.
Vinos Finos is a great place for large groups of people to celebrate birthday parties, promotions, baby showers, corporate events, bachelorette parties, etc. Winner of "Top Chefs' and "winning wine list" according to Raleigh's Midtown Magazine.

properties.name: Wake Forest Dairy Depot
properties.description: The Wake Forest Dairy Depot is a quaint walk-up/drive-thru ice cream shop serving delicious sundaes, milkshakes, floats, chillers, and signature Train Wrecks!

properties.name: Wakefield Tavern
properties.description: Wakefield Tavern is a locally-owned restaurant with a lot to offer. Wakefield Tavern serves brunch, lunch, dinner, drinks, and offers catering options. The restaurant hosts events weekly including live music nights, Trivia Tuesdays, and Wine Wednesdays!

properties.name: Wang's Bistro
properties.description: Wang's Bistro features Chinese, American, Italian and Japanese cuisines. Roast beef, BBQ, spare ribs, ice cream, beef and chicken, dim sum, stuffed mushroom, mussels, sushi bars, salmon, roast ham and pizza, desserts, cocktail shrimp, seafood combo, fish, huge salad bar and much more. Come enjoy Wang's all you can eat buffet!

properties.name: Wang's Kitchen
properties.description: The owners at Wang's Kitchen pick all their ingredients carefully and use only the freshest and natural ones to prepare every dish, and try to cook them in a healthier way to provide the most nutritious food. Much attention has been attached to ensure you have a cozy and inviting ambiance where you can enjoy not only the great meal but also the authentic atmosphere.

properties.name: Wang's Kitchen (Creedmoor)
properties.description: Wang's Kitchen is known for its modern interpretation of classic dishes and its insistence on only using high-quality, fresh ingredients. Dine in and takeout available.

properties.name: Wang's Kitchen - Apex
properties.description: Wang's Kitchen in Apex offers the best Chinese food at a great value. Wang's has a diverse menu with a wide range of flavors served with love. Wang's is open for lunch or dinner, for pick-up or dine in.

properties.name: Waraji Japanese Restaurant
properties.description: This sushi restaurant located near Crabtree Valley Mall in Raleigh, N.C. serves Japanese entrees and is open for lunch and dinner. Waraji is the winner on many best of awards for sushi and Japanese cuisine. There is a complete sushi menu, including sashimi and specialty rolls. For those who prefer their food cooked, there are numerous noodle soups, combination plates, appetizers and entrees like tempura and teriyaki as well as an izakaya bar.

properties.description: Unassuming spot serving Japanese & Thai fare, including sushi & sashimi, plus sake, wine & spirits in Cary, North Carolina.

properties.description: WhichWich is a superior sandwich shop featuring 51 sandwiches all custom made for each customer.

properties.name: Which Wich - North Hills
properties.description: Choose from more than 50 superior sandwiches, custom-crafted with the freshest meats, cheeses, and more than 60 toppings! It's your wich - any way you want it!

properties.description:
Some want to make superior sandwiches. Some want to make the world a better place. We want to do both.

Choose from more than 50 superior sandwiches, custom-crafted with the freshest meats, cheeses, and more than 60 toppings! It's your wich - any way you want it!

properties.name: Whiskey Kitchen
properties.description: One part whiskey bar, one part Southern kitchen. Whiskey Kitchen is a hip destination for inventive, regionally-inspired dishes, craft cocktails and an extensive selection of over 300 whiskies from around the world. The former garage space sets a relaxed and welcoming tone, whether you’re seated indoors, admiring the rows of whiskey against the backdrop of a dramatic feast-themed mural behind the bar, or on the spacious patio with a prime view of leafy Nash Square across the street.

properties.name: White Oak Grill
properties.description: Country bar and grill featuring home cooked lunch specials, daily drink specials, live music, karaoke, poker, cold beer, burgers, BBQ, and pizza.

properties.name: Wild Wing Cafe
properties.description: Wild Wing serves up good wings, good beer, and good times. A sports bar dedicated to quality food and great service. Live music on Friday nights.

properties.name: Wild Wing Cafe
properties.description: Wild Wing Cafe is a franchise "spreading their wings" across the Southeast US. Voted Best Wings in Raleigh in 2008 by Independent Magazine, Wild Wing serves up good wings, good beer, and good times. A sports bar dedicated to quality food and great service. Live music every Friday and Saturday.

properties.name: Wilson's Eatery
properties.description: Wilson's Eatery serves up locally sourced, scratch made sandwiches, flatbreads and salads in a casual counter service environment. Dine inside our comfortable warehouse space, on our outdoor deck or in the spacious Beer Garden, which we share with our sister company, Lynnwood Brewing Concern. Wash it all down with fresh LBC beers, house-made sodas and craft cocktails made with spirits from N.C. distilleries.

properties.name: Wings Over Raleigh
properties.description: Wings Over Raleigh serves wings, boneless wings, ribs, sandwiches, and fries for takeout and delivery. The boneless wings (or chicken tenders if you like) are fresh hand breaded not frozen processed junk. Wings are fresh, huge, juicy, and cooked in a manner which helps keep them as crispy as possible for delivery. At Wings Over they believe that takeout and delivery food should be of the same quality and have the same effort put into it as good restaurant food.

properties.name: Wingstop
properties.description: Lemon Pepper. Atomic. Mango Habanero. If your mouth is watering just reading those flavors then Wingstop has done their job. The goal isn't just to bring you quality wings. It's to make wings that are worth craving, even obsessing about. Enjoy traditional wings or boneless strips, sauced and tossed in your choice of 11 flavors. Add tasty sides for a meal that can feed any appetite.

properties.name: Wingstop - Alexander Promenade
properties.description: Lemon Pepper. Atomic. Mango Habanero. If your mouth is watering just reading those flavors then Wingstop has done their job. The goal isn't just to bring you quality wings. It's to make wings that are worth craving, even obsessing about. Enjoy traditional wings or boneless strips, sauced and tossed in your choice of 11 flavors. Add tasty sides for a meal that can feed any appetite.

properties.name: Winston's Grille
properties.description:
Locally owned and operated, Winston’s Grille has been a favorite Raleigh landmark for 25+ years. Over the years, Winston’s has become a neighborhood gathering place for friends, family, celebrations and business meetings. Winston's strives to consistently provide you with great food and service in a casual and comfortable atmosphere. Whether you are looking for a private room, large table, cozy booth, quiet intimate table or outside dining on our beautiful patio, they have a setting for you. Join them for lunch, dinner or Sunday brunch or even just drop in for an appetizer and a drink or coffee and dessert. Winston's Grille would love to see you soon!
Photo via the restaurant

properties.name: Wonderland Tapas & Cocktails
properties.description: Welcome to the Wonderland, an amazing dining and social adventure.

properties.name: Woody's - Morrisville
properties.description: Almost three decades have gone by since the inception of Woody's. Since then two Woody's locations have gone on to become Raleigh area institutions, each with a diverse, friendly staff and an exceptionally loyal clientele. Woody's award-winning food, extensive selection of booze and lively, non-conformist atmosphere and attitude keep our loyal patrons coming back year after year.

properties.name: Woody's Sports Tavern & Grill
properties.description: The Triangle's ultimate sports bar! 25 wide screen tv's in high definition. All ABC permits. Daily lunch and drink specials.

properties.name: Woody's at City Market
properties.description: Established in 1993, Woody's at City Market has been a staple in the Moore Square District of downtown Raleigh as one of the Triangle's favorite neighborhood taverns. Nestled among the quaint cobblestone streets of historic City Market they have become not only the place for local residents to enjoy different varieties of entertainment, but also an establishment that has been able to grow with the city and help host many diverse groups of travelers. Woody's prides themselves on being a place that you can enjoy with friends playing trivia, having lunch with the family, catching the game with your buddies, or listening to local musicians on weekend nights.

properties.name: Wynton's World Cooking School
properties.description:
Use your taste buds and words to immerse yourself in Wynton’s World unique opportunities! Wynton’s World specializes in culinary arts, foreign language instruction, and educational travel. 

Fit for teens and adults, Wynton’s World provides culinary classes for all levels of experience in the Triangle area, as well as a multitude of Foreign language and culture classes. 

We also specialize in international travel opportunities through culinary tours, and teen or adult Spanish study abroad programs. Visit us today to explore all the wonderful opportunities Wynton’s World provides for the community.

properties.name: Yard House
properties.description: An upscale-casual eatery known for great food, classic rock music and 100-250 taps of imported, craft and specialty ales and lagers. Yard House features a center island bar and an endless fleet of tap handles ranging from classic lagers to more obscure ales. The award-winning and extensive menu of American fusion cuisine features more than 130 items including appetizers, salads, pastas, sandwiches, street tacos, grilled burgers, individual-size pizzas, seafood, steaks and ribs. Lively environment is created by colorful abstract artwork, classic rock music and flat screens in every direction showcasing the day's news and sporting events. The perfect place to celebrate a special occasion or gather your family for dinner.

properties.name: Yatai Market - Transfer Co. Food Hall
properties.description: Yatai Market is a global-inspired fish market, restaurant and speakeasy set inside Transfer Food Hall of Downtown Raleigh. Led by renowned Sushi Chef Magno Tapia (M Sushi), the market will boast multiple food and beverage stalls within it where various styles of seafare are celebrated. In one stall, freshly prepared seafood staples like sushi and ramen from Japan will take center stage whereas another stall will showcase familiar Baja-style fish tacos. A third stall tucked around the corner will make way for guests to enjoy a speakeasy experience boasting a globetrotting bar menu that will range from sake cocktails to Japanese Whiskey Old Fashioneds and Mezcal Margaritas.

properties.name: Yellow Dog Bread Company
properties.description: Yellow Dog Bread Company specializes in handmade artisan breads and southern influenced pastries.

properties.name: Zanyu Asian Noodles

properties.description: Zaxby’s is a fast-casual chicken restaurant chain currently operating more than 500 restaurants in 13 states. Zaxby's, the home of indescribably good chicken!

properties.name: Zaxby's
properties.description: Stop by today for drive-thru service or order ahead using the website or the app. The Zaxby's founders had the simple idea to serve delicious chicken fingers, wings, sandwiches and salads in a fun, offbeat atmosphere where you can be yourself. That small idea grew into something much bigger...which is how Zaxby's ended up here in your neighborhood. Whether you're driving thru after a hectic day, or catering a special event, Zaxby's is excited to serve your community.

properties.name: Zaxby's
properties.description: Stop by today for drive-thru service or order ahead using the website or the app. The Zaxby's founders had the simple idea to serve delicious chicken fingers, wings, sandwiches and salads in a fun, offbeat atmosphere where you can be yourself. That small idea grew into something much bigger...which is how Zaxby's ended up here in your neighborhood. Whether you're driving thru after a hectic day, or catering a special event, Zaxby's is excited to serve your community.

properties.name: Zayka Indian Cuisine
properties.description: Zayka offers guests an authentic dining experience with traditional Punjabi Northern Indian Cuisine and native beverages. Their menu offers a variety of dishes each cooked with authentic ingredients, spices, and style whilst served to your table with appropriate garnishing and sides. The emphasis on fresh and diverse vegetables and sauces is key to elevating the flavors of Zayka. An exciting selection of cocktails, wine and beer can also be enjoyed from the bar.

properties.name: Zest Cafe & Home Art
properties.description: Fresh daily prepared cuisine/bi-weekly changing menu items. Excellent, friendly service - surrounded by home furnishings accessories and gifts.

properties.name: Zest Sushi & Small Plates
properties.description: Nestled in the heart of downtown Cary, N.C., Zest Sushi & Small Plates captures casual elegance in a relaxed, yet chic setting with an approachable Asian-focused menu, vibrant bar program & genuine hospitality.

properties.name: bartaco
properties.description: bartaco is inspired by the beach culture of Brazil, Uruguay and southern California. Bartaco is upscale street food with a coastal vibe in a relaxed environment.

properties.name: lucettegrace
properties.description: lucettegrace is a contemporary patisserie in the heart of downtown Raleigh. They specialize in sweet and savory breakfast pastries, desserts and light lunch.

properties.name: Brewery Bhavana
properties.description: Here and now. Communal beer experiences that exhibit the hand of the maker. Brewery, dim sum, book and flower shop in the heart of downtown Raleigh.

properties.name: Aviator Brewing Company
properties.description: Founded to provide fine ales, seasonal releases and barrel aged ales in N.C. In addition to offering brewery tours for the public at the Brewery, its brews may be sampled daily at the Aviator Brewing Tap House, located in downtown Varina.

properties.name: Bombshell Beer Company
properties.description: Enjoy pints and flights in the inviting taproom and beer garden, or grab a growler or canned beer to go at N.C.'s first 100% women-owned microbrewery. Food trucks on-site Thurs.-Sat., and there's live music on many weekend evenings. Brewery tours available by reservation. Please visit website for complete listing of hours, brewery tours, food trucks and events.

properties.name: Bond Brothers Beer Company
properties.description: A microbrewery and taproom in historic downtown Cary. Additionally, there is a large patio area with adjacent event space for private parties. The tap list features kettle sours, IPAs and Stouts while their bottle list is barrel aged funky and sour beer all made on site!

properties.name: Altered State Brewing
properties.description: Altered State Brewing is a North Raleigh brewery and taproom releasing new beers every Thursday.

properties.name: Ancillary Fermentation
properties.description: The Branch at Ancillary is a former bank at the corner of Wake Forest Rd. and Hardimont hosting a "permanently impermanent" beer, food and art experience. Enjoy Ancillary beers on tap, pop-up food experiences and rotating art shows.

properties.name: Aunty Betty's Gin & Absinthe Bar
properties.description: Aunty Betty’s Gin & Absinthe Bar is a concept dreamed up by the minds at the Hibernian Hospitality Group and Greg Ewan. Bringing Irish and American traditional gin to the Morgan Street Food Hall. Serving nothing but the finest craft cocktails in the city!

properties.name: Aviator Brewing Company
properties.description:
Founded to provide fine ales, seasonal releases and barrel aged ales in N.C. In addition to offering brewery tours for the public at the Brewery, its brews may be sampled daily at the Aviator Brewing Tap House, located in downtown Varina. Tour Hours: Thurs.-Fri., 6:30pm; Sat., 4-6:30pm (every 30 minutes); Sun., 5:30pm.
First photo in gallery: Chris Richman

properties.name: BREW Coffee Bar - McNeill Pointe
properties.description: Driven by community and focused on superior quality and excellent customer service, BREW is a perfect destination for a morning coffee or an evening cocktail.

properties.name: Bearded Bee Brewing Company
properties.description: Bearded Bee Brewing Company's mission is to brew great beer using local ingredients, support the honeybee and local beekeepers, and create a place for the community to gather. The brewery has a large taproom and beer garden, and our vision is for it to become the hive of Wendell... A place where friends, family, and pets gather to enjoy great company and great beer!

properties.name: Blackbird Brewery
properties.description:
Blackbird Brewery is a family-owned and brewer-owned local brewery in Wake Forest, NC. We are not a venture, an investment or a pet project. This is our life. You can taste it in each sip and feel it when you walk into our tap room. For out of town visitors or taproom regulars we are a place to call home, even if it’s just for an hour. At Blackbird Brewery, you’re not just one of our customers, you’re one of us.

We invite you to come enjoy one of our many local beers (or two) in our 1,000 ft. taproom or our 5,000 ft. outdoor patio and beer garden in Wake Forest, N.C.

properties.name: Bombshell Beer Company
properties.description: Enjoy pints and flights in the inviting taproom and beer garden, or grab a growler or canned beer to go at N.C.'s first 100% women-owned microbrewery. Food trucks on-site Thurs.-Sat., and there's live music on many weekend evenings. Brewery tours available by reservation. Please visit website for complete listing of hours, brewery tours, food trucks and events.

properties.name: Bond Brothers Beer Company
properties.description: A microbrewery and taproom in historic downtown Cary. Additionally, there is a large patio area with adjacent event space for private parties. The tap list features kettle sours, IPAs and Stouts while their bottle list is barrel aged funky and sour beer all made on site!

properties.name: Bond Brothers Eastside
properties.description: Bond Brothers Beer Company's second location, Bond Brothers Eastside is a shared space to expand their clean barrel program and to share our love for live music with our Cary community.

properties.name: Brewery Bhavana
properties.description: Here and now. Communal beer experiences that exhibit the hand of the maker. Brewery, dim sum, book and flower shop in the heart of downtown Raleigh.

properties.name: Brueprint Brewing Company
properties.description:
Better than a recipe, a brewing “blueprint” combines science and great culinary skill to create a Brüeprint.


Brüeprint is dedicated to traditional social interaction while sampling delicious beer. Their hope is that you’ll rest your phone for a few minutes to have a real conversation, partake in or watch a game with friends or take in a great band. Whatever your idea of connecting is, plan for a great time—grab a Brüeprint!

properties.name: Carolina Brewing Company
properties.description: Brewers of tasty liquids since 1995. Visit one of the oldest breweries in the state and the oldest in Wake County. Free tours every Sat., 1pm and 4pm. Taproom open Wed.-Thurs., 4-10pm; Fri., 2-10pm; Sat., noon-10pm; Sun., noon-6pm. Enjoy taproom only beers in addition to regulars. Outside seating too! Check website for events and food trucks.

properties.name: Carolina Brewing Company Wendell Taproom
properties.description: Carolina Brewing Company's Wendell taproom features 20 draft taps and mixed beverages as well as non-alcoholic offerings.

properties.name: Chatham Hill Winery, Wine Bar & Event Venue
properties.description: An urban winery, moments from downtown Raleigh and RDU, Chatham Hill Winery is one of the oldest wineries in the state and producer of award-winning, European-style wines such as Chardonnay, Viognier, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. Winery tours and wine tasting offered Tues.-Sun. ($10).

properties.name: Clouds Brewing Taproom
properties.description: Clouds Brewing Taproom pours beers from seasonal releases to year-round varieties keeping to their German-inspired roots.

properties.name: Compass Rose Brewery
properties.description: Brewing globally inspired, locally produced ales. This brewery seeks out great ingredients and beer styles from around the globe then brings them home to Raleigh. They encourage you to “Trust Your Compass” to create your personal adventure. The taproom is a comfortable environment to find some of the best beers in Raleigh. Weekly events include Trivia, Open Mic Night, live music and a rotation of food trucks, along with games for kids of all ages. You can even bring the dog! Brewery tours available the first Sat. of each month at 2pm and 4pm.

properties.name: Cotton House Craft Brewers
properties.description:
Cotton House Craft Brewers is a brewery and tap house focused on the rich history and community of Cary, NC. Beer made with hops from our NC farm served from the historic Pasmore House.

Food may be ordered within Cotton House from the Mayton Inn kitchen and other outside foods are welcome.

properties.name: Crank Arm Brewing
properties.description: Crank Arm is an award-winning craft brewery with tasting room based in downtown Raleigh. Conveniently located just one block from Red Hat Amphitheater and two blocks from the Convention Center. Its mission is to brew delicious innovative beer and to support the cycling community. Winner 2018 GABF Gold and 2016 GABF Bronze medals both in the American Belgo Category.

properties.name: East Bower Cider Company
properties.description: East Bower Cider Company Raleigh's first cidery located in East End Market on Whitaker Mill Rd. Serving in-house produced cider and guest taps as well as a curated list of rotating cider, beer and wine.

properties.name: Edit Beer Co.
properties.description: Edit Beer Co. is a craft brewery in Raleigh, N.C., featuring 20 taps and a mix of beers brewed on-site along with curated wine and cider.

properties.name: Fortnight Brewing Company
properties.description: Fortnight is a craft brewery and pub in Cary, offering traditional English-style beers that incorporate both premium U.K. and U.S. ingredients. Its mission is to produce high-quality beer that is approachable and easy to drink. Cask ale always on tap. Tour hours: Sat.-Sun., 2pm, 3pm and 4pm.

properties.name: Funguys Brewing
properties.description: As avid beer lovers, the Funguys Brewing Team came to Raleigh to bring a unique kind of flavor to the area. We believe that a beer should be brewed to be shared, enjoyed, and considered, preferably with a good friend and in an accommodating setting. Funguys Brewing’s mission is to create local craft brews with the freshness and flavor that is desired by craft consumers.

properties.name: Gizmo Brew Works
properties.description: Deep in the Umstead Industrial Park, something stirs. Amid the clank of modern machinery, a group of workers busy themselves with one of the world's oldest crafts: brewing. At Gizmo Brew Works, this meeting of contemporary technology and ancient know-how produces a tempting slate of small-batch beers. Never ones to shy away from curious guests, brewers also open up their facility for Sat. tours, walking groups through the beer-making process during 30-minute explorations. Tour hours: Sat., 2pm and 4pm.

properties.name: Heirloom Brewshop
properties.description: Heirloom Brewshop is a specialty coffee shop, premium tea house, and sake bar with Asian-inspired aesthetics and menu. A solace from the city in Raleigh's Warehouse District.

properties.name: Heyday Brewing
properties.description: Heyday Brewing is a restaurant and brewery with a distinctly southern accent. Equal parts North Carolina and Louisiana, Heyday is built on a sincere foundation of southern hospitality. It’s also built on the shared belief that any day with great beer and great food and great friends can be a Heyday. We look forward to meeting you here.

properties.name: Incendiary Brewing Taproom
properties.description: Incendiary Brewing Company was founded by Brandon Branscome and John Bacon.  Both Brandon and John are local guys raised in Winston-Salem. Labor Day weekend 2018, Incendiary Brewing Company opened their doors.  Incendiary made a name for itself quickly for its IPAs, stouts, and their unique outdoor space dubbed, The Coalpit.  Beginning 2021, they plan to launch a new Summer concert series, Coalpit Live.

properties.name: KōMANA Brewing Company
properties.description:
KōMANA sets out to provide the highest quality in Kombucha & unique alcoholic and non-alcoholic options from around the world, including CRAFT BEER!

Our vision is to create an approachable environment and product in Kombucha for everyone to explore and enjoy! We believe that everyone should be able to experience the benefits of Kombucha and intend to transform old Kombucha stigmas into positive interactions. We want to be the company that provides an atmosphere that is not only welcoming but adventurous, enjoyable and enlightening.

We are here to elevate the mindful drinking movement and offer a destination like no other!

properties.name: Local Time Brewing
properties.description: Local Time Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom in Holly Springs, N.C. where great stories, new friends, and craft beer come together. Founded by Chris and Kelly Gallagher the beers are inspired by the ingredients, brewing techniques, and cultures from around the world.

properties.name: Lonerider Brewing Company
properties.description:
Lonerider opened its doors in Raleigh on Jan. 23, 2009 with a beer and a dream. Today, Lonerider is among the top 150 craft breweries in U.S. according to 2013 Brewers Association published data. With an eye for quality, Lonerider crafted each of its beers with the highest quality ingredients. As a result Lonerider has a portfolio of award winning beers, including honors from national contests such as GABF and U.S. Beer Open. 


Over the years, Lonerider has been overwhelmed by the number of outlaws with an enthusiasm for craft beers. Lonerider is proud to be located in N.C., which has undoubtedly become the Southern State for beer. Remember there is a Lonerider in all of us!


Tasting Room open daily. Public tours available every other Sat., 2-5pm. Private tours also available.

properties.name: Lynnwood Brewing Concern
properties.description: Lynnwood Brewing Concern is a full-scale production facility, complete with a taproom and regular food truck schedule. The taproom serves a half-dozen standard brews, as well as rotating seasonal beers. The brewery uses fresh, flavorful hops, yeast, malted barley, wheat and more to create that ideal taste that makes customers keep coming back for more.

properties.name: Lynnwood Brewing Concern at Lynnwood Grill
properties.description: Lynnwood Brewing Concern's (LBC's) original brewery location at Lynnwood Grill in North Raleigh pumps out quality brews every day. Using fresh, flavorful hops, yeast, malted barley, wheat and more, LBC creates that ideal taste that makes customers keep coming back for more. LBC also has a full-scale production facility, complete with a taproom, in the Five Points area of Raleigh.

properties.name: Mordecai Beverage Co.
properties.description: Mordecai Beverage Co. is a local bottle shop, taproom and small batch brewery, located just outside of historic Oakwood and Mordecai neighborhoods.

properties.name: Neuse River Brewing Company
properties.description:
NRBC is a craft brewery located in Raleigh, North Carolina. Situated between North Raleigh and Downtown, NRBC is nestled just outside of the Five Points neighborhood with five other craft breweries located within a one-mile radius. NRBC focuses on Belgian ales and IPAs but also experiments with contemporary and experimental styles, offering a wide selection and something for everyone. 

The Taproom at NRBC is a combination of old meets new, with the original aesthetics of the brewery kept intact by only adding a simple bar, handcrafted tables and an herb garden outside. Guests are invited to take in the beauty of the building's character and enjoy each other's company while taking in a view of the Downtown city skyline, relaxing by the herb garden and drinking a beer crafted specifically for their guests in mind. 

The Brasserie at NRBC was added in late 2019 and is open serving European Bistro inspired fare with a N.C. a twist to complement their Belgian inspired craft beers.

properties.name: Nickelpoint Brewing Co.
properties.description: Nickelpoint Brewing Co. is a craft brewery located in the Five Points neighborhood of Raleigh that offers classic, European-style ales. While brewing classic styles, they also utilize the latest in brewing science and quality control techniques to ensure consistency in the beer they brew. Nickelpoint boasts a 20bbl brew house with a tasting room where customers can mingle and imbibe, as well as take a guided tour through the brewery to learn about the process of brewing craft beer. Tours and tastings available by appointment. Just like the neighborhood they call home, Nickelpoint is eclectic and progressive, but ultimately they are steeped in tradition.

properties.name: Norse Brewing Company
properties.description: We are a Modern Viking Community of All Peoples. A brotherhood and sisterhood of people who are all different both on the outside and the inside, but when we come together we are one and the same joining our differences in strength and celebration to each do our small part to make the Great Feast truly great and together drink from the horn of plenty.

properties.name: Norse Brewing Longhouse
properties.description: Norse Brewing Longhouse, located in downtown Zebulon, is a hotspot for Nordic-inspired cuisine and Norse Brewing's locally-crafted beers.

properties.name: Oak City Amaretto
properties.description: The Oak City Amaretto recipe is a twist on the owner's Grandma Scalabrino's original Sicilian amaretto recipe. From their family to yours, Saluti! and Grazie! Free tour and tasting offered every Sat. at 2pm.

properties.name: Oaklyn Springs Brewery
properties.description: Oaklyn Springs Brewery takes pride in serving unique, finely crafted beer you can enjoy with friends and family in our newly opened and inviting tap room.  Established in 2014, Oaklyn began by building on their enthusiasm to brew the finest craft beer and are now open to boldly share our passion with friends and neighbors in the local community.

properties.name: Oaklyn Springs Taproom - Downtown Varina
properties.description:
Oaklyn Springs Taproom - Downtown Varina. Good friends, better beer.

Oaklyn Springs Brewery takes pride in serving unique, finely crafted beer you can enjoy with friends and family in our newly opened and inviting tap room.  Established in 2014, Oaklyn began by building on their enthusiasm to brew the finest craft beer and are now open to boldly share our passion with friends and neighbors in the local community.

properties.name: Olde Raleigh Distillery
properties.description: Olde Raleigh Distillery is a family-owned distillery located in the heart of Zebulon, N.C. We feature an event space, tasting room with a full bar and small-batch bourbon.

properties.name: Pinetop Distillery
properties.description: Raleigh-based distillery bringing handcrafted spirits to the Oak City using local craftsmen and ingredients to present the bold taste of the South. $10 distillery tours and tastings offered Sat., 1-5pm. Carolina Moonshine and Carolina Gin available for purchase.

properties.name: Ponysaurus Brewing Co. Raleigh
properties.description:
Located in Raleigh Iron Works, Ponysaurus Brewing Co. Barrel Room & Restaurant has 18 taps and a full bar offering beer cocktails, liquor, wine & the real star of the show: Ponysaurus Brewing Co. beers! Our kitchen features 14” pizza, apps, burgers, sandwiches & much more.

In addition, our Raleigh location includes a sour-beer facility with production space for barrel aging, blending & bottling.

properties.name: R&D Brewing Seven Saturdays Taproom
properties.description:
R&D Brewing is a team of beer industry veterans with over 150 years of beer experience.

In 2017 we constructed a 3.5 bbl pilot brewing system to research, develop and gain feedback from our many connections within our community. The system created a space for innovation and creativity that allowed us to produce award-winning beers. We received a Gold Medal for the Bock and a Bronze for the Mexican Lager at the 2018 U.S. Open Beer Championship. Seven Saturdays IPA & Riviera Lager received Silver medals in the American IPA and International Style Pilsner Lager categories at the 2019 U.S. Open Beer Championship.  Remix took home the bronze medal in the fruit IPA category. Our portfolio has expanded to include the Official Team Beers of the Carolina Hurricanes and Wake Forest University.

That commitment to creating the perfect beer is the driving force behind our recent 20 bbl brewhouse upgrade with plans to continue expanding operations in a new 30,000+ square foot production facility located in Raleigh, N.C. that will include a taproom and outdoor beer garden. 

Our most recent project, the Seven Saturdays Tap Room, opened its doors in February of 2022.  We look forward to you joining us there for a delicious R&D Brewing beer.

properties.name: Raleigh Beer Garden
properties.description: With more than 350 beers on tap, passionate mind Niall Hanley’s Raleigh Beer Garden has one of the world's largest beer selections, made official when representatives from Guinness World Records visited in 2015. Located in downtown Raleigh's Glenwood South entertainment district, the venue has plenty of outdoor space, including a rooftop "garden" with seating that makes it the perfect warm-weather hangout. And this beer garden does more than just beer—a full dining menu includes everything from handcrafted pizzas to cheese and charcuterie plates.

properties.name: Raleigh Brewing Company
properties.description: Raleigh Brewing Company (RBC) was founded by home brewers who wanted to give craft beer back to the community that they hold dear. They produce six year-round brews, one seasonal beer every two months and countless experimental batches, all available at their taproom and around Raleigh. RBC is a 20 barrel commercial brewing facility with an attached home-brew supply shop and spacious tap room. They also have the Tavern Room, which will hold 40-60 people, that can be rented out and closed off for meetings, receptions, etc. Tour hours: 1st and 3rd Sat. of each month at 3pm. Brew tours are $5 and include the tour itself and a tasting of RBC's six core beers.

properties.name: Raleigh Brewing Taproom (RDU)
properties.description: Raleigh Taproom brings the craft beer trend to Terminal 2. Since 2013, Raleigh Brewing has become Wake County’s third largest production brewery and Raleigh Taproom offers guests a taste of this award winning concept along with a full bar and a robust menu offering something for everyone breakfast through dinner.

properties.name: Raleigh Rum Company
properties.description:
Born out of the owners' love of craft brews and booze, Raleigh Rum Company has become a very welcome addition to N.C., and it is the result of a lot of hard work. Among the few craft distilleries in N.C., Raleigh Rum Company creates small-batch rums from scratch. Raleigh Rum Company's White Rum is a bold, authentic spirit made with only molasses and brown sugar. Each batch is double-distilled and goes through a round of oak aging in between distillations to help create a smooth and rich flavor. Free tours and tastings offered every Sat. at 2pm.
Photo via Raleigh Rum Company

properties.name: Seventy Eight °C Spirits
properties.description:
Seventy Eight °C Spirits, Inc., is a micro distillery headquartered in Raleigh, N.C., notable for being the first legal distillery in Wake County. Founded by Donald McIntyre and Jared Sargent; both chemical industry veterans who aspired to establish a distillery that combined their scientific knowledge with their passion for craft spirits. Their objective is to implement a scientific approach in the manufacturing of craft spirits whenever possible. The boiling point of pure ethanol, 78°C, inspired the distillery's name.


The mission is to produce delicious spirits that are pleasing to the senses, using only the highest quality ingredients. The initial offering is a limoncello, which delivers a slightly sweet, fresh lemony taste. Jalapeño limoncello was introduced in Aug. 2015, introducing a unique flavor by incorporating a sweet lemony liquor with a dose of savory heat on the finish. A Blood Orangecello was released in Nov. 2015. Two new items were released in Aug. 2016, a pecan pie vodka, The Barn, and a Red Apple Vodka, AGG.

properties.name: Sneaky Penguin Brewing
properties.description: Sneaky Penguin Brewing is a small craft brewery in North Raleigh brewing a variety of styles on their 7bbl system that is visible from the taproom. The taproom is welcoming and open with a warehouse feel in a shopping plaza. There is also outdoor seating available.

properties.name: South Line Brewing
properties.description: South Line Brewing Company's goal is to fuse the art of fermentation with street art and live music. Located near downtown Cary, N.C.

properties.name: Southern Peak Brewery
properties.description: Southern Peak Brewery brings a neighborhood brewery and taproom to Apex. The seven-barrel brewhouse allows the freedom to continually experiment with new recipes and the neighborhood location is reminiscent of the original breweries that were located right in the heart of the community.

properties.name: Standard Beer and Food
properties.description: Standard is committed to providing our community with a unique beer and food experience.  Our comfortable family-friendly space will serve as a gathering spot to enjoy the company of your friends and neighbors. The synergy between beer, food, people and space is what Standard is all about.

properties.name: The Mason Jar Lager Company
properties.description: Focusing on lager beers, The Mason Jar Lager Company offers up four delicious brews year-round: Happy Place Helles, Virtue IPL, Small Town Bock and Stick Barn Schwarzbier. Plus, the Healing Waters Small Batch Series features a new beer every Sun.!

properties.name: The Mill
properties.description: The Mill is located in the historic district of Fuquay-Varina. They feature N.C. craft beer, premium wines, fair-trade and organic coffee seven days a week. The Mill's goal is to provide a unique space that will make them a destination, a gathering place and a cornerstone in Fuquay-Varina. Be Social, Drink Local.

properties.name: Triangle Beer Co.
properties.description: Triangle Beer Co. is a brewery and taproom in downtown Cary, N.C. offering multiple taps, outdoor and indoor seating and Crafty Concepts, a permanent mobile kitchen offering food and catering options.

properties.name: Trophy Brewing + Pizza
properties.description: Trophy Brewing Company is a three-barrel nano brewery in downtown Raleigh featuring a full bar and growlers to go. Their beer is something, often unique, and always tasty. The bar is comfortable and their staff is well versed in the way of zymurgy, small talk and making you feel at home.

properties.name: Trophy Brewing Co. + Taproom
properties.description: Trophy on Maywood is the next step of the evolution of Trophy Brewing Company. This 20bbl brewhouse, taproom and patio offers 12 rotating drafts of Trophy's finest beer, as well as food trucks, all within minutes of downtown.

properties.name: Vicious Fishes Taproom & Biergarten
properties.description: Vicious Fishes Taproom & Biergarten features VF's production brewery, a gorgeous taproom and expansive biergarten with fire pit and outdoor bar.

properties.name: Watts & Ward
properties.description: Watts & Ward craft cocktail bar was founded upon the underground spirit of 1920s America.
