When legislation such as the Watts act of 1903 and the Ward Law of 1905 set out to crush the free spirits of this state, over a decade before Prohibition, the clever and untamed citizens united in the subterranean. These establishments were alive with music, uproarious with life and bootleg spirits flowed like the streams that connect N.C. from the mountains to the sea. Nearly one hundred years later, Watts & Ward finds itself at the forefront of the battle to keep that culture alive as purveyors of an idea. Of an era. Of a lifestyle. Watts & Ward. Fighting the good fight for another hundred years to come.

properties.name: White Street Brewing Company
properties.description:
White Street Brewing Co., located in historic downtown Wake Forest, handcrafts flavorful, small-batch ales and lagers which you can enjoy in the taproom or at a multitude of local establishments.  Boasting a rock solid flagship team of brews, including a gold winning Kolsch-Style Ale, White Street Brewing Co. also crafts superb seasonal and special release brews; such as the Russian Imperial Stout, Koschei the Dealthless.


Photo credits: Will Haddock (WSBC)

properties.name: Wye Hill Kitchen & Brewing
properties.description: Come for the brews and stay for the brews at Wye Hill Kitchen & Brewing. Wye Hill offers craft brewed beers and chef-driven bar food with a bird's-eye view of downtown from atop Boylan Avenue.

properties.name: Big Al's BBQ
properties.description: Slow roasted. Wood fired. Award-winning Carolina Smokin' Hot BBQ deliciousness.

properties.name: De Plantas Latin Fusion
properties.description:
de plantas = from plants
100% PLANT-BASED FOOD TRUCK & LATIN-FUSION EXPERIENCE

Our mission statement is simple and straightforward. We aim to create a healthier and cleaner lifestyle without sacrificing taste. At de plantas, we strive to bring all the amazing flavors from a fusion of latin culinary cuisine to the Wake County.

Join us at 1601 Garner Station Blvd, Raleigh, NC 27603 near Cheer Extreme

properties.name: Aristotle Spirits
properties.description: Aristotle Spirits is Garner’s first legal distillery! North Carolina spirits rooted in history and science. Experience excellence in its finest form at Aristotle Spirits.

properties.name: Killjoy
properties.description: Killjoy is a colorful, comfortable cocktail bar where all drinks are treated with the same exquisite respect. Posh meets eccentric here with an envy-worthy playlist and a relaxing vibe in a place where your mixologist takes care in handcrafting each drink to your exact taste and preference. We invite you to sip a classic cocktail, choose a selection from our innovative, spirit-free menu, or ignite your inspiration by creating your own potion made from the highest quality ingredients. Every drink we create is treated with the utmost respect and it shows. From our kitchen, you’ll find small plates to enjoy from the culinary direction of Chef Jake Wood. Whether you’re shaking off a long day or kicking off a big night, you’ve come to the right place.

properties.name: The Ark Royal
properties.description:
The Ark Royal is a modern tiki lounge in downtown Raleigh that specializes in exotic spirits and cocktails. 


The Ark Royal was the name of Sir Walter Raleigh’s ship in 1586. Raleigh was an explorer, a ruthless conquerer and ultimately a pirate. Much of his later life was spent hunting for El Dorado, the fabled “City of Gold.”

Though he searched, theorized and struggled to find it, the poor bastard never found El Dorado and  was beheaded in 1618 by King James for antagonizing the Spanish.

Our lounge is not an ode to Sir Walter Raleigh, but it is an ode to exploration, adventure and discovery. Our exotic cocktails feature ingredients from many cultures from many regions around the world. This blend of spices, spirits, sweeteners and liqueurs offers fascinating insight into a whole world of history, tradition and flavor.

The style of cocktails we offer are known as TIKI drinks, but originally, they were known as exotic drinks, or as Don the Beachcomber called them; “Rhum Rhapsodies.”

TIKI is exploration. It is adventure. It is discovery. It is The Ark Royal.

properties.name: The Wine Feed
properties.description: TheWineFeed.com offers a selection of constantly changing, high-quality wines that are ready to drink. We offer free delivery locally, pick-up hours at our store in downtown Raleigh, and delivery by UPS.

properties.name: FRESH. Local Ice Cream - Raleigh
properties.description: FRESH gets their ingredients fresh every week from local dairy farms and produces the ice cream right in the store. Also look out for FRESH. The Truck around the Raleigh area.

properties.name: Amorino
properties.description: Amorino delights connoisseurs around the world with its finest quality gelato, which is made according to traditional Italian methods. The taste of each gelato is not only dependent on the most rigorous selection of sourced ingredients but also on the patience and the attentiveness of highly trained chefs during its preparation. Amorino insists on using only organic and natural products, paying particular attention origins of each ingredient and also by monitoring production methods. Enjoy Italian gelato at its finest. Macarons, chocolates, sweets, hot drinks and milkshakes also available.

properties.name: Pints Ice Cream & Beer
properties.description: We make all our ice cream in shop from scratch, which means we do not buy a bagged base and mix in our flavors. We purchase all our produce and dairy from local farms. Our dairy comes from Homeland Creamery in Julian NC, we also grow our own herbs. We have 10 rotating taps that include beers made right here in North Carolina. You can either enjoy an ice cream, a beer or be adventurous and try them together as a beer float!

properties.name: Adventures in Bloom - Metal-Stamping Workshop
properties.description:
In this hands-on workshop, you’ll learn the basics of stamping on metal to create personalized jewelry and accessories. Laura, your expert and host, will guide you through the process and show you all the necessary tools and materials to get started. You will have complete control over your piece, and by the end of class, Laura will help turn your masterpiece into a finished product to take home. There is also wide range of stamping options aside from jewelry, such as keychains, bookmarks, ornaments and more! 

$34/person includes a practice piece (Bonus keychain!) and a finished piece of whatever you choose – this can be a necklace, earrings, bookmark, bracelet, ornament – you name it! An “al-a-carte” menu is also available for those that decide they would like to make more than just one piece. Beads and charms can also be added for color and style.

We keep our price points accessible to all, keeping everything under $100 and most items under $20. Shopping local doesn’t have to be out of reach and handmade doesn’t just have to be for special occasions.

The workshop takes approximately 1.5 hours and is held in our Downtown Apex, NC studio. Travel workshops are also available, just ask! Feel free to bring beverages and snacks and enjoy a unique craft experience that even the non-crafty can enjoy.

properties.name: Blending Over Backwards - Olde Raleigh Distillery Tour
properties.description:
Olde Raleigh Distillery is a blend of old and new, just like its signature blended whiskey. Come take a behind-the-scenes tour with Brandon McCraney who has spent years immersing himself in the spirits industry to dissect the world of whiskey. As blender, he hand-selects and harvests each barrel to create distinct and flavorful small-batch spirits. As distiller, he oversees the creation of house-made heirloom bourbon using a process known as élevage to age and infuse a depth of flavors. 

There's a lot to see in this little distillery. Admire the beautiful and sustainable repurposed design of Olde Raleigh, from its handcrafted bar to its cocktail table whiskey barrels. Explore the barrel room and discover the way that everything from wood to weather can transform flavor. Enlighten your knowledge of spirits and learn the basics of distilling and the art of blending. And last, but certainly not least, end your tour with a taste of Olde Raleigh’s newest, unique blended batch.

Price starts at:
$34 per person for a tour and tasting
$107 per person for the customized barrel tasting experience
Minimum of 6 people for a private group, usually given on Saturdays at 1 pm

properties.name: Borrowing Something Sweet – Honey Tasting & Hive Tour
properties.description:
Come to the Stone Ridge Farm Market in Zebulon, NC for a scenic outdoors experience where you can taste a range of different local honeys, explore the construction of a beehive up close, and learn straight from some awesome local experts why beekeeping is such a fascinating and vital part of our lives.

Steve and Shannon Baxter are local beekeepers and business owners along with being just delightful and engaged people. They operate Baxter’s Bees, a family-owned business dedicated to saving the world by restoring the honeybee population 1 hive at a time.

Price starts at $75 for up to 6 people, $15 more per extra person.

properties.name: Brush the Skyline - Watercolors and Brews Workshop
properties.description:
Join Lauren Blackwell, Raleigh native and local artist, as she takes you to one of downtown’s favorite local breweries and scenic overlooks for a session in painting skylines. Relax, have a drink or some dinner from Wye Hill Kitchen & Brewing, and appreciate a gorgeous view of the city at sunset while Lauren guides you through a workshop on watercolor landscapes. All supplies will be provided and you will be able to take home a travel canvas of your own creation for the memory. Lauren loves teaching art for all skill levels so whether you paint regularly or have never held a brush, this experience is just the right blend of creative and fun. 

The workshop lasts for roughly 1 hour, but guests are encouraged to stay and patronize Wye Hill if they would like. Food and drink is a la carte and the workshop will take place outdoors so dress accordingly!

Price starts at $225 for up to 5 people, $45 for each additional person.

properties.name: Crochet Anywhere – Crocheting Workshop & Meetup
properties.description:
Did you know that you can crochet pretty much anywhere? It’s a wonderful exercise in creativity and mindfulness and all it takes is a single tool and some yarn which require almost no space. To prove that point, we’re creating a series of crocheting workshops in places all over the Raleigh area, from parks, to coffee houses, to clubs with some incredible local crochet artists.

Suzy is a lifelong crocheter. She’s been looping threads since a guest speaker in her 2nd grade class placed that glorious hook in her hand back in 2004. Since then, she hasn’t put it down – crocheting everything from mushroom-shaped bags to full blown outfits. Suzy believes that if you can crack the code to the fundamentals, you can crochet anything. And she wants to show you how!

Price starts at $100 for up to 5 people and includes each person receiving their own crochet hook and bundle of yarn to keep. $20 more for each additional person up to a maximum of 12 people. (Though we may be able to accommodate more with advance notice)

properties.name: Daniel Woody’s Foraging Adventure
properties.description:
Daniel Woody is a current student at North Carolina State University, majoring in parks, recreation and tourism management, hoping to specialize in foraging. He is offering walking tours of different parts of Raleigh, such as Lake Raleigh and downtown. While on the tour you will be learning how to forage, looking for different things you can use to spice up your dinners in an interesting way. Raleigh used to be home to many farms and different types of vegetation before World War II, and some of that vegetation is still here today, which is some of the things you will be looking for! This tour is available to guests of all ages and is recommended for families and groups of friends that are interested in a unique local experience. This tour will involve moderate physical activity consisting of walking distances up to two miles with hands-on activities. This tour will approximately last two hours, will start in select areas of Raleigh and is available mostly on weekends. 

Daniel Woody has lived in N.C. his whole life and grew up in the quiet town of Oxford. Growing up, he and his brothers explored the woods around his home in hopes of finding entertainment for themselves. As he explored those woods, he began finding things that he could bring home to his family to use for meals. Since then, his love for foraging has grown, and he even teaches his friends how to forage as well. He is looking to pass on this useful skill and knowledge to anyone interested in the Raleigh area.

Foraging experiences are $85 per person attending, with children under 12 being able to attend for free.

properties.name: Downtown Raleigh Coffee Stroll
properties.description:
Greg is an avid coffee lover and a frequent dweller of Raleigh’s proliferating local coffee shop scene. In this experience, he will meet his guests in the Moore Square area to begin an unscripted stroll around downtown walking in and out of his favorite coffee shops. On this tour, guests will learn some local history and colorful facts about the downtown Raleigh area while exploring a variety of different coffee drinks and roasts along with the downtown coffee culture. Regular stops on this stroll may include; A place at The Table, Videri Chocolatier, Raleigh Raw, Lucette Grace, Sir Walter Coffee, and 42 and Lawrence, but the tour will be customized to accommodate date, time, and the weather.

The tour takes between 1.5-2 hours and for the sake of comfort in the weather, mornings work best in summer and afternoons in winter.

Price starts at $200 for a tour of up to ten people and coffee tastes of different kinds are provided.

properties.name: Experience Urban Farming – Raleigh City Farm Tour
properties.description:
If you’re hankering for a farm tour, we would love to book a private tour of the farm for you. Visitors will be led by an experienced staff member or volunteer to explore all of the gardens, production areas, and buildings. Explore the clever and innovative ways that Raleigh City Farm uses a little bit of space to grow a lot of produce and make an even bigger impact.

These were the words that planted the seed we now recognize as Raleigh City Farm. From the birth of the urban community farm idea in 2010, to when it came time to dig Raleigh City Farm’s first rows in March 2012, the local community raised $25,000 in hand from initial donations and RCF broke ground and has never stopped growing. The project is now a decade old, has been well tended by countless volunteer and team members, and has been exploring community space, social enterprise, serving people, and learning about farming ever since!

Price starts at $50 per tour with a minimum of 6 people and a maximum of 24 people.

properties.name: Journey Through Sound – Live Music & Meditation Experience
properties.description:
Come visit Donøvan’s ranch, take a deep breath, and let your mind wander to some live music. The experience begins with delicious herbal tea and light breath work before moving to the sound journey taking place on a bass resonance table. The table is designed to let the music from the surrounding speakers vibrate directly through the surface itself, creating a multifaceted sensory experience that is delightfully easy to get lost in. 

Donøvan strives to adjust the experience to the participants needs and comforts. When playing music, he likes to pull from the emotions in a person’s life at the time and adjusts his style to encourage exploring both the challenging aspects of one’s life as well as remembering what relaxes us, surprises us, and brings us joy. At the end of the experience and throughout, he will explain some of his instrumentation, techniques, and equipment as a means of telling his own story and connecting people to an often unfamiliar craft.

1 on 1 journey starts at $50 Couples journey starts at $100 with cacao chocolate and tulsi tea included Group journeys start at $75 for up to 3 people with $25 per extra person Cacao is available upon request with all bookings for an additional $25. Live performance recordings are also available upon advance request for an additional $25.

properties.name: Stop and Taste the Flowers - Herbal Tea Workshop
properties.description:
Matthias is a true artist of tastes and smells and he founded JASPER & GOLD as the gift he wants to share with the world. He has spent years researching how to properly steep tea while extracting flavor from natural botanical ingredients to maximize flavor, nutrients, and quality. 

Begin your experience with a warm and delicious herbal infusion while you learn about the surprising depth of story and artistry that goes into selecting herbs for tea. Then try it yourself! Whether you want to feel like an herbal artist or a mad alchemist, pack your own infusion from a selection of beautiful dried herbs and ingredients. Finally, Matthias will lead a short session on how to utilize tea to practice mindfulness. Our lives are busy and loud; the ritual of drinking tea can be a great way to bring yourself back to the present and can be a healthy and enjoyable daily practice.

The workshop takes approximately 1 hour and can take place just about anywhere. Private workshops cost $100 for up to 6 people. $15 more per extra person.

properties.name: Sunset Paddle Trip on Falls Lake
properties.description:
Banks Dixon is the owner and operator of Frogs Hollow Outdoors, a paddlesports and adventure services outfitter, which has run trips throughout N.C. since 1998. Helping others have meaningful and positive experiences in the great outdoors is his passion. Banks has been guiding and instructing adventure and nature-based activities for over 25 years. 

We will meet at the water 45 minutes-to-an-hour prior to sunset to acquaint everyone with their boats and gear. Once we launch we'll have a leisurely paddle to a prime location to watch the sun as it drops below the horizon. As the final glints of sun have disappeared, we will begin our slightly circuitous return paddle. As the light fades we'll take in the sights and sounds of the water after dark on this relaxing and fun experience. Group can vary from two people to the maximum number of 10 people.

$42.50 per person for publicly scheduled paddle tours. Private booking price varies with group size, see below… 1 person – $280/person 2-3 people – $109/person 4-5 people – $78/person 6-9 people – $67/person 10-14 people – $56/person 15-19 people – $54/person 20-24 people – $50/person 25+ people – $45/person

properties.name: Triangle Treasure Hunt
properties.description:
Guests will embark on a thrilling scavenger hunt around either downtown Raleigh or Cary where they will search outside for clues, solve puzzles and crack codes to unlock the treasure chest and reveal the prize inside! The hunt will take guests to some of the most historical, artistic and unique locations around the area. After teams complete the scavenger hunt, Ben and Whitney will share the history and stories of the locations that guests visited along the journey. The entire experience will take between 90 and 120 minutes. The hunt will include walking from location to location for a total of about two miles. Guests may choose to travel at their own pace and will be in communication with their hunt guides at all times. A treasure map will guide you along the way, leading you to places to discover, clues to find, puzzles to solve and codes to crack. Let the adventure begin! 

Originally from Ohio, Ben and Whitney now work, play and live in Raleigh, N.C. Here Ben works at a local university helping to plan intramural sports and exciting activities around campus. He is also an avid runner and uses this as a way to explore the Raleigh area. Whitney works with special events in Raleigh and plays an important role in the festivals, races and attractions that frequent the city. In their spare time they both like to explore the city, in particular the growing craft brewery scene. The duo were traveling in Florence, Italy, roaming the streets following a hunt, and when they returned, they thought to bring a similar option to the Research Triangle Region.

Hunts are also offered at these locations: Warehouse District of downtown Raleigh, Cary.

Price starts at $20 per person for existing tours. For private group pricing…
Up to 10 people – $150
11-20 people – $250
21-30 people – $325
31-40 people – $400
41-50 people – $475

properties.name: Walking on Color – Street Art Walk
properties.description:
New to Raleigh or just visiting? Raleigh is a rapidly growing, ever-changing city. Many factors play into what's shifting, and that’s reflecting in its art scene. Have fun and get to know what's going on up close and personal!

The Warehouse District Art Walk starts at CAM at Martin and West Sts. and meanders through the district then up towards Nash Square. Along the way, you'll see colorful wall murals, street art and sculpture. You'll also be invited to interact with others and reflect upon how and why creativity leads to a rich and meaningful life.

Annelies and Greg's style is similar to a walking TED talk as they'll cover a wide variety of interesting topics and warm your heart. Their kindness, joy and established connections within the local art scene make it feel like you’re visiting with a good friend.

Take home happiness and a great appreciation for life with Annelies and Greg.

Annelies believes creativity matters. She’s an executive integrative life and leadership coach, speaker, author and artist with a masters in coaching and a knack for poking in a good way. To learn more about Annelies, check out her coaching website, www.conduitforchange.com, and art website, www.anneliesgentile.com. 

Greg believes life is richer when we communicate, cooperate and collaborate with one another and with the world around us. He's an award-winning facilitator and arts-educator teaching applied philosophy through music in corporations, congregations, communities and classrooms. You can find him online at www.drumforchange.com, in a hammock or perhaps behind a brew of one sort of another in locally-owned establishments throughout the city.

The price for this event is $25 per person with a minimum group size of 5 people.

properties.name: Boulted Bread
properties.description: Boulted Bread is a stone mill and bakery located in downtown Raleigh. They serve craft bread and pastries made with a variety of heirloom and locally sourced grains.

properties.name: Premier Cakes
properties.description: Premier Cakes is a full-scale bakery, specializing in made from scratch 9", three layer cakes, pies and international desserts and pastries. Up to 20 or more individual servings available daily.

properties.name: La Farm Bakery & Cafe
properties.description: Artisan bread bakery and European-style cafe, owned by Master Baker Lionel Vatinet. La Farm Bakery is a realization of a lifelong dream... a modern bakery that continues the centuries-old baking traditions and techniques, honoring the ordinary yet extraordinary boulangeries that once flourished in every little town in France. Taste La Farm's artisan breads, tarts, pastries, sandwiches and specialty products and experience the taste of hundreds of years of French cuisine.

properties.name: Adventure Landing
properties.description: A great place to play with three miniature golf courses, speedway go-karts, extreme laser tag, an interactive video arcade, batting cages and a full-service snack bar. Good for groups, birthday parties and fun for all ages. Convenient location, open daily.

properties.name: All In Adventures
properties.description: Located in the Triangle Town Center Mall, explore six unique escape rooms in Raleigh, N.C. with All in Adventures. From Treasure Island to our Black Ops escape room, each mystery offers something for everyone. With 50 minutes to complete the challenge, race the clock in our adrenaline-inducing adventures. Each room has two difficulty levels. You have the opportunity to challenge your problem-solving skills. Be the decoder, detective, or superhero you always wanted to be! Book your escape room in Raleigh today!

properties.name: Amaze Room Escapes
properties.description: At Amaze Room Escapes, you’re sure to enjoy a unique and challenging experience! We are a family owned and operated business located on Gresham Lake Road in Raleigh. We provide a mental and physical adventure in themed rooms where players use clues and strategy to solve a series of problems and riddles to accomplish their objective before time runs out. Escape rooms are a global sensation and can range in themes, intensity, and physical activity.

properties.name: Big Air Trampoline Park
properties.description: Big Air offers high-flying fun for the whole family where you can literally bounce off the walls! The best part, ALL attractions are included. Enjoy our 7 Rock Walls, Bull Riding, Ninja Courses, Dodgeball, Battlebeam, a 4-story Lil'Ninja Adventure Course, Main Court, Pit, Ropes Course, and more.

properties.name: Buffaloe Lanes South
properties.description:
Buffaloe Lanes South is one of three Buffaloe Lanes Family Entertainment Centers in the triangle.  Buffaloe Lanes Family Bowling Entertainment Centers, have been devoted to the community for more than 25 years. All Buffaloe Lanes Centers are alcohol free and are now smoke-free, family based facilities dedicated to family values, with a bright, clean, and friendly atmosphere.

NO. OF LANES: 32 
SCORING SYSTEM: Electronic 
AIR CONDITIONING: Yes 
PARKING CAPACITY: 200

properties.name: Cloer Family Vineyards
properties.description: A fun place to bring your whole family and enjoy the day strolling through the vineyards or having a picnic lunch with a bottle of wine. Wines currently available for tasting include Veranda, Riesling, Matador, Carlos, and Noble. Wine tastings: $5; tours are free. Hours: Fri., noon-5pm; Sat., 11am-5pm.

properties.name: Color Me Mine Cary
properties.description: Color Me Mine is a paint-it-yourself ceramic art studio! Come and experience the art of having fun!

properties.name: Crossroads Corn Maze
properties.description: Crossroads Corn Maze is the place where family, farm and fun meet! What better way to enjoy Fall than with a 5-acre corn maze, hay maze, fresh fall produce, games and more. We are centrally located in Northeast Wake County and only a few short miles from North Raleigh, Rolesville, Knightdale, Wendell and Wake Forest! We look forward to seeing you on the farm!

properties.name: DJ's Berry Patch and Farm Fresh Produce
properties.description:
DJ's Berry Patch is a pre-picked or pick-your-own Strawberry and Produce Farm. Our Raleigh area strawberry farm is conveniently located just minutes off Highway 64, right off Davis Drive in the town of Apex. DJ's also offers produce, pumpkins, mums and Christmas Trees.

DJ's is committed to providing our customers with the freshest and finest varieties of strawberries and other spring and summer produce. The fall brings pumpkins and mums. Our Christmas tree lot opens in late November.

properties.name: Flour Power Kids Cooking Studios
properties.description: All children love to explore the world around them through hands-on discovery. Add the ingredients of fun, energetic adults and the love for home cooked food, and you have stirred up the essence of a Lil' Chef. From preschool to teens, Flour Power Kids Cooking Studios sizzles up amazing programs such as Birthday Parties, Weekly Classes, Camps, Corporate Events and Kids Night Out.

properties.name: Flower Power Kids Cooking Studio
properties.description: Flour Power teaches Culinary Creators (that’s ALL of us, BTW!) to enjoy the sacred act of cooking and learn about food as a lifelong adventure. They want you to play with your food! Make a mess in Flower Power's studio kitchens through experimentation and simply having a good time.  They’ll even help you clean it up when you’re done.

properties.name: Frankie's Fun Park
properties.description:
Frankie's of Raleigh serves up great rides, great food and great times. Go-karts, miniature golf, bumper boats, amusement rides, laser tag, batting cages and an awesome arcade are part of the mega mix of fun! Frankie's has got it all. Sized up for little kids, big kids and those who still think they're kids.


With no admission fee, you pay as you play. Frankie's is open everyday and extra late so you can kiss your bedtime goodbye. See you soon at Frankie's... the Triangle area's premier place for FUN!

properties.name: Galaxy Fun Park
properties.description: Galaxy Fun Park is 60,000-square-feet of indoor family fun! Have a blast that is out of this world with trampolines, go-karts, laser tag, ropes course, spin zone, soft play, indoor black-light mini-golf, cafe and more.

properties.name: Game On Escapes & More
properties.description: Games On Escapes & More offers a great way to challenge your mind, take a break from cell phones, bond with family, friends, and co-workers, and just get a little extra outside the box thinking in your life.  Games On Escapes & More has four escape room games running at our Cary location. MacGregor Manor, Trapped in a Jungle, ​the Sorcerer's Mistake and the Rest Easy Motel.  Check out rooms below.  We hope to host your next adventure shortly.

properties.name: Granny Pearl's Farm
properties.description: Granny Pearl's Farm is a local farm that grows grapes, raspberries, blackberries, mushrooms and a variety of other fruits and vegetables. You can pick-you-own or they will pick them for you!

properties.name: Grasshopper Farms
properties.description: Located in Knightdale, N.C., and just a short drive from surrounding towns such as Wendell, Zebulon, Clayton, and Raleigh, N.C., Grasshopper Farms is a local agritourism farm with fun for the whole family! On the farm you'll find strawberry picking in the spring and summer, pumpkins and a 4-acre corn maze in the fall, Christmas trees and wreaths in the winter, a country store with fresh produce and made in NC products, as well as an ice cream and coffee shop open year-round. We even have a great assortment of plants, shrubs, perennials, and annuals at our plant nursery that are perfect for your gardening, landscaping, and porch decorating needs.  We host Maker's Markets and other special events, and have space to rent for birthday parties, etc.

properties.name: Haven Farm
properties.description:
Haven Farm is a family-owned wedding and event venue nestled on 40 acres in Knightdale, N.C. The property's white-washed, modern barn is surrounded by meadows and forest, making it the perfect venue for garden ceremonies, fun receptions and other social events. 

Located at 8521 Buffaloe Rd., Haven Farm also offers overnight stays at two of the property's renovated buildings, a petting zoo, a nature playground and the Haven Farm Shoppe. The shoppe is open from 10am-6pm Wed.-Sun. selling local gifts, goodies, plants and accessories, as well as foods, snacks and beverages. The zoo and playground are only open during shop hours.

properties.name: Jean's Neighborhood Market
properties.description:
Jean's Berry Patch is a pre-pick strawberry farm with other seasonal vegetables available that opens seasonally in April of each year.

Ragan and Holly's Pumpkin Patch is a seasonal farm at Jean's Berry Patch offering a large selection of gourds and pumpkins, plus corn stalks and other fall decorating items.

properties.name: Joy Worthy Co.
properties.description: Joy Worth offers creative workshops that nurture our sense of self worth through art, community gatherings and the study of emotional wellness.

properties.name: Ken's Korny Corn Maze
properties.description: Come get lost in Ken's six acre corn maze and over two and a half miles of paths! Family fun for all ages! Activities include a children's maze, rope maze, concessions, picnic area, photo opportunities, hay barn, corn crib, gourd checkers, monster truck and tractor, miniature golf, tether ball, hay rides and pumpkins. Open from mid-Sept. to mid-Nov. each year.

properties.name: Kings Dining & Entertainment
properties.description: From the start, Kings has focused on rekindling the fun and escape of bowling by creating a memorable entertainment experience, emphasizing good food, cold beer, creative cocktails and great music! Each Kings location features upscale, retro-inspired décor and executive-chef designed menus brought to life by “best-in-industry” service. With varied entertainment options, themed nights and state-of-the-art audio visual equipment, Kings sets itself apart as an unparalleled social scene for all occasions; be it a family outing, a date night hotspot, a corporate event or just to connect with friends. Enjoy 30,000 square feet of pure entertainment with 18 ten-pin bowling lanes, full-size billiards tables, 30+ arcade style games, award-winning food, private event space and over 50 giant HDTV's and HD projector screens.

properties.name: Little Doodles Play Cafe
properties.description: Little Doodles Play Cafe provides families in the Triangle Area with a safe space for creative play, fun events, and birthday parties. We feature a kid-friendly art studio, an indoor play space, and a Wi-Fi-enabled cafe area with seating for grown-ups.

properties.name: Medlin Farm
properties.description: Medlin Farm is a family-owned farm offering corn mazes, hay rides, gem mining and more through the end of October.

properties.name: Naylor Family Farm and Corn Maze
properties.description: Naylor Family Farm and Corn Maze offers a variety of outdoor fun a 10-acre giant corn maze, pumpkin patch, petting zoo, kids play area and more.

properties.name: Ninja Cow Farm
properties.description: Ninja Cow Farm is open by appointment only. The main product is beef and pork, but they also sell chicken whole and in cuts. They sell consumer-direct by the cut. This means you can buy a steak, sausage or hamburger as much or as little as you want. Ninja Cow Farm is a member of the N.C. Agritourism Networking Association and the Carolina Farming Stewardship Association.

properties.name: Page Farms
properties.description: Page Farms is a fourth generation family farm that offers strawberry picking in the spring, blackberry picking in the summer and pumpkin picking and corn maze in the fall.

properties.name: Partee Shack
properties.description:
ParTee Shack is Raleigh's ultimate indoor entertainment venue! Featuring three 18-hole indoor mini golf courses, virtual golf and multi-sport simulators, food, drinks and fun! Get ready for the craziest game of mini golf you have ever seen with unique obstacles at every hole including: a  zip-line, pinball machine, foosball table, and MORE!

You can also play a round of golf like the pros on one of our TruGolf simulators (coming soon). Play some of the most famous golf courses in the world or compete in virtual games such as soccer, baseball, football and arcade-style games including the popular zombie dodgeball.

In between rounds, we have your off-the-green needs covered. Visit our full service snack bar for a drink and bite to eat! ParTee Shack is the par-fect venue in the Triangle for your next corporate outing, birthday party, or special event.

properties.name: Phillips Farms of Cary
properties.description:
Phillips Farms is proud of its long history of family ownership and quality farm products serving central North Carolina for over 100 years. Lee Phillips, the current owner, purchased Phillips Farms from his grandfather's estate, William Busbee Ennis, in 1976. The farm's primary crops were straw, hay and tobacco. In 1996 Phillips Farms began a successful strawberry picking farm frequented by thousands of adults and their children every year. In response to public health concerns and changes in the market, Phillips Farms ceased farming tobacco products in 1998.

To this day, Phillips Farms continues farming hay, straw, corn and strawberry crops at various seasons throughout the year and sells Christmas trees every Dec. The farm's major attractions are the family Corn Maze and Haunted Farm. Thousands of families visit the farm for a healthy dose of family entertainment and a little scare, all in good fun.

properties.name: Pump It Up Inflatable Party Zone
properties.description: Kelly McHugh, Owner of Pump It Up of Raleigh, bought the franchise in 2009 with the desire to create an environment where families and friends could get together to celebrate, socialize and exercise for fun - stress free. Pump It Up of Raleigh  was voted best Kids Party Place by Carolina Parents & Nickelodeon's Parents Picks Awards Best Kids Party Place in the Triangle! The Triangle's premier PRIVATE party place for kids of all ages.

properties.name: Raleigh City Farm
properties.description: Raleigh City Farm is a nonprofit urban farm founded in 2011 on a formerly vacant one-acre lot in downtown Raleigh. Our mission is to grow the next generation of farmers by connecting our community to sustainable agriculture. Learn more here!

properties.name: Room 5280
properties.description: Room 5280 is a real life adventure game designed for groups of friends, families, co-workers and strangers. Find the hidden objects, figure out the clues and solve the puzzles to escape Room 5280. You have 60 minutes! Reservations required. Book today to see if you have what it takes to escape!

properties.name: Science Fun For Everyone
properties.description: Science Fun For Everyone (SFFE) is a team of passionate professionals with degrees in science and/or education, who have experience working with children in many different settings. SFFE is an organization that features fun, hands-on science involvements that are academically and age appropriate in many different settings... from Preschool ages all the way to older elementary activities. Visit website for a complete list of summer camps, track out camps, single day camps and more!

properties.name: Stars and Strikes
properties.description:
Stars and Strikes is a family entertainment center that offers bowling, bumper cars, laser tag and arcade for kids of all ages.

Corporate and team-building events are also available.

properties.name: The Family Farm on Avent Ferry
properties.description:
The Family Farm on Avent Ferry, located in Southwestern Wake County, has been in the same family for 6 generations.  In 2012, The Family Farm opened to the public during the Fall and Christmas season.  Their 75 year old traditional cow barn, 100+ year old log tobacco barn and 65 year old traditional tobacco barn create a unique setting.  

The Family Farm on Avent Ferry sells North Carolina grown pumpkins every Fall.  Be sure to visit for your decorating needs.  The Family Farm offers a variety of specialty pumpkins, gourds, corn stalks and hay bales.  Take some photographs on a vintage John Deere Tractor and let us take care of you like family.

properties.name: Times Up Escape Rooms
properties.description: Times Up Escape Rooms are exhilarating, interactive experiences designed to test the wits of the participants. Small groups are locked into a room and have 60 minutes to look for clues, solve puzzles and riddles, read ciphered messages and strategize within the group to escape the room. Whether or not you have beat the clock and escape the room, Times Up Escape Rooms offers an opportunity for team building events and a fun filled adventure for friends, families, co-workers, social groups or even complete strangers.

properties.name: Tractor's Corn Maze
properties.description: Tractor's Corn Maze is an eight-acre corn maze open late Sept. through the end of Oct. offering hay rides, free pumpkin with entry, pumpkin painting, corn pit and more!

properties.name: Treasure Quest Mining
properties.description: Treasure Quest Mining is an indoor gem mining experience and prehistoric gift shop located near downtown Apex.

properties.name: Urban Air Adventure Park
properties.description: Urban Air offers a full line-up of activities the entire family can enjoy. From wall-to-wall trampolines, dodgeball courts, and obstacle courses, to tube playgrounds with multi-level climbing ropes and twisting tubes, this adventure park offers a one-of-a-kind experience for enthusiastic adventurists and their pint-sized counterparts! Let 'em fly! Let 'em learn! Let 'em play!

properties.name: Urban Air Morrisville
properties.description:
Urban Air Morrisville offers an immersive indoor park experience, ideal for families seeking a day filled with thrilling activities and entertainment. Our array of attractions includes a ropes course, trampolines, 360 bumper cars, an indoor skydiving tunnel, a charming cafe,  and much more, ensuring an unforgettable adventure for all ages. Urban Air is the Raleigh area's only indoor skydiving facility.

Additionally, we feature a glamorous salon "Glamour Salon", perfect for hosting princess-themed birthday parties complete with glamour manicures, adding an extra touch of elegance and fun to any celebration.

properties.name: Wake Escape
properties.description: Wake Escape is Wake Forest's first escape room and provides entertaining challenge for those who love to solve puzzles and play games!

properties.name: Winterpast Farm
properties.description: A 10-acre animal and child sanctuary where humans can interact with animals and nature. A place to have a birthday party or a bonfire when you turn 50 (or five). A place Boy Scouts can launch a rocket or camp out and get fresh eggs from the barn in the morning. A place to scatter the ashes of your dead pet. A home that celebrates adoption with all adopted children visiting the farm for free. During your visit Farmer Mary can show you, your family or group the barn, introduce the animals, walk the land if you like and you can feed, pet and hold the animals.Please set up your visit to the farm in advance and don't just drop by. The best way to schedule a visit to Winterpast Farm is to check the posted open dates and hours, which are always updated on most blog posts on the website, Facebook posts at Winterpast Farm or posts at winterpast_farm on Instagram. Then text Farmer Mary at 919.244.1800.

properties.name: Bittersweet
properties.description: Bittersweet is a terribly wonderful dessert, coffee and cocktail lounge with an all-natural, seasonal menu. They are a place where you can get bourbon with your pie, champagne with your cake and Irish whiskey in your coffee. The menu changes each season, with drink and dessert pairing specials offered regularly. They also have a full coffee and espresso menu—everything from cappuccinos to pourovers—with beans from Counter Culture Coffee in Durham.

properties.name: Jubala Coffee
properties.description: Jubala Coffee is inspired by the customer experience. To the customer that wants to sip their espresso at the bar, or the customer that needs a space for a group business meeting, they value your experience. To the customer looking for a weekend breakfast spot for the family, or the customer wanting a drip coffee to take on the way to work, they value your experience. Jubala is driven by the quality of the experience, not just the product.

properties.name: 321 Coffee - Farmers Market
properties.description: 321 Coffee is a nonprofit coffee shop staffed by individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and operate at the NC State Farmers' Market. Our mission is to incorporate these individuals into the workplace in a meaningful way. Stop by, grab a latte, chat with the baristas, and join the 321 Coffee community.

properties.name: 41 North Coffee
properties.description:
Coffee, dessert, smoothies and a great atmosphere for reading alone or a night out with friends in downtown Wendell.
Photo via 41 North

properties.name: 42 & Lawrence
properties.description: 42 & Lawrence is an organic coffee bar and juice rail operated with a nod toward the community-oriented Italian espresso bar.

properties.name: Aversboro Coffee
properties.description: Aversboro Coffee is a independently owned and operated coffee house focused on providing friendly service, great coffee and a perfect place to connect, share experiences and relax with family and friends. They offer a variety of great-tasting hot, iced and frozen espresso-based beverages, smoothies and fresh-baked goods. They also carry many coffee alternatives such as chai latte, hot chocolate and assorted teas.

properties.name: BREW Coffee Bar
properties.description: Driven by community and focused on superior quality and excellent customer service, BREW is a perfect destination for a morning coffee or an evening cocktail.

properties.name: Black & White Coffee Roasters
properties.description: Black and White Coffee Roasters' mission is to bring exciting coffee to the people, while improving the quality of life for those who grow, harvest and process the coffee.

properties.name: Black & White Coffee at Videri Chocolate Factory
properties.description:
Located inside the Videri Chocolate Factory in downtown Raleigh, this cafe is our second location and not only has great coffee but great chocolate too! 

Our Raleigh cafe also has free parking which is hard to come by in DT Raleigh.

properties.name: Brus on Main
properties.description: Brus on Main is a quaint cafe serving New York coffee, treats as well as breakfast pizzas, grilled paninis and power bowls. Brus on Main aims to support and give back to their community.

properties.name: Bumble Tea
properties.description: Bumble Tea is the new place for boba, waffles, ice cream, and coffee. With our beautiful NC State inspired murals on the wall and our colorful drinks, it is clear what all the buzz is about. So, buzz on by and grab a treat.

properties.name: Carriage House Coffee
properties.description: At Carriage House Coffee, we believe a cup of coffee can change the world. Owners Skyeler and Tracy started Carriage House Coffee because they believed that spreading joy by serving the best gourmet coffee has a ripple effect. Our passion and our mission is to impact our community through partnering with local businesses and charities, while providing you with the best coffee experience.

properties.name: Common Grounds Coffee House
properties.description: Common Grounds Coffee is a cozy little coffeehouse in the renovated historic building The Promenade, across from the Fire Department in downtown Apex, N.C. Stop in for great coffees, teas, desserts, and gelato.

properties.name: Crema & More Cafe
properties.description: Crema offers gourmet coffee and ice cream, as well as homemade soups, freshly made salads and sandwiches!

properties.name: Crema Coffee & Bakery
properties.description: Whether it's green, roasted, brewed or extracted, Crema Coffee and Bakery is dedicated to providing you with premiere coffee and friendly customer service. All of coffees are roasted on site with the intended goal of redefine your coffee experience.

properties.name: Cultivate Coffee Roasters
properties.description: Cultivate Coffee Roastery is not just your neighborhood coffee shop it is our roastery location! You get to see into our roasting process, while drinking the freshest coffee around. With a modern industrial twist on a small town coffee shop vibe, when you are here you will feel at home with friendly baristas and local owners. Cultivate Coffee is excited to get to know you as you get to know us! Come have a cup of coffee with us.

properties.name: Cup A Joe
properties.description: A Raleigh Landmark Since 1991!

properties.name: DeJa Brew
properties.description: A locally owned, independent coffee house serving handcrafted, micro roasted coffees, locally baked bagels, muffins, breads and pastries.

properties.name: Drift Ridgewood Cafe
properties.description: Drift Ridgewood Cafe is a full service breakfast, brunch and lunch cafe served with first class coffee, cocktails and bubbly. Counter service and Mobile Ordering available for takeaway food and drinks.

properties.name: Esteamed Coffee
properties.description:
Esteamed Coffee is a non-profit coffee shop and cafe in downtown Cary, N.C. 

Our mission: create meaningful employment for people with intellectual/developmental, communication and visual differing abilities.

properties.name: Fount Coffee + Kitchen
properties.description: Fount Coffee + Kitchen is a specialty coffee bar located in the heart of Research Triangle Park celebrating craft, quality and community.

properties.name: Full Bloom Coffee and Craft Cafe
properties.description: Local micro-roaster in Garner who sources amazing coffee from around the world, roasts them in small batches and ships them fresh to you within days of roasting. Visit the Full Bloom cafe for traditional, authentically made coffee drinks from handcrafted roasted coffee beans, grilled panini sandwiches for breakfast and lunch, as well as local craft beer on tap.

properties.name: Global Village Organic Coffee
properties.description:
Global Village is Raleigh's home for Organic and Shade Grown Coffee.  Since 2000, Global Village has served the finest organic coffee and espresso, whole leaf organic teas, pastries and paninis.

Global Village offers a warm and inviting space for reading, conversation or just recharging the batteries before you jump back into your day.  Located across from NC State University so there are always a lot of smart, friendly people to meet from around the world.

properties.name: Idle Hour Coffee
properties.description: Idle Hour Coffee Roasters offers coffee, tea, baked goods and Vietnamese cuisine.

properties.name: Iris Coffee Lab
properties.description: Iris Coffee Lab is a coffee lab exploring natural flavors and close-knit community. They are Glenwood South's first specialty coffee shop and gluten-free eatery.

properties.name: Jubala Coffee
properties.description: Jubala Coffee is inspired by the customer experience. To the customer that wants to sip their espresso at the bar, or the customer that needs a space for a group business meeting, they value your experience. To the customer looking for a weekend breakfast spot for the family, or the customer wanting a drip coffee to take on the way to work, they value your experience. Jubala is driven by the quality of the experience, not just the product.

properties.name: Jubala Coffee - Hillsborough St.
properties.description: Located on the ground level of the Aloft Raleigh hotel, Jubala Coffee is inspired by the customer experience. To the customer that wants to sip their espresso at the bar, or the customer that needs a space for a group business meeting, they value your experience. To the customer looking for a weekend breakfast spot for the family, or the customer wanting a drip coffee to take on the way to work, they value your experience. Jubala is driven by the quality of the experience, not just the product.

properties.name: Jubala Coffee - North Hills
properties.description: Located in North Hills, Jubala is one of Raleigh's premier specialty coffee shop and cafe dedicated to crafting incomparable coffee beverages, serving flavorful comfort food, and fostering an excellent customer experience.

properties.name: Kiwi Cafe and Smoothies
properties.description: Kiwi is a café offering delicious gourmet paninis, wraps, salads, freshly squeezed, detox juices, mouth-watering smoothies, homemade soups, micro-batch roasted exotic coffees, breakfast sandwiches and in-house baked goods. They are gluten-free friendly and use environmentally friendly, compostable products. Kiwi supports local farmers.

properties.name: La Horchateria
properties.description: La Horchateria offers a variety of hispanic beverages from horchata to agua fresca, smoothies and coffee as well as baked goods like concha sandwiches, donut sandwiches, cupcakes waffles and more!

properties.name: Little Native Coffee Co.
properties.description:
At Little Native Coffee, we believe that coffee is more than just a drink, it's an opportunity to slow down. Pause. Recharge. Housed in a historic building at 426 S. Person St - this little space will never grow in size or get torn down. As the landscape around us rapidly changes and grows, we hope to stay rooted into the heart of the city - a little native space that reminds Raleigh of its roots.

We hope our intentional menu offerings - and design aesthetic - will not only fuel your work, discussions and mood, but it will inspire, empower and provoke a deeper purpose within them, too.

properties.name: Lucky Tree Gallery & Café
properties.description:
Lucky Tree Gallery & Café opened its doors in 2015 but it did not start there. Twin sisters Amanda and Ashley had dreamed of going into business together since childhood. The inspiration of Lucky Tree comes from their neighborhood treehouse. The décor is artistically put together using items that would have otherwise been discarded. Much like their childhood treehouse they hope that people within the community would consider it their own. 

Lucky Tree represents artwork and handmade items from more than 50 local artists, its coffee is roasted in Durham NC, and milk by NC State's Howling Cow.  The sister have been busy baking up delicious treats that you can feel good about eating. The menu is made using whole ingredients and is completely wheat free, with many of the items being vegan friendly. The sisters want to provide products and goods that they can stand behind.  Lucky Tree will likely keep evolving as a business and artistic expression.

properties.name: Milo's Cafe
properties.description:
Welcome to Milo’s Cafe, where Colombian and French Algerian cultures blend harmoniously over a shared love for coffee and delectable cuisine. Founded by a dynamic duo—she hailing from Colombia and him French/ Algerian—our journey began in the heart of Paris, where our paths crossed and our shared passion ignited.
Driven by our mutual love for quality coffee and exceptional food, we've embarked on a mission to bring a fresh concept to the charming town of Morrisville. As young parents to a vibrant one-year-old boy, we understand the importance of community and connection. That's why Milo’s Cafe isn't just a place to grab a cup of coffee or a bite to eat; it's a gathering spot where neighbors become friends and every visit feels like coming home.

Our vision goes beyond serving delicious food and beverages; we aim to create an identity for Morrisville—a place where diverse cultures come together, where stories are shared, and where memories are made. At Milo’s Cafe, you're not just a customer; you're part of our extended family. Join us in celebrating the richness of Colombian and French Algerian heritage while fostering a sense of belonging in our community.

properties.name: Mokka Cafe & Croissanterie
properties.description: Mokka Cafe and Croissanterie offers coffee and luxurious desserts.

properties.name: NCMA Café
properties.description: NCMA Café, in the West Building of the North Carolina Museum of Art, offers small bites and Southern inspired entrées. Chef Rick Sloan’s rotating culinary collection incorporates beef, seafood, poultry and vegan/gluten free selections.  The coffee lounge features barista-crafted beverages.

properties.name: New World Cafe
properties.description: New World Cafe features locally-roasted Counter Culture Coffee offering a full Manual Pour Coffee bar (such as Cone Drip and Chemex), traditional European-style espresso drinks, frozen coffee drinks, smoothies, hot and iced teas and loose leaf hot teas served with a french press. Breakfast sandwiches, healthy wraps, international sandwiches, salads, homemade cookies and brownies also available.

properties.name: Press Coffee, Crepes & Cocktails
properties.description:
At Press, we believe that simple ingredients become extraordinary when treated with integrity and care. 

That good food and drink are inspirational when our customers learn what makes an ingredient special or why things are done a certain way. That locally-sourced, quality food should be accessible to all and that exceptional coffee and cocktails, when prepared with skill and focus, create an inviting, educational experience.

We don’t think ‘hand-crafted’ and ‘high-quality’ should be code words for expensive. We know that small, local businesses that support other small, local businesses are essential to fostering a thriving and sustainable community. We wear our hearts on our sleeves a little bit. And we think that’s OK. Oh, we’re also kinda (really) obsessed with coffee, cocktails and crepes.

properties.name: Purr Cup Cafe
properties.description:
If you love cats and coffee as much as we do, this is the place for you.

Purr Cup Cafe's mission is to create a haven for cat-lovers to enjoy a quality beverage or locally made treat in the company of adoptable cats looking for love and forever homes.

properties.name: Right Meow Cat Cafe
properties.description: Half boba tea and coffee drinks. Half rescue cats. Right Meow Cat Cafe is a drink cafe with a mission to help rescue kitties find their furever homes. You can visit for drinks or book for cat sessions, whether for therapy or adoption. It all helps the cats. Booking online in advance is highly recommended and socks are required.

properties.name: Sir Walter Coffee
properties.description: Located on the street level of The Edison Lofts on E. Davie St. in downtown Raleigh. Sir Walter Coffee is a fun coffee barista bar that focuses on coffee, craft and comfort.

properties.name: Sir Walter Coffee + Kitchen
properties.description: Sir Walter Coffee + Kitchen is a creative coffee shop/cafe by day and full restaurant/bar at night.

properties.name: Sola Coffee Cafe
properties.description: Sola Coffee Cafe serves the finest coffees and teas, local craft beers, European wines, gourmet sandwiches, salads, neapolitan pizza, baked goods and "soon to be famous" hot mini donuts. A place for friends and family to connect over food and drink.

properties.name: Sonder Coffee
properties.description:
Sonder Coffee is a coffeehouse and restaurant located in Treelight Square in Wendell, N.C.

Sonder features hand-crafted specialty coffees made with homemade coffee syrups and beans from Raleigh Coffee Company. Sonder serves breakfast and lunch featuring open-faced sandwiches, paninis, fresh fruit smoothie bowls and more café-style food made with fresh ingredients.

properties.name: Stewart's Bistro
properties.description: Stewart’s Bistro is a specialty coffee, gourmet espresso and full breakfast (and lunch) coffee shop in Wake Forest. Fresh roasted coffee (purchased from a local roaster/Carrboro Coffee Roasters) is made especially for you to meet your specific taste. Quick and scrumptious breakfast selections, prepared by talented chefs, are served all day long.

properties.name: Summer Moon Coffee
properties.description:
Summer Moon Heritage is located in The Shoppes at Heritage Village. Summer Moon Coffee is the home of famed oak roasted coffee and legendary sweet cream. 

Founded in Texas Hill Country, Summer Moon aims to create a distinctive, out-of-this-world experience that people will go out of their way to enjoy. Summer Moon roasts every batch of coffee beans in hand-built brick roasters, over seasoned Texas oak. The time-honored process used today was inspired by 19th-century coffee masters. They match their devotion to taste with the creation of a cozy, family atmosphere, made possible by friendly baristas. Their signature "Moon Milk" sweet cream is one of their greatest attractions.

properties.name: Thanks A Latte
properties.description: Thanks A Latte is a unique destination for coffee and gifts! Enjoy locally produced Larry's Coffee and sweet treats from a local baker. Also find a gift for any occasion at Thanks A Latte!

properties.name: The Creative Cup
properties.description: The Creative Cup is downtown Zebulon's local coffee shop owned and operated local moms. Focused on community, Creative Cup is a cross between “Friends”& “Cheers”: A place where we want to know your name; where our couch is your couch. A place where old and young can gather around share stories and a great cup of coffee. In addition to coffee we will offer all kinds of classes and workshops.

properties.name: The Optimist
properties.description: The Optimist is your neighborhood coffee house and local haunt serving coffee, sandwiches, snacks and more. Specialty coffee is what we do best. Together with our amazing local partner Black&White roasters, and our team of consistent, creative and talented baristas, we strive to provide an inviting and satisfying experience with the best quality and care, and precision possible. We appreciate you so much for taking the time to come see us!

properties.name: The Third Place
properties.description:
Welcome to The Third Place, located at 1811 Glenwood Avenue in the Five Points area of Raleigh - a cozy and eclectic coffeehouse.  Enjoy coffee, breakfast, sandwiches, vegetarian fare and yummy desserts surrounded by rich red Oriental rugs, warmly hued walls and exotic glass lanterns suspended from the antique tin ceiling.  A full menu, with many items made right in the shop, is available from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m.


The name, The Third Place, comes from the book written by Ray Oldenburg in which he celebrates the "third places" in our lives - after home and work, these are the places where people can relax in good company on a regular basis.  We invite you to make us your "third place!"

properties.name: Thousand Hills Coffee
properties.description: LTH Coffee & Social at NOVEL Morrisville is a place where connection becomes effortless through the shared value of balancing work and play. This is the place to gather with friends, families, and co-workers morning, noon, and night—from taking a quiet moment to start the day together over cups of specialty coffee to swapping stories over pints of local beer fresh from the tap in the evening.

properties.name: Wake Forest Coffee Company
properties.description: Wake Forest Coffee Company's mission is to encourage friendships for the betterment of the community through the crafting and consumption of delicious beverages.

properties.name: James B. Hunt Jr. Library (North Carolina State University)
properties.description: Designed to be a major competitive advantage for the university, the Hunt Library is a signature building that both enables and reflects N.C. State’s vision as a preeminent technological research university recognized for its innovative education and research addressing the grand challenges of society. Its bold design is a visual statement of its bold purpose: to be a place not of the past but of the future, a place where our students, faculty and partners can gather to research, learn, experiment, collaborate and strengthen N.C. State’s long tradition of leading transformative change.

properties.name: AMC Dine-In Holly Springs 9
properties.description: Ovation Cinema Grill offers a dining experience unlike any other. The extensive restaurant menu, full bar and seat-side service produce a truly unique combination of exceptional dining, service and movies. Enjoy a great meal and Hollywood's latest blockbuster, all from the comfort of luxury theater seating. Dinner with your movie? This might just be the entertainment ticket you've been looking for!

properties.name: African American Cultural Celebration
properties.description: The African American Cultural Celebration is the statewide kickoff to Black History Month at the North Carolina Museum of History in downtown Raleigh. Named a Top 20 Event by the Southeast Tourism Society since 2015, the 19th Annual African American Cultural Celebration will feature musicians, storytellers, dancers, chefs, historians, playwrights, authors, artists, reenactors, and more.

properties.name: Alice Aycock Poe Center for Health Education
properties.description: Poe Center for Health Education is a nonprofit organization dedicated to educate and empower NC children, youth and their families to make choices that increase positive health behaviors. The Poe Center is available to rent, provide meeting space and field trips for schools, teams, and other organizations.

properties.name: American Indian Heritage Celebration
properties.description: Held in January.Musicians, dancers, artists, storytellers, and authors from North Carolina’s eight state-recognized tribes gather for this popular family event. Named a Top 20 Event by the Southeast Tourism Society, the American Indian Heritage Celebration offers something for all ages and gives a firsthand opportunity to learn about the state’s American Indian culture (with a population of over 120,000), past and present. Activities include craft demonstrations, hands-on activities, games, foods, and much more.

properties.name: Artsplosure
properties.description:
Since its first festival in April 1980, Artsplosure has presented scores of outdoor programs and large-scale festivals featuring thousands of established and emerging visual, performing, and interdisciplinary artists in numerous traditional and non-traditional indoor venues and outdoor settings.

Artsplosure was initially organized in 1978 by the Raleigh Arts Commission to produce high quality and accessible arts festivals, and to serve as an umbrella organization for emerging and established arts groups seeking to reach wider audiences. The first event was remarkable: a citywide arts festival that combined an “explosion” of art activity with people’s “exposure” to all types of art. This month-long celebration of the arts featured 58 different performing groups and presented 560 artists in 16 sites around the city.

properties.name: Boylan Heights ArtWalk
properties.description: The Boylan Heights ArtWalk is a great way to start the holiday season and is always a popular event. Over one hundred artists and craftspeople sell a wide range of glasswork, jewelry, metalwork, woodwork, fiber, clay work and ceramics, photography and prints, multimedia, painting  and other art from the neighborhood’s porches, yards, and sidewalks. Spend the day and check out what our local art scene has to offer. Admission is free. Food will be available for purchase from the Boylan Neighborhood Association.

properties.name: Brewgaloo
properties.description:
Brewgaloo is a two-day festival featuring over 110 craft breweries from around North Carolina and partnering with local food trucks, local vendors and local bands to bring you N.C.’s largest craft beer festival!

The fun begins Friday night with a sampler event from 6-10pm featuring limited releases, barrel aged and sour beers. Friday night’s block party is the perfect start to the weekend and a great way to get a taste of Brewgaloo in a compact footprint.

Saturday’s street festival spans the length of Fayetteville St. and fills downtown Raleigh with more than 110 N.C. craft breweries, local food trucks and local vendors. With two stages of live music and a DJ on the courthouse steps, this lively festival is sure to be a good time.

properties.name: Cameron Village Underground
properties.description:
Originally known as The Village Subway, this was an underground entertainment district located beneath the Cameron Village shopping area. Operating throughout the 1970s and 1980s, the Underground offered nightclubs, restaurants and retail options for patrons. 

The Underground was closed in 1984 due to safety concerns; however, there are current plans to reopen the space in the future.

properties.name: CaribMask Caribbean Carnival
properties.description: CaribMask Caribbean Carnival is a yearly celebration of Caribbean culture and cuisine that begins with vibrant carnival masqueraders marching through Fayetteville St. into the CaribMask Festival Village which houses Caribbean food vendors as well as arts and crafts markets, live performers from the Caribbean and the CaribMask Kid's Corner.

properties.name: Carolina Hurricanes
properties.description: The NHL's Carolina Hurricanes play at Lenovo Center, October-April. For ticket information, call 866.NHL.CANES or visit CarolinaHurricanes.com/tickets. For general information, visit website.

properties.name: Carolina Mudcats
properties.description: MiLB’s Carolina Mudcats are the Class-A affiliate of the Milwaukee Brewers and a proud Wake County staple since 1991. Come out to the ballpark and enjoy America’s pastime, April through September; visit website for tickets and schedule information. Play ball and #GoMudcats!

properties.name: Carolina Roller Derby
properties.description: Carolina Roller Derby are a founding member of the Women’s Flat-Track Derby Association. An active member of the community since 2004, Carolina Roller Derby takes part in charitable outreach programs and local events. See them compete at XL Sports World, in Apex.

properties.name: Cary Heritage Museum
properties.description: Housed in a restored 1868 railroad hotel, the Page-Walker Arts & History Center offers visitors insights into the local history in the Cary Heritage Museum. Visit website for a list of current exhibitions and activities. Free admission. Group tours by reservation only. Hours: Mon.-Thurs., 10am -9:30pm; Fri., 10am-5pm; Sat., 10am-1pm. Please call to verify access to galleries and museum, as they are Mordecai Historic Park multipurpose spaces.

properties.name: City Brew Tours - Raleigh
properties.description: City Brew Tours - Raleigh is the most exciting way to experience all the best craft beer the City of Oaks has to offer! Join them for an all-inclusive behind the scenes tour of Raleigh's best breweries - featuring up to 16 different beers, a beer-paired meal, and round-trip transportation!

properties.name: City of Raleigh Museum (COR Museum)
properties.description: Featuring exhibits that change periodically and focus on the history of the city, the museum is housed in the 1874 Briggs Building, which retains many of its original features, including the tin ceiling in the museum gallery. Free admission; a recommended donation of $5 for adults can be placed in the donation box in the gift shop. Group tours available with advance notice. Hours: Tues.-Sat., 9am-4pm; Sun., 1-4pm.

properties.name: Crabtree Valley Mall
properties.description: Crabtree Valley Mall is Raleigh's premier shopping mall with a unique mix of over 220 stores including Michael Kors, Lego, H&M, Pottery Barn, Coach, Apple, The North Face, Forever 21, Tommy Bahama, Altar'd State, Think Geek, The Disney Store and Build A Bear. Remember to visit one of the exclusive restaurants including The Cheesecake Factory, PF Chang's, Kanki Japanese House of Steaks and Sushi, McCormick & Schmick's Seafood & Steaks, Torii By Kanki, Crabtree Beer Garden, Brio Tuscan Grille and Fleming's Prime Steakhouse and Wine Bar. Valet parking is available. Call for additional information.

properties.name: Downtown Raleigh First Friday
properties.description: First Friday, presented by the Downtown Raleigh Alliance, showcases the vibrant art and creative community in Downtown Raleigh on the first Friday of every month from 6-9pm. The free public event features a variety of local art galleries and studios, museums and exhibitors that stay open late, put on special events and often offer refreshments. Retailers and restaurants participate by showcasing art, music or offering a First Friday special

properties.name: Glenwood South
properties.description: Raleigh’s trendiest district, burgeoning with an eclectic mix of restaurants, shopping and spirited nightlife, this area attracts hipsters of all ages. Live music spills out of bars and clubs, giving Glenwood Ave. a soundtrack all its own. Don’t miss: the district’s two hotels, for sleeping it off.

properties.name: Got to Be NC Festival
properties.description: Got to Be NC Festival highlights all the great things from North Carolina. Festival goers can enjoy carnival games and rides, live music, food, animal and agricultural displays, antique tractors, and more. Most of the festival is free with the following exceptions: $3 admission charge for the Food Lion Local Goodness Marketplace; and costs for rides, games and food. Free events include the concerts on the outdoor stage, antique tractors and parades, commercial exhibits in the Graham Building, racing pigs, grandstand shows and more.

properties.name: Gregg Museum of Art & Design
properties.description: With a permanent collection of 35,000+ objects available for research and enjoyment (including textiles, ceramics, photography and Native American/tribal art) and an ongoing series of exhibitions and programs, this is one of the Southeast's cultural treasures.

properties.name: Harris Energy & Environmental Center
properties.description:
Located about two miles from the Harris Nuclear Plant and 22 miles south of Raleigh, the center features exhibits and films on electricity and nuclear energy for middle school students and up.
Hours: by appointment only on weekdays during regular business hours.

properties.name: Historic Glenwood-Brooklyn
properties.description: Glenwood-Brooklyn occupies the blocks along both sides of the segment of Glenwood Avenue between Peace Street and Wade Avenue. The neighborhood marked the beginning of the suburbanization of land north of Raleigh’s city limits, which ended at Johnson Street from 1857 to 1907.  While most residents were government employees, small business owners, salespeople, or railroad employees, a few white-collar workers also chose to live in Glenwood-Brooklyn, generally in more substantial and stylish houses. Cameron Park and Boylan Heights developed around the same time as Glenwood-Brooklyn, each aimed at a different set of customers. The dominant architectural styles in the neighborhood include Queen Anne, Colonial Revival, Craftsman, and transitional styles that incorporated elements of Colonial Revival with Queen Anne or Craftsman.

properties.name: Historic Oakwood Candlelight Tour
properties.description:
There's a feeling of a small town community right in the middle of downtown Raleigh. Historic Oakwood is a community of homes most of which are dated from the mid-1800s to the early 1900s. There's a continuing effort to preserve the Victorian, Queen Anne and Craftsman architectural styles of these homes from a century ago. The immaculate care of the exterior of a home is only a prelude to the beauty and attention to detail given to the interiors.
Your annual opportunity to tour the interior of some of these homes happens each December during the Historic Oakwood Candlelight Tour®. Homes are staffed with docents to enlighten you on the rich history of each property. Tour the properties at your own pace in any order.

properties.name: Historic Raleigh Trolley Tours
properties.description:
Enjoy a narrated tour of downtown Raleigh aboard the Raleigh Trolley. Trolley tours offered each Saturday in March through December, with the exceptions of Christmas Day and New Year’s Day.

Hour-long Saturday tours begin and end at Mordecai Historic Park at 11 a.m., 12 p.m., 1 p.m., and 2 p.m. Please arrive early to purchase or obtain tickets and meet the trolley on time.

Bookings for each Saturday begin on Tuesday of the week. Tickets may be purchased by phone or in person at the Mordecai Historic Park Visitor Center, 1101 Wake Forest Road, Raleigh, 27604. Pay by cash, credit card (American Express, Mastercard, or Visa) or by check to the City of Raleigh.

Admission: $10 adults, $6 youth (7-17), and free for children (6 years and under).

properties.name: Holiday Express
properties.description: Holiday Express, hosted by City of Raleigh Parks, Recreation and Cultural Resources Department, is a yearly festival within Pullen Park that transforms the park into a holiday wonderland. Families can enjoy holiday lights and displays, a holiday train ride, local entertainment, carousel ride, crafts and a visit with Santa.

properties.name: Holly Springs Salamanders
properties.description: The Holly Springs Salamanders, part of the Coastal Plain League, is a Collegiate Summer Baseball league that plays at Ting Park in Holly Springs.

properties.name: Hopscotch Music Festival
properties.description:
Hopscotch Music Festival, called "America's (Secretly) Best Festival" and "the premiere experimental and underground festival in America", features more than 130 bands over 3 days in venues throughout downtown Raleigh.

Hopscotch is known for adventurous lineups, memorable performances, and a fan-friendly atmosphere. From a large outdoor main stage in Raleigh City Plaza to intimate club shows, the festival offers music in almost every genre imaginable—rock, hip-hop, metal, folk, electronic, experimental, and more—and its programming highlights this diversity each year.

From its inception in 2010, Hopscotch has been a signature event for the creative community of Raleigh, North Carolina. Approximately 25% of the festival’s performers hail from in-state—a figure few, if any, nationally recognized music festivals can claim. With official programming stretching across 12 walkable venues, Hopscotch is a city-wide celebration for locals and fans visiting from faraway locales.

properties.name: Hot Air Marketing
properties.description: A hot air balloon ride in the Raleigh, N.C. area is a one of the most beautiful adventures anyone can experience. Hot Air Marketing is glad to help you find the right hot air balloon ride to fit your goals and expectations. While Hot Air Marketing is primarily focused on corporate, public relations and community relations oriented hot air ballooning, they do offer some private balloon rides for passengers. After all, Hot Air Marketing is first and foremost ambassadors for hot air ballooning. Visit website for more details and to inquire about your hot air balloon flight.

properties.name: IBMA Bluegrass Live! powered by PNC
properties.description: IBMA Bluegrass Live! powered by PNC is a two-day festival that sets up eight stages of free music, a dance tent, a barbecue championship, tons of art vendors and more in downtown Raleigh. The Main Stage at Red Hat Amphitheater is free (Limited preferred reserved seating is available for purchase in sections 1-3 of the amphitheater)!

properties.name: James B. Hunt Jr. Library (North Carolina State University)
properties.description: Designed to be a major competitive advantage for the university, the Hunt Library is a signature building that both enables and reflects N.C. State’s vision as a preeminent technological research university recognized for its innovative education and research addressing the grand challenges of society. Its bold design is a visual statement of its bold purpose: to be a place not of the past but of the future, a place where our students, faculty and partners can gather to research, learn, experiment, collaborate and strengthen N.C. State’s long tradition of leading transformative change.

properties.name: Jordan Lake Guided Pontoon Boat Tours
properties.description: Sit back and enjoy a guided pontoon boat tour of beautiful Jordan Lake! Enjoy the large 14-passenger pontoon with adequate shade. Jordan Lake Tours is the original tour company in the Triangle. Capt. Dave will navigate the waters where you will see bald eagle, heron, finches and other wildlife abound - so bring a camera! Entering our fifth season, tours run seven days a week from sunrise to sunset. Book your tour online.

properties.name: Kirby Derby
properties.description:
