properties.description: The first Cabela's in N.C., this 105,000-square-foot Garner store is located near the intersection of I-40 and U.S. Hwy. 70. The Garner store boasts rustic log construction, stonework, a mountain replica, an aquarium, an indoor archery test area, dozens of museum-quality wildlife displays, a Gun Library and a Bargain Cave. The Garner Cabela's also features a boat shop, perfect for those trips to the Outer Banks! If shopping the wide selection of outdoor equipment works up your appetite, stop by the in-store deli for a hearty wild-game sandwich, then grab dessert in the Fudge Shop where the fudge is made fresh daily! Cabela's also offers a Conference Room available to be rented out for small meetings or events.

properties.name: Cameron Clothing
properties.description: Cameron Clothing Co. is a beautifully appointed ladies specialty store offering an extensive sportswear collection, accessories and gifts. Our combined 35+ years of experience in women's specialty merchandising and our commitment to our customers has laid a good foundation for our business. Cameron Clothing now brings expanded lines including daytime dresses, special occasion, and mother-of-the-bride attire.

properties.name: Capital Plaza
properties.description: Located along Capital Blvd., just north of Raleigh, Capital Plaza is a 300,000+ square foot retail shopping area anchored by Target, Home Deport, Staples and PetSmart.

properties.name: Capitol Comics of Raleigh
properties.description: Capitol Comics is your one stop comics shop for all your funny book needs.

properties.name: Carpenter Wine Cellar
properties.description: Carpenter Wine Cellar is a locally owned, neighborhood wine + beer shop with an inviting taproom pouring cold beer + great wine.

properties.name: Cary Downtown Farmers Market
properties.description: The market’s mission is to be a cozy place for people to shop for goods they can feel great about, and to build bonds between Cary residents and their local farmers, which will ultimately strengthen the area’s sense of community. The market is a growers-only market, with only handcrafted goods for sale, no re-selling is allowed. The market features items grown or crafted by the vendors, who have traveled less than a 100-mile radius of downtown Cary. The market is always open, rain or shine, Apr.-Nov.

properties.name: Cary Quilting Company
properties.description: Cary Quilting Company is a female-owned quilt supplies shop based in beautiful Cary, NC. They offer thousands of quilting cottons, notions, patterns, and amazing classes as well as professional longarm quilting services and binding services. In May of 2017, Cary Quilting Company expanded the shop from their original historic home in downtown Cary to a larger space full of natural light at Northwoods Market on Harrison Avenue in Cary. In April of 2018, they grew the shop to include a large Meeting Center and dedicated Longarm Quilting room.

properties.name: Cellar 55
properties.description: Cellar 55 is a fine wine and craft beer store that allows customers to explore, taste, learn about and enjoy the world of premium wine and beer. Their mission is to provide advice and education so that all can understand and enjoy what they are drinking at all price points. Cellar 55 offers a tasting room utilizing self- serve technology to try and enjoy featured wine and beer and regular classes and events featuring experts, importers and brewers. Visit Cellar 55 at the Fuquay Crossing Shopping Center.

properties.name: Channy Bride and Beyond
properties.description: Channy Bride and Beyond was created with the mission to help every woman look and feel beautiful on their special day. Channy offers wedding dresses, prom dresses and formal wear.

properties.name: Charlotte's Inc. - North Hills
properties.description: From simple $29 earrings to designer 18k and diamond rings, Charlotte’s has something for everyone. Charlotte’s customers are on the cutting edge of fashion, gifts and home accessories. The expanded gift department has the latest for babies and toddlers plus perfect ideas for teenagers.

properties.name: Charlotte's Inc. - Village District
properties.description: From simple $10 earrings to designer sterling, Charlotte's has something for everyone. Known especially for its sterling silver, Charlotte's exclusive line of designer silver has made this shop a destination. The majority of Charlotte's jewelry can be engraved, by machine or by hand, helping customers create an heirloom.

properties.name: Chatham Street Wine Market
properties.description: Chatham Street Wine Market is a boutique wine shop and tasting bar located in the heart of downtown Cary. They sell wines from all over the world, with a focus on smaller production, family-owned wines that are also great values. Customers are able to enjoy a glass of wine at the tasting bar and they host regular, free wine tastings every Thursday from 5-7pm.

properties.name: Cheshire Cat Antique Gallery
properties.description: Cheshire Cat Antique Gallery is a multi-dealer antique mall with 20,000 square feet of underground shopping delight. They have over 100 dealers who carry: mid-century furniture, Asian designs, collectibles, art, sterling, fine jewelry, costume jewelry, lighting, interior decorating, and much more. They also offer restoration and repair for porcelain, glass, jewelry, watches, lamps, and silver. Their experts can provide appraisal service for divorce, estate, taxes, and more.

properties.name: Christian Science Reading Room
properties.description: More than a bookstore, The Christian Science Reading Room is a community space to read, study the Bible and Christian Science literature, and pray. Stop on by and ask us questions, research prayer and healing, purchase Bibles, Science and Health, as well as other works by Mary Baker Eddy, Christian Science publications, and music. The Christian Science Reading Room is located in downtown Raleigh at 201 Fayetteville Street, at the corner of Hargett & Fayetteville Streets.

properties.name: City Garden Design
properties.description: Garden and gifts in the heart of downtown Cary; plant workshops, interior and exterior plant design.

properties.name: City Market
properties.description: Experience historic City Market, home to art galleries, restaurants and specialty shops. The original cobblestone streets are lit by lamps and filled with 19th-century charm. Individual business hours vary.

properties.name: City of Raleigh Museum (COR Museum) Store
properties.description: The City of Raleigh Museum Store features a selection of unique Raleigh gift items along with a wonderful selection of local artisans. From postcards and refrigerator magnets, to T-shirts, coffee mugs and local history books, make the Museum Store your destination for Raleigh-related items. The COR Museum also has a library of thousands of images, all of which are available as historic reprints.

properties.name: Classic Clothiers
properties.description: Classic Clothiers is one of the premier consignment shops for high end ladies fashion and accessories. Serving the Cary area for over twenty-five years. Consignors accepted by appointment only.

properties.name: Club Champion Golf
properties.description: Club Champion is the perfect experience for golf lovers: enjoy a Tour-level custom golf club fitting with Master Fitters and over 35,000 hittable head and shaft combinations. Whether you're fitted for a single club or the full bag, Club Champion is the nation's #1 option for better fits and lower scores.

properties.name: Cocoon Gallery
properties.description: Cocoon Gallery offers a collection of functional artworks, locally imagined and locally created by 60+ master artisans. Wares and wearables for gifts or for yourself.

properties.name: Comic World
properties.description: Comic World is a family friendly comic book store in the heart of Zebulon offering new and vintage comic books for all ages. Trade-ins are welcome.

properties.name: Conte's Bike Shop - Cary
properties.description:
Conte's Bike Shop is proud to have been selected as a 10-time winner of the coveted “Top 100 Best Bicycle Retailers” in the country designation awarded by the National Bicycle Dealers Association. Working with the top suppliers in the industry and the industry’s leading trade publication, Bicycle Retailer and Industry News, criteria used to pick the winners included market share, community outreach and store appearance. “There are more than 5,200 bicycle retailers in the United States,” said Thomas Prehn, president of the research company. “For Conte's Bike Shop to achieve the status of one of the Top 100 Bicycle Retailers in the nation is no small matter. This bike shop stands as the best of the best,” he said.

Conte’s Bike Shop has been selected by Tidewater Women Magazine as the recipient of the Ladies Choice Award in the Bike Shops category. This distinction followed the Company’s designation as “Retailer of the Year” by the Retail Alliance. In 2016, Bicycle Retailer and Industry News selected Conte’s as one of only 6 Award nominees for National Bicycle Retailer of the Year.

properties.name: Conte's Bike Shop - Ridgewood
properties.description:
All Star Bike Shop has serviced the Raleigh-RTP bicycling community since 1978 and have received the "Best in the Triangle" Award several years running. All Star supports and promotes local cycling, racing and the N.C. State Games. Stop in one of their friendly shops for the latest trail and ride information, or browse the excellent selection of everything bicycles!


With three convenient locations, they offer an exceptional bike shop experience. Working with the top cycling manufacturers like Giant, Specialized and others, gives customers the advantage of selection and quality! All Star Bike Shops carry a full line of Road, Mountain, Tandem, BMX and custom bikes. They also offer the best accessories from Shimano, Campy, Yakima, Mavic, Thule, Bell Sports, Bianchi and more!

properties.name: Copper Penny Boutique
properties.description: Copper Penny collections are curated with a Southern eye—aimed at capturing the effortless beauty that embodies a unique cosmopolitan style. Find everything you may need to compose a distinctive wardrobe—designer clothing, footwear, jewelry and accessories—selected expressly for you by an expertly trained staff.

properties.name: Copperline Plant Co.
properties.description: Copperline Plant Company is Raleigh's home for houseplants, offering a wide selection of plants, pots, and accessories. Whether you're a seasoned plant parent or just starting out, our knowledgeable staff can help you find the perfect plants for your home. We also offer plant care classes and consultations to help you keep your plants healthy and thriving.

properties.name: Craft Habit
properties.description: Craft, Love, Repeat. That’s our mantra and we know it’s yours. You love making things, you love color and texture and shapes. You get jazzed about a new tool, or a new material, or an old technique made modern. You sew, you cut, you bead, you fold, you make. We are your people. Come join us as we craft, love and repeat.

properties.name: Crafty Beer Shop
properties.description: Crafty Beer Shop carries the best of national and international craft beer, while keeping a focus on the N.C. beer offerings. They have eight different beers on tap at all times, rotating stock and access to the best beers in N.C. and the world. All beer is sold by the bottle so you can feel free to choose what YOU want. With a relaxing coffee shop vibe, offering free wifi and an inviting and comfortable beer bar to go along with a neighborhood feel, Crafty is a great spot to go after work or to finish your work, meet friends, watch a game, have a meeting, hang out on the weekend or for a night out. Come try some craft beers on the eight taps, grab your favorites in a custom made six pack to take home or have a glass of wine from the rotating wine offerings (not everyone loves craft beer as much as Crafty does!) Crafty Beer Shop also strives to support the local community – offering local snack items, displaying local artists work and often featuring local musicians. Crafty caters to the newbie to the craft beer scene as well as craft beer veterans. Come and experience the Craft!

properties.name: Crafty Beer Shop - Lafayette Village
properties.description: Crafty Beer Shop carries the best of national and international craft beer, while keeping a focus on the N.C. beer offerings. They have eight different beers on tap at all times, rotating stock and access to the best beers in N.C. and the world. All beer is sold by the bottle so you can feel free to choose what YOU want. With a relaxing coffee shop vibe, offering free wifi and an inviting and comfortable beer bar to go along with a neighborhood feel, Crafty is a great spot to go after work or to finish your work, meet friends, watch a game, have a meeting, hang out on the weekend or for a night out. Come try some craft beers on the eight taps, grab your favorites in a custom made six pack to take home or have a glass of wine from the rotating wine offerings (not everyone loves craft beer as much as Crafty does!)  Crafty caters to the newbie to the craft beer scene as well as craft beer veterans. Come and experience the Craft!

properties.name: Crewz Leather
properties.description: Crewz Leather is a specialty LGBTQ+ store located within Flex night club.

properties.name: Crossroads Plaza
properties.description: You’ll find more than what you came for, with 60+ exciting stores, services and restaurants, including HomeGoods, Old Navy, Stein Mart, Best Buy, Michaels, Marshalls, A.C. Moore, DSW, Bed Bath & Beyond, Petco, Dick’s Sporting Goods, ULTA and Toys “R” Us. Most stores open Mon.-Sat., 10am-9pm; Sun., 1-6pm.

properties.name: Crowemag Toys
properties.description: Crowemag Toys offers items for kids and adult collectors alike. Crowemag Toys carries a wide selection of Star Wars, Transformers, GI Joe, Super Hero, Comics, Hot Wheels, vintage and other miscellaneous stuff.

properties.name: Crude Bitters and Sodas & The Bittery
properties.description: Crude Bitters and Sodas is a cocktail supply shop, soda fountain and classroom in downtown Raleigh. These small-batch cocktail bitters and sodas are hand-made by human hands utilizing only the finest ingredients and careful attention. Cocktail bitters are used to enhance a cocktail, give a slight edge to the nightcap and sub-par bitters can leave your drink in ruin. The Bittery also offers mocktails with bitters, seltzers, shrubs and more!

properties.name: Curate Raleigh
properties.description: Curate Raleigh hosts over 50 local artists in a cozy downtown Raleigh storefront! Artists rotate monthly so there is always something new.

properties.name: Cute Buttons
properties.description: Cute Buttons is the hottest new store in the Triangle for wedding invitations, social stationery, great goodies for your home and office, and the most unique gifts that will wow that special someone in your life. Don't take our word for it...come see for yourself!

properties.name: Cycle Logic
properties.description: Visit Raleigh's oldest bike shop, serving the cycling community since 1974. Full service bike shop providing new and used bikes, professional repairs, and an infectious enthusiasm for bicycles and the adventures they create!

properties.name: D's Bottle Shop & Craft Beer College
properties.description: Come in and browse D's Bottle Shop's selection of 400+ brews, representing efforts of more than 140 brewers, hailing from 25 states and nine countries. Sample one of their eight craft brews on tap or take home a growler of your favorite. A thoughtful collection of wines also available.

properties.name: DECO Raleigh
properties.description: DECO Raleigh is a lively, colorful, customer-centered gift shop and gallery in downtown Raleigh. The shop is walkable, unique, eclectic, smart and interactive. The focus is on offering great products to downtown workers, residents and visitors.

properties.name: DGX
properties.description: The store you need when you need it most. Whether it's coffee on your way to work, a quick bite to eat or those last-minute supplies—DGX has got you covered!

properties.name: DRINK
properties.description:
DRINK is not your usual wine shop, but more of a small wine society of friends. 

Born out of a passion for wine and the desire to share quality, small production wines with a focus on family and interesting stories, DRINK invites you to the intimacy and comfort of The Living Room to learn about and experience  new innovative wines that the "dreamers" from each corner of the world. Due to the nature of such limited productions, there will be an ever changing stock of wines to experience.

properties.name: Decree Company
properties.description: At Decree, we create the finest stationery in-house with our printing presses from the early 1900’s. Please come by and see the presses in action as we create new greeting cards everyday. Also, we have a fine array of gifts that are not found anywhere else. From handmade Italian Umbrellas to fine desk accessories – we assure you will be able to find the perfect gift for the person who has everything. Finally, stop in to sign up for our letterpress classes where you can come in and make your own card, guided by an expert in a relaxing environment with wine and appetizers on our letterpress machines. We look forward to seeing you at Raleigh’s luxury stationery boutique.

properties.name: Delicious Skateboard Shop
properties.description: Delicious Skateboard Shop is a specialty skate goods store in North Raleigh offering boards, equipment and accessories.

properties.name: Designed For Joy
properties.description:
Designed For Joy is a transitional work experience for women coming from trafficking, homelessness, time in prison, overcoming addiction or other vulnerable situations. We provide living wage work hours while building confidence and refreshing resumes. We are launching equipped women into the marketplace.

Drawing from our rich history of international mission work and partnerships with creative co-ops abroad, we feature a few product lines available through DFJ from outside of the US. We are especially excited about the DFJ product lines that are goods developed outside of the US and then created into new products by our artists.

properties.name: Designed For Joy - North Hills
properties.description:
Designed For Joy is a transitional work experience for women coming from trafficking, homelessness, time in prison, overcoming addiction or other vulnerable situations. We provide living wage work hours while building confidence and refreshing resumes. We are launching equipped women into the marketplace.

Drawing from our rich history of international mission work and partnerships with creative co-ops abroad, we feature a few product lines available through DFJ from outside of the US. We are especially excited about the DFJ product lines that are goods developed outside of the US and then created into new products by our artists.

properties.name: Disaster Area Designs
properties.description: Disaster Area Designs makes custom MIDI controllers, pedalboard switchers and effects pedals. They specialize in helping musicians get more out of the gear they already own.

properties.name: Dress
properties.description: Dress. is your consignment resource for selling women's designer clothes, shoes, handbags and jewelry. They sell fabulous new and lightly worn designer merchandise. Consider cleaning out your closet and letting Dress do the work for you. With a fabulous selection, Dress consignment boutique carries a blend of new and consigned women’s clothes at great prices! They also work with boutiques to assist with their overstock or unsold pieces. Because they love fashion and a bargain, Dress wants all customers to have the same experience. Consign or shop and with Dress Raleigh and you will see what great service and selection looks like.

properties.name: Ealdwine
properties.description:
Ealdwine, an old English name meaning “old friend”, is the passion project of friends Matt Gray and Jim Pietryka. 

Ealdwine offers a curated assortment of some of the finest brands in the menswear industry. Our centerpiece is Alden shoes. Made in Massachusetts since 1884, Alden makes some of the finest shoes in the world today. 

In addition to Alden, Ealdwine are proud to carry iconic brands such as Coppley (Custom Suiting), Frank Clegg Leatherworks, William Henry Designs, Mizzen + Main and much more.

properties.name: East Coast Gaming & Gamers Geekery & Tavern
properties.description: East Coast Gaming is a games and gaming supply store providing competitively priced products to the local and online community. We offer products online, and play experiences by partnering with local establishments.

properties.name: East Wake Collective
properties.description: East Wake Collective is retail shop hosting a variety of local small business where all of the products you will find are handmade or handpick by the brand owner. East Wake Collective was founded on the belief that if we all can work together, small businesses can thrive. Wake county is full of amazing makers, creators, and artisans who's product and work speak volumes in the community's they represent and we love to showcase that!

properties.name: Eastern Disc Golf
properties.description: Eastern Disc Golf is a specialty sporting goods store featuring disc golf discs, gear and baskets.

properties.name: Edge of Urge
properties.description: Edge of Urge is a boutique for men and women specializing in handmade and independent designer clothing, shoes, jewelry and accessories. They strongly support handmade, DIY, innovative and creative thinking. Edge of Urge has introduced many up-and-coming designers, as well as more established designers, to bring a matchless collection of their favorite things! New items arriving daily.

properties.name: Edible Arrangements
properties.description: Edible Arrangements stores create magnificent, fresh fruit arrangements and gourmet chocolate dipped fruit to order, for pick-up or delivery, seven days a week.

properties.name: El Toro Supermarket
properties.description: A Mexican supermarket with fresh meats and produce plus prepared foods and other grocery items.

properties.name: Event Horizon Games
properties.description: Event Horizon Games is a local board game and card game store carrying hundreds of game titles including such classic Euro games as Settlers of Catan, Ticket to Ride, Carcassonne and Puerto Rico. Event Horizon also carries a great selection of games for children, role playing games, collectible card games, used books, new and older comics, out of print gaming materials, chess sets, hot and cold snacks and drinks and more.

properties.name: Fairview Greenhouses Garden Center
properties.description:
Family owned and operated since 1974. Beautiful homegrown annual flowers grown right on site as well as a diverse selection of perennials, trees and shrubs. Garden gifts, bird products, mulch, fertilizers, pottery and more!


Fairview prides themselves on top quality, homegrown plant material. Theyhave two acres of greenhouse space that is used for growing annual flowers and poinsettias, and also offer an additional eight acres devoted solely to trees, shrubs, groundcovers and perennials. Whether your project is small scale or rather large, Fairview is certain to have what you are looking for!

properties.name: Falls Village Shopping Center
properties.description: Falls Village is conveniently located and just minutes from I-540, which makes for an easy trip to The Research Triangle Park and RDU International Airport. Falls Village is anchored by TJ Maxx and HomeGoods.

properties.name: Father & Son Antiques
properties.description: Father & Son Antiques is an antique shop that sells modern furnishings, vintage clothing and accessories, records and books. The second floor is also home to  Vintage and Southern Swank. The shop is over 10,000 square feet of mid-century wonderfulness.

properties.name: Fenton
properties.description: This is Fenton. Where the best parts of life in The Triangle are found in one place. This will be your favorite place to play, to gather, to relax and to celebrate.

properties.name: Fight or Flight Comics
properties.description: Fight or Flight Comics is a comic shop offering new comics, graphic novels, plenty of back issues, manga and more!

properties.name: Foundation's Edge
properties.description: Foundation's Edge is a full-service comic shop with 30 years of experience, knowledgeable staff, a 110,000+ back issue collection, manga, RPGs & card games, lots more!

properties.name: Frank's Cyclery
properties.description: Frank’s Cyclery was created in early 2002 and opened its doors for sales in early 2003 to offer the Triangle area a bike shop focused on customer service and care plus a showcase for Frank’s capabilities. They are a true mechanic's shop and this is the focal point of our business. Their specialties are mid to upper-end production and custom road and mountain bikes, custom hand-built wheels and repair service but will help each customer find whatever cycling products they need. Frank's Cyclery's goal is your satisfaction and to share their passion for cycling with you, the customer.

properties.name: Fuquay Spice and Tea
properties.description: Fuquay Spice and Tea is a locally, woman-owned and family-run purveyor of the finest spices, loose leaf teas, oils, vinegars, and local goods.

properties.name: Galatea Boutique
properties.description: Situated in a renovated warehouse in Raleigh's Seaboard Station, Galatea Boutique strives to provide you with hand selected clothing and accessories to fit your way of life and define your style.

properties.name: Gallery at The Cotton Company
properties.description: The Gallery at The Cotton Company houses three resident studio artists as well as the work of over 21 other local artists. Stop in and see the studios of Ginger Meek Allen (Metalsmith), Theresa Brown (Pastel, Oil and Watercolor Portraits and Dick Larsen (Oil Paintings and Pet Portraits). Additionally, the Gallery hosts one visiting artist exhibit monthly.

properties.name: Game Theory
properties.description:
Game Theory's mission is to provide the ultimate place for gamers to meet, shop, and play.
Our store is fully stocked with games, supplies, snacks, and a friendly staff to help you. We host in-store gaming events every day of the week and we welcome all players from newbies to seasoned veterans.

We specialize in role-playing games, board games, card games, and miniatures. We carry everything you need to get started or take your game to the next level.

Most importantly, we understand that gaming is supposed to be FUN! We know that YOU are the most important thing that this hobby has going for it and our customer service shows it!

properties.name: Gateway Plaza
properties.description: Gateway Plaza is a re-imagined retail and creative offices space located at the crossroads of Capital and Crabtree boulevards.

properties.name: Gateway To Essentials
properties.description: Located on the ground floor of the Truist building and Sheraton Raleigh Hotel, Gateway To Essentials is a convenience store with tea/coffee, other beverages, snacks, candies, tobacco, medicines, health & beauty, gifts, greeting cards, stationery, electronics etc.

properties.name: Gather Goods Co.
properties.description: Gather is a beautiful, plant filled gift shop & classroom in downtown Raleigh that features a curated selection of well made artisanal gift products: local foods, bath salts and oils, plants and terrariums, jewelry, apparel and accessories for men and women, note cards and local foods, the majority of which are made by N.C. designers. Housed in a micro space, this is a tiny shop with a lot of soul. In addition, the classroom space hosts craft, food, gardening and business classes.

properties.name: Gena Chandler
properties.description: At Gena Chandler, you will find the girls’ favorite lines including Rachel Pally, M Missoni, Alice + Olivia, Diane Von Furstenberg, J Brand, Rock & Republic and True Religion. If you are ever in the Raleigh area, stop in and say hello, the girls are always there!

properties.name: Giorgios Epicurean Market (GEM)
properties.description:
Delight your culinary senses and discover a gourmet market experience with a butcher, bakery, coffee bar, prepared foods, quality ingredients, fine wines, and gourmet gifts – all under one roof.

Giorgios Epicurean Market is more than a market – this is a place to learn about our products, their benefits, and how to use and incorporate them in everyday life. GEM is a space to explore an expertly curated selection of gourmet gifts and fine wines, gather with friends for breakfast, lunch, or dinner, and pick up your favorite cut of meat or prepared foods on your way home.

properties.name: Grand Asia Market
properties.description: Since our humble start in 1997, we've been doing our best to provide the community with the highest quality Asian groceries. We are excited and grateful to carry thousands of fresh and dry products from countries such as China, Japan, India, Indonesia, Korea, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam.  Please stop by and one of our locations, we're looking forward to seeing you!

properties.name: Great Grapes
properties.description: Great Grapes offers a wide selection of wine and craft beer, along with several types of glassware including Riedel, wine accessories and unique food and cheese merchandise. Their focus is to help you find the right product that fits your needs.

properties.name: Great Outdoor Provision Co.
properties.description: We specialize in clothing and gear for outdoor recreation including hiking, canoeing, kayaking, camping, trail running and much more.

properties.name: Green Front Interiors & Rugs
properties.description: Green Front Interiors and Rugs offers visitors 30,000 square feet of furniture and design inspiration. Whether you're searching for a finishing touch or are starting from an empty space, our Green Front team can help you find what you're looking for.

properties.name: Greenway Beer and Wine
properties.description: Greenway Beer and Wine in North Raleigh features craft beer and wine that you can enjoy in the shop or take home. They have 10 draft beers on rotation and alternating bottles of wine by the glass. Expect the unexpected as they take your taste buds on a wild ride!

properties.name: GrillBillies Barbecue
properties.description: A one stop shop for everything related to barbecue, including a full line of smokers, grills, roasters and cookers. The retail store offers seasoning and sauces used by the professional Pitmaster along with smoking woods, tools and equipment. GrillBillies also offers cooking classes and hosts events like cooking competitions. In addition, they rent out smokers, roasters and more. Basically, if you are looking for anything related to barbecuing, GrillBillies can help you find it, whether it's in the store or if they need to order it for you.

properties.name: H & H Shoe Repair and Pedorthic Facility
properties.description: H & H offers shoe repair services, as well as other types of repair (luggage, bags, belts, etc.) They also have a Pedorthist on staff who professionally fit customers in shoes (athletic, dress and casual) and a fabricating lab on-site to make custom orthotics and modify all types of shoes.

properties.name: H Mart
properties.description:
H Mart is a wildly popular Asian supermarket that has an emphasis on Korean foods. You'll find fresh and affordable produce, a full selection of meats and seafoods, baked goods, frozen foods, plenty of Korean skin care products, housewares, countless shelves of crackers, cookies, candy, seaweed, rice, grains, teas and, of course, all those delicious sauces.

A food court with an array of authentic Korean, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese and Chinese cuisine is also available.

properties.name: Harmony Farms Natural Food Store
properties.description: Natural grocery and supplement market offering a large gluten-free, organic produce and vegan selection. Fresh, organic juice bar open daily.

properties.name: Harry's Guitar Shop
properties.description:
Harry's Guitar Shop opened in 1985 in Raleigh. Since then, they have consistently provided top notch gear, service and instruction to all types of musicians, from professionals to first-time buyers. In addition to the extensive selection of instruments, Harry's keep a wide variety of strings, straps, tubes, pickups and other accessories on hand.


A variety of instructional books including popular artists songbooks and guides for the entire range of instruments are available. Harry's Guitar Shop is also a full service guitar shop with a full inventory of guitar parts in stock.

properties.name: Haydon & Company
properties.description: Haydon & Company proudly handcrafts fine quality, custom jewelry in the heart of Raleigh.  For over 4 decades, our in-house master jewelers have custom crafted rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, cuff links, and signet rings with unique, custom jewelry that delights our customers and lasts for generations. Please come visit our jewelry store to see the quality, craftsmanship, and dedication we bring to every piece we create.

properties.name: Hellbent.
properties.description: Hellbent is a name that instills the idea of change, reckless determination, purpose, fearlessness, guts, and of course, bad-assery.  This brand is determined to help you find that reckless yet confident spirit in you, to showcase boss women that uplift other women, and to provide high quality merchandise that will make you feel proud to own and addicted to wearing. Everything from Hellbent is either designed by their owner, private label, or specially curated and found for the brand that compliments who you are without compromising style and good vibes.

properties.name: HighCraft Beer Market
properties.description: HighCraft Beer Market is a curator, purveyor and ambassador of a great collection of high-quality craft beer, located at the West Park Shopping Center in Cary. The selection is expansive, composed of everything from the best American micro-brews to beers made by the oldest breweries of Europe. Somewhere among the 12-tap tasting bar and walls of 800+ bottled beers, you are sure to find yourself a great beer and good times. If the choices seem daunting, or you just want a recommendation, the owner and “beer guy” will be on hand to guide you. HighCraft also carries a nice selection of craft sodas and wines. Come by for a draft beer or to stock up your fridge!

properties.name: HighCraft Beer Market - Downtown Apex
properties.description: HighCraft Beer Market provides only the best craft beer from local North Carolina brands like Burial, DSSOLVR, New Belgium, Sierra Nevada, and more domestic beer like Grimm from Brooklyn to international beer!

properties.name: Holly Springs Farmers Market
properties.description:
The Farmers Market brings fresh-off-the-farm vegetables and herbs; locally raised beef; local honey; farm fresh eggs; artisan breads, cheeses and cookies; and lots more right to downtown Holly Springs. 


The Farmers Market is a N.C. “producers only” market - the vendors at the market have grown or made the products that they are selling. Most items are from within 15 miles of Holly Springs, providing you with the freshest produce around. The market runs on Sat., May through mid-Oct., from 8:30am-12:30pm.

properties.name: Holly Springs Towne Center
properties.description: Holly Springs Towne Center features a mix of retail favorites. Featuring national brands like Marshalls, Dick's Sporting Goods and Pier 1 Imports, as well as a variety of local specialty stores and services you won't want to miss. Whether you are hungry for a quick bite at lunch, a sports night with friends, a unique dining experience or just a tasty treat, Holly Springs Towne Center has it all, featuring fine restaurants and casual eateries for any occasion. Also check out the regular family fun events and evening concert series.

properties.name: Hopper Piano
properties.description: For more than five decades the name Hopper Piano has been associated with the ultimate piano buying experience. With a long legacy of selection and service Hopper Piano is honored to be Eastern N.C.'s only authorized Steinway and Sons representative. Hopper Piano also offers instrument restoration, installation, in-home services and more for pianos and organs.

properties.name: Hoppy Endings
properties.description: Full bar and bottle shop with the largest selection of bourbon, whisk(e)y, and scotch in the Southeast US.

properties.name: Hoppy House Taproom & Hangout Place
properties.description: Hoppy House Taproom & Hangout Place is an upcoming Self-Pour Taproom in the Research Triangle Park in Morrisville North Carolina. RTP's first Self-Pour Taproom!

properties.name: House Creek Beverage Co.
properties.description: Bottle Rev is a Raleigh craft beer store. Mix-a-Six from over 1,000+ selections, or sit down at the bar and have a beer on tap.

properties.name: House of Hops
properties.description: Looking for a full service craft beer bottle shop that offers 24 draft beer selections that change daily? House of Hops is comfortable, fun atmosphere that offers customers the option of buying their favorite craft bottled beer or draft beer filled in growlers. You can take your beer home or make House of Hops your second home and enjoy a pint of fresh draft beer or a cold bottled beer at our unique full service bar or hang out on our outdoor patio with friends. House of Hops is a dog friendly environment that's relaxing while offering access to a large selection of draft and craft beer. Stop by and enjoy the experience!

properties.name: House of Hops - McNeil Point
properties.description: Looking for a full service craft beer bottle shop that offers 24 draft beer selections that change daily? House of Hops is comfortable, fun atmosphere that offers customers the option of buying their favorite craft bottled beer or draft beer filled in growlers. You can take your beer home or make House of Hops your second home and enjoy a pint of fresh draft beer or a cold bottled beer at our unique full service bar or hang out on our outdoor patio with friends. House of Hops is a dog friendly environment that's relaxing while offering access to a large selection of draft and craft beer. Stop by and enjoy the experience!

properties.name: House of Swank Clothing Company
properties.description: House of Swank Clothing Company - home of the raddest N.C.-themed thirsts and swag.

properties.name: Hunt & Gather
properties.description:
Hunt & Gather fine estate furnishings in Seaboard Station is one of the area's admired locations for finding inspired interiors for your home. Locally owned and independently operated, Hunt & Gather believes in creating a welcoming and service oriented experience where one can put together and entire room or can find that special one of a kind piece to make your home that special place.


This shop features 30 vendors, professional designers and decorators, all housed in a 14,000-square-foot showroom that includes 24-foot ceilings, 8,000-square-feet of hand chosen consignments and room to stand back and see a vast collection of beautiful furnishings.

properties.name: Inside Out Sports
properties.description: Inside Out Sports boasts more than 5,000 square feet of retail space and houses an extensive inventory of cutting-edge swimming, cycling and running merchandise. Bikes, wheels, trainers, bike cases and wetsuits also available for rental.

properties.name: Inspirations Home Decor & More
properties.description: Inspirations offers 30 vendor boutiques and upscale consignments selling furniture, accessories, rugs, art, fashions, new and vintage clothing, jewelry, coffee bar and Man Cave. Mirrored in the selection of vendors, you will find everything from traditional to contemporary designs and the desire to bring back the value of customer service. When you walk in you will not be helped by a salesperson, but rather a person eager to help you plan an entire area, transforming a house into a home. You will not just be buying a top, scarf or accessory, but purchasing items to complete your wardrobe, including those unique signature pieces.

properties.name: Jerry's Artarama
properties.description: Jerry's Artarama in Raleigh proclaims to have the Guaranteed LOWEST prices on art supplies and materials, custom picture framing, brushes, paints and more, from your favorite local art supply store. In business for more than 40 years, open seven days a week offering a wide selection of art products at great prices with great customer service.

properties.name: John Montgomery Violins
properties.description: John Montgomery, Inc. offers full restoration for violins, violas, and violoncellos. As an instrument maker, John Montgomery builds copies of historical instruments as well as models of his own design. Other services include bow rehairing and insurance appraising. Set up work is of professional quality for both modern playing and period performance practice.

properties.name: K-Town Market
properties.description: K-Town Market is a renowned Asian market in Raleigh, N.C. K-Town Market has fresh produce, a vast selection of frozen foods, and a small bakery for customers to enjoy. Choi's Kitchen is a Korean cuisine restaurant within the market.

properties.name: Kannon's Clothing Raleigh, Men's Store
properties.description: Kannon's carries dozens of world-class clothing lines. Suits and sportcoats, formal attire, casual sportwear, shoes, ties and stylish, yet functional, outerwear. From the business professional to the young man trying to make that first impression, Kannon's can furnish everything to complete a stylish yet practical wardrobe for men in all phases of life.

properties.name: Kannon's Clothing Raleigh, Women's Store
properties.description: Love fashion? Need that special look? The Kannon's family is there to help guide you through the shopping process. The staff utilizes their expert knowledge of fashion and most importantly the understanding of the "needs of the customer" to make clothing selection both fun and stress-free. This is known as the "Kannon's Experience"!

properties.name: Keepin' It Collective
properties.description:
Keepin' It Collective is a streetwear store located in Historic Downtown Apex. 

Since day one, the collective has valued style and attention to detail in fashion, music, and all general aspects of culture. 

KIC is more than a name. It’s a mentality, a lifestyle, an action applied within our approach. We push forward with respect for the past, gratitude for the present, and optimism for the future. KIC is a collective of visions and memories, a space made of great energy and inspiring creativity while paying homage to our history of pop culture. 

Our team is dedicated to the curation of vintage clothing, streetwear, and sneakers. To inspire and promote growth and progress within our community, we vow always to Keep It Collective.

properties.name: KnB'S Marketplace
properties.description: KnB'S is a marketplace atmosphere where you can shop many local merchants. KnB'S Marketplace has lots of unique finds, vintage jewelry and shabby chic, furniture, old and new. The marketplace also has a full coffee bar and carries keurig coffee pods.

properties.name: Lafayette Village
properties.description: Lafayette Village is a European-style village in North Raleigh. Located on over six acres off I-540 and Falls of Neuse Rd., it offers locally owned gourmet restaurants and upscale shopping. Lafayette Village features patio dining along the Village Green, secure underground parking, office suites and recurring events from live music to artist exhibits. Architecturally designed and built to depict a European village – not unlike one in France or Italy – the thematic center encourages strolls through paved walkways and quaint boutique shops.

properties.name: Lightship Neon
properties.description: Lightship Neon is Raleigh's neon design studio, custom sign shop, and workshop space. In addition to creating new signs, we repair & restore older neon, and we teach hands-on classes in the art, science and history of luminous tube production. We host private events for 2-30 participants, such as corporate retreats, team-building activities, bachelor/bachelorette parties, or family gatherings.

properties.name: Liles Clothing Studio
properties.description: Among the shops and restaurants of North Hills is Raleigh's premier destination for menswear. Liles Clothing Studio's custom selection is unmatched: suits, sport coats, trousers, shirts, belts, ties and footwear. The off-the-rack selections complement their custom clothing, with everything from suits and sport coats to premium denim jeans, pocket squares, socks and neckwear. The experienced staff is dedicated to making you look your best, no matter your level of sartorial sophistication. Whether off-the-rack or custom, you will not find a better fit in the Triangle than at Liles Clothing Studio in North Hills.

properties.name: Lily Mae's
properties.description:
Lily Mae's is a growing retail business dedicated to bringing customers the latest in fashion at affordable prices. From fashion earrings and designer jewelry to popular shoes and seasonable gifts, you are sure to find something for everyone at our stores. With Stores in Wake Forest and North Raleigh, Lily Mae's features local artists' work ranging from jewelry to hand-painted picture frames and key chain charms. From children's gifts to holiday gifts, Lily Mae's is your one-stop shop for the latest in fashion, accessories and gifts for the home.

Lily Mae's is constantly updated with new merchandise so check back frequently. If you don't see something you are looking for, please ask. We are happy to search for specific products for you. We want your experience to be the experience in personalized shopping. Hours: Mon.-Wed., 10am-7pm; Thur.-Sat., 10am-8pm; Sun., Noon-5pm.

properties.name: Limited Run Retail
properties.description: Limited Run Games is focused on preserving games in a physical format. Publishing over 300 games in its lifetime and winning awards for its bespoke Collector’s Editions, Limited Run is the gold standard in bringing digital-only games to physical form.

properties.name: Litmus Gallery & Studio
properties.description: Litmus Gallery & Studios is a working gallery showcasing resident and guest artists from around the Triangle. A wide variety of disciplines including pottery, sculpture, oil and watercolor painting, mosaics and mixed media are presented. The gallery is open for scheduled showings and events and by appointment.

properties.name: Local 919 Craft Beer + Fine Wine
properties.description:
Local 919 was born from a group of locals who formed a friendship over the love of craft beer and wine. We are business people, beer experts, wine connoisseurs, writers, and even doctors! Local 919 recognizes the sense of community and family a neighbor gathering location creates. To that end, we strive to be the perfect location for you and your neighbors to meet, relax, and try some of the best craft beer, fine wine, and top-shelf spirits available. 

Look for events, come and watch a game, or hang out with friends. Whatever it is, we want you to be able to come, meet new neighbors, make lifelong friends, and tell people, "We met at Local 919."

properties.name: Locals Seafood Market
properties.description: Locals Seafood sells fresh seafood every weekend at local farmers markets. Our crew is happy to share their knowledge about how a species tastes, the best way to cook it, and how it was caught or harvested.

properties.name: Logan's Garden Shop
properties.description: Logan's Trading Company, a one stop garden shop, has been owned and operated by the Logan family since 1965. With everything for your garden plus unique gifts and accessories, shopping at Logan's is truly a memorable experience.

properties.name: MADISON - Village District
properties.description: MADISON is a women’s specialty multi-brand retailer representing accessible luxury. MADISON aims to inspire your closet without having to spend a fortune. Inspired by classic design with contemporary updates, MADISON offers unique and feminine pieces, which fashionable women have come to love. The collections are current and exciting, focusing on the most coveted styles with an emphasis on quality and detail. Every season delivers a fresh aesthetic featuring flattering cuts, colors and prints. From timeless shift dresses and luxurious sweaters to carefully curated accessories, there is something for everyone.

properties.name: MODE Consignment Boutique
properties.description: MODE Consignment Boutique offers name brand and designer items to fashionable shoppers who appreciate a realistically affordable price

properties.name: MacLellan Bagpipes
properties.description:
MacLellan Bagpipes is a specialty bagpipe production space and retail store located in downtown Zebulon and owned by Roddy MacLellan, artisan and master maker of distinctive, limited production and bespoke bagpipes.

MacLellan instruments are crafted from the finest materials, using traditional skills originating in Scotland. Attention to detail and dedication to the highest standards of quality--guarantee a bagpipe which is more than just a musical instrument but also a work of art.

properties.name: Magnolia House
properties.description: Shirley Hunsberger has been Fuquay's Magnolia House framer since 1994. Hunsberger is not only a framer but a practicing artist whose commission work ranges from wedding portraits to watercolor landscapes. Magnolia House also sells both original art and reproductions at affordable prices.

properties.name: Main & Taylor
properties.description:
Main & Taylor is a beautiful shoe and handbag salon located in North Hills shopping center in Raleigh. With a reputation for a vast selection of designer names and sizes ranging from 4 to 12 in quad, slim, narrow, and medium widths, there is something for every lifestyle and budget. The Raleigh location includes shop-in-shops by Stuart Weitzman and Donald J. Pliner. These two departments ensure that customers are seeing the most extensive selection of shoes by these two famed designers. Main & Taylor is proud to be the only retailer in N.C. to present the Stuart Weitzman “ribbon” concept shop and is one of only two boutiques in the country selected by Stuart for this prestigious honor.


While shoes are the main focus, the handbags should not be missed. They come in luxe leathers, metallic finishes and exotic skins. Clutches, hobos, satchels and totes are all there but with unique twists that makes it hard to walk out without one. The evening section has been the go-to spot for women who know how important the right shoe is for that special occasion.

properties.name: Marbles PlayStore
properties.description:
Know Before You Go: Marbles is transforming the central courtyard into the Marbles Playway! This construction phase (expected to last from June-Oct. 2024) will result in the closure of some entrances and walkways around the Marbles campus. The temporary museum entrance is located at the corner of Blount and Hargett Sts. All museum visitors are required to enter through the Marbles PlayStore.
For more information about navigating around Marbles during this time, click here.
Shop local at the Marbles PlayStore! We have innovative, educational, and whimsical children's merchandise so you can take home the power of play. Every purchase supports play at Marbles. Don't forget, you don't need to buy admission to the museum to shop.

properties.name: Midtown Farmers Market
properties.description: The third year of the Midtown Farmers’ Market looks to include both new and returning vendors and features a variety of fresh local produce including organic, sustainable vegetables, cheeses, herbs, flowers, meats and specialty baked goods.

properties.name: Mission Market
properties.description: Mission Market is a community focused store with ethically sourced goods and beverages.

properties.name: Moon and Lola
properties.description: Moon and Lola is a unique jewelry line that focuses on the customer. Offering beautifully crafted pieces - from feminine charms to bold accent pieces.

properties.name: Moore Square Market
properties.description:
Pick up your local produce and treats, meet up with friends and enjoy live music at Moore Square Market! Enjoy a picnic and games in the park or lunch from local restaurants, get some shopping done at nearby stores and make an afternoon in DTR. The market features vendors selling fresh, seasonal goods as well as original, high-quality crafts. Fruits, vegetables, meats, seafood, eggs, dairy, artisanal goods, pastries and much more can all be found at the market. All vendors operate within 90 miles of Raleigh.

Moore Square Market is an evolution of the Raleigh Downtown Farmer's Market. The Market was relocated with the reopening of Moore Square in 2019. In addition to the weekly vendors, the Market has theme days with special programming, live music, children's activities, weekly non-profits and more. 

Moore Square Market is open from 11am-3pm every Sun. from May 14-Oct. 22. The Market is managed by Downtown Raleigh Alliance and the City of Raleigh Parks, Recreation, and Cultural Resources Department.

properties.name: Mort's Trophies & Awards
properties.description: Mort's is a full service trophy shop with engravings for custom plaques, trophies, acrylics, glass and other custom awards. When you're looking for a unique gift for any kind of event, call Mort’s Trophies & Awards.

properties.name: Motor Boatin'
properties.description: Spice up your free time with a jet ski or boat rental from Motor Boatin. Offering affordable and entertaining rentals that help families and communities have fun together while enjoying the natural beauty of N.C. Located in Wake Forest, right on Falls Lake and just minutes from Cary, Apex, Holly Springs, the Triangle, Garner, Knightdale and neighboring communities. Motor Boatin' rentals will make your vacations and parties unforgettable.

properties.name: Munjo Munjo
properties.description: Munjo Munjo is a Hispanic artist-owned and -operated retail shop in the middle of downtown Raleigh. In addition to Munjo-brand apparel, accessories & more, the studio produces and stocks products from various local & regional independent artists and creators, especially highlighting women and BIPOC artists, through collaborative works, live art events and other opportunities.

properties.name: Nadeau
properties.description: Nadeau: Furniture With a Soul offers unique and handcrafted solid wood furniture from around the globe, at unbelievably affordable prices. Nadeau was founded on the idea that great furniture should be attainable by everyone.

properties.name: Nashona
properties.description:
NASHONA is a fashion forward women’s clothing line that specializes in collaborating modern styles handcrafted with vibrant African fabrics from Tanzania. Our 100% wax cotton kangas and kitenges are versatile, unique, and of the highest quality. We seek to provide exceptional prints and high fashion apparel while helping to serve both our local and global communities. A portion of all sales goes to benefit the Shalom Orphanage in Karatu, Tanzania.

The phrase "Made with ❤️ Tanzania" can be found written across the tag of each NASHONA piece. NASHONA, ("I sew" in Swahili), was created by Lilian K Danieli, a Tanzanian native who resides in North Carolina. Lilian established the line in 2012 with the goal of serving her community and merging two different cultures by providing traditional African prints in modern silhouettes for a unique statement. NASHONA's success is attributed to a loyal team of local Tanzanians, retailers and brand ambassadors who share Lillian's vision of fashion and philanthropy.

properties.name: Needlepoint
properties.description: Since Mar. of 1999, Needlepoint has been inviting stitchers to visit their retail and online shop for needlepoint canvases, kits, threads and more!

properties.name: North Carolina General Stores
properties.description: Located in the beautiful downtown district of Wake Forest, this store specializes in N.C.-made BBQ sauces, specialty foods, local art, pottery and photography.

properties.name: North Carolina Museum of Art Museum Store
properties.description: The Museum Store features unique jewelry, glass, books, scarves, kids’ items and commissioned works created exclusively for the NCMA by local and international designers and artisans. Open during regular museum hours. Shop online any time.

properties.name: North Carolina Museum of History Museum Shop (Open Until Dec. 29, 2024)
properties.description:
At The Museum Shop, located at the North Carolina Museum of History in Raleigh, Tar Heel traditions abound in the impressive selection of N.C. handmade ornaments, pottery, jewelry and other items. Other North Carolina-related products include specialty foods, children's toys, men's ties, books and more. 

All profits from the sale of Museum Shop products support the programs and educational projects of the N.C. Museum of History. The Museum Shop is operated by the Museum of History Associates.

properties.name: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences Museum Store & Nature Art Gallery
properties.description: The Museum Store, operated by Friends of the Museum, offers a wide assortment of books, videos, CDs, gems, jewelry, natural science kits, educational toys and more.

properties.name: North Hills
properties.description: Discover an eclectic mix of 130+ local shops, restaurants, world-class bars, spas and premier hotels. With stadium-style cinemas, the area's first upscale bowling lounge, a Farmers' Market, outdoor concerts and year-round events, Raleigh's Midtown awaits you. Most stores open Mon.-Sat., 10am-6pm; Sun., noon-6pm.

properties.name: North Street Beer Station
properties.description: The North Street Beer Station is a great place to pick up or taste one of over 500+ craft beers. Throughout the year they host tap takeovers, cask nights, tastings and other heady flavors of entertainment.

properties.name: Oak City Cycling Project
properties.description: A local, independent cycling shop in downtown Raleigh focused on increasing bicycle ridership through sales, service, outreach and community. Oak City Cycling Project services all kinds of bikes, sells new and used bikes, hosts bike maintenance classes and rents bikes.

properties.name: Onward Reserve
properties.description:
Onward Reserve is a specialty men’s apparel and lifestyle brand. By incorporating our founder’s appreciation for life's genuine moments and his spirit for the outdoors, Onward Reserve outfits the gentleman’s lifestyle from day to night, weekday to weekend, and inspires us all to live authentically. 
 
With a laid-back approach to luxury and unwavering quality, Onward Reserve offers a personalized shopping experience with everything from performance and tailored sportswear to t-shirts featuring original works of art, as well as a curated assortment of accessories and distinctive gifts. 

Onward Reserve is located in Cameron Village at 404 Daniels St., near the intersection of Clark Ave.

properties.name: Origami Styling
properties.description: Origami Styling, located in downtown Raleigh, is vintage clothing for women, men, kids & home! Personal styling available by appointment.

properties.name: Page 158 Books
properties.description: Page 158 Books is a locally-owned, independent bookstore in beautiful, downtown Wake Forest.

properties.name: Pallbearer
properties.description: Pallbearer is a vintage boutique in the heart of downtown Raleigh! We stock unisex, mens, and womens clothing and accessories ranging from the 1950's to Y2K. Whether you're looking for a glamorous new outfit or swaggy casuals, we got you covered. Come check out Pallbearer while you explore the beautiful historic streets of downtown.

properties.name: Paper Source
properties.description:
Paper Source is a unique retailer of specialty paper, custom invitations, gift wrap, craft supplies and other products to inspire creativity, aiming to inspire everyone to “Do Something Create Every Day.”

You’ll find inspiration in every corner of the store and website--from their collection of note cards, envelopes and paper in their Paper Source color palette, walls lined in beautiful fine papers from around the world, scrapbooking and crafting supplies and a curated gift selection.

Paper Source also has a signature collection of Paper Source wedding invitations, birth announcements, stationery and other custom printed items for any occasion. The store associates look forward to helping you navigate any craft project or special event, and introducing you to something new!

properties.name: Parcero Studio - Yarn & Gifts Shop
properties.description:
At Parcero Studio, we offer a curated selection of high-quality yarns perfect for creating baskets, bags, sweaters, stuffed animals, and a variety of macramé projects. We’re proud to collaborate with talented local artists to bring you unique, handmade gifts that are perfect for the holiday season and beyond. Our collection features luxury candles, stunning resin art, handcrafted leather hats and coozies, cozy chunky blankets, oversized cardigans, and everyone’s favorite crochet animals and veggies. Whether you’re a maker or looking for the perfect gift, Parcero Studio has something special for you.

Don’t miss our future hands-on workshops in basic crochet and macramé, perfect for beginners or those looking to refine their skills. Our studio also features a welcoming, cozy space where the community can relax, unwind, and work on their craft projects.

We also believe in giving back. When you visit Parcero Studio, we invite you to bring a new pair of white crew socks to help support our local homeless community. As a token of our appreciation, you’ll receive a handmade crochet coaster—perfect for your car or home.

properties.name: Park West Village
properties.description: Park West Village is a 100-acre, mixed-use development that includes a town center district, a community center with sought-after major retail anchors like Target, upscale casual restaurants and Stone Theatre Park West 14 cinemas.

properties.name: Parkside Town Commons
properties.description: Parkside Town Commons features a mix of retail and restaurant favorites! From national brands like Target, Field & Stream and Golf Galaxy to Harris Teeter and a wide variety of local specialty stores and services you won't want to miss. Parkside also features fine restaurants and eateries for any taste or occasion.  From the beautiful landscape to unique sculptures Parkside Town Commons is a place to come visit and stay for a while.

properties.name: Patel Brothers
properties.description: At Patel Brothers, our mission is to bring the best ingredients from around the world, right to your doorstep. With a wide variety of authentic regional ingredients, we strive to reconnect people with the familiar flavor of India.

properties.name: Peak of the Vine
properties.description: Peak of the Vine is a unique combination of wine lounge and wine cellar shop. Enjoy the warm and friendly atmosphere of our lounge as you sip on exceptional wines from around the world; or choose your favorite bottles to take home. Conveniently located in Historic Downtown Apex, Peak of the Vine is the perfect destination to meet friends and enjoy delicious wines, beer, and charcuterie plates. Join our wine club with wine tasting nights and food trucks. We have live music and other special events on Fridays and Saturdays. Book your party or special events with us in our wine cellar, lounge, or beautiful outdoor garden area. We are a place "Where there are no strangers, only friends you haven't met.

properties.name: Pelagic Beer & Wine
properties.description: Pelagic Beer & Wine seeks to offer an impressive selection of high quality, delicious craft beer and wine, while contributing to the community by supporting local merchants and artists and promoting sustainability.

properties.name: Peter Millar
properties.description: A premium lifestyle apparel brand featuring a wide range of casual sportswear, tailored dress furnishings and luxury and performance golf attire. The storefront offers finer gentlemen's apparel in a welcoming, customer-centered environment. The 1,600-square-foot store is located at Raleigh's acclaimed Midtown in North Hills Shopping Center, just minutes away from the brand's design headquarters.

properties.name: Petersons' Consigning Design
properties.description:
At Petersons' Consigning Design, store inventory changes more often than the weather and the best items don't stay long. Our most savvy customers visit regularly to scout new arrivals and hunt for one-of-a-kind treasures. 
Whether you live in an apartment, a cottage, or a mansion--we have items to furnish and accessorize your space. Our consignors shop all over the world and now you can too. 
If you have items to sell, discover how easy it is to consign. We accept sofas, bedroom sets, dining tables, office furniture, and decorative accessories ranging from antiques to contemporary. If you are downsizing, moving, or are simply redecorating, we offer a way to get more cash for your items without the hassles of garage sales or newspaper ads.
We are now accepting ladies' apparel and embellishments in addition to home furnishings and decor.
Shop today at Petersons' Consigning Design and Consigning Design Loft to discover unique home decor and stylish apparel at 60% to 70% below retail.

properties.name: Pharmacy Bottle + Beverage
properties.description: Pharmacy Bottle + Beverage in downtown Cary offers a unique tap room with over 10 drafts available and a retail selection of craft beer and wine.

properties.name: Pigfish Lane
properties.description: Pigfish Lane Antiques & Interiors offers an experience combining design, expertise and 'Interesting Stuff' by elegantly showcasing extraordinary items in one convenient Raleigh location.

properties.name: Plantation Point Shopping Center
properties.description: Welcome to Plantation Point Shopping Center, Raleigh's center for value and selection. This shopping area is anchored by BJ's Wholesale, Marshall's, Big Lots and Petco, along with Life Time Fitness and much more. In addition to great shopping, the center also hosts the Plantation Point Farmers' Market every Saturday from 9am-2pm, year round, rain or shine. You'll find the freshest produce, baked goods, specialty foods, fine arts and crafts for sale by local farmers and artisans. The Kids' Zone at the farmers' market offers free weekly arts and crafts for children. Free Saturday morning Yoga classes are also offered from 8-9am every weekend in space 101. Plantation Point Shopping Center is located at the intersection of I-540 and Capital Blvd. in Raleigh.

properties.name: Play4Life Comics
properties.description: Play4Life Comics is a full-service comic book shop carrying current and vintage comic books and action figures. Play4Life also hosts the Wake Forest mini comic-con which is a family-friendly community oriented comic convention.

properties.name: Pleasant Valley Promenade
properties.description: Pleasant Valley Promenade, located at the corner of US Hwy. 70 (Glenwood Ave.) and Pleasant Valley Rd., is home to 40+ stores. The shopping center has more than 362,000-square-feet of retail space and is anchored by Marshalls, Golfsmith and Bed Bath and Beyond.

properties.name: Pop-Up Shops at Martin Street
properties.description:
The Pop-Up Shops at Martin Street is a pop-up retail store program in Downtown Raleigh aimed to support minority- and women-owned businesses. The storefront location is available for pop-up retail tenants looking to share an affordable retail space with other up-and-coming retailers, participate in business counseling, and experience the Downtown Raleigh market. Current tenants include:

Frills Atelier offers vintage jewelry and accessories. Hillary Davis, owner of Frills and a former fashion industry designer and creator, sources vintage jewelry and accessories for resale or reworking— producing a new product through combinations of multiple items or restoring statement pieces to their former glory
Aesthetic Appeal Jewelry creates and sells handmade, one-of-a-kind gemstone jewelry.

This program is led by Downtown Raleigh Alliance, Wake Tech Entrepreneurship & Small Business Center, LM Restaurants and Lenovo, and aims to increase the presence, inclusion, and equity of business ownership in Downtown Raleigh.

properties.name: Possibilities
properties.description: Possibilities, is an extension of the owners style: artsy, colorful, comfortable, stylish and fun! You'll feel the friendly vibe at her Cary location, where the helpful staff is gracious and welcoming. Spirited clothing and accessories for women can be found at Possibilities!

properties.name: Poyner Place
properties.description: Poyner Place is open-air shopping area with more than 400,000-square-feet of restaurant and shopping space anchored by Super Target.

properties.name: Quail Ridge Books
properties.description: Quail Ridge Books & Music is a locally owned independent shop brimming with books of every genre, an award winning children's department, unique gift items and including a wide range of incredible book-themed merchandise including journals, scented candles, tons of calendars, bookish t-shirts and comfy socks as well as bookish wall art. Their friendly, knowledgeable staff is dedicated to providing the best in customer service

properties.name: Quercus Studio
properties.description:
Quercus Studio is the boutique and workshop of goldsmith, Lauren Ramirez. Formerly running her business by word of mouth for several years in the San Francisco Bay Area, Lauren showcases her nature-inspired wares and hand-crafted fine jewelry, alongside the wearable art of a few other designers.


In addition to jewelry, Quercus carries a small selection of accessories, textiles and objects for the home. The rustic and sun-drenched space in downtown Raleigh is in business to create special adornments for the non-traditional client.

properties.name: Quintessentials
properties.description: From the beautiful fixtures, to the antique tables and upholstered library chairs, this shop feels like home. Quintessentials’ owner has harmoniously arranged tabletop, linen and gift finds in every price point, from the world’s top designers. The owners handpicked collectibles and gifts share space with one of a kind antiques, a custom made flatware display and the stunning china and crystal rooms showcase hundreds of patterns. A 19th century French drapery table proudly displays bridal registry selections for all to admire. This assortment makes Quintessentials the ultimate tabletop and gift destination of the Carolinas. The friendly and knowledgeable sales staff paired with the decidedly comfortable atmosphere makes shopping and bridal registry at Quintessentials a delightful experience for over seventeen years.

properties.name: RC Hobby
properties.description: Radio-controlled cars & trucks, RC planes, drones, rockets, plastic models, pine car, kites, paints, service repair available for your RC... Mini-Z Track & CrawlerCourse.

properties.name: REI - Recreational Equipment, Inc. Cary
properties.description: REI loves to get outside and play, and they know first-hand the importance of quality outdoor gear. REI stands behind all of their products with a 100% satisfaction guarantee and design their own line of award-winning REI brand gear and clothing.

properties.name: REI - Recreational Equipment, Inc. Raleigh
properties.description: REI loves to get outside and play, and they know first-hand the importance of quality outdoor gear. REI stands behind all of their products with a 100% satisfaction guarantee, and design their own line of award-winning REI brand gear and clothing.

properties.name: Raleigh Cheesy
properties.description: Beautiful, hand-crafted cheese and charcuterie boards. Raleigh Cheesy specializes in creating one-of-a-kind grazing platters for you to enjoy at any event you might be hosting. This brick-and-mortar location offers grab-and-go snack size boxes, next-day pickup orders for larger boards or options for gathering any items you might need for creating your own cheeseboard.

properties.name: Raleigh Denim Workshop
properties.description: Located in the front of the workshop located in downtown Raleigh, Raleigh Denim Workshop and Curatory is a carefully curated shop of local and worldly goods, chosen because of their care for craft, superior design and master process. The Curatory stocks the complete Raleigh Denim collection, as well as other exclusive well-crafted collections.

properties.name: Raleigh Diamond
properties.description: Come enjoy Raleigh's largest collection of fine, designer, estate and antique jewelry. The 10,000 square foot showroom is the largest in N.C. and has that perfect gift for every person, in every price range. Raleigh Diamond specializes in custom designed engagement rings. Their diamond selection is endless and they will not be undersold. Services include jewelry and timepiece repair and appraisal. Raleigh Diamond can even help you recycle unwanted gold, platinum and diamonds, as they are a top-rated buyer of precious metals in the Raleigh area.

properties.name: Raleigh Vintage
properties.description: Raleigh Vintage is a curated space in downtown Raleigh for those living a gentle and sustainable life. We offer handpicked, high-quality vintage and new clothing and accessories. We also carry vintage home goods and small independent jewelry and apothecary brands. Every piece is special and has a story to tell.

properties.name: Raleigh Furniture Gallery
properties.description: The Raleigh Furniture Gallery is the Triangle's premier destination for high end estate quality furniture, fine art, Persian rugs and antiques.  The Raleigh Furniture Gallery purchases and consigns single items through entire estates. Voted Raleigh's #1 Furniture Store and finalist for Best Antique Store two years running by WRAL.com.

properties.name: Reader's Corner
properties.description: Used book, music and comic store on Raleigh's Hillsborough St.

properties.name: Red Line Beer & Wine
properties.description: Craft beer and wine bottle shop near NC State University. Wide selection of import, domestic and craft beer, wine and champagne, as well as 24 rotating taps. Order beer and wine on demand and have it delivered using the Red Line Delivery app.

properties.name: Retro Modern Furnishings
properties.description: Unique modern furnishings for your home that celebrate the past yet look toward the future. Retro Modern Furnishings focuses on vintage and upcycled products and new products that support local and up-in-coming makers and craftsman. The storefront is on Dawson St. next door to the Hue apartments.

properties.name: Revolver Consignment Boutique
properties.description: Revolver Boutique is an upscale consignment/vintage shop for men and women featuring clothing, jewelry, and art. Revolver offers a great selection of designer & vintage apparel for men & women. Clothing, shoes, handbags, etc by Dianne von Furstenberg, Trina Turk, Catherine Malandrino, Juicy Couture, Prada, Michael Stars, & MANY others. You can also find jewelry, t-shirts, & artwork by local designers. We have jeans such as True Religion, Paige, Joe's, Sevens, Citizens, Rock & Republic, & Hudson…just to name a few. Hours: Mon.-Sat., 10am-7pm; Sun., 1-5pm.

properties.name: Ridgewood Shopping Center
properties.description: Ridgewood Shopping Center exists to make your life a little easier. Visit them today and experience the difference.

properties.name: Ridgewood Wine & Beer Company
properties.description: Ridgewood Wine & Beer Company carries a large selection of wine and beer from all over the world. They specialize in finding great everyday selections that will fit any budget as well as that special bottle for the serious collector. If you are looking for something specific, stop in or give them a call. If it's not in stock they will be glad to order it for you.

properties.name: Right of Way Equipment Co.
properties.description: Right of Way Equipment Co. offers residential and commercial landscape equipment sales. Choose them for high-quality service and sales of lawn mowers, handheld equipment such as chainsaws and leaf blowers and more.

properties.name: Root-Bound Plant Shop
properties.description: Root-Bound is a family owned business that specializes in indoor houseplants, supplies, and services. Come for indoor plants, repotting supplies, rare plants, and more!

properties.name: Riparian Provision Co.
properties.description:
The vision for Riparian Provision Co. is to create a welcoming gathering space filled with positive conversation and connection. Our aesthetic embraces our passion for the environment, local food and sustainability.  Our goods showcase our belief in supporting independent brands through our carefully curated selection of craft beer, wine, cider plants, and provisions.

We are committed to supporting Independent breweries. We showcase local and regional beer from smaller brands to help the craft beer industry grow and thrive.  We source wine from smaller vineyards that celebrate values such as sustainability, biodiversity, and culture. We have a curated selection of reds, whites, rosé, and natural, biodynamic wines. 

We are gardeners and plant lovers in our spare time. We value organic, sustainable gardening and support farms that share those values. We have houseplants for sale year-round, along with planters and plant care items. We host Native Plant Sales and have a passion for environmentally and pollinator-friendly plants.

properties.name: Root & Branch
properties.description: Root & Branch, located in the RDU International Airport, is not your traditional “airport store.” Longtime supporters of N.C. culture and the ever-growing maker community, Jessie Williams of Edge of Urge and Pam Blondin of DECO Raleigh curate a collection of goods that are rooted in the region and state.

properties.name: Rose & Lee Co.
properties.description: Rose & Lee Collective is a women-owned, community-focused boutique that curates a beautiful collection of clothing, accessories, and gifts from thoughtful, conscientious brands. We’re doing our part to shift the fashion and gift industries toward a more sustainable future, and we’re eager for our customers to join us on the journey. Drop by our store or shop online for a curated selection of clothing, accessories, and gifts from thoughtful, global brands. Our approach to ethical fashion is simple and effortless — we’re here to help you uplift your style and make a positive impact on local and global communities and our planet. In our opinion, feel-good style and thoughtfully-considered clothing absolutely go hand-in-hand.

properties.name: Roshambo Beverage Company
properties.description: Located in the southeastern corner of downtown Raleigh, Roshambo Beverage Company offers a selection of your favorite craft beer, wine, cider, and more. All are welcome, including dogs!

properties.name: Runologie
