properties.description: Runologie is an independent running supplier in downtown Raleigh. They curate a selection of products which respond to the specific needs of each type of runner. Choose from numerous fitness brands, as well as for footwear fitting and coaching/training workshops.

properties.name: Saks Fifth Avenue
properties.description: Located at Triangle Town Center, Saks Fifth Avenue is renowned as an arbiter of modern style. Saks offers the finest designer collections for men and women, as well as accessories, cosmetics and home furnishings, all supported by highly personalized customer relationships.

properties.name: Sam Ash Music Store
properties.description: Shop the hottest music and sound gear at Sam Ash Music Store! Sam Ash's staff of serious musicians and technicians care about their customers, so you’ll always get the most honest and helpful advice in your area of expertise. They are committed to serving all of your musical needs with a vast selection of the finest musical instruments, products and print music in any price range. Sam Ash has something for you, whether you are a newbie, a professional or someone who just loves to make music.

properties.name: Same Old Same Old Vintage
properties.description:
Same Old Same Old Vintage is a vintage clothing shop that sells Denim, Western Wear, Cowboy Boots, Tees, Accessories, and much more. While we specialize in Western flare, we believe in selling something that anyone can wear. S.O.S.O. promotes inclusivity by providing plus sizes and gendering clothes as little as possible. Whether you're looking to get outfitted or want to admire some vintage gems, definitely come check us out. 

Come One, Come All!

properties.name: Scentsuosity
properties.description:
These handmade natural products are inspired by the power of nature to enhance your daily experience. Customizable formulas ensure that each product is perfectly infused with pure essential oils, raw butters, mineral salts, herbs, emollient oils, floral waters and other organic and botanical ingredients. The Scentsuosity experience marries nurture and nature to achieve complete unification of mind, body and soul!


Wanting to tap into your inner creative side? Are you suffering from sensitive skin issues? Sign up for a class at Scentsuosity and create your own soaps, balms and lotions. Visit website for class calendar or call for a private party class.

properties.name: Science Safari
properties.description: Science Safari carries high quality microscopes, telescopes, rockets and chemistry experiments, but around every corner are toys, toddler toys, family games, science discovery kits, an awesome Playmobil selection and more toys that you won't find anywhere else.

properties.name: Shoppes at Midway Plantation
properties.description: Shoppes at Midway Plantation is a shopping destination that offers more than 425,000 square feet of retail space with several major chains & more!

properties.name: Simply Blush Bridal
properties.description: Simply Blush Bridal offers a hand-selected, unique mix of wedding dresses that meet every taste and budget. From bold and robust silhouettes, to simple, clean-lined dresses, natural light, knowledgeable stylists, and personalized attention are just a few of the ways Simply Blush Bridal distinguishes itself as a fresh presence in Zebulon, N.C.

properties.name: Six Forks Station
properties.description: Six Forks Station, in North Raleigh near Six Forks Rd. and I-540, has been a large shopping area for more than 30 years. Anchored by The Home Depot and Bed Bath and Beyond, this almost 500,000-square-foot shopping area has shopping, restaurants and a cinema.

properties.name: So & So Books
properties.description: So & So Books is an independent bookstore in downtown Raleigh featuring a thoughtfully curated selection of the owners favorite books in all the major genres.

properties.name: Social Status
properties.description: The design of the store boast angled hardwood ceiling and is located in City Market, a historically art saturated area of downtown Raleigh. City Market was chosen as the location because of the cobble stone streets and the art and music festivals that are frequently held in the area. Raleigh was a great location for the final Social Status location due to the emerging fashion, art and design scene. Raleigh is also rich with colleges and universities in close proximity of the Raleigh boutique.

properties.name: Soho Consignments
properties.description: Welcome to Raleigh Furniture Store, SoHo Consignments. We are Raleigh North Carolina’s first choice in “Fine furnishings for the sophisticated home” and THE place to buy and sell furniture in Raleigh. We’re also rated one of the best furniture stores in Cary, having won back to back Cary New’s “Best of Cary” awards in 2012 and 2013.

properties.name: Soil Toppers, Inc.
properties.description: This market will offer LOCAL farm produce, art, and local music....a wonderful blend of local farm produce and talent! A great place for a family outing on Saturday morning!

properties.name: Sound Off Records and Hi-Fi
properties.description: For purists, dabblers and everyone in between.  Sound Off Records and Hi-Fi sells and buys used records and vintage audio equipment.  Record cleaning services and equipment repair are also available. Located in the basement of the Carter building.

properties.name: South Hills Mall & Plaza
properties.description: South Hills Mall & Plaza... a little something for everyone! This plaza had a history way before it became South Hills. The upper level of South Hills Plaza is made of brick from a building that once served as the girls' dormitory for Cary High School. This same building was later used as a "teach-erage" or home for the teachers.

properties.name: State Farmers Market, Raleigh
properties.description: More than fresh vegetables, it’s a family adventure. Considered one of the nation’s best and most modern markets, visitors enjoy 75 acres of indoor/outdoor specialty shops, restaurants and garden center, with fruits, vegetables, meats, and gift products from across the state. Free admission. Hours: Mon.-Sat., 5am-7pm; Sun., 8am-5pm.

properties.name: State of Beer
properties.description: State of Beer's bottle shop offers numerous beers from near and far, as well as food, seven days a week. Stop by for a six-pack of craft brews and enjoy lunch or dinner from their growing menu of salads and sandwiches.

properties.name: Stone Ridge Farm Market
properties.description: At Stone Ridge Farm Market you will find friendly service and the freshest, highest quality, N.C. grown fruits and vegetables available in the Greater Raleigh area. Stone Ridge also has a great line on specialty products, including jams, jellies, pickled vegetables, snack mixes, candy, cookbooks and more! In the fall they grow over 50 varieties of pumpkins, winter squash and gourds. Stone Ridge Farm Market also supply's beautiful Christmas trees, wreaths and garland which arrive fresh from the Blue Ridge Mountains in late November.

properties.name: Stonehenge Market Shopping Center
properties.description: Fashion! Dining! Specialty! And much more! Enjoy everyday shopping at great stores such as Harris Teeter and Stein Mart or experience an array of specialty shops such as the Hallmark store and Wine 'n Things. Dine at Outback Steakhouse, Carolina Wing Company or enjoy dessert at Ben & Jerry's.

properties.name: Streets of London Antiques
properties.description: Streets of London Antiques is a fine antiques specialist who imports directly from England. Conveniently located just outside downtown Cary. From furniture to works of art, Streets of London Antiques has it all. Visit during open hours or contact them to schedule and appointment.

properties.name: StyleFinder
properties.description: StyleFinder helps women reduce the stress of getting dressed. Know what to wear and how to wear it for life.

properties.name: Sur La Table
properties.description: Sur La Table is the quintessential place for discovering and exploring the kitchen. With a highly-regarded in-store cooking class program, Sur La Table provides an unparalleled selection of high-quality tools for cooking and dining. Matched with the passion of knowledgeable employees, customers can choose from a selection of products that celebrate cooking and entertaining from all over the world.

properties.name: SuzAnna's Antiques
properties.description: SuzAnna's Antiques is a small, mother and daughter owned antique shop in North Raleigh. With seasonal and everyday antiques filling the store, now is the time to rome around the shop.

properties.name: Sweet Peas Urban Gardens
properties.description:
The team at Sweet Peas Urban Gardens believes that urban farming is fundamental to the creation of healthy, sustainable food production for our growing metropolitan society. As more folks flock to revitalized inner cities and neighborhoods, the demand for locally produced fresh food is expanding, catalyzing a re-evaluation of the potential of these traditionally non-agricultural landscapes. Moving from rural fields of row crops to dense neighborhood farms and gardens constitutes an urgent and exciting transition.

Sweet Peas Urban Gardens has emerged to be one of the most successful pioneers of this transition in the Triangle. Started by Tami Purdue on her own residential property, Sweet Peas Urban Gardens stays true to the name; this urban farm is located less than 7 miles from downtown Raleigh. The team grows over fifty-five varieties of microgreens and vegetable shoots exemplifying the precepts of the urban farm movement

properties.name: Tasty Beverage
properties.description: Tasty Beverage Company is a craft beer store in the Raleigh Depot. They have an extensive selection of around 1,200 packaged beers and six draft beers for your consumption and subsequent enjoyment. Have the best day ever! Chombers!

properties.name: The 1903.
properties.description: A "one stop shop" where you can find anything from home decor to baby gifts and everything in between! A little slice of heaven in downtown Wendell.

properties.name: The BalloonZ Shop + Teal HouZ
properties.description:
Balloonz offers a vast variety of inimitable and vividly colored themed balloons along with other party supplies in order to cater your event to the fullest. Whether you want to plan a unicorn themed party or an engagement party, you’ll get every kind of décor for throwing the most incomparable event. 

Check out their storefront in North Hills where they also operate Teal Houz, a boutique clothing store for teens and tweens!
​

properties.name: The Beerded Lady
properties.description: Craft beer bottle shop offering 12 rotating drafts and retail options including single 12 ounce bottles, 22 ounce bombers, 32 ounce and 64 ounce growlers and six-packs.

properties.name: The Bike Guy
properties.description: The Bike Guy is a full service bike shop located on the greenway at the base of Falls Dam on the Neuse River in Wake Forest. They strive to offer impeccable service, solid diverse products and lots of good vibes. Whether it's a simple flat tire repair or a custom bike build, the shop can handle even the trickiest of repairs and also offers an ever-expanding line of bicycles and apparel to suit your needs. If you're looking to experience the spectacular Greenway Trail but don't have a bicycle, The Bike Guy has an array of rental options to get you on your way. Come see them and take in the beauty of Raleigh's greenways!

properties.name: The Butcher's Market - Cary
properties.description: The Butcher’s Market is one of the best places in Raleigh and Cary to buy top quality local items. The father/son team work diligently to offer an extensive selection of local products matched with exceptional service and a passion for quality food.

properties.name: The Butcher's Market - Holly Springs
properties.description: The Butcher’s Market is one of the best places in Raleigh, Cary and Holly Springs to buy top quality local items. The father/son team work diligently to offer an extensive selection of local products matched with exceptional service and a passion for quality food.

properties.name: The Butcher's Market - Raleigh
properties.description: The Butcher’s Market is one of the best places in Raleigh, Cary and Holly Springs to buy top quality local items. The father/son team work diligently to offer an extensive selection of local products matched with exceptional service and a passion for quality food.

properties.name: The Centerpiece
properties.description: Raleigh’s newest art gallery and latest addition to the N. Person Street neighborhood. We exhibit exceptional fine art, provide workshops with renowned artists, and offer superior custom framing and art consulting services. We are excited for this venture and look forward to building relationships within the downtown community. If you are in the area, stop by and say hello!

properties.name: The Container Store
properties.description: Today, with locations from coast to coast, The Container Store's average 25,000 square feet and showcase more than 10,000 innovative products to help customers save space and, ultimately, save them time. The store layout is divided into lifestyle sections marked with brightly colored banners such as Closet, Kitchen, Office and Laundry. Wherever you look in the store, there's always someone in a blue apron who's ready to help solve everything from the tiniest of storage problems to the most intimidating organizational challenges.

properties.name: The Corner Biergarten and Bottle Shop
properties.description:
TCB - The Corner Biergarten is Fuquay-Varina's fun and dog-friendly German Taproom and Bottle Shop where everyone knows your name. Enjoy 20+ German, Craft, and Domestic Beers on tap as well as a large selection of Ciders, Wines and Craft Sodas.

We are conveniently located in the Five Points Centre (US 401/1625 N Main Street), in the building next to Sheetz and near the NC 42/NC 55 intersection. If you're searching for a unique variety of beer, cider or wine to enjoy at home or bring to an event, our bottle shop offers even more options! Our friendly staff is here to serve you and answer any questions you may have.

properties.name: The Cotton Company
properties.description:
A unique shopping destination located in historic Wake Forest in a renovated warehouse. Browse among the boutiques of home furnishings and accessories, art and fine crafts, women’s fashion, quality toys, gifts and collectibles. Visit resident artists  in their studios. The Cotton Company has something for everyone.
Hours: Mon.-Thurs., 10am-6pm; Fri.-Sat.,
10am-8pm; Sun., 1-5pm.

properties.name: The Downtown Rolesville Farmers Market
properties.description: The Rolesville Farmers Market is a seasonal market that offers a variety of locally sourced produce, meat, eggs as well has hand crafted items.

properties.name: The Factory
properties.description:
Located in historic Wake Forest, the Factory offers a dynamic mix of specialty shopping, dining, sports,  entertainment and activities for the entire family. Come and visit to eat, shop and play.
Hours: Daily, 8am-11pm; individual business hours vary.

properties.name: The Fish House Seafood Market
properties.description: The Fish House offers all varieties of fresh seafood - crab legs, shelled crabs, crab meat, shrimps, scallops, fish, frog legs, and more. Fresh daily from the N.C. Coasts! Come see us today for all of your seafood needs.

properties.name: The Flourish Market
properties.description: The Flourish Market is all about spreading dignity across the globe. Online shop and storefront boutique in downtown Raleigh that partners with 32 brands that work all over the world, providing dignified jobs and fair wages to inspiring artisans and makers in vulnerable communities.

properties.name: The Gallery Located at Stained Glass Associates, Inc.
properties.description: The Gallery at Stained Glass Associates offers all types of unique art by N.C. artists. The art collection ranges from stained glass windows/panels, jewelry, pencil sketches, paintings, pottery, sculptures, hand blown glass, photography, wood turnings, furniture and much more. Another unique trait about the Gallery is the history of the building. It is actually the oldest building in Knightdale and is a wonderful part of history just to see. This business has been family-owned and operated since 1958, so each piece is truly a unique heirloom of art that can be passed down to generations to come.

properties.name: The Green Monkey
properties.description: A Raleigh gift gallery with a craft beer bar. You can sip on your favorite brew while you shop, or just hang out with the locals at the bar. Most of the store is stocked from local artisans from around Raleigh and N.C. The Green Monkey's mission is to make shopping fun for you so that you may leave a little happier than you arrived. The friendly staff is here to help you find that special gift for yourself or someone else. When you are looking for unique, you need The Green Monkey.

properties.name: The Hop Yard
properties.description: Craft beer retail store with a 18-tap tasting bar.

properties.name: The Impeccable Pig
properties.description: The Impeccable Pig is a family owned and operated fashion boutique based out of Dallas, TX. Their mission is to fulfill the fashion needs of customers at modest prices with exceptional customer service. Each store is filled with a diverse selection of women's clothing that are fashion-forward and modestly priced with a family-like atmosphere to each customer.

properties.name: The Perfect Piece
properties.description:
The Perfect Piece is your upscale furniture, consignment, and home decor store with 35+ individually owned boutiques.

Come and visit our 3,000 square foot showroom and browse our fine collection of new and previously-loved furniture and home accessories which are beautifully staged in small rooms.

properties.name: The Raleigh Market
properties.description: The Raleigh Market at the Historic N.C. State Fairgrounds has been a triangle tradition since 1971. Our fun, family-friendly atmosphere draws tens of thousands of shoppers every weekend. The flea market showcases more than 500 vendors, offering everything from antiques and collectibles to handicrafts, furniture, homemade goodies, clothing, jewelry, and…well, the list just goes on and on! Open Saturday and Sunday, 9am-5pm. Admission and parking are Free!

properties.name: The Raleigh Wine Shop
properties.description: The Raleigh Wine Shop was created out of a shared passion among three friends and wine industry veterans. The newly expanded shop welcomes both wine novice and connoisseur with a bright, inviting atmosphere and varied price points on quality wines created with the purity of the fruit in mind. In addition to carefully selected wines, the Raleigh Wine Shop will also carry beer and provisions that traditionally pair with wines such as olives, cheese, locally made crackers and salami. Coffee and olive oils will also be available.

properties.name: The Self Care Marketplace
properties.description: The Self Care Marketplace is a mindfully curated, one stop shop for all things self-care. Created to serve the conscious consumer and the artisan brand.

properties.name: The Shoppes on Main
properties.description: At The Shoppes on Main you will find a unique and eclectic shopping experience as well as wide variety of events and special activities for you and your family. Inside you will find over thirty distinctive shops that offer a wide variety of upscale boutique items, hand crafted artisan pieces, gourmet foods as well as one of a kind gift and novelty items. Pamper yourself inside The Shoppes on Main at the chic full service salon with a mani-pedi, color and cut or a soothing facial. Having a special event, why not book Soiree to host your gathering. An elegant destination for any occasion... bridal luncheon, birthday party, princess tea or baby shower, they've got it covered at Soiree. Stop in The Shoppes on Main today and experience a unique taste of downtown.

properties.name: Thompson-Lynch Company
properties.description: Home lighting and accessory store. Custom lamp building-repair, shade replace, custom shades and chandelier restoration. Thompson-Lynch also sells prints, mirrors, flowers and other home accessories. Home consultations are available by appointment.

properties.name: Tibetan Himalayan Gift Shop
properties.description: Tibetan Himalayan Gift Shop is a family-owned business specializing in an assortment of merchandise ranging from Tibet to the entire Himalayan regions. The owners make an attempt to travel to the Himalayan countries twice a year and collect the unique items from the Tibetan and Hiamalayan artists, craftsmen, dealers, etc. Tibetan and Himalayan apparel, spiritual items and home decor can be found at the Tibetan Himalayan Gift Shop.

properties.name: Trader Joe's - Cary
properties.description: Trader Joe's is a neighborhood grocery store with amazing food and drink from around the globe and around the corner. Great quality at great prices. That's what we call value.

properties.name: Trader Joe's - Raleigh
properties.description: Trader Joe's is a neighborhood grocery store with amazing food and drink from around the globe and around the corner. Great quality at great prices. That's what we call value.

properties.name: Treelight Square
properties.description: Treelight Square has got it going on. And by “it” we mean a whole lot of everything. Grab an early coffee or a nightcap. Take the dog for a check-up or check him into doggy daycare. Drop the kids at daycare or drop into the grocery for that missing ingredient. Whatever it is that you need (or want!) to do, you can do it here. Located in Wendell Falls.

properties.name: Trellis Beauty
properties.description: Trellis Beauty is a an education-based retailer and service provider for Clean Beauty. Visit the country's first Beauty Steam Bar™. We offer facials, brows, makeup, and spray tans too!

properties.name: Trellis Floral
properties.description: Trellis Florals is a Parisian style floral boutique in the heart of North Hills. They specialize in bespoke arrangements, hand trimmed topiary, beautiful pottery and garden inspired gifts. Here you can explore their attached solarium while browsing French antiques and unique plantings.

properties.name: TrenLend
properties.description:
TrenLend is dedicated to providing customers with access to a wide range of stylish, high-quality apparel
without the commitment of purchase. Their mission is to make fashion accessible and affordable by merging the traditional retail model with the clothing rental industry, offering a unique and one-of-a-kind experience. TrenLend’s clothing rental service not only offers convenience and affordability but also promotes a sustainable fashion industry by reducing waste and encouraging mindful consumption.

properties.name: TrenLend - Raleigh
properties.description: TrenLend's mission is to transform the way people approach fashion by providing convenient clothing rental services within their local community. They believe that everyone deserves access to a diverse and ever-evolving wardrobe, without the burden of ownership.

properties.name: TresLife
properties.description: TrêsLife is dedicated to providing safer, all-natural, and paraben-free beauty products for all hair and skin types and textures.

properties.name: Triangle Strings
properties.description: Triangle Strings is a full service violin, viola and cello shop with over 35 years of experience. Owner Jerry Pasewicz is a current member and President Emeritus of the American Federation of Violin and Bow Makers. He and his staff specialize in instrument and bow repair and restoration for musicians and dealers across North America.

properties.name: Triangle Wine Company - Cary
properties.description: Triangle Wine Company, a locally owned and operated retail store, sells fine wine and craft beer. The large, comprehensive selection of wine and beer, knowledgeable staff and competitive pricing are the hallmarks of what make Triangle Wine Company so unique. Most of all, they believe that to share some cheer with one another is a communion, a true gift and one of life's great pleasures.

properties.name: Triangle Wine Company - Holly Springs
properties.description: Triangle Wine Company, a locally owned and operated retail store, sells fine wine and craft beer. properties.name: Trig Modern
properties.description: Founded on a vision of timeless design and contemporary comfort, Trig Modern is a furniture haven nestled in the heart of Raleigh. The showroom invites you to step into a world of mid-century modern charm, modern aesthetics and Scandinavian elegance. As you explore the carefully curated selection, you'll discover pieces that blend seamlessly with your unique style and transform your living space into a haven of sophistication and comfort. Whether you're an interior design enthusiast, a homeowner seeking to redefine your space or a collector of timeless furniture, Trig Modern is your trusted partner in creating spaces that reflect your personality and lifestyle. Their dedication to finding quality craftsmanship and timeless designs ensures that every piece offered is not only a functional addition but also a statement of your discerning taste.

properties.name: Trolley Pub Beer Shop
properties.description: The Warehouse District's quick-stop choice for craft and domestic beer, wine and ciders. Browse the tasteful selection of craft and domestic beers, craft ciders and select wines. A collection of local gifts also for sale.

properties.name: Trunkshow
properties.description: TrunkShow is your local boutique in the Raleigh area. Conveniently located where Wake Forest Rd., Automotive Way, and Brookside Dr. meet, our multi-dealer mall has the best vintage and handmade goods around. Whether you are looking for vintage clothing, furniture, artwork, wall décor, or handmade items, we’ve got you covered. Our selection is so unique and eclectic, you are sure to find numerous one-of-a-kind items that would make the perfect gift for that special someone in your life who seems to have just about one of everything. Come by to see what we have available today!

properties.name: Ultimate Comics - Cary
properties.description:
Now, not only will you be able to find brand-new hot-off-the-press comic books and hard-to-find in-the-box toys, Ultimate Comics has added an entire back issue warehouse for you to peruse at your leisure! Find that perfect back issue to fill in your collection or that killer '80s toy you've been looking everywhere for.

So come on in and check us out - Ultimate service, Ultimate selection, Ultimate Comics!

properties.name: Union Camp Collective
properties.description: Hand-picked vintage and antique furnishings from near and far, that scope every era, style and price. Part vintage and antique store. Part creative co-op. Part event space. Part workshop. Part art gallery.

properties.name: Uniquities at Village District
properties.description: Village District is home to Uniquities' largest location and proud to offer the most extensive collection of denim and specialty tees in the area, including Splendid, Kain, Market, American Apparel, C+C California, and James Perse. Our denim wall features over 600 pairs of the latest styles by top premium denim designers, such as Citizen's of Humanity, James, JBrand, Joe's, Resin, True Religion and Seven. Great to wear with our Dolce Vita and Jeffrey Campbell shoes. Come and check out our extensive shoe department. Frye boots for all seasons, DVF shoes, Steven, Steve Madden, Matiko, Yosi Samra, and many more! We also have a seasonal selection of Ugg Australia boots. Hours: Mon.-Sat., 10am-7pm; Sun., Noon-6pm.

properties.name: Uniquities of North Hills
properties.description: Perched on the corner, Uniquities of North Hills has an abundance of offerings from your favorite contemporary designers. Old favorites such as Splendid, Ella Moss, and Susana Monaco. Newcomers Three Dots, Elizabeth and James, Gorjana, Parker, and Jay Godfrey add spot-on trend to the mix with jackets, dresses, and more! Complete your look with a belt from Elise M, or a pair of Frye boots. Handbags from Kooba, M20, Marc by Marc Jacobs, Twelfth Street by Cynthia Vincent and Rebecca Minkoff keep the handbag selection fresh and fun! In true Uniquities fashion, an impressive denim selection from Citizens of Humanity, Seven, J Brand, James Jeans, Joe's Jeans, and True Religion along with up and coming denim designers, arriving daily. Hours: Mon.-Sat., 10am-7pm; Sun., Noon-6pm.

properties.name: Unleashed at City Market
properties.description: Unleashed, the Dog & Cat Store is locally owned and operated with the mission to provide the best supplies for dogs and cats, at affordable prices!

properties.name: Unlikely Professionals
properties.description:
Unlikely Professionals is a specialty men's boutique, brought to you by Edge of Urge.

Fueled by curiosity and the thrill of the hunt, Unlikely Professionals seeks out makers with a story to tell and inspiration to share. They collect thoughtful, artful, uncommon goods for you and your nest from emerging and independent designers from North Carolina, across the country, and around the world. This boutique carries jewelry, unisex clothing, leather goods, one-of-a-kind clothes for babies and kids, accessories, art, and treasures for you and every room in your home!

properties.name: Unorthodox Vintage

properties.description: Uptown Cheapskate offers gently worn brand name fashion at a fraction of the prices paid in malls, department stores and specialty boutiques.

properties.name: Urban Outfitters
properties.description: Located in the Dillon, Urban Outfitters is a lifestyle retailer dedicated to inspiring customers through a unique combination of product, creativity and cultural understanding.

properties.name: Urban Pothos Houseplant Shop
properties.description: Urban Pothos is a Latinx- and LGBT-owned houseplant shop created by plant people for plant people. Our goal is to inspire community and put a plant in every home. Come as you are! You'll find a wide variety of indoor houseplants as well as some unique and rare varieties. We also offer houseplants accessories and plan to offer workshops, classes and more.

properties.name: VOM FASS
properties.description: What VOM FASS has to offer is a unique shopping experience that combines knowledge with excellence. When you enter the shop you're invited to enter into a warm and comfortable setting where you are valued on a personal level, and where a meaningful connection is made. Everything VOM FASS does is intended to give you a positive buying experience while sampling and purchasing premium quality oil, vinegar, and spices. VOM FASS goes beyond just selling the highest-quality products; they provide a comprehensive range of culinary, health, and beauty offerings to support your personal journey to health.

properties.name: Vault Craft Beer
properties.description: Settled between The Raleigh Convention Center and historic Boylan Heights neighborhood sits a building constructed in 1957. Acclaimed architect F. Carter Williams, FAIA, designed the building for the First National Bank. At the time, it was one of the first 'drive-thru' banks in Raleigh. The current owners used the buildings original plans to restore and preserve it’s sleek, mid-century modern architecture. Instead of a teller counter, Vault Craft Beer has 16 taps for draft beer and two large built-in coolers with cold beer to drink on site or take home.

properties.name: Vermillion
properties.description: The Vermillion concept was created by combining an entertaining shopping experience with beautiful clothing. Vermillion's goal is to help women find something wonderful to wear while providing them with the most friendly and knowledgeable service possible.

properties.name: Vestique - Cary
properties.description: Vestique offers unique and trendy fashion options including shorts, denim, skirts, dresses, tops, shoes and accessories. Everything in the store is high-quality and under $100, typically ranging between $30-$50. Shoppers are the first priority and each one is given the personal attention and service they need to look and feel their best.

properties.name: Village District
properties.description: A Raleigh tradition. More than 100 unique and distinctive shops, cafés, restaurants and services. Stroll six city blocks and explore one-of-a-kind shops, specialty stores and national favorites. Dine indoors or out at the many cafés and restaurants. Village District, where great style is always in fashion. Most stores open Mon.-Sat., 10am-7pm; Sun., 1-6pm.

properties.name: Voda Boutique
properties.description:
Welcome to Voda, not just a retail space, a state of mind. Voda means water—calm and clarity. When we are near the water, we relax and our mind is at ease. Voda strives to create a laid-back, stylish shopping experience where customers always feel welcome.


The Voda gal is a sister, friend and a trendsetter—so whether shopping for a brunch, date night or vacay, Voda offers everything you need to be the best dressed in all your life experiences. So come in, unwind and let them help you reach your Voda mentality.

properties.name: Vow'd Weddings
properties.description: Vow'd is a different kind of wedding brand. One with fancy dresses, distinctive accessories, and charming gifts at prices that won’t break the bank. One where giving back is a part of the very fabric of who we are.

properties.name: Wake Forest Farmers Market
properties.description:
Over the years, the Wake Forest Farmers' Market has grown into a lively community event each Sat. morning. This market offers fresh-off-the-farm produce; pasture-raised beef, poultry and pork; free-range eggs; fresh and dried herbs; honey, jams and preserves; fresh-cut flowers; and delicious baked goods. The majority of the farm products are raised using environmentally sustainable agricultural practices, which are healthy for the soil, water, air, animals and YOU!


Open every Sat., Apr.-Oct., from 8am-noon. Also open every Wed., June-Sept., from 3-6pm. Winter hours are every Sat., Nov.-Mar., from 10am-noon.

properties.name: Walley’s Tavern
properties.description: TapLine Growler is a growler filling station and tasting room in Holly Springs.

properties.name: Western Wake Farmers Market

The Western Wake Farmers’ Market was conceived by a set of Wake County moms with a desire to feed their families with locally grown food.

Our mission is for all people in our community to become educated about and benefit from locally grown food. Our aim is to help all walks of life, from the farmers to the local community members to those less fortunate who might need assistance through the local food bank.

April-November: Sat., 8am-noon; December-March: Sat., 9:30am-noon.

properties.name: Woof Gang Bakery & Grooming
properties.description:
Woof Gang Bakery is the leader in raw, frozen and grain-free diets for cats and dogs. Offering premium pet food selections, as well as gourmet dog treats, tough toys, grooming products, stylish collars and leads, and much more! 

Woof Gang Grooming is the very best in Pet Care, providing a clean, friendly and relaxed environment to make your pooch feel at home. They are furnished with the best equipment that will keep your furry friend safe and comfortable.

properties.name: dailypint
properties.description:
Will Clay and Eric Roth are seasoned visual effects veterans of the film and gaming industries with more than 25 years collective experience, and a roster of impressive credits. They met while working on blockbusters such as Star Wars: Episode II and The Mummy Returns.
From there, Will continued working in visual effects on Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets, Hulk, and Pirates of the Caribbean while Eric transitioned to animated features, working for DreamWorks Animation on such hits as Shrek, Kung Fu Panda and How to Train Your Dragon 2.
But the two film veterans also shared a love for craft beer so they decided to collaborate on a new project—a craft beer venue that would combine their love for hops and Hollywood. Here, at Dailypint their vision has turned into a reality.

properties.name: Yeet Street Discs
properties.description: Yeet Street Discs is the first shop in the Triangle dedicated to the sport of disc golf. We have the largest inventory of discs in the area with over 28 disc brands. We also carry  disc golf accessories like baskets, backpacks and bags, stools, chalk bags, minis, and training equipment. Our knowledgeable, friendly staff offers unbeatable customer service and can offer advice to beginners and regular players alike.

properties.name: Abbotts Creek Trail
properties.description:
Moderate 2.6-mile one-way connector trail in Raleigh Greenway System that features a Blue Heron Habitat and connects the Neuse River Trail to Simms Branch Trail at North Wake Landfill District Park.

Paved and sidewalk connector from Neuse River Trail to Simms Branch Trail.  Starting at Neuse River Trail, sections of boardwalk over swampy areas as well as hilly paved sections, the trail uses sidewalk connectors along two sections of Falls River Avenue and along Durant Road.  The trail features a Blue Heron habitat and connects to North Wake Landfill District Park and Durant Nature Preserve.  Good for walking, hiking, trail running or biking.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/abbots-creek-trail

Hilltop Needmore Town Park & Preserve Trail
properties.description:
This preserve was once a golf course and has since been converted into a community green space. The paved cart path has become the walking trail through the neighborhood and offers many miles of path. There are restrooms located in the big parking area. The path passes by scenic ponds, open green space, and wildlife viewing opportunities.

There is not much shade, so be prepared with sun protection and water.

Accessibility: This trail is likely accessible with assistance for visitors using wheelchairs, mobility equipment, or strollers or visitors may need to avoid the steeper sections for safety. 

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/hilltop-needmore-red-trail--3

properties.name: Neuse River Trail
properties.description: The Neuse River Greenway Trail—a 27.5-mile paved, uninterrupted greenway that stretches from Falls Lake in North Raleigh to the Wake County line in southeast Raleigh—is a year-round haven for outdoor recreation. With views of historical sites as well as winding boardwalk areas and suspension bridges crossing over wetlands, the trail is open to joggers, walkers, runners, cyclists, roller-bladers and others. Many consider the Neuse River Greenway Trail to be the gem of the 100-plus-mile Capital Area Greenway System.

properties.name: Swift Creek Loop Trail
properties.description:
Check out this 0.7-mile loop trail near Cary, North Carolina. Generally considered an easy route, it takes an average of 18 min to complete. This is a popular trail for birding, hiking, and running, but you can still enjoy some solitude during quieter times of day. The trail is open year-round and is beautiful to visit anytime. Dogs are welcome, but must be on a leash.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/swift-creek-loop-trail

properties.name: Lake Crabtree Trail
properties.description:
Get to know this 6.1-mile loop trail near Morrisville, North Carolina. Generally considered a moderately challenging route, it takes an average of 1 h 56 min to complete. This is a popular trail for hiking and running, but you can still enjoy some solitude during quieter times of day. The trail is open year-round and is beautiful to visit anytime. Dogs are welcome, but must be on a leash.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/lake-crabtree-trail

properties.name: Sycamore Trail
properties.description:
The Sycamore Trail is situated within William B. Umstead State Park, and its trailhead is located on the park's northern side, accessible from the Highway 70 entrance. It is a popular park and can get quite crowded on pleasant days.

Although there are no breathtaking scenic views or towering mountains, the trail is a pleasant walk through the woods. Located right next to Raleigh, the park offers a perfect escape from the city's hustle-bustle.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/sycamore-trail--3

properties.name: Durant Nature Preserve Border Loop Trail
properties.description:
The Durant Nature Preserve Border Loop Trail is primarily level and offers views of hardwood trees and rock outcrops. However, patches of mud are present on the trail, especially by the creek, which separates the Simms Branch Trail from the forested Border Trail.

The Border Trail runs parallel to the creek as you hike along it. Occasionally, you have to hop across rocks or go through water. Whale Rocks is a noteworthy location where you may view enormous rock formations that have a whale-like appearance. Natural sand pits and dry creek beds can be found along the trail. Additionally, the trail winds through pine tree-heavy sections. There are plenty of wildlife chances, including red-tailed hawks, turtles, lizards, and minnows.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/durant-nature-preserve-border-loop-trail

properties.name: Chestnut Oak Loop Trail
properties.description:
Explore this 1.2-mile loop trail near Cary, North Carolina. Generally considered an easy route, it takes an average of 26 min to complete. This is a popular trail for birding, hiking, and running, but you can still enjoy some solitude during quieter times of day. The trail is open year-round and is beautiful to visit anytime. Dogs are welcome, but must be on a leash.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/chestnut-oak-loop-trail

properties.name: Lake Johnson East Loop Trail
properties.description:
The Lake Johnson Trail includes a 3.5-mile paved greenway loop as well as a 1.9-mile unpaved loop plus another 1.0 mile of out and backs to scenic lake overlooks. Part of the paved loop includes a section of Walnut Creek Greenway Trail. The paved portion goes through the woods, along the lake, and across the dam.  

The unpaved portion, a bit less traveled, goes to the headwaters of the lake. Both can cross the boardwalk across the lake to complete a figure 8 if you want. The trail has flat sections, hilly sections, sections into the woods, and sections along the lake, offering quite a bit of diversity of terrain. Great place to get closer to nature in Raleigh.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/lake-johnson-east-loop-trail

properties.name: Lake Johnson West Loop Trail
properties.description:
Head out on this 2.0-mile loop trail near Raleigh, North Carolina. Generally considered an easy route, it takes an average of 39 min to complete. This is a popular trail for birding, hiking, and running, but you can still enjoy some solitude during quieter times of day. The trail is open year-round and is beautiful to visit anytime. Dogs are welcome, but must be on a leash.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/lake-johnson-west-loop-trail

properties.name: Shelley Lake Trail
properties.description:
Nice shady path around a lake, good for the whole family. Not too many hills but some side trails if you would like to make your route longer.

Accessibility: There is a large paved parking lot at the start of the trail but there do not appear to be any designated accessible parking spaces or striped access aisles there. The main trail surface is paved/boardwalk and it is typically at least six feet wide. There is a steep section up to 12% at about 0.2 miles where equipment users may need assistance, but past that around the loop it is estimated to be mostly gentle, all 6% or less. 

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/shelley-lake-trail

properties.name: Fleming Loop Path
properties.description:
This walking track is a paved pathway that is great for walking, jogging, road biking, and rollerblading. Fleming Loop Recreational Park makes for a great community resource and can be enjoyed by all ages and abilities.

Other amenities in the park include picnic areas, restrooms, a playground, soccer fields, other multi-purpose fields, and a seasonal concession stand.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/fleming-loop-recreational-park

properties.name: Park Greenway/Loop Trail
properties.description:
Park Greenway winds through Latham Park parallel to North Buffalo Creek. This paved multi-use path features 20 fitness stations. The fitness trail section starts at the intersection of Wendover Avenue and Cridland Road and extends northeast to the North Elm Street trailhead. In addition, there are tennis facilities, basketball courts, and Little League baseball fields available in the park.

Photo Credit: https://wandermaps.link/Park-Greenway

properties.name: Basil Creek Trail
properties.description:
Head out on this 9.4-mile out-and-back trail near Hays, North Carolina. Generally considered a challenging route, it takes an average of 4 h 19 min to complete. This trail is great for hiking, and it's unlikely you'll encounter many other people while exploring. The trail is open year-round and is beautiful to visit anytime. Dogs are welcome, but must be on a leash.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/basin-creek-trail

properties.name: Bass Lake Trail
properties.description:
This is a great well maintained trail around Bass Lake with lovely views of the lake. Most of the trail is mulch-covered as it loops around the lake.

Accessibility: Visitors using wheelchairs, mobility equipment, or strollers may need all-terrain tires or adaptive/motorized equipment for the surface type and grade. Visitors using wheelchairs, mobility equipment, or strollers may need assistance in the steeper sections or to avoid them for safety. 

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/bass-lake

properties.name: Creekside Trail
properties.description:
Creekside Trail is an out and back trail with a short loop at the end. It could also be called the field side trail as it travels more beside NC State's fields and over some swampy area more than beside a creek.  Mostly flat, it is accessed from the north end of the Wetlands Boardwalk. It travels along the Steep Hill Creek floodplain and uses several footbridges and boardwalks across the swampy, muddy areas. When this was posted, they were currently repairing and adding several boardwalk areas.

The centerpiece of the 174-acre park is Historic Yates Mill, which is the last operable water-powered gristmill in Wake County (more than 70 water mills once existed in the area).  The Mill and the property surrounding it were purchased in 1963 by NC State University.  The Mill was placed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974 and was restored to working order through a grassroots community effort by 2005.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/millpond-and-creekside-trail

properties.name: Perk Depot Greenway
properties.description:
The Park Depot Greenway connects Old Honeycutt Park to the South Lakes subdivision, providing access to Willow Spring High School and South Lakes Elementary School. This route is perfect for family-friendly activities such as walking, jogging, and biking on its paved surface.

Accessibility: This trail is likely accessible for visitors using wheelchairs, mobility equipment, or strollers. There is at least 1 designated van-accessible parking space with striped access aisles in the paved parking lot. The trail surface is paved asphalt or wooden boardwalk with edge railings, typically at least 6 feet wide. This trail is estimated to be mostly gentle (5% or less).

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/perk-depot-greenway

properties.name: Hickory Hollow Loop
properties.description:
Try this 3.0-mile loop trail near Hendersonville, North Carolina. Generally considered an easy route, it takes an average of 1 h 9 min to complete. This is a very popular area for hiking and running, so you'll likely encounter other people while exploring. The best times to visit this trail are March through October. Dogs are welcome, but must be on a leash.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/hickory-mountain-road-hooker-creek-trail-and-white-pine-trail-loop

properties.name: Hummingbird Trail
properties.description:
Fabulous view and 36 ft water front. This lot is gentle, yet elevation is higher for that most wonderful of lake views.

Photo Credit: https://www.hikingproject.com/trail/7070366/hummingbird-trail

properties.name: Jeff Wells Trail
properties.description:
This trail has a great view of nature and downtown Fuquay-Varina. The trail connects to the 48-acres of Carroll Howard Johnson Environmental Park, where hikers have fantastic views on nature and a creek. The Jeff Wells Trail connects from Carroll Howard Park through a greenway near neighborhoods to South Park. It is worth a hike.

Photo Credit: https://www.hikingproject.com/trail/7069765/jeff-wells-trail

properties.name: Laurel Lane
properties.description:
The land was donated for an Environmental Education Park by the late Mayor Alfred Johnson and his wife Carroll Howard Johnson. Additional land was donated by Horace Tart.

Photo Credit: https://www.hikingproject.com/trail/7070319/laurel-lane

properties.name: North Turkey Creek Trail
properties.description:
This is a relatively challenging unpaved multi-use trail with some steep inclines and windy turns. Hikers, cyclists, and equestrians are able to use this trail. Trail goers navigating with mobility equipment may need assistance along this entire route due to consistent moderately steep to steep (over 8%) grades and unpaved surfaces. 

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/north-turkey-creek-trail

properties.name: The Top of the Hill Trail
properties.description:
This short gravel trail winds up a hill built atop a capped landfill, offering stunning 360-degree views of the surrounding landscape. The trail is smooth, well-maintained, and easy-going, though the hill might pose a challenge for some. This is a great addition to the Deponie Drive loop, which circles the base of the hill.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/top-of-hill-trail

properties.name: South Turkey Creek Trail
properties.description:
South Turkey Creek Trail is part of the Umstead State Park multi-use trail system (MUTs) and connects the Reedy Creek trail to the North Turkey Creek and Cedar Ridge trails. This trail is mostly an easy to moderate connector trail. Gravel street parking has been marked with a waypoint. 

Accessibility: Visitors using wheelchairs, mobility equipment, or strollers may need all-terrain tires or adaptive/motorized equipment for the surface type and grade. Visitors using wheelchairs, mobility equipment, or strollers may need assistance in the steeper section or to avoid it for safety. 

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/ar/trail/us/north-carolina/south-turkey-creek-trail

properties.name: Wilkerson Nature Preserve to Falls Dam and Back
properties.description:
Lovely hike including big rocks, a pond, and views of Falls Lake from the dam.

Photo Credit: https://www.alltrails.com/explore/trail/us/north-carolina/looping-annie-wilkerson-to-falls-dam
